vulg: liber generationis Iesu Christi filii David filii Abraham
clem: Liber generationis Jesu Christi filii David, filii Abraham.
tr: βιβλος γενεσεως ιησου χριστου υιου δαβιδ υιου αβρααμ
kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

vulg: Abraham genuit Isaac Isaac autem genuit Iacob Iacob autem genuit Iudam et fratres eius
clem: Abraham genuit Isaac. Isaac autem genuit Jacob. Jacob autem genuit Judam, et fratres ejus.
tr: αβρααμ εγεννησεν τον ισαακ ισαακ δε εγεννησεν τον ιακωβ ιακωβ δε εγεννησεν τον ιουδαν και τους αδελφους αυτου
kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

vulg: Iudas autem genuit Phares et Zara de Thamar Phares autem genuit Esrom Esrom autem genuit Aram
clem: Judas autem genuit Phares, et Zaram de Thamar. Phares autem genuit Esron. Esron autem genuit Aram.
tr: ιουδας δε εγεννησεν τον φαρες και τον ζαρα εκ της θαμαρ φαρες δε εγεννησεν τον εσρωμ εσρωμ δε εγεννησεν τον αραμ
kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

vulg: Aram autem genuit Aminadab Aminadab autem genuit Naasson Naasson autem genuit Salmon
clem: Aram autem genuit Aminadab. Aminadab autem genuit Naasson. Naasson autem genuit Salmon.
tr: αραμ δε εγεννησεν τον αμιναδαβ αμιναδαβ δε εγεννησεν τον ναασσων ναασσων δε εγεννησεν τον σαλμων
kjv: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

vulg: Salmon autem genuit Booz de Rachab Booz autem genuit Obed ex Ruth Obed autem genuit Iesse Iesse autem genuit David regem
clem: Salmon autem genuit Booz de Rahab. Booz autem genuit Obed ex Ruth. Obed autem genuit Jesse. Jesse autem genuit David regem.
tr: σαλμων δε εγεννησεν τον βοοζ εκ της ραχαβ βοοζ δε εγεννησεν τον ωβηδ εκ της ρουθ ωβηδ δε εγεννησεν τον ιεσσαι
kjv: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

vulg: David autem rex genuit Salomonem ex ea quae fuit Uriae
clem: David autem rex genuit Salomonem ex ea qu fuit Uri.
tr: ιεσσαι δε εγεννησεν τον δαβιδ τον βασιλεα δαβιδ δε ο βασιλευς εγεννησεν τον σολομωντα εκ της του ουριου
kjv: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

vulg: Salomon autem genuit Roboam Roboam autem genuit Abiam Abia autem genuit Asa
clem: Salomon autem genuit Roboam. Roboam autem genuit Abiam. Abias autem genuit Asa.
tr: σολομων δε εγεννησεν τον ροβοαμ ροβοαμ δε εγεννησεν τον αβια αβια δε εγεννησεν τον ασα
kjv: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

vulg: Asa autem genuit Iosaphat Iosaphat autem genuit Ioram Ioram autem genuit Oziam
clem: Asa autem genuit Josophat. Josophat autem genuit Joram. Joram autem genuit Oziam.
tr: ασα δε εγεννησεν τον ιωσαφατ ιωσαφατ δε εγεννησεν τον ιωραμ ιωραμ δε εγεννησεν τον οζιαν
kjv: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

vulg: Ozias autem genuit Ioatham Ioatham autem genuit Achaz Achaz autem genuit Ezechiam
clem: Ozias autem genuit Joatham. Joatham autem genuit Achaz. Achaz autem genuit Ezechiam.
tr: οζιας δε εγεννησεν τον ιωαθαμ ιωαθαμ δε εγεννησεν τον αχαζ αχαζ δε εγεννησεν τον εζεκιαν
kjv: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

vulg: Ezechias autem genuit Manassen Manasses autem genuit Amon Amon autem genuit Iosiam
clem: Ezechias autem genuit Manassen. Manasses autem genuit Amon. Amon autem genuit Josiam.
tr: εζεκιας δε εγεννησεν τον μανασση μανασσης δε εγεννησεν τον αμων αμων δε εγεννησεν τον ιωσιαν
kjv: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

vulg: Iosias autem genuit Iechoniam et fratres eius in transmigratione Babylonis
clem: Josias autem genuit Jechoniam, et fratres ejus in transmigratione Babylonis.
tr: ιωσιας δε εγεννησεν τον ιεχονιαν και τους αδελφους αυτου επι της μετοικεσιας βαβυλωνος
kjv: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

vulg: et post transmigrationem Babylonis Iechonias genuit Salathihel Salathihel autem genuit Zorobabel
clem: Et post transmigrationem Babylonis: Jechonias genuit Salathiel. Salathiel autem genuit Zorobabel.
tr: μετα δε την μετοικεσιαν βαβυλωνος ιεχονιας εγεννησεν τον σαλαθιηλ σαλαθιηλ δε εγεννησεν τον ζοροβαβελ
kjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

vulg: Zorobabel autem genuit Abiud Abiud autem genuit Eliachim Eliachim autem genuit Azor
clem: Zorobabel autem genuit Abiud. Abiud autem genuit Eliacim. Eliacim autem genuit Azor.
tr: ζοροβαβελ δε εγεννησεν τον αβιουδ αβιουδ δε εγεννησεν τον ελιακειμ ελιακειμ δε εγεννησεν τον αζωρ
kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

vulg: Azor autem genuit Saddoc Saddoc autem genuit Achim Achim autem genuit Eliud
clem: Azor autem genuit Sadoc. Sadoc autem genuit Achim. Achim autem genuit Eliud.
tr: αζωρ δε εγεννησεν τον σαδωκ σαδωκ δε εγεννησεν τον αχειμ αχειμ δε εγεννησεν τον ελιουδ
kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

vulg: Eliud autem genuit Eleazar Eleazar autem genuit Matthan Matthan autem genuit Iacob
clem: Eliud autem genuit Eleazar. Eleazar autem genuit Mathan. Mathan autem genuit Jacob.
tr: ελιουδ δε εγεννησεν τον ελεαζαρ ελεαζαρ δε εγεννησεν τον ματθαν ματθαν δε εγεννησεν τον ιακωβ
kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

vulg: Iacob autem genuit Ioseph virum Mariae de qua natus est Iesus qui vocatur Christus
clem: Jacob autem genuit Joseph virum Mari, de qua natus est Jesus, qui vocatur Christus.
tr: ιακωβ δε εγεννησεν τον ιωσηφ τον ανδρα μαριας εξ ης εγεννηθη ιησους ο λεγομενος χριστος
kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

vulg: omnes ergo generationes ab Abraham usque ad David generationes quattuordecim et a David usque ad transmigrationem Babylonis generationes quattuordecim et a transmigratione Babylonis usque ad Christum generationes quattuordecim
clem: Omnes itaque generationes ab Abraham usque ad David, generationes quatuordecim: et a David usque ad transmigrationem Babylonis, generationes quatuordecim: et a transmigratione Bayblonis usque ad Christum, generationes quatuordecim.
tr: πασαι ουν αι γενεαι απο αβρααμ εως δαβιδ γενεαι δεκατεσσαρες και απο δαβιδ εως της μετοικεσιας βαβυλωνος γενεαι δεκατεσσαρες και απο της μετοικεσιας βαβυλωνος εως του χριστου γενεαι δεκατεσσαρες
kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

vulg: Christi autem generatio sic erat cum esset desponsata mater eius Maria Ioseph antequam convenirent inventa est in utero habens de Spiritu Sancto
clem: Christi autem generatio sic erat: cum esset desponsata mater ejus Maria Joseph, antequam convenirent inventa est in utero habens de Spiritu Sancto.
tr: του δε ιησου χριστου η γεννησις ουτως ην μνηστευθεισης γαρ της μητρος αυτου μαριας τω ιωσηφ πριν η συνελθειν αυτους ευρεθη εν γαστρι εχουσα εκ πνευματος αγιου
kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

vulg: Ioseph autem vir eius cum esset iustus et nollet eam traducere voluit occulte dimittere eam
clem: Joseph autem vir ejus cum esset justus, et nollet eam traducere, voluit occulte dimittere eam.
tr: ιωσηφ δε ο ανηρ αυτης δικαιος ων και μη θελων αυτην παραδειγματισαι εβουληθη λαθρα απολυσαι αυτην
kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

vulg: haec autem eo cogitante ecce angelus Domini in somnis apparuit ei dicens Ioseph fili David noli timere accipere Mariam coniugem tuam quod enim in ea natum est de Spiritu Sancto est
clem: Hc autem eo cogitante, ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis ei, dicens: Joseph, fili David, noli timere accipere Mariam conjugem tuam: quod enim in ea natum est, de Spiritu Sancto est.
tr: ταυτα δε αυτου ενθυμηθεντος ιδου αγγελος κυριου κατ οναρ εφανη αυτω λεγων ιωσηφ υιος δαβιδ μη φοβηθης παραλαβειν μαριαμ την γυναικα σου το γαρ εν αυτη γεννηθεν εκ πνευματος εστιν αγιου
kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

vulg: pariet autem filium et vocabis nomen eius Iesum ipse enim salvum faciet populum suum a peccatis eorum
clem: Pariet autem filium: et vocabis nomen ejus Jesum: ipse enim salvum faciet populum suum a peccatis eorum.
tr: τεξεται δε υιον και καλεσεις το ονομα αυτου ιησουν αυτος γαρ σωσει τον λαον αυτου απο των αμαρτιων αυτων
kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus: for he shall save his people from their sins.

vulg: hoc autem totum factum est ut adimpleretur id quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem
clem: Hoc autem totum factum est, ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem:
tr: τουτο δε ολον γεγονεν ινα πληρωθη το ρηθεν υπο του κυριου δια του προφητου λεγοντος
kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

vulg: ecce virgo in utero habebit et pariet filium et vocabunt nomen eius Emmanuhel quod est interpretatum Nobiscum Deus
clem: Ecce virgo in utero habebit, et pariet filium: et vocabunt nomen ejus Emmanuel, quod est interpretatum Nobiscum Deus.
tr: ιδου η παρθενος εν γαστρι εξει και τεξεται υιον και καλεσουσιν το ονομα αυτου εμμανουηλ ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον μεθ ημων ο θεος
kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

vulg: exsurgens autem Ioseph a somno fecit sicut praecepit ei angelus Domini et accepit coniugem suam
clem: Exsurgens autem Joseph a somno, fecit sicut prcepit ei angelus Domini, et accepit conjugem suam.
tr: διεγερθεις δε ο ιωσηφ απο του υπνου εποιησεν ως προσεταξεν αυτω ο αγγελος κυριου και παρελαβεν την γυναικα αυτου
kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

vulg: et non cognoscebat eam donec peperit filium suum primogenitum et vocavit nomen eius Iesum
clem: Et non cognoscebat eam donec peperit filium suum primogenitum: et vocavit nomen ejus Jesum.
tr: και ουκ εγινωσκεν αυτην εως ου ετεκεν τον υιον αυτης τον πρωτοτοκον και εκαλεσεν το ονομα αυτου ιησουν
kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Jesus.

vulg: cum ergo natus esset Iesus in Bethleem Iudaeae in diebus Herodis regis ecce magi ab oriente venerunt Hierosolymam
clem: Cum ergo natus esset Jesus in Bethlehem Juda in diebus Herodis regis, ecce magi ab oriente venerunt Jerosolymam,
tr: του δε ιησου γεννηθεντος εν βηθλεεμ της ιουδαιας εν ημεραις ηρωδου του βασιλεως ιδου μαγοι απο ανατολων παρεγενοντο εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

vulg: dicentes ubi est qui natus est rex Iudaeorum vidimus enim stellam eius in oriente et venimus adorare eum
clem: dicentes: Ubi est qui natus est rex Judorum? vidimus enim stellam ejus in oriente, et venimus adorare eum.
tr: λεγοντες που εστιν ο τεχθεις βασιλευς των ιουδαιων ειδομεν γαρ αυτου τον αστερα εν τη ανατολη και ηλθομεν προσκυνησαι αυτω
kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

vulg: audiens autem Herodes rex turbatus est et omnis Hierosolyma cum illo
clem: Audiens autem Herodes rex, turbatus est, et omnis Jerosolyma cum illo.
tr: ακουσας δε ηρωδης ο βασιλευς εταραχθη και πασα ιεροσολυμα μετ αυτου
kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

vulg: et congregans omnes principes sacerdotum et scribas populi sciscitabatur ab eis ubi Christus nasceretur
clem: Et congregans omnes principes sacerdotum, et scribas populi, sciscitabatur ab eis ubi Christus nasceretur.
tr: και συναγαγων παντας τους αρχιερεις και γραμματεις του λαου επυνθανετο παρ αυτων που ο χριστος γενναται
kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

vulg: at illi dixerunt ei in Bethleem Iudaeae sic enim scriptum est per prophetam
clem: At illi dixerunt: In Bethlehem Jud: sic enim scriptum est per prophetam:
tr: οι δε ειπον αυτω εν βηθλεεμ της ιουδαιας ουτως γαρ γεγραπται δια του προφητου
kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

vulg: et tu Bethleem terra Iuda nequaquam minima es in principibus Iuda ex te enim exiet dux qui reget populum meum Israhel
clem: [Et tu Bethlehem terra Juda, nequaquam minima es in principibus Juda: ex te enim exiet dux, qui regat populum meum Isral.]
tr: και συ βηθλεεμ γη ιουδα ουδαμως ελαχιστη ει εν τοις ηγεμοσιν ιουδα εκ σου γαρ εξελευσεται ηγουμενος οστις ποιμανει τον λαον μου τον ισραηλ
kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

vulg: tunc Herodes clam vocatis magis diligenter didicit ab eis tempus stellae quae apparuit eis
clem: Tunc Herodes clam vocatis magis diligenter didicit ab eis tempus stell, qu apparuit eis:
tr: τοτε ηρωδης λαθρα καλεσας τους μαγους ηκριβωσεν παρ αυτων τον χρονον του φαινομενου αστερος
kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

vulg: et mittens illos in Bethleem dixit ite et interrogate diligenter de puero et cum inveneritis renuntiate mihi ut et ego veniens adorem eum
clem: et mittens illos in Bethlehem, dixit: Ite, et interrogate diligenter de puero: et cum inveneritis, renuntiate mihi, ut et ego veniens adorem eum.
tr: και πεμψας αυτους εις βηθλεεμ ειπεν πορευθεντες ακριβως εξετασατε περι του παιδιου επαν δε ευρητε απαγγειλατε μοι οπως καγω ελθων προσκυνησω αυτω
kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

vulg: qui cum audissent regem abierunt et ecce stella quam viderant in oriente antecedebat eos usque dum veniens staret supra ubi erat puer
clem: Qui cum audissent regem, abierunt, et ecce stella, quam viderant in oriente, antecedebat eos, usque dum veniens staret supra, ubi erat puer.
tr: οι δε ακουσαντες του βασιλεως επορευθησαν και ιδου ο αστηρ ον ειδον εν τη ανατολη προηγεν αυτους εως ελθων εστη επανω ου ην το παιδιον
kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

vulg: videntes autem stellam gavisi sunt gaudio magno valde
clem: Videntes autem stellam gavisi sunt gaudio magno valde.
tr: ιδοντες δε τον αστερα εχαρησαν χαραν μεγαλην σφοδρα
kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

vulg: et intrantes domum invenerunt puerum cum Maria matre eius et procidentes adoraverunt eum et apertis thesauris suis obtulerunt ei munera aurum tus et murram
clem: Et intrantes domum, invenerunt puerum cum Maria matre ejus, et procidentes adoraverunt eum: et apertis thesauris suis obtulerunt ei munera, aurum, thus, et myrrham.
tr: και ελθοντες εις την οικιαν ευρον  ειδον  το παιδιον μετα μαριας της μητρος αυτου και πεσοντες προσεκυνησαν αυτω και ανοιξαντες τους θησαυρους αυτων προσηνεγκαν αυτω δωρα χρυσον και λιβανον και σμυρναν
kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense and myrrh.

vulg: et responso accepto in somnis ne redirent ad Herodem per aliam viam reversi sunt in regionem suam
clem: Et responso accepto in somnis ne redirent ad Herodem, per aliam viam reversi sunt in regionem suam.
tr: και χρηματισθεντες κατ οναρ μη ανακαμψαι προς ηρωδην δι αλλης οδου ανεχωρησαν εις την χωραν αυτων
kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

vulg: qui cum recessissent ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Ioseph dicens surge et accipe puerum et matrem eius et fuge in Aegyptum et esto ibi usque dum dicam tibi futurum est enim ut Herodes quaerat puerum ad perdendum eum
clem: Qui cum recessissent, ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Joseph, dicens: Surge, et accipe puerum, et matrem ejus, et fuge in gyptum, et esto ibi usque dum dicam tibi. Futurum est enim ut Herodes qurat puerum ad perdendum eum.
tr: αναχωρησαντων δε αυτων ιδου αγγελος κυριου φαινεται κατ οναρ τω ιωσηφ λεγων εγερθεις παραλαβε το παιδιον και την μητερα αυτου και φευγε εις αιγυπτον και ισθι εκει εως αν ειπω σοι μελλει γαρ ηρωδης ζητειν το παιδιον του απολεσαι αυτο
kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

vulg: qui consurgens accepit puerum et matrem eius nocte et recessit in Aegyptum
clem: Qui consurgens accepit puerum et matrem ejus nocte, et secessit in gyptum:
tr: ο δε εγερθεις παρελαβεν το παιδιον και την μητερα αυτου νυκτος και ανεχωρησεν εις αιγυπτον
kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

vulg: et erat ibi usque ad obitum Herodis ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem ex Aegypto vocavi filium meum
clem: et erat ibi usque ad obitum Herodis: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem: Ex gypto vocavi filium meum.
tr: και ην εκει εως της τελευτης ηρωδου ινα πληρωθη το ρηθεν υπο του κυριου δια του προφητου λεγοντος εξ αιγυπτου εκαλεσα τον υιον μου
kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

vulg: tunc Herodes videns quoniam inlusus esset a magis iratus est valde et mittens occidit omnes pueros qui erant in Bethleem et in omnibus finibus eius a bimatu et infra secundum tempus quod exquisierat a magis
clem: Tunc Herodes videns quoniam illusus esset a magis, iratus est valde, et mittens occidit omnes pueros, qui erant in Bethlehem, et in omnibus finibus ejus, a bimatu et infra secundum tempus, quod exquisierat a magis.
tr: τοτε ηρωδης ιδων οτι ενεπαιχθη υπο των μαγων εθυμωθη λιαν και αποστειλας ανειλεν παντας τους παιδας τους εν βηθλεεμ και εν πασιν τοις οριοις αυτης απο διετους και κατωτερω κατα τον χρονον ον ηκριβωσεν παρα των μαγων
kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.

vulg: tunc adimpletum est quod dictum est per Hieremiam prophetam dicentem
clem: Tunc adimpletum est quod dictum est per Jeremiam prophetam dicentem:
tr: τοτε επληρωθη το ρηθεν υπο ιερεμιου του προφητου λεγοντος
kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

vulg: vox in Rama audita est ploratus et ululatus multus Rachel plorans filios suos et noluit consolari quia non sunt
clem: [Vox in Rama audita est ploratus, et ululatus multus: Rachel plorans filios suos, et noluit consolari, quia non sunt.]
tr: φωνη εν ραμα ηκουσθη θρηνος και κλαυθμος και οδυρμος πολυς ραχηλ κλαιουσα τα τεκνα αυτης και ουκ ηθελεν παρακληθηναι οτι ουκ εισιν
kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

vulg: defuncto autem Herode ecce apparuit angelus Domini in somnis Ioseph in Aegypto
clem: Defuncto autem Herode, ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Joseph in gypto,
tr: τελευτησαντος δε του ηρωδου ιδου αγγελος κυριου κατ οναρ φαινεται τω ιωσηφ εν αιγυπτω
kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

vulg: dicens surge et accipe puerum et matrem eius et vade in terram Israhel defuncti sunt enim qui quaerebant animam pueri
clem: dicens: Surge, et accipe puerum, et matrem ejus, et vade in terram Isral: defuncti sunt enim qui qurebant animam pueri.
tr: λεγων εγερθεις παραλαβε το παιδιον και την μητερα αυτου και πορευου εις γην ισραηλ τεθνηκασιν γαρ οι ζητουντες την ψυχην του παιδιου
kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.

vulg: qui surgens accepit puerum et matrem eius et venit in terram Israhel
clem: Qui consurgens, accepit puerum, et matrem ejus, et venit in terram Isral.
tr: ο δε εγερθεις παρελαβεν το παιδιον και την μητερα αυτου και ηλθεν εις γην ισραηλ
kjv: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

vulg: audiens autem quod Archelaus regnaret in Iudaea pro Herode patre suo timuit illo ire et admonitus in somnis secessit in partes Galilaeae
clem: Audiens autem quod Archelaus regnaret in Juda pro Herode patre suo, timuit illo ire: et admonitus in somnis, secessit in partes Galil.
tr: ακουσας δε οτι αρχελαος βασιλευει επι της ιουδαιας αντι ηρωδου του πατρος αυτου εφοβηθη εκει απελθειν χρηματισθεις δε κατ οναρ ανεχωρησεν εις τα μερη της γαλιλαιας
kjv: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

vulg: et veniens habitavit in civitate quae vocatur Nazareth ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetas quoniam Nazareus vocabitur
clem: Et veniens habitavit in civitate qu vocatur Nazareth: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetas: Quoniam Nazarus vocabitur.
tr: και ελθων κατωκησεν εις πολιν λεγομενην ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  οπως πληρωθη το ρηθεν δια των προφητων οτι ναζωραιος κληθησεται
kjv: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

vulg: in diebus autem illis venit Iohannes Baptista praedicans in deserto Iudaeae
clem: In diebus autem illis venit Joannes Baptista prdicans in deserto Jud,
tr: εν δε ταις ημεραις εκειναις παραγινεται ιωαννης ο βαπτιστης κηρυσσων εν τη ερημω της ιουδαιας
kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

vulg: et dicens paenitentiam agite adpropinquavit enim regnum caelorum
clem: et dicens: Pnitentiam agite: appropinquavit enim regnum clorum.
tr: και λεγων μετανοειτε ηγγικεν γαρ η βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

vulg: hic est enim qui dictus est per Esaiam prophetam dicentem vox clamantis in deserto parate viam Domini rectas facite semitas eius
clem: Hic est enim, qui dictus est per Isaiam prophetam dicentem: [Vox clamantis in deserto: Parate viam Domini; rectas facite semitas ejus.]
tr: ουτος γαρ εστιν ο ρηθεις υπο ησαιου του προφητου λεγοντος φωνη βοωντος εν τη ερημω ετοιμασατε την οδον κυριου ευθειας ποιειτε τας τριβους αυτου
kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

vulg: ipse autem Iohannes habebat vestimentum de pilis camelorum et zonam pelliciam circa lumbos suos esca autem eius erat lucustae et mel silvestre
clem: Ipse autem Joannes habebat vestimentum de pilis camelorum, et zonam pelliceam circa lumbos suos: esca autem ejus erat locust, et mel silvestre.
tr: αυτος δε ο ιωαννης ειχεν το ενδυμα αυτου απο τριχων καμηλου και ζωνην δερματινην περι την οσφυν αυτου η δε τροφη αυτου ην ακριδες και μελι αγριον
kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

vulg: tunc exiebat ad eum Hierosolyma et omnis Iudaea et omnis regio circa Iordanen
clem: Tunc exibat ad eum Jerosolyma, et omnis Juda, et omnis regio circa Jordanem;
tr: τοτε εξεπορευετο προς αυτον ιεροσολυμα και πασα η ιουδαια και πασα η περιχωρος του ιορδανου
kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,

vulg: et baptizabantur in Iordane ab eo confitentes peccata sua
clem: et baptizabantur ab eo in Jordane, confitentes peccata sua.
tr: και εβαπτιζοντο εν τω ιορδανη υπ αυτου εξομολογουμενοι τας αμαρτιας αυτων
kjv: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

vulg: videns autem multos Pharisaeorum et Sadducaeorum venientes ad baptismum suum dixit eis progenies viperarum quis demonstravit vobis fugere a futura ira
clem: Videns autem multos pharisorum, et sadducorum, venientes ad baptismum suum, dixit eis: Progenies viperarum, quis demonstravit vobis fugere a ventura ira?
tr: ιδων δε πολλους των φαρισαιων και σαδδουκαιων ερχομενους επι το βαπτισμα αυτου ειπεν αυτοις γεννηματα εχιδνων τις υπεδειξεν υμιν φυγειν απο της μελλουσης οργης
kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

vulg: facite ergo fructum dignum paenitentiae
clem: Facite ergo fructum dignum pnitenti.
tr: ποιησατε ουν καρπους αξιους της μετανοιας
kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

vulg: et ne velitis dicere intra vos patrem habemus Abraham dico enim vobis quoniam potest Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrahae
clem: Et ne velitis dicere intra vos: Patrem habemus Abraham. Dico enim vobis quoniam potens est Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrah.
tr: και μη δοξητε λεγειν εν εαυτοις πατερα εχομεν τον αβρααμ λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι δυναται ο θεος εκ των λιθων τουτων εγειραι τεκνα τω αβρααμ
kjv: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

vulg: iam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est omnis ergo arbor quae non facit fructum bonum exciditur et in ignem mittitur
clem: Jam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est. Omnis ergo arbor, qu non facit fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
tr: ηδη δε και η αξινη προς την ριζαν των δενδρων κειται παν ουν δενδρον μη ποιουν καρπον καλον εκκοπτεται και εις πυρ βαλλεται
kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

vulg: ego quidem vos baptizo in aqua in paenitentiam qui autem post me venturus est fortior me est cuius non sum dignus calciamenta portare ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto et igni
clem: Ego quidem baptizo vos in aqua in pnitentiam: qui autem post me venturus est, fortior me est, cujus non sum dignus calceamenta portare: ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto, et igni.
tr: εγω μεν βαπτιζω υμας εν υδατι εις μετανοιαν ο δε οπισω μου ερχομενος ισχυροτερος μου εστιν ου ουκ ειμι ικανος τα υποδηματα βαστασαι αυτος υμας βαπτισει εν πνευματι αγιω και πυρι
kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance. but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

vulg: cuius ventilabrum in manu sua et permundabit aream suam et congregabit triticum suum in horreum paleas autem conburet igni inextinguibili
clem: Cujus ventilabrum in manu sua: et permundabit aream suam: et congregabit triticum suum in horreum, paleas autem comburet igni inextinguibili.
tr: ου το πτυον εν τη χειρι αυτου και διακαθαριει την αλωνα αυτου και συναξει τον σιτον αυτου εις την αποθηκην το δε αχυρον κατακαυσει πυρι ασβεστω
kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

vulg: tunc venit Iesus a Galilaea in Iordanen ad Iohannem ut baptizaretur ab eo
clem: Tunc venit Jesus a Galila in Jordanem ad Joannem, ut baptizaretur ab eo.
tr: τοτε παραγινεται ο ιησους απο της γαλιλαιας επι τον ιορδανην προς τον ιωαννην του βαπτισθηναι υπ αυτου
kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

vulg: Iohannes autem prohibebat eum dicens ego a te debeo baptizari et tu venis ad me
clem: Joannes autem prohibebat eum, dicens: Ego a te debeo baptizari, et tu venis ad me?
tr: ο δε ιωαννης διεκωλυεν αυτον λεγων εγω χρειαν εχω υπο σου βαπτισθηναι και συ ερχη προς με
kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?

vulg: respondens autem Iesus dixit ei sine modo sic enim decet nos implere omnem iustitiam tunc dimisit eum
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit ei: Sine modo: sic enim decet nos implere omnem justitiam. Tunc dimisit eum.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν προς αυτον αφες αρτι ουτως γαρ πρεπον εστιν ημιν πληρωσαι πασαν δικαιοσυνην τοτε αφιησιν αυτον
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

vulg: baptizatus autem confestim ascendit de aqua et ecce aperti sunt ei caeli et vidit Spiritum Dei descendentem sicut columbam venientem super se
clem: Baptizatus autem Jesus, confestim ascendit de aqua, et ecce aperti sunt ei cli: et vidit Spiritum Dei descendentem sicut columbam, et venientem super se.
tr: και βαπτισθεις ο ιησους ανεβη ευθυς απο του υδατος και ιδου ανεωχθησαν αυτω οι ουρανοι και ειδεν το πνευμα του θεου καταβαινον ωσει περιστεραν και ερχομενον επ αυτον
kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

vulg: et ecce vox de caelis dicens hic est Filius meus dilectus in quo mihi conplacui
clem: Et ecce vox de clis dicens: Hic est Filius meus dilectus, in quo mihi complacui.
tr: και ιδου φωνη εκ των ουρανων λεγουσα ουτος εστιν ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος εν ω ευδοκησα
kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

vulg: tunc Iesus ductus est in desertum ab Spiritu ut temptaretur a diabolo
clem: Tunc Jesus ductus est in desertum a Spiritu, ut tentaretur a diabolo.
tr: τοτε ο ιησους ανηχθη εις την ερημον υπο του πνευματος πειρασθηναι υπο του διαβολου
kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

vulg: et cum ieiunasset quadraginta diebus et quadraginta noctibus postea esuriit
clem: Et cum jejunasset quadraginta diebus, et quadraginta noctibus, postea esuriit.
tr: και νηστευσας ημερας τεσσαρακοντα και νυκτας τεσσαρακοντα υστερον επεινασεν
kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

vulg: et accedens temptator dixit ei si Filius Dei es dic ut lapides isti panes fiant
clem: Et accedens tentator dixit ei: Si Filius Dei es, dic ut lapides isti panes fiant.
tr: και προσελθων αυτω ο πειραζων ειπεν ει υιος ει του θεου ειπε ινα οι λιθοι ουτοι αρτοι γενωνται
kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

vulg: qui respondens dixit scriptum est non in pane solo vivet homo sed in omni verbo quod procedit de ore Dei
clem: Qui respondens dixit: Scriptum est: Non in solo pane vivit homo, sed in omni verbo, quod procedit de ore Dei.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν γεγραπται ουκ επ αρτω μονω ζησεται ανθρωπος αλλ επι παντι ρηματι εκπορευομενω δια στοματος θεου
kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

vulg: tunc adsumit eum diabolus in sanctam civitatem et statuit eum supra pinnaculum templi
clem: Tunc assumpsit eum diabolus in sanctam civitatem, et statuit eum super pinnaculum templi,
tr: τοτε παραλαμβανει αυτον ο διαβολος εις την αγιαν πολιν και ιστησιν αυτον επι το πτερυγιον του ιερου
kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

vulg: et dixit ei si Filius Dei es mitte te deorsum scriptum est enim quia angelis suis mandabit de te et in manibus tollent te ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum
clem: et dixit ei: Si Filius Dei es, mitte te deorsum. Scriptum est enim: Quia angelis suis mandavit de te, et in manibus tollent te, ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ει υιος ει του θεου βαλε σεαυτον κατω γεγραπται γαρ οτι τοις αγγελοις αυτου εντελειται περι σου και επι χειρων αρουσιν σε μηποτε προσκοψης προς λιθον τον ποδα σου
kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

vulg: ait illi Iesus rursum scriptum est non temptabis Dominum Deum tuum
clem: Ait illi Jesus: Rursum scriptum est: Non tentabis Dominum Deum tuum.
tr: εφη αυτω ο ιησους παλιν γεγραπται ουκ εκπειρασεις κυριον τον θεον σου
kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

vulg: iterum adsumit eum diabolus in montem excelsum valde et ostendit ei omnia regna mundi et gloriam eorum
clem: Iterum assumpsit eum diabolus in montem excelsum valde: et ostendit ei omnia regna mundi, et gloriam eorum,
tr: παλιν παραλαμβανει αυτον ο διαβολος εις ορος υψηλον λιαν και δεικνυσιν αυτω πασας τας βασιλειας του κοσμου και την δοξαν αυτων
kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

vulg: et dixit illi haec tibi omnia dabo si cadens adoraveris me
clem: et dixit ei: Hc omnia tibi dabo, si cadens adoraveris me.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ταυτα παντα σοι δωσω εαν πεσων προσκυνησης μοι
kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

vulg: tunc dicit ei Iesus vade Satanas scriptum est Dominum Deum tuum adorabis et illi soli servies
clem: Tunc dicit ei Jesus: Vade Satana: Scriptum est enim: Dominum Deum tuum adorabis, et illi soli servies.
tr: τοτε λεγει αυτω ο ιησους υπαγε σατανα γεγραπται γαρ κυριον τον θεον σου προσκυνησεις και αυτω μονω λατρευσεις
kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

vulg: tunc reliquit eum diabolus et ecce angeli accesserunt et ministrabant ei
clem: Tunc reliquit eum diabolus: et ecce angeli accesserunt, et ministrabant ei.
tr: τοτε αφιησιν αυτον ο διαβολος και ιδου αγγελοι προσηλθον και διηκονουν αυτω
kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

vulg: cum autem audisset quod Iohannes traditus esset secessit in Galilaeam
clem: Cum autem audisset Jesus quod Joannes traditus esset, secessit in Galilam:
tr: ακουσας δε ο ιησους οτι ιωαννης παρεδοθη ανεχωρησεν εις την γαλιλαιαν
kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

vulg: et relicta civitate Nazareth venit et habitavit in Capharnaum maritimam in finibus Zabulon et Nepthalim
clem: et, relicta civitate Nazareth, venit, et habitavit in Capharnaum maritima, in finibus Zabulon et Nephthalim:
tr: και καταλιπων την ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  ελθων κατωκησεν εις καπερναουμ την παραθαλασσιαν εν οριοις ζαβουλων και νεφθαλειμ
kjv: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

vulg: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Esaiam prophetam
clem: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam:
tr: ινα πληρωθη το ρηθεν δια ησαιου του προφητου λεγοντος
kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

vulg: terra Zabulon et terra Nepthalim via maris trans Iordanen Galilaeae gentium
clem: [Terra Zabulon, et terra Nephthalim, via maris trans Jordanem, Galila gentium:
tr: γη  ζαβουλων και γη  νεφθαλειμ οδον θαλασσης περαν του ιορδανου γαλιλαια  των εθνων
kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

vulg: populus qui sedebat in tenebris lucem vidit magnam et sedentibus in regione et umbra mortis lux orta est eis
clem: populus, qui sedebat in tenebris, vidit lucem magnam: et sedentibus in regione umbr mortis, lux orta est eis.]
tr: ο λαος ο καθημενος εν σκοτει ειδεν φως μεγα και τοις καθημενοις εν χωρα και σκια θανατου φως ανετειλεν αυτοις
kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

vulg: exinde coepit Iesus praedicare et dicere paenitentiam agite adpropinquavit enim regnum caelorum
clem: Exinde cpit Jesus prdicare, et dicere: Pnitentiam agite: appropinquavit enim regnum clorum.
tr: απο τοτε ηρξατο ο ιησους κηρυσσειν και λεγειν μετανοειτε ηγγικεν γαρ η βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

vulg: ambulans autem iuxta mare Galilaeae vidit duos fratres Simonem qui vocatur Petrus et Andream fratrem eius mittentes rete in mare erant enim piscatores
clem: Ambulans autem Jesus juxta mare Galil, vidit duos fratres, Simonem, qui vocatur Petrus, et Andream fratrem ejus, mittentes rete in mare (erant enim piscatores),
tr: περιπατων δε ο ιησους παρα την θαλασσαν της γαλιλαιας ειδεν δυο αδελφους σιμωνα τον λεγομενον πετρον και ανδρεαν τον αδελφον αυτου βαλλοντας αμφιβληστρον εις την θαλασσαν ησαν γαρ αλιεις
kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

vulg: et ait illis venite post me et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum
clem: et ait illis: Venite post me, et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις δευτε οπισω μου και ποιησω υμας αλιεις ανθρωπων
kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

vulg: at illi continuo relictis retibus secuti sunt eum
clem: At illi continuo relictis retibus secuti sunt eum.
tr: οι δε ευθεως αφεντες τα δικτυα ηκολουθησαν αυτω
kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

vulg: et procedens inde vidit alios duos fratres Iacobum Zebedaei et Iohannem fratrem eius in navi cum Zebedaeo patre eorum reficientes retia sua et vocavit eos
clem: Et procedens inde, vidit alios duos fratres, Jacobum Zebedi, et Joannem fratrem ejus, in navi cum Zebedo patre eorum, reficientes retia sua: et vocavit eos.
tr: και προβας εκειθεν ειδεν αλλους δυο αδελφους ιακωβον τον του ζεβεδαιου και ιωαννην τον αδελφον αυτου εν τω πλοιω μετα ζεβεδαιου του πατρος αυτων καταρτιζοντας τα δικτυα αυτων και εκαλεσεν αυτους
kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

vulg: illi autem statim relictis retibus et patre secuti sunt eum
clem: Illi autem statim relictis retibus et patre, secuti sunt eum.
tr: οι δε ευθεως αφεντες το πλοιον και τον πατερα αυτων ηκολουθησαν αυτω
kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

vulg: et circumibat Iesus totam Galilaeam docens in synagogis eorum et praedicans evangelium regni et sanans omnem languorem et omnem infirmitatem in populo
clem: Et circuibat Jesus totam Galilam, docens in synagogis eorum, et prdicans Evangelium regni: et sanans omnem languorem, et omnem infirmitatem in populo.
tr: και περιηγεν ολην την γαλιλαιαν ο ιησους διδασκων εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων και κηρυσσων το ευαγγελιον της βασιλειας και θεραπευων πασαν νοσον και πασαν μαλακιαν εν τω λαω
kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

vulg: et abiit opinio eius in totam Syriam et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes variis languoribus et tormentis conprehensos et qui daemonia habebant et lunaticos et paralyticos et curavit eos
clem: Et abiit opinio ejus in totam Syriam, et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes, variis languoribus, et tormentis comprehensos, et qui dmonia habebant, et lunaticos, et paralyticos, et curavit eos:
tr: και απηλθεν η ακοη αυτου εις ολην την συριαν και προσηνεγκαν αυτω παντας τους κακως εχοντας ποικιλαις νοσοις και βασανοις συνεχομενους και δαιμονιζομενους και σεληνιαζομενους και παραλυτικους και εθεραπευσεν αυτους
kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

vulg: et secutae sunt eum turbae multae de Galilaea et Decapoli et Hierosolymis et Iudaea et de trans Iordanen
clem: et secut sunt eum turb mult de Galila, et Decapoli, et de Jerosolymis, et de Juda, et de trans Jordanem.
tr: και ηκολουθησαν αυτω οχλοι πολλοι απο της γαλιλαιας και δεκαπολεως και ιεροσολυμων και ιουδαιας και περαν του ιορδανου
kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

vulg: videns autem turbas ascendit in montem et cum sedisset accesserunt ad eum discipuli eius
clem: Videns autem Jesus turbas, ascendit in montem, et cum sedisset, accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus,
tr: ιδων δε τους οχλους ανεβη εις το ορος και καθισαντος αυτου προσηλθον αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

vulg: et aperiens os suum docebat eos dicens
clem: et aperiens os suum docebat eos dicens:
tr: και ανοιξας το στομα αυτου εδιδασκεν αυτους λεγων
kjv: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

vulg: beati pauperes spiritu quoniam ipsorum est regnum caelorum
clem: Beati pauperes spiritu: quoniam ipsorum est regnum clorum.
tr: μακαριοι οι πτωχοι τω πνευματι οτι αυτων εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: beati mites quoniam ipsi possidebunt terram
clem: Beati mites: quoniam ipsi possidebunt terram.
tr: μακαριοι οι πενθουντες οτι αυτοι παρακληθησονται
kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

vulg: beati qui lugent quoniam ipsi consolabuntur
clem: Beati qui lugent: quoniam ipsi consolabuntur.
tr: μακαριοι οι πραεις οτι αυτοι κληρονομησουσιν την γην
kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

vulg: beati qui esuriunt et sitiunt iustitiam quoniam ipsi saturabuntur
clem: Beati qui esuriunt et sitiunt justitiam: quoniam ipsi saturabuntur.
tr: μακαριοι οι πεινωντες και διψωντες την δικαιοσυνην οτι αυτοι χορτασθησονται
kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

vulg: beati misericordes quia ipsi misericordiam consequentur
clem: Beati misericordes: quoniam ipsi misericordiam consequentur.
tr: μακαριοι οι ελεημονες οτι αυτοι ελεηθησονται
kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

vulg: beati mundo corde quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt
clem: Beati mundo corde: quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt.
tr: μακαριοι οι καθαροι τη καρδια οτι αυτοι τον θεον οψονται
kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

vulg: beati pacifici quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur
clem: Beati pacifici: quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur.
tr: μακαριοι οι ειρηνοποιοι οτι αυτοι υιοι θεου κληθησονται
kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

vulg: beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter iustitiam quoniam ipsorum est regnum caelorum
clem: Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter justitiam: quoniam ipsorum est regnum clorum.
tr: μακαριοι οι δεδιωγμενοι ενεκεν δικαιοσυνης οτι αυτων εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: beati estis cum maledixerint vobis et persecuti vos fuerint et dixerint omne malum adversum vos mentientes propter me
clem: Beati estis cum maledixerint vobis, et persecuti vos fuerint, et dixerint omne malum adversum vos mentientes, propter me:
tr: μακαριοι εστε οταν ονειδισωσιν υμας και διωξωσιν και ειπωσιν παν πονηρον ρημα καθ υμων ψευδομενοι ενεκεν εμου
kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

vulg: gaudete et exultate quoniam merces vestra copiosa est in caelis sic enim persecuti sunt prophetas qui fuerunt ante vos
clem: gaudete, et exsultate, quoniam merces vestra copiosa est in clis. Sic enim persecuti sunt prophetas, qui fuerunt ante vos.
tr: χαιρετε και αγαλλιασθε οτι ο μισθος υμων πολυς εν τοις ουρανοις ουτως γαρ εδιωξαν τους προφητας τους προ υμων
kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

vulg: vos estis sal terrae quod si sal evanuerit in quo sallietur ad nihilum valet ultra nisi ut mittatur foras et conculcetur ab hominibus
clem: Vos estis sal terr. Quod si sal evanuerit, in quo salietur? ad nihilum valet ultra, nisi ut mittatur foras, et conculcetur ab hominibus.
tr: υμεις εστε το αλας της γης εαν δε το αλας μωρανθη εν τινι αλισθησεται εις ουδεν ισχυει ετι ει μη βληθηναι εξω και καταπατεισθαι υπο των ανθρωπων
kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

vulg: vos estis lux mundi non potest civitas abscondi supra montem posita
clem: Vos estis lux mundi. Non potest civitas abscondi supra montem posita,
tr: υμεις εστε το φως του κοσμου ου δυναται πολις κρυβηναι επανω ορους κειμενη
kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

vulg: neque accendunt lucernam et ponunt eam sub modio sed super candelabrum ut luceat omnibus qui in domo sunt
clem: neque accedunt lucernam, et ponunt eam sub modio, sed super candelabrum, ut luceat omnibus qui in domo sunt.
tr: ουδε καιουσιν λυχνον και τιθεασιν αυτον υπο τον μοδιον αλλ επι την λυχνιαν και λαμπει πασιν τοις εν τη οικια
kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

vulg: sic luceat lux vestra coram hominibus ut videant vestra bona opera et glorificent Patrem vestrum qui in caelis est
clem: Sic luceat lux vestra coram hominibus: ut videant opera vestra bona, et glorificent Patrem vestrum, qui in clis est.
tr: ουτως λαμψατω το φως υμων εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων οπως ιδωσιν υμων τα καλα εργα και δοξασωσιν τον πατερα υμων τον εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

vulg: nolite putare quoniam veni solvere legem aut prophetas non veni solvere sed adimplere
clem: Nolite putare quoniam veni solvere legem aut prophetas: non veni solvere, sed adimplere.
tr: μη νομισητε οτι ηλθον καταλυσαι τον νομον η τους προφητας ουκ ηλθον καταλυσαι αλλα πληρωσαι
kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

vulg: amen quippe dico vobis donec transeat caelum et terra iota unum aut unus apex non praeteribit a lege donec omnia fiant
clem: Amen quippe dico vobis, donec transeat clum et terra, jota unum aut unus apex non prteribit a lege, donec omnia fiant.
tr: αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν εως αν παρελθη ο ουρανος και η γη ιωτα εν η μια κεραια ου μη παρελθη απο του νομου εως αν παντα γενηται
kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

vulg: qui ergo solverit unum de mandatis istis minimis et docuerit sic homines minimus vocabitur in regno caelorum qui autem fecerit et docuerit hic magnus vocabitur in regno caelorum
clem: Qui ergo solverit unum de mandatis istis minimis, et docuerit sic homines, minimus vocabitur in regno clorum: qui autem fecerit et docuerit, hic magnus vocabitur in regno clorum.
tr: ος εαν ουν λυση μιαν των εντολων τουτων των ελαχιστων και διδαξη ουτως τους ανθρωπους ελαχιστος κληθησεται εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων ος δ αν ποιηση και διδαξη ουτος μεγας κληθησεται εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: dico enim vobis quia nisi abundaverit iustitia vestra plus quam scribarum et Pharisaeorum non intrabitis in regnum caelorum
clem: Dico enim vobis, quia nisi abundaverit justitia vestra plus quam scribarum, et pharisorum, non intrabitis in regnum clorum.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι εαν μη περισσευση η δικαιοσυνη υμων πλειον των γραμματεων και φαρισαιων ου μη εισελθητε εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων
kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: audistis quia dictum est antiquis non occides qui autem occiderit reus erit iudicio
clem: Audistis quia dictum est antiquis: Non occides: qui autem occiderit, reus erit judicio.
tr: ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη τοις αρχαιοις ου φονευσεις ος δ αν φονευση ενοχος εσται τη κρισει
kjv: Ye have heard that it was said of them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

vulg: ego autem dico vobis quia omnis qui irascitur fratri suo reus erit iudicio qui autem dixerit fratri suo racha reus erit concilio qui autem dixerit fatue reus erit gehennae ignis
clem: Ego autem dico vobis: quia omnis qui irascitur fratri suo, reus erit judicio. Qui autem dixerit fratri suo, raca: reus erit concilio. Qui autem dixerit, fatue: reus erit gehenn ignis.
tr: εγω δε λεγω υμιν οτι πας ο οργιζομενος τω αδελφω αυτου εικη ενοχος εσται τη κρισει ος δ αν ειπη τω αδελφω αυτου ρακα ενοχος εσται τω συνεδριω ος δ αν ειπη μωρε ενοχος εσται εις την γεενναν του πυρος
kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

vulg: si ergo offeres munus tuum ad altare et ibi recordatus fueris quia frater tuus habet aliquid adversum te
clem: Si ergo offers munus tuum ad altare, et ibi recordatus fueris quia frater tuus habet aliquid adversum te:
tr: εαν ουν προσφερης το δωρον σου επι το θυσιαστηριον κακει μνησθης οτι ο αδελφος σου εχει τι κατα σου
kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

vulg: relinque ibi munus tuum ante altare et vade prius reconciliare fratri tuo et tunc veniens offers munus tuum
clem: relinque ibi munus tuum ante altare, et vade prius reconciliari fratri tuo: et tunc veniens offeres munus tuum.
tr: αφες εκει το δωρον σου εμπροσθεν του θυσιαστηριου και υπαγε πρωτον διαλλαγηθι τω αδελφω σου και τοτε ελθων προσφερε το δωρον σου
kjv: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

vulg: esto consentiens adversario tuo cito dum es in via cum eo ne forte tradat te adversarius iudici et iudex tradat te ministro et in carcerem mittaris
clem: Esto consentiens adversario tuo cito dum es in via cum eo: ne forte tradat te adversarius judici, et judex tradat te ministro: et in carcerem mittaris.
tr: ισθι ευνοων τω αντιδικω σου ταχυ εως οτου ει εν τη οδω μετ αυτου μηποτε σε παραδω ο αντιδικος τω κριτη και ο κριτης σε παραδω τω υπηρετη και εις φυλακην βληθηση
kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

vulg: amen dico tibi non exies inde donec reddas novissimum quadrantem
clem: Amen dico tibi, non exies inde, donec reddas novissimum quadrantem.
tr: αμην λεγω σοι ου μη εξελθης εκειθεν εως αν αποδως τον εσχατον κοδραντην
kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

vulg: audistis quia dictum est antiquis non moechaberis
clem: Audistis quia dictum est antiquis: Non mchaberis.
tr: ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη τοις αρχαιοις ου μοιχευσεις
kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

vulg: ego autem dico vobis quoniam omnis qui viderit mulierem ad concupiscendum eam iam moechatus est eam in corde suo
clem: Ego autem dico vobis: quia omnis qui viderit mulierem ad concupiscendum eam, jam mchatus est eam in corde suo.
tr: εγω δε λεγω υμιν οτι πας ο βλεπων γυναικα προς το επιθυμησαι αυτης ηδη εμοιχευσεν αυτην εν τη καρδια αυτου
kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

vulg: quod si oculus tuus dexter scandalizat te erue eum et proice abs te expedit enim tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum quam totum corpus tuum mittatur in gehennam
clem: Quod si oculus tuus dexter scandalizat te, erue eum, et projice abs te: expedit enim tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum, quam totus corpus tuum mittatur in gehennam.
tr: ει δε ο οφθαλμος σου ο δεξιος σκανδαλιζει σε εξελε αυτον και βαλε απο σου συμφερει γαρ σοι ινα αποληται εν των μελων σου και μη ολον το σωμα σου βληθη εις γεενναν
kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

vulg: et si dextera manus tua scandalizat te abscide eam et proice abs te expedit tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum quam totum corpus tuum eat in gehennam
clem: Et si dextra manus tua scandalizat te, abscide eam, et projice abs te: expedit enim tibi ut pereat unum membrorum tuorum, quam totum corpus tuum eat in gehennam.
tr: και ει η δεξια σου χειρ σκανδαλιζει σε εκκοψον αυτην και βαλε απο σου συμφερει γαρ σοι ινα αποληται εν των μελων σου και μη ολον το σωμα σου βληθη εις γεενναν
kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

vulg: dictum est autem quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam det illi libellum repudii
clem: Dictum est autem: Quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam, det ei libellum repudii.
tr: ερρεθη δε οτι ος αν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου δοτω αυτη αποστασιον
kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

vulg: ego autem dico vobis quia omnis qui dimiserit uxorem suam excepta fornicationis causa facit eam moechari et qui dimissam duxerit adulterat
clem: Ego autem dico vobis: quia omnis qui dimiserit uxorem suam, excepta fornicationis causa, facit eam mchari: et qui dimissam duxerit, adulterat.
tr: εγω δε λεγω υμιν οτι ος αν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου παρεκτος λογου πορνειας ποιει αυτην μοιχασθαι και ος εαν απολελυμενην γαμηση μοιχαται
kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

vulg: iterum audistis quia dictum est antiquis non peierabis reddes autem Domino iuramenta tua
clem: Iterum audistis quia dictum est antiquis: Non perjurabis: reddes autem Domino juramenta tua.
tr: παλιν ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη τοις αρχαιοις ουκ επιορκησεις αποδωσεις δε τω κυριω τους ορκους σου
kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

vulg: ego autem dico vobis non iurare omnino neque per caelum quia thronus Dei est
clem: Ego autem dico vobis, non jurare omnino, neque per clum, quia thronus Dei est:
tr: εγω δε λεγω υμιν μη ομοσαι ολως μητε εν τω ουρανω οτι θρονος εστιν του θεου
kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

vulg: neque per terram quia scabillum est pedum eius neque per Hierosolymam quia civitas est magni Regis
clem: neque per terram, quia scabellum est pedum ejus: neque per Jerosolymam, quia civitas est magni regis:
tr: μητε εν τη γη οτι υποποδιον εστιν των ποδων αυτου μητε εις ιεροσολυμα οτι πολις εστιν του μεγαλου βασιλεως
kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

vulg: neque per caput tuum iuraveris quia non potes unum capillum album facere aut nigrum
clem: neque per caput tuum juraveris, quia non potes unum capillum album facere, aut nigrum.
tr: μητε εν τη κεφαλη σου ομοσης οτι ου δυνασαι μιαν τριχα λευκην η μελαιναν ποιησαι
kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

vulg: sit autem sermo vester est est non non quod autem his abundantius est a malo est
clem: Sit autem sermo vester, est, est: non, non: quod autem his abundantius est, a malo est.
tr: εστω δε ο λογος υμων ναι ναι ου ου το δε περισσον τουτων εκ του πονηρου εστιν
kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

vulg: audistis quia dictum est oculum pro oculo et dentem pro dente
clem: Audistis quia dictum est: Oculum pro oculo, et dentem pro dente.
tr: ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη οφθαλμον αντι οφθαλμου και οδοντα αντι οδοντος
kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

vulg: ego autem dico vobis non resistere malo sed si quis te percusserit in dextera maxilla tua praebe illi et alteram
clem: Ego autem dico vobis, non resistere malo: sed si quis te percusserit in dexteram maxillam tuam, prbe illi et alteram:
tr: εγω δε λεγω υμιν μη αντιστηναι τω πονηρω αλλ οστις σε ραπισει επι την δεξιαν σου σιαγονα στρεψον αυτω και την αλλην
kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

vulg: et ei qui vult tecum iudicio contendere et tunicam tuam tollere remitte ei et pallium
clem: et ei, qui vult tecum judicio contendere, et tunicam tuam tollere, dimitte ei et pallium:
tr: και τω θελοντι σοι κριθηναι και τον χιτωνα σου λαβειν αφες αυτω και το ιματιον
kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.

vulg: et quicumque te angariaverit mille passus vade cum illo alia duo
clem: et quicumque te angariaverit mille passus, vade cum illo et alia duo.
tr: και οστις σε αγγαρευσει μιλιον εν υπαγε μετ αυτου δυο
kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

vulg: qui petit a te da ei et volenti mutuari a te ne avertaris
clem: Qui petit a te, da ei: et volenti mutuari a te, ne avertaris.
tr: τω αιτουντι σε διδου και τον θελοντα απο σου δανεισασθαι μη αποστραφης
kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

vulg: audistis quia dictum est diliges proximum tuum et odio habebis inimicum tuum
clem: Audistis quia dictum est: Diliges proximum tuum, et odio habebis inimicum tuum.
tr: ηκουσατε οτι ερρεθη αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου και μισησεις τον εχθρον σου
kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

vulg: ego autem dico vobis diligite inimicos vestros benefacite his qui oderunt vos et orate pro persequentibus et calumniantibus vos
clem: Ego autem dico vobis: Diligite inimicos vestros, benefacite his qui oderunt vos, et orate pro persequentibus et calumniantibus vos:
tr: εγω δε λεγω υμιν αγαπατε τους εχθρους υμων ευλογειτε τους καταρωμενους υμας καλως ποιειτε τους μισουντας υμας και προσευχεσθε υπερ των επηρεαζοντων υμας και διωκοντων υμας
kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

vulg: ut sitis filii Patris vestri qui in caelis est qui solem suum oriri facit super bonos et malos et pluit super iustos et iniustos
clem: ut sitis filii Patris vestri, qui in clis est: qui solem suum oriri facit super bonos et malos: et pluit super justos et injustos.
tr: οπως γενησθε υιοι του πατρος υμων του εν ουρανοις οτι τον ηλιον αυτου ανατελλει επι πονηρους και αγαθους και βρεχει επι δικαιους και αδικους
kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

vulg: si enim diligatis eos qui vos diligunt quam mercedem habebitis nonne et publicani hoc faciunt
clem: Si enim diligitis eos qui vos diligunt, quam mercedem habebitis? nonne et publicani hoc faciunt?
tr: εαν γαρ αγαπησητε τους αγαπωντας υμας τινα μισθον εχετε ουχι και οι τελωναι το αυτο ποιουσιν
kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

vulg: et si salutaveritis fratres vestros tantum quid amplius facitis nonne et ethnici hoc faciunt
clem: Et si salutaveritis fratres vestros tantum, quid amplius facitis? nonne et ethnici hoc faciunt?
tr: και εαν ασπασησθε τους αδελφους υμων μονον τι περισσον ποιειτε ουχι και οι τελωναι ουτως ποιουσιν
kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

vulg: estote ergo vos perfecti sicut et Pater vester caelestis perfectus est
clem: Estote ergo vos perfecti, sicut et Pater vester clestis perfectus est.
tr: εσεσθε ουν υμεις τελειοι ωσπερ ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις τελειος εστιν
kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

vulg: adtendite ne iustitiam vestram faciatis coram hominibus ut videamini ab eis alioquin mercedem non habebitis apud Patrem vestrum qui in caelis est
clem: Attendite ne justitiam vestram faciatis coram hominibus, ut videamini ab eis: alioquin mercedem non habebitis apud Patrem vestrum qui in clis est.
tr: προσεχετε την ελεημοσυνην υμων μη ποιειν εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων προς το θεαθηναι αυτοις ει δε μηγε μισθον ουκ εχετε παρα τω πατρι υμων τω εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

vulg: cum ergo facies elemosynam noli tuba canere ante te sicut hypocritae faciunt in synagogis et in vicis ut honorificentur ab hominibus amen dico vobis receperunt mercedem suam
clem: Cum ergo facis eleemosynam, noli tuba canere ante te, sicut hypocrit faciunt in synagogis, et in vicis, ut honorificentur ab hominibus. Amen dico vobis, receperunt mercedem suam.
tr: οταν ουν ποιης ελεημοσυνην μη σαλπισης εμπροσθεν σου ωσπερ οι υποκριται ποιουσιν εν ταις συναγωγαις και εν ταις ρυμαις οπως δοξασθωσιν υπο των ανθρωπων αμην λεγω υμιν απεχουσιν τον μισθον αυτων
kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

vulg: te autem faciente elemosynam nesciat sinistra tua quid faciat dextera tua
clem: Te autem faciente eleemosynam, nesciat sinistra tua quid faciat dextera tua:
tr: σου δε ποιουντος ελεημοσυνην μη γνωτω η αριστερα σου τι ποιει η δεξια σου
kjv: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

vulg: ut sit elemosyna tua in abscondito et Pater tuus qui videt in abscondito reddet tibi
clem: ut sit eleemosyna tua in abscondito, et Pater tuus, qui videt in abscondito, reddet tibi.
tr: οπως η σου η ελεημοσυνη εν τω κρυπτω και ο πατηρ σου ο βλεπων εν τω κρυπτω αυτος αποδωσει σοι εν τω φανερω
kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

vulg: et cum oratis non eritis sicut hypocritae qui amant in synagogis et in angulis platearum stantes orare ut videantur ab hominibus amen dico vobis receperunt mercedem suam
clem: Et cum oratis, non eritis sicut hypocrit qui amant in synagogis et in angulis platearum stantes orare, ut videantur ab hominibus: amen dico vobis, receperunt mercedem suam.
tr: και οταν προσευχη ουκ εση ωσπερ οι υποκριται οτι φιλουσιν εν ταις συναγωγαις και εν ταις γωνιαις των πλατειων εστωτες προσευχεσθαι οπως αν φανωσιν τοις ανθρωποις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι απεχουσιν τον μισθον αυτων
kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

vulg: tu autem cum orabis intra in cubiculum tuum et cluso ostio tuo ora Patrem tuum in abscondito et Pater tuus qui videt in abscondito reddet tibi
clem: Tu autem cum oraveris, intra in cubiculum tuum, et clauso ostio, ora Patrem tuum in abscondito: et Pater tuus, qui videt in abscondito, reddet tibi.
tr: συ δε οταν προσευχη εισελθε εις το ταμιειον σου και κλεισας την θυραν σου προσευξαι τω πατρι σου τω εν τω κρυπτω και ο πατηρ σου ο βλεπων εν τω κρυπτω αποδωσει σοι εν τω φανερω
kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

vulg: orantes autem nolite multum loqui sicut ethnici putant enim quia in multiloquio suo exaudiantur
clem: Orantes autem, nolite multum loqui, sicut ethnici, putant enim quod in multiloquio suo exaudiantur.
tr: προσευχομενοι δε μη βαττολογησητε ωσπερ οι εθνικοι δοκουσιν γαρ οτι εν τη πολυλογια αυτων εισακουσθησονται
kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

vulg: nolite ergo adsimilari eis scit enim Pater vester quibus opus sit vobis antequam petatis eum
clem: Nolite ergo assimilari eis: scit enim Pater vester, quid opus sit vobis, antequam petatis eum.
tr: μη ουν ομοιωθητε αυτοις οιδεν γαρ ο πατηρ υμων ων χρειαν εχετε προ του υμας αιτησαι αυτον
kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

vulg: sic ergo vos orabitis Pater noster qui in caelis es sanctificetur nomen tuum
clem: Sic ergo vos orabitis: [Pater noster, qui es in clis, sanctificetur nomen tuum.
tr: ουτως ουν προσευχεσθε υμεις πατερ ημων ο εν τοις ουρανοις αγιασθητω το ονομα σου
kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

vulg: veniat regnum tuum fiat voluntas tua sicut in caelo et in terra
clem: Adveniat regnum tuum; fiat voluntas tua, sicut in clo et in terra.
tr: ελθετω η βασιλεια σου γενηθητω το θελημα σου ως εν ουρανω και επι της γης
kjv: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

vulg: panem nostrum supersubstantialem da nobis hodie
clem: Panem nostrum supersubstantialem da nobis hodie,
tr: τον αρτον ημων τον επιουσιον δος ημιν σημερον
kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.

vulg: et dimitte nobis debita nostra sicut et nos dimisimus debitoribus nostris
clem: et dimitte nobis debita nostra, sicut et nos dimittimus debitoribus nostris.
tr: και αφες ημιν τα οφειληματα ημων ως και ημεις αφιεμεν τοις οφειλεταις ημων
kjv: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

vulg: et ne inducas nos in temptationem sed libera nos a malo
clem: Et ne nos inducas in tentationem, sed libera nos a malo. Amen.]
tr: και μη εισενεγκης ημας εις πειρασμον αλλα ρυσαι ημας απο του πονηρου οτι σου εστιν η βασιλεια και η δυναμις και η δοξα εις τους αιωνας αμην
kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

vulg: si enim dimiseritis hominibus peccata eorum dimittet et vobis Pater vester caelestis delicta vestra
clem: Si enim dimiseritis hominibus peccata eorum: dimittet et vobis Pater vester clestis delicta vestra.
tr: εαν γαρ αφητε τοις ανθρωποις τα παραπτωματα αυτων αφησει και υμιν ο πατηρ υμων ο ουρανιος
kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

vulg: si autem non dimiseritis hominibus nec Pater vester dimittet peccata vestra
clem: Si autem non dimiseritis hominibus: nec Pater vester dimittet vobis peccata vestra.
tr: εαν δε μη αφητε τοις ανθρωποις τα παραπτωματα αυτων ουδε ο πατηρ υμων αφησει τα παραπτωματα υμων
kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

vulg: cum autem ieiunatis nolite fieri sicut hypocritae tristes demoliuntur enim facies suas ut pareant hominibus ieiunantes amen dico vobis quia receperunt mercedem suam
clem: Cum autem jejunatis, nolite fieri sicut hypocrit, tristes. Exterminant enim facies suas, ut appareant hominibus jejunantes. Amen dico vobis, quia receperunt mercedem suam.
tr: οταν δε νηστευητε μη γινεσθε ωσπερ οι υποκριται σκυθρωποι αφανιζουσιν γαρ τα προσωπα αυτων οπως φανωσιν τοις ανθρωποις νηστευοντες αμην λεγω υμιν οτι απεχουσιν τον μισθον αυτων
kjv: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

vulg: tu autem cum ieiunas ungue caput tuum et faciem tuam lava
clem: Tu autem, cum jejunas, unge caput tuum, et faciem tuam lava,
tr: συ δε νηστευων αλειψαι σου την κεφαλην και το προσωπον σου νιψαι
kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

vulg: ne videaris hominibus ieiunans sed Patri tuo qui est in abscondito et Pater tuus qui videt in abscondito reddet tibi
clem: ne videaris hominibus jejunans, sed Patri tuo, qui est in abscondito: et Pater tuus, qui videt in abscondito, reddet tibi.
tr: οπως μη φανης τοις ανθρωποις νηστευων αλλα τω πατρι σου τω εν τω κρυπτω και ο πατηρ σου ο βλεπων εν τω κρυπτω αποδωσει σοι εν τω φανερω
kjv: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

vulg: nolite thesaurizare vobis thesauros in terra ubi erugo et tinea demolitur ubi fures effodiunt et furantur
clem: Nolite thesaurizare vobis thesauros in terra: ubi rugo, et tinea demolitur: et ubi fures effodiunt, et furantur.
tr: μη θησαυριζετε υμιν θησαυρους επι της γης οπου σης και βρωσις αφανιζει και οπου κλεπται διορυσσουσιν και κλεπτουσιν
kjv: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

vulg: thesaurizate autem vobis thesauros in caelo ubi neque erugo neque tinea demolitur et ubi fures non effodiunt nec furantur
clem: Thesaurizate autem vobis thesauros in clo, ubi neque rugo, neque tinea demolitur, et ubi fures non effodiunt, nec furantur.
tr: θησαυριζετε δε υμιν θησαυρους εν ουρανω οπου ουτε σης ουτε βρωσις αφανιζει και οπου κλεπται ου διορυσσουσιν ουδε κλεπτουσιν
kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

vulg: ubi enim est thesaurus tuus ibi est et cor tuum
clem: Ubi enim est thesaurus tuus, ibi est et cor tuum.
tr: οπου γαρ εστιν ο θησαυρος υμων εκει εσται και η καρδια υμων
kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

vulg: lucerna corporis est oculus si fuerit oculus tuus simplex totum corpus tuum lucidum erit
clem: Lucerna corporis tui est oculus tuus. Si oculus tuus fuerit simplex, totum corpus tuum lucidum erit.
tr: ο λυχνος του σωματος εστιν ο οφθαλμος εαν ουν ο οφθαλμος σου απλους η ολον το σωμα σου φωτεινον εσται
kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

vulg: si autem oculus tuus nequam fuerit totum corpus tuum tenebrosum erit si ergo lumen quod in te est tenebrae sunt tenebrae quantae erunt
clem: Si autem oculus tuus fuerit nequam, totum corpus tuum tenebrosum erit. Si ergo lumen, quod in te est, tenebr sunt: ips tenebr quant erunt?
tr: εαν δε ο οφθαλμος σου πονηρος η ολον το σωμα σου σκοτεινον εσται ει ουν το φως το εν σοι σκοτος εστιν το σκοτος ποσον
kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

vulg: nemo potest duobus dominis servire aut enim unum odio habebit et alterum diliget aut unum sustinebit et alterum contemnet non potestis Deo servire et mamonae
clem: Nemo potest duobus dominis servire: aut enim unum odio habebit, et alterum diliget: aut unum sustinebit, et alterum contemnet. Non potestis Deo servire et mammon.
tr: ουδεις δυναται δυσιν κυριοις δουλευειν η γαρ τον ενα μισησει και τον ετερον αγαπησει η ενος ανθεξεται και του ετερου καταφρονησει ου δυνασθε θεω δουλευειν και μαμμωνα
kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

vulg: ideo dico vobis ne solliciti sitis animae vestrae quid manducetis neque corpori vestro quid induamini nonne anima plus est quam esca et corpus plus est quam vestimentum
clem: Ideo dico vobis, ne solliciti sitis anim vestr quid manducetis, neque corpori vestro quid induamini. Nonne anima plus est quam esca, et corpus plus quam vestimentum?
tr: δια τουτο λεγω υμιν μη μεριμνατε τη ψυχη υμων τι φαγητε και τι πιητε μηδε τω σωματι υμων τι ενδυσησθε ουχι η ψυχη πλειον εστιν της τροφης και το σωμα του ενδυματος
kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

vulg: respicite volatilia caeli quoniam non serunt neque metunt neque congregant in horrea et Pater vester caelestis pascit illa nonne vos magis pluris estis illis
clem: Respicite volatilia cli, quoniam non serunt, neque metunt, neque congregant in horrea: et Pater vester clestis pascit illa. Nonne vos magis pluris estis illis?
tr: εμβλεψατε εις τα πετεινα του ουρανου οτι ου σπειρουσιν ουδε θεριζουσιν ουδε συναγουσιν εις αποθηκας και ο πατηρ υμων ο ουρανιος τρεφει αυτα ουχ υμεις μαλλον διαφερετε αυτων
kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

vulg: quis autem vestrum cogitans potest adicere ad staturam suam cubitum unum
clem: Quis autem vestrum cogitans potest adjicere ad staturam suam cubitum unum?
tr: τις δε εξ υμων μεριμνων δυναται προσθειναι επι την ηλικιαν αυτου πηχυν ενα
kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

vulg: et de vestimento quid solliciti estis considerate lilia agri quomodo crescunt non laborant nec nent
clem: Et de vestimento quid solliciti estis? Considerate lilia agri quomodo crescunt: non laborant, neque nent.
tr: και περι ενδυματος τι μεριμνατε καταμαθετε τα κρινα του αγρου πως αυξανει ου κοπια ουδε νηθει
kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

vulg: dico autem vobis quoniam nec Salomon in omni gloria sua coopertus est sicut unum ex istis
clem: Dico autem vobis, quoniam nec Salomon in omni gloria sua coopertus est sicut unum ex istis.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ουδε σολομων εν παση τη δοξη αυτου περιεβαλετο ως εν τουτων
kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

vulg: si autem faenum agri quod hodie est et cras in clibanum mittitur Deus sic vestit quanto magis vos minimae fidei
clem: Si autem fnum agri, quod hodie est, et cras in clibanum mittitur, Deus sic vestit, quanto magis vos modic fidei?
tr: ει δε τον χορτον του αγρου σημερον οντα και αυριον εις κλιβανον βαλλομενον ο θεος ουτως αμφιεννυσιν ου πολλω μαλλον υμας ολιγοπιστοι
kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

vulg: nolite ergo solliciti esse dicentes quid manducabimus aut quid bibemus aut quo operiemur
clem: Nolite ergo solliciti esse, dicentes: Quid manducabimus, aut quid bibemus, aut quo operiemur?
tr: μη ουν μεριμνησητε λεγοντες τι φαγωμεν η τι πιωμεν η τι περιβαλωμεθα
kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

vulg: haec enim omnia gentes inquirunt scit enim Pater vester quia his omnibus indigetis
clem: hc enim omnia gentes inquirunt. Scit enim Pater vester, quia his omnibus indigetis.
tr: παντα γαρ ταυτα τα εθνη επιζητει οιδεν γαρ ο πατηρ υμων ο ουρανιος οτι χρηζετε τουτων απαντων
kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

vulg: quaerite autem primum regnum et iustitiam eius et omnia haec adicientur vobis
clem: Qurite ergo primum regnum Dei, et justitiam ejus: et hc omnia adjicientur vobis.
tr: ζητειτε δε πρωτον την βασιλειαν του θεου και την δικαιοσυνην αυτου και ταυτα παντα προστεθησεται υμιν
kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

vulg: nolite ergo esse solliciti in crastinum crastinus enim dies sollicitus erit sibi ipse sufficit diei malitia sua
clem: Nolite ergo solliciti esse in crastinum. Crastinus enim dies sollicitus erit sibi ipsi: sufficit diei malitia sua.
tr: μη ουν μεριμνησητε εις την αυριον η γαρ αυριον μεριμνησει τα εαυτης αρκετον τη ημερα η κακια αυτης
kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

vulg: nolite iudicare ut non iudicemini
clem: Nolite judicare, ut non judicemini.
tr: μη κρινετε ινα μη κριθητε
kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

vulg: in quo enim iudicio iudicaveritis iudicabimini et in qua mensura mensi fueritis metietur vobis
clem: In quo enim judicio judicaveritis, judicabimini: et in qua mensura mensi fueritis, remetietur vobis.
tr: εν ω γαρ κριματι κρινετε κριθησεσθε και εν ω μετρω μετρειτε αντιμετρηθησεται υμιν
kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

vulg: quid autem vides festucam in oculo fratris tui et trabem in oculo tuo non vides
clem: Quid autem vides festucam in oculo fratris tui, et trabem in oculo tuo non vides?
tr: τι δε βλεπεις το καρφος το εν τω οφθαλμω του αδελφου σου την δε εν τω σω οφθαλμω δοκον ου κατανοεις
kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

vulg: aut quomodo dicis fratri tuo sine eiciam festucam de oculo tuo et ecce trabis est in oculo tuo
clem: aut quomodo dicis fratris tuo: Sine ejiciam festucam de oculo tuo, et ecce trabs est in oculo tuo?
tr: η πως ερεις τω αδελφω σου αφες εκβαλω το καρφος απο του οφθαλμου σου και ιδου η δοκος εν τω οφθαλμω σου
kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

vulg: hypocrita eice primum trabem de oculo tuo et tunc videbis eicere festucam de oculo fratris tui
