clem: Hypocrita, ejice primum trabem de oculo tuo, et tunc videbis ejicere festucam de oculo fratris tui.
tr: υποκριτα εκβαλε πρωτον την δοκον εκ του οφθαλμου σου και τοτε διαβλεψεις εκβαλειν το καρφος εκ του οφθαλμου του αδελφου σου
kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

vulg: nolite dare sanctum canibus neque mittatis margaritas vestras ante porcos ne forte conculcent eas pedibus suis et conversi disrumpant vos
clem: Nolite dare sanctum canibus: neque mittatis margaritas vestras ante porcos, ne forte conculcent eas pedibus suis, et conversi dirumpant vos.
tr: μη δωτε το αγιον τοις κυσιν μηδε βαλητε τους μαργαριτας υμων εμπροσθεν των χοιρων μηποτε καταπατησωσιν αυτους εν τοις ποσιν αυτων και στραφεντες ρηξωσιν υμας
kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

vulg: petite et dabitur vobis quaerite et invenietis pulsate et aperietur vobis
clem: Petite, et dabitur vobis: qurite, et invenietis: pulsate, et aperietur vobis.
tr: αιτειτε και δοθησεται υμιν ζητειτε και ευρησετε κρουετε και ανοιγησεται υμιν
kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

vulg: omnis enim qui petit accipit et qui quaerit invenit et pulsanti aperietur
clem: Omnis enim qui petit, accipit: et qui qurit, invenit: et pulsanti aperietur.
tr: πας γαρ ο αιτων λαμβανει και ο ζητων ευρισκει και τω κρουοντι ανοιγησεται
kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

vulg: aut quis est ex vobis homo quem si petierit filius suus panem numquid lapidem porriget ei
clem: Aut quis est ex vobis homo, quem si petierit filius suus panem, numquid lapidem porriget ei?
tr: η τις εστιν εξ υμων ανθρωπος ον εαν αιτηση ο υιος αυτου αρτον μη λιθον επιδωσει αυτω
kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

vulg: aut si piscem petet numquid serpentem porriget ei
clem: aut si piscem petierit, numquid serpentem porriget ei?
tr: και εαν ιχθυν αιτηση μη οφιν επιδωσει αυτω
kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

vulg: si ergo vos cum sitis mali nostis bona dare filiis vestris quanto magis Pater vester qui in caelis est dabit bona petentibus se
clem: Si ergo vos, cum sitis mali, nostis bona data dare filiis vestris: quanto magis Pater vester, qui in clis est, dabit bona petentibus se?
tr: ει ουν υμεις πονηροι οντες οιδατε δοματα αγαθα διδοναι τοις τεκνοις υμων ποσω μαλλον ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις δωσει αγαθα τοις αιτουσιν αυτον
kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

vulg: omnia ergo quaecumque vultis ut faciant vobis homines et vos facite eis haec est enim lex et prophetae
clem: Omnia ergo qucumque vultis ut faciant vobis homines, et vos facite illis. Hc est enim lex, et prophet.
tr: παντα ουν οσα αν θελητε ινα ποιωσιν υμιν οι ανθρωποι ουτως και υμεις ποιειτε αυτοις ουτος γαρ εστιν ο νομος και οι προφηται
kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

vulg: intrate per angustam portam quia lata porta et spatiosa via quae ducit ad perditionem et multi sunt qui intrant per eam
clem: Intrate per angustam portam: quia lata porta, et spatiosa via est, qu ducit ad perditionem, et multi sunt qui intrant per eam.
tr: εισελθετε δια της στενης πυλης οτι πλατεια η πυλη και ευρυχωρος η οδος η απαγουσα εις την απωλειαν και πολλοι εισιν οι εισερχομενοι δι αυτης
kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

vulg: quam angusta porta et arta via quae ducit ad vitam et pauci sunt qui inveniunt eam
clem: Quam angusta porta, et arcta via est, qu ducit ad vitam: et pauci sunt qui inveniunt eam!
tr: οτι στενη η πυλη και τεθλιμμενη η οδος η απαγουσα εις την ζωην και ολιγοι εισιν οι ευρισκοντες αυτην
kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

vulg: adtendite a falsis prophetis qui veniunt ad vos in vestimentis ovium intrinsecus autem sunt lupi rapaces
clem: Attendite a falsis prophetis, qui veniunt ad vos in vestimentis ovium, intrinsecus autem sunt lupi rapaces:
tr: προσεχετε δε απο των ψευδοπροφητων οιτινες ερχονται προς υμας εν ενδυμασιν προβατων εσωθεν δε εισιν λυκοι αρπαγες
kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

vulg: a fructibus eorum cognoscetis eos numquid colligunt de spinis uvas aut de tribulis ficus
clem: a fructibus eorum cognoscetis eos. Numquid colligunt de spinas uvas, aut de tribulis ficus?
tr: απο των καρπων αυτων επιγνωσεσθε αυτους μητι συλλεγουσιν απο ακανθων σταφυλην η απο τριβολων συκα
kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

vulg: sic omnis arbor bona fructus bonos facit mala autem arbor fructus malos facit
clem: Sic omnis arbor bona fructus bonos facit: mala autem arbor malos fructus facit.
tr: ουτως παν δενδρον αγαθον καρπους καλους ποιει το δε σαπρον δενδρον καρπους πονηρους ποιει
kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

vulg: non potest arbor bona fructus malos facere neque arbor mala fructus bonos facere
clem: Non potest arbor bona malos fructus facere: neque arbor mala bonos fructus facere.
tr: ου δυναται δενδρον αγαθον καρπους πονηρους ποιειν ουδε δενδρον σαπρον καρπους καλους ποιειν
kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

vulg: omnis arbor quae non facit fructum bonum exciditur et in ignem mittitur
clem: Omnis arbor, qu non facit fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
tr: παν δενδρον μη ποιουν καρπον καλον εκκοπτεται και εις πυρ βαλλεται
kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

vulg: igitur ex fructibus eorum cognoscetis eos
clem: Igitur ex fructibus eorum cognoscetis eos.
tr: αραγε απο των καρπων αυτων επιγνωσεσθε αυτους
kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

vulg: non omnis qui dicit mihi Domine Domine intrabit in regnum caelorum sed qui facit voluntatem Patris mei qui in caelis est ipse intrabit in regnum caelorum
clem: Non omnis qui dicit mihi, Domine, Domine, intrabit in regnum clorum: sed qui facit voluntatem Patris mei, qui in clis est, ipse intrabit in regnum clorum.
tr: ου πας ο λεγων μοι κυριε κυριε εισελευσεται εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων αλλ ο ποιων το θελημα του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

vulg: multi dicent mihi in illa die Domine Domine nonne in nomine tuo prophetavimus et in tuo nomine daemonia eiecimus et in tuo nomine virtutes multas fecimus
clem: Multi dicent mihi in illa die: Domine, Domine, nonne in nomine tuo prophetavimus, et in nomine tuo dmonia ejecimus, et in nomine tuo virtutes multas fecimus?
tr: πολλοι ερουσιν μοι εν εκεινη τη ημερα κυριε κυριε ου τω σω ονοματι προεφητευσαμεν και τω σω ονοματι δαιμονια εξεβαλομεν και τω σω ονοματι δυναμεις πολλας εποιησαμεν
kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

vulg: et tunc confitebor illis quia numquam novi vos discedite a me qui operamini iniquitatem
clem: Et tunc confitebor illis: Quia numquam novi vos: discedite a me, qui operamini iniquitatem.
tr: και τοτε ομολογησω αυτοις οτι ουδεποτε εγνων υμας αποχωρειτε απ εμου οι εργαζομενοι την ανομιαν
kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

vulg: omnis ergo qui audit verba mea haec et facit ea adsimilabitur viro sapienti qui aedificavit domum suam supra petram
clem: Omnis ergo qui audit verba mea hc, et facit ea, assimilabitur viro sapienti, qui dificavit domum suam supra petram,
tr: πας ουν οστις ακουει μου τους λογους τουτους και ποιει αυτους ομοιωσω αυτον ανδρι φρονιμω οστις ωκοδομησεν την οικιαν αυτου επι την πετραν
kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

vulg: et descendit pluvia et venerunt flumina et flaverunt venti et inruerunt in domum illam et non cecidit fundata enim erat super petram
clem: et descendit pluvia, et venerunt flumina, et flaverunt venti, et irruerunt in domum illam, et non cecidit: fundata enim erat super petram.
tr: και κατεβη η βροχη και ηλθον οι ποταμοι και επνευσαν οι ανεμοι και προσεπεσον τη οικια εκεινη και ουκ επεσεν τεθεμελιωτο γαρ επι την πετραν
kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

vulg: et omnis qui audit verba mea haec et non facit ea similis erit viro stulto qui aedificavit domum suam supra harenam
clem: Et omnis qui audit verba mea hc, et non facit ea, similis erit viro stulto, qui dificavit domum suam super arenam:
tr: και πας ο ακουων μου τους λογους τουτους και μη ποιων αυτους ομοιωθησεται ανδρι μωρω οστις ωκοδομησεν την οικιαν αυτου επι την αμμον
kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

vulg: et descendit pluvia et venerunt flumina et flaverunt venti et inruerunt in domum illam et cecidit et fuit ruina eius magna
clem: et descendit pluvia, et venerunt flumina, et flaverunt venti, et irruerunt in domum illam, et cecidit, et fuit ruina illius magna.
tr: και κατεβη η βροχη και ηλθον οι ποταμοι και επνευσαν οι ανεμοι και προσεκοψαν τη οικια εκεινη και επεσεν και ην η πτωσις αυτης μεγαλη
kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

vulg: et factum est cum consummasset Iesus verba haec admirabantur turbae super doctrinam eius
clem: Et factum est: cum consummasset Jesus verba hc, admirabantur turb super doctrina ejus.
tr: και εγενετο οτε συνετελεσεν ο ιησους τους λογους τουτους εξεπλησσοντο οι οχλοι επι τη διδαχη αυτου
kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

vulg: erat enim docens eos sicut potestatem habens non sicut scribae eorum et Pharisaei
clem: Erat enim docens eos sicut potestatem habens, et non sicut scrib eorum, et pharisi.
tr: ην γαρ διδασκων αυτους ως εξουσιαν εχων και ουχ ως οι γραμματεις
kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

vulg: cum autem descendisset de monte secutae sunt eum turbae multae
clem: Cum autem descendisset de monte, secut sunt eum turb mult:
tr: καταβαντι δε αυτω απο του ορους ηκολουθησαν αυτω οχλοι πολλοι
kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

vulg: et ecce leprosus veniens adorabat eum dicens Domine si vis potes me mundare
clem: et ecce leprosus veniens, adorabat eum, dicens: Domine, si vis, potes me mundare.
tr: και ιδου λεπρος ελθων προσεκυνει αυτω λεγων κυριε εαν θελης δυνασαι με καθαρισαι
kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

vulg: et extendens manum tetigit eum Iesus dicens volo mundare et confestim mundata est lepra eius
clem: Et extendens Jesus manum, tetigit eum, dicens: Volo. Mundare. Et confestim mundata est lepra ejus.
tr: και εκτεινας την χειρα ηψατο αυτου ο ιησους λεγων θελω καθαρισθητι και ευθεως εκαθαρισθη αυτου η λεπρα
kjv: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

vulg: et ait illi Iesus vide nemini dixeris sed vade ostende te sacerdoti et offer munus quod praecepit Moses in testimonium illis
clem: Et ait illi Jesus: Vide, nemini dixeris: sed vade, ostende te sacerdoti, et offer munus, quod prcepit Moyses, in testimonium illis.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ο ιησους ορα μηδενι ειπης αλλ υπαγε σεαυτον δειξον τω ιερει και προσενεγκε το δωρον ο προσεταξεν μωσης εις μαρτυριον αυτοις
kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

vulg: cum autem introisset Capharnaum accessit ad eum centurio rogans eum
clem: Cum autem introisset Capharnaum, accessit ad eum centurio, rogans eum,
tr: εισελθοντι δε τω ιησου εις καπερναουμ προσηλθεν αυτω εκατονταρχος παρακαλων αυτον
kjv: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

vulg: et dicens Domine puer meus iacet in domo paralyticus et male torquetur
clem: et dicens: Domine, puer meus jacet in domo paralyticus, et male torquetur.
tr: και λεγων κυριε ο παις μου βεβληται εν τη οικια παραλυτικος δεινως βασανιζομενος
kjv: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

vulg: et ait illi Iesus ego veniam et curabo eum
clem: Et ait illi Jesus: Ego veniam, et curabo eum.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ο ιησους εγω ελθων θεραπευσω αυτον
kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.

vulg: et respondens centurio ait Domine non sum dignus ut intres sub tectum meum sed tantum dic verbo et sanabitur puer meus
clem: Et respondens centurio, ait: Domine, non sum dignus ut intres sub tectum meum: sed tantum dic verbo, et sanabitur puer meus.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο εκατονταρχος εφη κυριε ουκ ειμι ικανος ινα μου υπο την στεγην εισελθης αλλα μονον ειπε λογον και ιαθησεται ο παις μου
kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

vulg: nam et ego homo sum sub potestate habens sub me milites et dico huic vade et vadit et alio veni et venit et servo meo fac hoc et facit
clem: Nam et ego homo sum sub potestate constitutus, habens sub me milites, et dico huic: Vade, et vadit: et alii: Veni, et venit: et servo meo: Fac hoc, et facit.
tr: και γαρ εγω ανθρωπος ειμι υπο εξουσιαν εχων υπ εμαυτον στρατιωτας και λεγω τουτω πορευθητι και πορευεται και αλλω ερχου και ερχεται και τω δουλω μου ποιησον τουτο και ποιει
kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

vulg: audiens autem Iesus miratus est et sequentibus se dixit amen dico vobis non inveni tantam fidem in Israhel
clem: Audiens autem Jesus miratus est, et sequentibus se dixit: Amen dico vobis, non inveni tantam fidem in Isral.
tr: ακουσας δε ο ιησους εθαυμασεν και ειπεν τοις ακολουθουσιν αμην λεγω υμιν ουδε εν τω ισραηλ τοσαυτην πιστιν ευρον
kjv: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

vulg: dico autem vobis quod multi ab oriente et occidente venient et recumbent cum Abraham et Isaac et Iacob in regno caelorum
clem: Dico autem vobis, quod multi ab oriente et occidente venient, et recumbent cum Abraham, et Isaac, et Jacob in regno clorum:
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι πολλοι απο ανατολων και δυσμων ηξουσιν και ανακλιθησονται μετα αβρααμ και ισαακ και ιακωβ εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: filii autem regni eicientur in tenebras exteriores ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium
clem: filii autem regni ejicientur in tenebras exteriores: ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
tr: οι δε υιοι της βασιλειας εκβληθησονται εις το σκοτος το εξωτερον εκει εσται ο κλαυθμος και ο βρυγμος των οδοντων
kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

vulg: et dixit Iesus centurioni vade et sicut credidisti fiat tibi et sanatus est puer in hora illa
clem: Et dixit Jesus centurioni: Vade, et sicut credidisti, fiat tibi. Et sanatus est puer in illa hora.
tr: και ειπεν ο ιησους τω εκατονταρχω υπαγε και ως επιστευσας γενηθητω σοι και ιαθη ο παις αυτου εν τη ωρα εκεινη
kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

vulg: et cum venisset Iesus in domum Petri vidit socrum eius iacentem et febricitantem
clem: Et cum venisset Jesus in domum Petri, vidit socrum ejus jacentem, et febricitantem:
tr: και ελθων ο ιησους εις την οικιαν πετρου ειδεν την πενθεραν αυτου βεβλημενην και πυρεσσουσαν
kjv: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.

vulg: et tetigit manum eius et dimisit eam febris et surrexit et ministrabat eis
clem: et tetigit manum ejus, et dimisit eam febris, et surrexit, et ministrabat eis.
tr: και ηψατο της χειρος αυτης και αφηκεν αυτην ο πυρετος και ηγερθη και διηκονει αυτοις
kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

vulg: vespere autem facto obtulerunt ei multos daemonia habentes et eiciebat spiritus verbo et omnes male habentes curavit
clem: Vespere autem facto, obtulerunt ei multos dmonia habentes: et ejiciebat spiritus verbo, et omnes male habentes curavit:
tr: οψιας δε γενομενης προσηνεγκαν αυτω δαιμονιζομενους πολλους και εξεβαλεν τα πνευματα λογω και παντας τους κακως εχοντας εθεραπευσεν
kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

vulg: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Esaiam prophetam dicentem ipse infirmitates nostras accepit et aegrotationes portavit
clem: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam, dicentem: [Ipse infirmitates nostras accepit: et grotationes nostras portavit.]
tr: οπως πληρωθη το ρηθεν δια ησαιου του προφητου λεγοντος αυτος τας ασθενειας ημων ελαβεν και τας νοσους εβαστασεν
kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

vulg: videns autem Iesus turbas multas circum se iussit ire trans fretum
clem: Videns autem Jesus turbas multas circum se, jussit ire trans fretum.
tr: ιδων δε ο ιησους πολλους οχλους περι αυτον εκελευσεν απελθειν εις το περαν
kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

vulg: et accedens unus scriba ait illi magister sequar te quocumque ieris
clem: Et accedens unus scriba, ait illi: Magister, sequar te, quocumque ieris.
tr: και προσελθων εις γραμματευς ειπεν αυτω διδασκαλε ακολουθησω σοι οπου εαν απερχη
kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

vulg: et dicit ei Iesus vulpes foveas habent et volucres caeli tabernacula Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet
clem: Et dicit ei Jesus: Vulpes foveas habent, et volucres cli nidos; Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet.
tr: και λεγει αυτω ο ιησους αι αλωπεκες φωλεους εχουσιν και τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατασκηνωσεις ο δε υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ εχει που την κεφαλην κλινη
kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

vulg: alius autem de discipulis eius ait illi Domine permitte me primum ire et sepelire patrem meum
clem: Alius autem de discipulis ejus ait illi: Domine, permitte me primum ire, et sepelire patream meum.
tr: ετερος δε των μαθητων αυτου ειπεν αυτω κυριε επιτρεψον μοι πρωτον απελθειν και θαψαι τον πατερα μου
kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

vulg: Iesus autem ait illi sequere me et dimitte mortuos sepelire mortuos suos
clem: Jesus autem ait illi: Sequere me, et dimitte mortuos sepelire mortuos suos.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω ακολουθει μοι και αφες τους νεκρους θαψαι τους εαυτων νεκρους
kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

vulg: et ascendente eo in navicula secuti sunt eum discipuli eius
clem: Et ascendente eo in naviculam, secuti sunt eum discipuli ejus:
tr: και εμβαντι αυτω εις το πλοιον ηκολουθησαν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

vulg: et ecce motus magnus factus est in mari ita ut navicula operiretur fluctibus ipse vero dormiebat
clem: et ecce motus magnus factus est in mari, ita ut navicula operiretur fluctibus, ipse vero dormiebat.
tr: και ιδου σεισμος μεγας εγενετο εν τη θαλασση ωστε το πλοιον καλυπτεσθαι υπο των κυματων αυτος δε εκαθευδεν
kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

vulg: et accesserunt et suscitaverunt eum dicentes Domine salva nos perimus
clem: Et accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus, et suscitaverunt eum, dicentes: Domine, salva nos, perimus.
tr: και προσελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου ηγειραν αυτον λεγοντες κυριε σωσον ημας απολλυμεθα
kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

vulg: et dicit eis quid timidi estis modicae fidei tunc surgens imperavit ventis et mari et facta est tranquillitas magna
clem: Et dicit eis Jesus: Quid timidi estis, modic fidei? Tunc surgens imperavit ventis, et mari, et facta est tranquillitas magna.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις τι δειλοι εστε ολιγοπιστοι τοτε εγερθεις επετιμησεν τοις ανεμοις και τη θαλασση και εγενετο γαληνη μεγαλη
kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

vulg: porro homines mirati sunt dicentes qualis est hic quia et venti et mare oboediunt ei
clem: Porro homines mirati sunt, dicentes: Qualis est hic, quia venti et mare obediunt ei?
tr: οι δε ανθρωποι εθαυμασαν λεγοντες ποταπος εστιν ουτος οτι και οι ανεμοι και η θαλασσα υπακουουσιν αυτω
kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

vulg: et cum venisset trans fretum in regionem Gerasenorum occurrerunt ei duo habentes daemonia de monumentis exeuntes saevi nimis ita ut nemo posset transire per viam illam
clem: Et cum venisset trans fretum in regionem Gerasenorum, occurrerunt ei duo habentes dmonia, de monumentis exeuntes, svi nimis, ita ut nemo posset transire per viam illam.
tr: και ελθοντι αυτω εις το περαν εις την χωραν των γεργεσηνων υπηντησαν αυτω δυο δαιμονιζομενοι εκ των μνημειων εξερχομενοι χαλεποι λιαν ωστε μη ισχυειν τινα παρελθειν δια της οδου εκεινης
kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

vulg: et ecce clamaverunt dicentes quid nobis et tibi Fili Dei venisti huc ante tempus torquere nos
clem: Et ecce clamaverunt, dicentes: Quid nobis et tibi, Jesu fili Dei? Venisti huc ante tempus torquere nos?
tr: και ιδου εκραξαν λεγοντες τι ημιν και σοι ιησου υιε του θεου ηλθες ωδε προ καιρου βασανισαι ημας
kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

vulg: erat autem non longe ab illis grex porcorum multorum pascens
clem: Erat autem non longe ab illis grex multorum porcorum pascens.
tr: ην δε μακραν απ αυτων αγελη χοιρων πολλων βοσκομενη
kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

vulg: daemones autem rogabant eum dicentes si eicis nos mitte nos in gregem porcorum
clem: Dmones autem rogabant eum, dicentes: Si ejicis nos hinc, mitte nos in gregem porcorum.
tr: οι δε δαιμονες παρεκαλουν αυτον λεγοντες ει εκβαλλεις ημας επιτρεψον ημιν απελθειν εις την αγελην των χοιρων
kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

vulg: et ait illis ite at illi exeuntes abierunt in porcos et ecce impetu abiit totus grex per praeceps in mare et mortui sunt in aquis
clem: Et ait illis: Ite. At illi exeuntes abierunt in porcos, et ecce impetu abiit totus grex per prceps in mare: et mortui sunt in aquis.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις υπαγετε οι δε εξελθοντες απηλθον εις την αγελην των χοιρων και ιδου ωρμησεν πασα η αγελη των χοιρων κατα του κρημνου εις την θαλασσαν και απεθανον εν τοις υδασιν
kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

vulg: pastores autem fugerunt et venientes in civitatem nuntiaverunt omnia et de his qui daemonia habuerant
clem: Pastores autem fugerunt: et venientes in civitatem, nuntiaverunt omnia, et de eis qui dmonia habuerant.
tr: οι δε βοσκοντες εφυγον και απελθοντες εις την πολιν απηγγειλαν παντα και τα των δαιμονιζομενων
kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

vulg: et ecce tota civitas exiit obviam Iesu et viso eo rogabant ut transiret a finibus eorum
clem: Et ecce tota civitas exiit obviam Jesu: et viso eo, rogabant ut transiret a finibus eorum.
tr: και ιδου πασα η πολις εξηλθεν εις συναντησιν τω ιησου και ιδοντες αυτον παρεκαλεσαν οπως μεταβη απο των οριων αυτων
kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

vulg: et ascendens in naviculam transfretavit et venit in civitatem suam
clem: Et ascendens in naviculam, transfretavit, et venit in civitatem suam.
tr: και εμβας εις το πλοιον διεπερασεν και ηλθεν εις την ιδιαν πολιν
kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

vulg: et ecce offerebant ei paralyticum iacentem in lecto et videns Iesus fidem illorum dixit paralytico confide fili remittuntur tibi peccata tua
clem: Et ecce offerebant ei paralyticum jacentem in lecto. Et videns Jesus fidem illorum, dixit paralytico: Confide fili, remittuntur tibi peccata tua.
tr: και ιδου προσεφερον αυτω παραλυτικον επι κλινης βεβλημενον και ιδων ο ιησους την πιστιν αυτων ειπεν τω παραλυτικω θαρσει τεκνον αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι σου
kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

vulg: et ecce quidam de scribis dixerunt intra se hic blasphemat
clem: Et ecce quidam de scribis dixerunt intra se: Hic blasphemat.
tr: και ιδου τινες των γραμματεων ειπον εν εαυτοις ουτος βλασφημει
kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

vulg: et cum vidisset Iesus cogitationes eorum dixit ut quid cogitatis mala in cordibus vestris
clem: Et cum vidisset Jesus cogitationes eorum, dixit: Ut quid cogitatis mala in cordibus vestris?
tr: και ιδων ο ιησους τας ενθυμησεις αυτων ειπεν ινα τι υμεις ενθυμεισθε πονηρα εν ταις καρδιαις υμων
kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

vulg: quid est facilius dicere dimittuntur tibi peccata aut dicere surge et ambula
clem: Quid est facilius dicere: Dimittuntur tibi peccata tua: an dicere: Surge, et ambula?
tr: τι γαρ εστιν ευκοπωτερον ειπειν αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι η ειπειν εγειραι και περιπατει
kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

vulg: ut sciatis autem quoniam Filius hominis habet potestatem in terra dimittendi peccata tunc ait paralytico surge tolle lectum tuum et vade in domum tuam
clem: Ut autem sciatis, quia Filius hominis habet potestatem in terra dimittendi peccata, tunc ait paralytico: Surge, tolle lectum tuum, et vade in domum tuam.
tr: ινα δε ειδητε οτι εξουσιαν εχει ο υιος του ανθρωπου επι της γης αφιεναι αμαρτιας τοτε λεγει τω παραλυτικω εγερθεις αρον σου την κλινην και υπαγε εις τον οικον σου
kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

vulg: et surrexit et abiit in domum suam
clem: Et surrexit, et abiit in domum suam.
tr: και εγερθεις απηλθεν εις τον οικον αυτου
kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.

vulg: videntes autem turbae timuerunt et glorificaverunt Deum qui dedit potestatem talem hominibus
clem: Videntes autem turb timuerunt, et glorificaverunt Deum, qui dedit potestatem talem hominibus.
tr: ιδοντες δε οι οχλοι εθαυμασαν και εδοξασαν τον θεον τον δοντα εξουσιαν τοιαυτην τοις ανθρωποις
kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

vulg: et cum transiret inde Iesus vidit hominem sedentem in teloneo Mattheum nomine et ait illi sequere me et surgens secutus est eum
clem: Et, cum transiret inde Jesus, vidit hominem sedentem in telonio, Matthum nomine. Et ait illi: Sequere me. Et surgens, secutus est eum.
tr: και παραγων ο ιησους εκειθεν ειδεν ανθρωπον καθημενον επι το τελωνιον ματθαιον λεγομενον και λεγει αυτω ακολουθει μοι και αναστας ηκολουθησεν αυτω
kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

vulg: et factum est discumbente eo in domo ecce multi publicani et peccatores venientes discumbebant cum Iesu et discipulis eius
clem: Et factum est, discumbente eo in domo, ecce multi publicani et peccatores venientes, discumbebant cum Jesu, et discipulis ejus.
tr: και εγενετο αυτου ανακειμενου εν τη οικια και ιδου πολλοι τελωναι και αμαρτωλοι ελθοντες συνανεκειντο τω ιησου και τοις μαθηταις αυτου
kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

vulg: et videntes Pharisaei dicebant discipulis eius quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducat magister vester
clem: Et videntes pharisi, dicebant discipulis ejus: Quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducat magister vester?
tr: και ιδοντες οι φαρισαιοι ειπον τοις μαθηταις αυτου δια τι μετα των τελωνων και αμαρτωλων εσθιει ο διδασκαλος υμων
kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

vulg: at Iesus audiens ait non est opus valentibus medico sed male habentibus
clem: At Jesus audiens, ait: Non est opus valentibus medicus, sed male habentibus.
tr: ο δε ιησους ακουσας ειπεν αυτοις ου χρειαν εχουσιν οι ισχυοντες ιατρου αλλ οι κακως εχοντες
kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

vulg: euntes autem discite quid est misericordiam volo et non sacrificium non enim veni vocare iustos sed peccatores
clem: Euntes autem discite quid est: Misericordiam volo, et non sacrificium. Non enim veni vocare justos, sed peccatores.
tr: πορευθεντες δε μαθετε τι εστιν ελεον θελω και ου θυσιαν ου γαρ ηλθον καλεσαι δικαιους αλλ αμαρτωλους εις μετανοιαν
kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

vulg: tunc accesserunt ad eum discipuli Iohannis dicentes quare nos et Pharisaei ieiunamus frequenter discipuli autem tui non ieiunant
clem: Tunc accesserunt ad eum discipuli Joannis, dicentes: Quare nos, et pharisi, jejunamus frequenter: discipuli autem tui non jejunant?
tr: τοτε προσερχονται αυτω οι μαθηται ιωαννου λεγοντες δια τι ημεις και οι φαρισαιοι νηστευομεν πολλα οι δε μαθηται σου ου νηστευουσιν
kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

vulg: et ait illis Iesus numquid possunt filii sponsi lugere quamdiu cum illis est sponsus venient autem dies cum auferetur ab eis sponsus et tunc ieiunabunt
clem: Et ait illis Jesus: Numquid possunt filii sponsi lugere, quamdiu cum illis est sponsus? Venient autem dies cum auferetur ab eis sponsus: et tunc jejunabunt.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους μη δυνανται οι υιοι του νυμφωνος πενθειν εφ οσον μετ αυτων εστιν ο νυμφιος ελευσονται δε ημεραι οταν απαρθη απ αυτων ο νυμφιος και τοτε νηστευσουσιν
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

vulg: nemo autem inmittit commissuram panni rudis in vestimentum vetus tollit enim plenitudinem eius a vestimento et peior scissura fit
clem: Nemo autem immittit commissuram panni rudis in vestimentum vetus: tollit enim plenitudinem ejus a vestimento, et pejor scissura fit.
tr: ουδεις δε επιβαλλει επιβλημα ρακους αγναφου επι ιματιω παλαιω αιρει γαρ το πληρωμα αυτου απο του ιματιου και χειρον σχισμα γινεται
kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

vulg: neque mittunt vinum novum in utres veteres alioquin rumpuntur utres et vinum effunditur et utres pereunt sed vinum novum in utres novos mittunt et ambo conservantur
clem: Neque mittunt vinum novum in utres veteres: alioquin rumpuntur utres, et vinum effunditur, et utres pereunt. Sed vinum novum in utres novos mittunt: et ambo conservantur.
tr: ουδε βαλλουσιν οινον νεον εις ασκους παλαιους ει δε μηγε ρηγνυνται οι ασκοι και ο οινος εκχειται και οι ασκοι απολουνται αλλα βαλλουσιν οινον νεον εις ασκους καινους και αμφοτερα συντηρουνται
kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

vulg: haec illo loquente ad eos ecce princeps unus accessit et adorabat eum dicens filia mea modo defuncta est sed veni inpone manum super eam et vivet
clem: Hc illo loquente ad eos, ecce princeps unus accessit, et adorabat eum, dicens: Domine, filia mea modo defuncta est: sed veni, impone manum tuam super eam, et vivet.
tr: ταυτα αυτου λαλουντος αυτοις ιδου αρχων  εις  ελθων προσεκυνει αυτω λεγων οτι η θυγατηρ μου αρτι ετελευτησεν αλλα ελθων επιθες την χειρα σου επ αυτην και ζησεται
kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

vulg: et surgens Iesus sequebatur eum et discipuli eius
clem: Et surgens Jesus, sequebatur eum, et discipuli ejus.
tr: και εγερθεις ο ιησους ηκολουθησεν αυτω και οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

vulg: et ecce mulier quae sanguinis fluxum patiebatur duodecim annis accessit retro et tetigit fimbriam vestimenti eius
clem: Et ecce mulier, qu sanguinis fluxum patiebatur duodecim annis, accessit retro, et tetigit fimbriam vestimenti ejus.
tr: και ιδου γυνη αιμορροουσα δωδεκα ετη προσελθουσα οπισθεν ηψατο του κρασπεδου του ιματιου αυτου
kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

vulg: dicebat enim intra se si tetigero tantum vestimentum eius salva ero
clem: Dicebat enim intra se: Si tetigero tantum vestimentum ejus, salva ero.
tr: ελεγεν γαρ εν εαυτη εαν μονον αψωμαι του ιματιου αυτου σωθησομαι
kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

vulg: at Iesus conversus et videns eam dixit confide filia fides tua te salvam fecit et salva facta est mulier ex illa hora
clem: At Jesus conversus, et videns eam, dixit: Confide, filia, fides tua te salvam fecit. Et salva facta est mulier ex illa hora.
tr: ο δε ιησους επιστραφεις και ιδων αυτην ειπεν θαρσει θυγατερ η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε και εσωθη η γυνη απο της ωρας εκεινης
kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

vulg: et cum venisset Iesus in domum principis et vidisset tibicines et turbam tumultuantem
clem: Et cum venisset Jesus in domum principis, et vidisset tibicines et turbam tumultuantem, dicebat:
tr: και ελθων ο ιησους εις την οικιαν του αρχοντος και ιδων τους αυλητας και τον οχλον θορυβουμενον
kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

vulg: dicebat recedite non est enim mortua puella sed dormit et deridebant eum
clem: Recedite: non est enim mortua puella, sed dormit. Et deridebant eum.
tr: λεγει αυτοις αναχωρειτε ου γαρ απεθανεν το κορασιον αλλα καθευδει και κατεγελων αυτου
kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

vulg: et cum eiecta esset turba intravit et tenuit manum eius et surrexit puella
clem: Et cum ejecta esset turba, intravit: et tenuit manum ejus, et surrexit puella.
tr: οτε δε εξεβληθη ο οχλος εισελθων εκρατησεν της χειρος αυτης και ηγερθη το κορασιον
kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

vulg: et exiit fama haec in universam terram illam
clem: Et exiit fama hc in universam terram illam.
tr: και εξηλθεν η φημη αυτη εις ολην την γην εκεινην
kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

vulg: et transeunte inde Iesu secuti sunt eum duo caeci clamantes et dicentes miserere nostri Fili David
clem: Et transeunte inde Jesu, secuti sunt eum duo cci, clamantes, et dicentes: Miserere nostri, fili David.
tr: και παραγοντι εκειθεν τω ιησου ηκολουθησαν αυτω δυο τυφλοι κραζοντες και λεγοντες ελεησον ημας υιε δαβιδ
kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.

vulg: cum autem venisset domum accesserunt ad eum caeci et dicit eis Iesus creditis quia possum hoc facere vobis dicunt ei utique Domine
clem: Cum autem venisset domum, accesserunt ad eum cci. Et dicit eis Jesus: Creditis quia hoc possum facere vobis? Dicunt ei: Utique, Domine.
tr: ελθοντι δε εις την οικιαν προσηλθον αυτω οι τυφλοι και λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους πιστευετε οτι δυναμαι τουτο ποιησαι λεγουσιν αυτω ναι κυριε
kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

vulg: tunc tetigit oculos eorum dicens secundum fidem vestram fiat vobis
clem: Tunc tetigit oculos eorum, dicens: Secundum fidem vestram, fiat vobis.
tr: τοτε ηψατο των οφθαλμων αυτων λεγων κατα την πιστιν υμων γενηθητω υμιν
kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

vulg: et aperti sunt oculi illorum et comminatus est illis Iesus dicens videte ne quis sciat
clem: Et aperti sunt oculi eorum: et comminatus est illis Jesus, dicens: Videte ne quis sciat.
tr: και ανεωχθησαν αυτων οι οφθαλμοι και ενεβριμησατο αυτοις ο ιησους λεγων ορατε μηδεις γινωσκετω
kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

vulg: illi autem exeuntes diffamaverunt eum in tota terra illa
clem: Illi autem exeuntes, diffamaverunt eum in tota terra illa.
tr: οι δε εξελθοντες διεφημισαν αυτον εν ολη τη γη εκεινη
kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

vulg: egressis autem illis ecce obtulerunt ei hominem mutum daemonium habentem
clem: Egressis autem illis, ecce obtulerunt ei hominem mutum, dmonium habentem.
tr: αυτων δε εξερχομενων ιδου προσηνεγκαν αυτω ανθρωπον κωφον δαιμονιζομενον
kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

vulg: et eiecto daemone locutus est mutus et miratae sunt turbae dicentes numquam paruit sic in Israhel
clem: Et ejecto dmonio, locutus est mutus, et mirat sunt turb, dicentes: Numquam apparuit sic in Isral.
tr: και εκβληθεντος του δαιμονιου ελαλησεν ο κωφος και εθαυμασαν οι οχλοι λεγοντες οτι   ουδεποτε εφανη ουτως εν τω ισραηλ
kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

vulg: Pharisaei autem dicebant in principe daemoniorum eicit daemones
clem: Pharisi autem dicebant: In principe dmoniorum ejicit dmones.
tr: οι δε φαρισαιοι ελεγον εν τω αρχοντι των δαιμονιων εκβαλλει τα δαιμονια
kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

vulg: et circumibat Iesus civitates omnes et castella docens in synagogis eorum et praedicans evangelium regni et curans omnem languorem et omnem infirmitatem
clem: Et circuibat Jesus omnes civitates, et castella, docens in synagogis eorum, et prdicans Evangelium regni, et curans omnem languorem, et omnem infirmitatem.
tr: και περιηγεν ο ιησους τας πολεις πασας και τας κωμας διδασκων εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων και κηρυσσων το ευαγγελιον της βασιλειας και θεραπευων πασαν νοσον και πασαν μαλακιαν εν τω λαω
kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

vulg: videns autem turbas misertus est eis quia erant vexati et iacentes sicut oves non habentes pastorem
clem: Videns autem turbas, misertus est eis: quia erant vexati, et jacentes sicut oves non habentes pastorem.
tr: ιδων δε τους οχλους εσπλαγχνισθη περι αυτων οτι ησαν εκλελυμενοι και ερριμμενοι ωσει προβατα μη εχοντα ποιμενα
kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

vulg: tunc dicit discipulis suis messis quidem multa operarii autem pauci
clem: Tunc dicit discipulis suis: Messis quidem multa, operarii autem pauci.
tr: τοτε λεγει τοις μαθηταις αυτου ο μεν θερισμος πολυς οι δε εργαται ολιγοι
kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

vulg: rogate ergo dominum messis ut eiciat operarios in messem suam
clem: Rogate ergo Dominum messis, ut mittat operarios in messem suam.
tr: δεηθητε ουν του κυριου του θερισμου οπως εκβαλη εργατας εις τον θερισμον αυτου
kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

vulg: et convocatis duodecim discipulis suis dedit illis potestatem spirituum inmundorum ut eicerent eos et curarent omnem languorem et omnem infirmitatem
clem: Et convocatis duodecim discipulis suis, dedit illis potestatem spirituum immundorum, ut ejicerent eos, et curarent omnem languorem, et omnem infirmitatem.
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος τους δωδεκα μαθητας αυτου εδωκεν αυτοις εξουσιαν πνευματων ακαθαρτων ωστε εκβαλλειν αυτα και θεραπευειν πασαν νοσον και πασαν μαλακιαν
kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

vulg: duodecim autem apostolorum nomina sunt haec primus Simon qui dicitur Petrus et Andreas frater eius
clem: Duodecim autem Apostolorum nomina sunt hc. Primus, Simon, qui dicitur Petrus: et Andreas frater ejus,
tr: των δε δωδεκα αποστολων τα ονοματα εστιν ταυτα πρωτος σιμων ο λεγομενος πετρος και ανδρεας ο αδελφος αυτου ιακωβος ο του ζεβεδαιου και ιωαννης ο αδελφος αυτου
kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

vulg: Iacobus Zebedaei et Iohannes frater eius Philippus et Bartholomeus Thomas et Mattheus publicanus et Iacobus Alphei et Thaddeus
clem: Jacobus Zebedi, et Joannes frater ejus, Philippus, et Bartholomus, Thomas, et Matthus publicanus, Jacobus Alphi, et Thaddus,
tr: φιλιππος και βαρθολομαιος θωμας και ματθαιος ο τελωνης ιακωβος ο του αλφαιου και λεββαιος ο επικληθεις θαδδαιος
kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

vulg: Simon Cananeus et Iudas Scariotes qui et tradidit eum
clem: Simon Chananus, et Judas Iscariotes, qui et tradidit eum.
tr: σιμων ο κανανιτης και ιουδας ισκαριωτης ο και παραδους αυτον
kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

vulg: hos duodecim misit Iesus praecipiens eis et dicens in viam gentium ne abieritis et in civitates Samaritanorum ne intraveritis
clem: Hos duodecim misit Jesus, prcipiens eis, dicens: In viam gentium ne abieritis, et in civitates Samaritanorum ne intraveritis:
tr: τουτους τους δωδεκα απεστειλεν ο ιησους παραγγειλας αυτοις λεγων εις οδον εθνων μη απελθητε και εις πολιν σαμαρειτων μη εισελθητε
kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:

vulg: sed potius ite ad oves quae perierunt domus Israhel
clem: sed potius ite ad oves qu perierunt domus Isral.
tr: πορευεσθε δε μαλλον προς τα προβατα τα απολωλοτα οικου ισραηλ
kjv: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

vulg: euntes autem praedicate dicentes quia adpropinquavit regnum caelorum
clem: Euntes autem prdicate, dicentes: Quia appropinquavit regnum clorum.
tr: πορευομενοι δε κηρυσσετε λεγοντες οτι ηγγικεν η βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

vulg: infirmos curate mortuos suscitate leprosos mundate daemones eicite gratis accepistis gratis date
clem: Infirmos curate, mortuos suscitate, leprosos mundate, dmones ejicite: gratis accepistis, gratis date.
tr: ασθενουντας θεραπευετε λεπρους καθαριζετε νεκρους εγειρετε δαιμονια εκβαλλετε δωρεαν ελαβετε δωρεαν δοτε
kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

vulg: nolite possidere aurum neque argentum neque pecuniam in zonis vestris
clem: Nolite possidere aurum, neque argentum, neque pecuniam in zonis vestris:
tr: μη κτησησθε χρυσον μηδε αργυρον μηδε χαλκον εις τας ζωνας υμων
kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

vulg: non peram in via neque duas tunicas neque calciamenta neque virgam dignus enim est operarius cibo suo
clem: non peram in via, neque duas tunicas, neque calceamenta, neque virgam: dignus enim est operarius cibo suo.
tr: μη πηραν εις οδον μηδε δυο χιτωνας μηδε υποδηματα μηδε ραβδον  ραβδους  αξιος γαρ ο εργατης της τροφης αυτου εστιν
kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

vulg: in quamcumque civitatem aut castellum intraveritis interrogate quis in ea dignus sit et ibi manete donec exeatis
clem: In quamcumque autem civitatem aut castellum intraveritis, interrogate, quis in ea dignus sit: et ibi manete donec exeatis.
tr: εις ην δ αν πολιν η κωμην εισελθητε εξετασατε τις εν αυτη αξιος εστιν κακει μεινατε εως αν εξελθητε
kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

vulg: intrantes autem in domum salutate eam
clem: Intrantes autem in domum, salutate eam, dicentes: Pax huic domui.
tr: εισερχομενοι δε εις την οικιαν ασπασασθε αυτην
kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.

vulg: et siquidem fuerit domus digna veniat pax vestra super eam si autem non fuerit digna pax vestra ad vos revertatur
clem: Et siquidem fuerit domus illa digna, veniet pax vestra super eam: si autem non fuerit digna, pax vestra revertetur ad vos.
tr: και εαν μεν η η οικια αξια ελθετω η ειρηνη υμων επ αυτην εαν δε μη η αξια η ειρηνη υμων προς υμας επιστραφητω
kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

vulg: et quicumque non receperit vos neque audierit sermones vestros exeuntes foras de domo vel de civitate excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris
clem: Et quicumque non receperit vos, neque audierit sermones vestros: exeunte foras de domo, vel civitate, excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris.
tr: και ος εαν μη δεξηται υμας μηδε ακουση τους λογους υμων εξερχομενοι της οικιας η της πολεως εκεινης εκτιναξατε τον κονιορτον των ποδων υμων
kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

vulg: amen dico vobis tolerabilius erit terrae Sodomorum et Gomorraeorum in die iudicii quam illi civitati
clem: Amen dico vobis: Tolerabilius erit terr Sodomorum et Gomorrhorum in die judicii, quam illi civitati.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν ανεκτοτερον εσται γη σοδομων και γομορρων εν ημερα κρισεως η τη πολει εκεινη
kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

vulg: ecce ego mitto vos sicut oves in medio luporum estote ergo prudentes sicut serpentes et simplices sicut columbae
clem: Ecce ego mitto vos sicut oves in medio luporum. Estote ergo prudentes sicut serpentes, et simplices sicut columb.
tr: ιδου εγω αποστελλω υμας ως προβατα εν μεσω λυκων γινεσθε ουν φρονιμοι ως οι οφεις και ακεραιοι ως αι περιστεραι
kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

vulg: cavete autem ab hominibus tradent enim vos in conciliis et in synagogis suis flagellabunt vos
clem: Cavete autem ab hominibus. Tradent enim vos in conciliis, et in synagogis suis flagellabunt vos:
tr: προσεχετε δε απο των ανθρωπων παραδωσουσιν γαρ υμας εις συνεδρια και εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων μαστιγωσουσιν υμας
kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

vulg: et ad praesides et ad reges ducemini propter me in testimonium illis et gentibus
clem: et ad prsides, et ad reges ducemini propter me in testimonium illis, et gentibus.
tr: και επι ηγεμονας δε και βασιλεις αχθησεσθε ενεκεν εμου εις μαρτυριον αυτοις και τοις εθνεσιν
kjv: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

vulg: cum autem tradent vos nolite cogitare quomodo aut quid loquamini dabitur enim vobis in illa hora quid loquamini
clem: Cum autem tradent vos, nolite cogitare quomodo, aut quid loquamini: dabitur enim vobis in illa hora, quid loquamini:
tr: οταν δε παραδιδωσιν υμας μη μεριμνησητε πως η τι λαλησητε δοθησεται γαρ υμιν εν εκεινη τη ωρα τι λαλησετε
kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

vulg: non enim vos estis qui loquimini sed Spiritus Patris vestri qui loquitur in vobis
clem: non enim vos estis qui loquimini, sed Spiritus Patris vestri, qui loquitur in vobis.
tr: ου γαρ υμεις εστε οι λαλουντες αλλα το πνευμα του πατρος υμων το λαλουν εν υμιν
kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

vulg: tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem et pater filium et insurgent filii in parentes et morte eos adficient
clem: Tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem, et pater filium: et insurgent filii in parentes, et morte eos afficient:
tr: παραδωσει δε αδελφος αδελφον εις θανατον και πατηρ τεκνον και επαναστησονται τεκνα επι γονεις και θανατωσουσιν αυτους
kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

vulg: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum qui autem perseveraverit in finem hic salvus erit
clem: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum: qui autem perseveraverit usque in finem, hic salvus erit.
tr: και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων δια το ονομα μου ο δε υπομεινας εις τελος ουτος σωθησεται
kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

vulg: cum autem persequentur vos in civitate ista fugite in aliam amen enim dico vobis non consummabitis civitates Israhel donec veniat Filius hominis
clem: Cum autem persequentur vos in civitate ista, fugite in aliam. Amen dico vobis, non consummabitis civitates Isral, donec veniat Filius hominis.
tr: οταν δε διωκωσιν υμας εν τη πολει ταυτη φευγετε εις την αλλην αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν ου μη τελεσητε τας πολεις του ισραηλ εως αν ελθη ο υιος του ανθρωπου
kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.

vulg: non est discipulus super magistrum nec servus super dominum suum
clem: Non est discipulus super magistrum, nec servus super dominum suum:
tr: ουκ εστιν μαθητης υπερ τον διδασκαλον ουδε δουλος υπερ τον κυριον αυτου
kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

vulg: sufficit discipulo ut sit sicut magister eius et servus sicut dominus eius si patrem familias Beelzebub vocaverunt quanto magis domesticos eius
clem: sufficit discipulo ut sit sicut magister ejus, et servo, sicut dominus ejus. Si patremfamilias Beelzebub vocaverunt, quanto magis domesticos ejus?
tr: αρκετον τω μαθητη ινα γενηται ως ο διδασκαλος αυτου και ο δουλος ως ο κυριος αυτου ει τον οικοδεσποτην βεελζεβουλ  βεελζεβουβ  εκαλεσαν ποσω μαλλον τους οικιακους αυτου
kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

vulg: ne ergo timueritis eos nihil enim opertum quod non revelabitur et occultum quod non scietur
clem: Ne ergo timueritis eos. Nihil enim est opertum, quod non revelabitur: et occultum, quod non scietur.
tr: μη ουν φοβηθητε αυτους ουδεν γαρ εστιν κεκαλυμμενον ο ουκ αποκαλυφθησεται και κρυπτον ο ου γνωσθησεται
kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

vulg: quod dico vobis in tenebris dicite in lumine et quod in aure auditis praedicate super tecta
clem: Quod dico vobis in tenebris, dicite in lumine: et quod in aure auditis, prdicate super tecta.
tr: ο λεγω υμιν εν τη σκοτια ειπατε εν τω φωτι και ο εις το ους ακουετε κηρυξατε επι των δωματων
kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

vulg: et nolite timere eos qui occidunt corpus animam autem non possunt occidere sed potius eum timete qui potest et animam et corpus perdere in gehennam
clem: Et nolite timere eos qui occidunt corpus, animam autem non possunt occidere: sed potius timete eum, qui potest et animam et corpus perdere in gehennam.
tr: και μη φοβηθητε απο των αποκτεινοντων το σωμα την δε ψυχην μη δυναμενων αποκτειναι φοβηθητε δε μαλλον τον δυναμενον και ψυχην και σωμα απολεσαι εν γεεννη
kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

vulg: nonne duo passeres asse veneunt et unus ex illis non cadet super terram sine Patre vestro
clem: Nonne duo passeres asse veneunt? et unus ex illis non cadet super terram sine Patre vestro.
tr: ουχι δυο στρουθια ασσαριου πωλειται και εν εξ αυτων ου πεσειται επι την γην ανευ του πατρος υμων
kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

vulg: vestri autem et capilli capitis omnes numerati sunt
clem: Vestri autem capilli capitis omnes numerati sunt.
tr: υμων δε και αι τριχες της κεφαλης πασαι ηριθμημεναι εισιν
kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

vulg: nolite ergo timere multis passeribus meliores estis vos
clem: Nolite ergo timere: multis passeribus meliores estis vos.
tr: μη ουν φοβηθητε πολλων στρουθιων διαφερετε υμεις
kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

vulg: omnis ergo qui confitebitur me coram hominibus confitebor et ego eum coram Patre meo qui est in caelis
clem: Omnis ergo qui confitebitur me coram hominibus, confitebor et ego eum coram Patre meo, qui in clis est.
tr: πας ουν οστις ομολογησει εν εμοι εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων ομολογησω καγω εν αυτω εμπροσθεν του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

vulg: qui autem negaverit me coram hominibus negabo et ego eum coram Patre meo qui est in caelis
clem: Qui autem negaverit me coram hominibus, negabo et ego eum coram Patre meo, qui in clis est.
tr: οστις δ αν αρνησηται με εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων αρνησομαι αυτον καγω εμπροσθεν του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

vulg: nolite arbitrari quia venerim mittere pacem in terram non veni pacem mittere sed gladium
clem: Nolite arbitrari quia pacem venerim mittere in terram: non veni pacem mittere, sed gladium:
tr: μη νομισητε οτι ηλθον βαλειν ειρηνην επι την γην ουκ ηλθον βαλειν ειρηνην αλλα μαχαιραν
kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

vulg: veni enim separare hominem adversus patrem suum et filiam adversus matrem suam et nurum adversus socrum suam
clem: veni enim separare hominem adversus patrem suum, et filiam adversus matrem suam, et nurum adversus socrum suam:
tr: ηλθον γαρ διχασαι ανθρωπον κατα του πατρος αυτου και θυγατερα κατα της μητρος αυτης και νυμφην κατα της πενθερας αυτης
kjv: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

vulg: et inimici hominis domestici eius
clem: et inimici hominis, domestici ejus.
tr: και εχθροι του ανθρωπου οι οικιακοι αυτου
kjv: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

vulg: qui amat patrem aut matrem plus quam me non est me dignus et qui amat filium aut filiam super me non est me dignus
clem: Qui amat patrem aut matrem plus quam me, non est me dignus: et qui amat filium aut filiam super me, non est me dignus.
tr: ο φιλων πατερα η μητερα υπερ εμε ουκ εστιν μου αξιος και ο φιλων υιον η θυγατερα υπερ εμε ουκ εστιν μου αξιος
kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

vulg: et qui non accipit crucem suam et sequitur me non est me dignus
clem: Et qui non accipit crucem suam, et sequitur me, non est me dignus.
tr: και ος ου λαμβανει τον σταυρον αυτου και ακολουθει οπισω μου ουκ εστιν μου αξιος
kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

vulg: qui invenit animam suam perdet illam et qui perdiderit animam suam propter me inveniet eam
clem: Qui invenit animam suam, perdet illam: et qui perdiderit animan suam propter me, inveniet eam.
tr: ο ευρων την ψυχην αυτου απολεσει αυτην και ο απολεσας την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου ευρησει αυτην
kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

vulg: qui recipit vos me recipit et qui me recipit recipit eum qui me misit
clem: Qui recipit vos, me recipit: et qui me recipit, recipit eum qui me misit.
tr: ο δεχομενος υμας εμε δεχεται και ο εμε δεχομενος δεχεται τον αποστειλαντα με
kjv: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

vulg: qui recipit prophetam in nomine prophetae mercedem prophetae accipiet et qui recipit iustum in nomine iusti mercedem iusti accipiet
clem: Qui recipit prophetam in nomine prophet, mercedem prophet accipiet: et qui recipit justum in nomine justi, mercedem justi accipiet.
tr: ο δεχομενος προφητην εις ονομα προφητου μισθον προφητου ληψεται και ο δεχομενος δικαιον εις ονομα δικαιου μισθον δικαιου ληψεται
kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

vulg: et quicumque potum dederit uni ex minimis istis calicem aquae frigidae tantum in nomine discipuli amen dico vobis non perdet mercedem suam
clem: Et quicumque potum dederit uni ex minimis istis calicem aqu frigid tantum in nomine discipuli: amen dico vobis, non perdet mercedem suam.
tr: και ος εαν ποτιση ενα των μικρων τουτων ποτηριον ψυχρου μονον εις ονομα μαθητου αμην λεγω υμιν ου μη απολεση τον μισθον αυτου
kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

vulg: et factum est cum consummasset Iesus praecipiens duodecim discipulis suis transiit inde ut doceret et praedicaret in civitatibus eorum
clem: Et factum est, cum consummasset Jesus, prcipiens duodecim discipulis suis, transiit inde ut doceret, et prdicaret in civitatibus eorum.
tr: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους διατασσων τοις δωδεκα μαθηταις αυτου μετεβη εκειθεν του διδασκειν και κηρυσσειν εν ταις πολεσιν αυτων
kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

vulg: Iohannes autem cum audisset in vinculis opera Christi mittens duos de discipulis suis
clem: Joannes autem cum audisset in vinculis opera Christi, mittens duos de discipulis suis,
tr: ο δε ιωαννης ακουσας εν τω δεσμωτηριω τα εργα του χριστου πεμψας δυο των μαθητων αυτου
kjv: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

vulg: ait illi tu es qui venturus es an alium expectamus
clem: ait illi: Tu es, qui venturus es, an alium exspectamus?
tr: ειπεν αυτω συ ει ο ερχομενος η ετερον προσδοκωμεν
kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

vulg: et respondens Iesus ait illis euntes renuntiate Iohanni quae auditis et videtis
clem: Et respondens Jesus ait illis: Euntes renuntiate Joanni qu audistis, et vidistis.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις πορευθεντες απαγγειλατε ιωαννη α ακουετε και βλεπετε
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:

vulg: caeci vident claudi ambulant leprosi mundantur surdi audiunt mortui resurgunt pauperes evangelizantur
clem: Cci vident, claudi ambulant, leprosi mundantur, surdi audiunt, mortui resurgunt, pauperes evangelizantur:
tr: τυφλοι αναβλεπουσιν και χωλοι περιπατουσιν λεπροι καθαριζονται και κωφοι ακουουσιν νεκροι εγειρονται και πτωχοι ευαγγελιζονται
kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

vulg: et beatus est qui non fuerit scandalizatus in me
clem: et beatus est, qui non fuerit scandalizatus in me.
tr: και μακαριος εστιν ος εαν μη σκανδαλισθη εν εμοι
kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

vulg: illis autem abeuntibus coepit Iesus dicere ad turbas de Iohanne quid existis in desertum videre harundinem vento agitatam
clem: Illis autem abeuntibus, cpit Jesus dicere ad turbas de Joanne: Quid existis in desertum videre? arundinem vento agitatem?
tr: τουτων δε πορευομενων ηρξατο ο ιησους λεγειν τοις οχλοις περι ιωαννου τι εξηλθετε εις την ερημον θεασασθαι καλαμον υπο ανεμου σαλευομενον
kjv: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

vulg: sed quid existis videre hominem mollibus vestitum ecce qui mollibus vestiuntur in domibus regum sunt
clem: Sed quid existis videre? hominem mollibus vestitum? Ecce qui mollibus vestiuntur, in domibus regum sunt.
tr: αλλα τι εξηλθετε ιδειν ανθρωπον εν μαλακοις ιματιοις ημφιεσμενον ιδου οι τα μαλακα φορουντες εν τοις οικοις των βασιλεων εισιν
kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

vulg: sed quid existis videre prophetam etiam dico vobis et plus quam prophetam
clem: Sed quid existis videre? prophetam? Etiam dico vobis, et plus quam prophetam.
tr: αλλα τι εξηλθετε ιδειν προφητην ναι λεγω υμιν και περισσοτερον προφητου
kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

vulg: hic enim est de quo scriptum est ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam qui praeparabit viam tuam ante te
clem: Hic est enim de quo scriptum est: Ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam, qui prparabit viam tuam ante te.
tr: ουτος γαρ εστιν περι ου γεγραπται ιδου εγω αποστελλω τον αγγελον μου προ προσωπου σου ος κατασκευασει την οδον σου εμπροσθεν σου
kjv: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

vulg: amen dico vobis non surrexit inter natos mulierum maior Iohanne Baptista qui autem minor est in regno caelorum maior est illo
clem: Amen dico vobis, non surrexit inter natos mulierum major Joanne Baptista: qui autem minor est in regno clorum, major est illo.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν ουκ εγηγερται εν γεννητοις γυναικων μειζων ιωαννου του βαπτιστου ο δε μικροτερος εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων μειζων αυτου εστιν
kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

vulg: a diebus autem Iohannis Baptistae usque nunc regnum caelorum vim patitur et violenti rapiunt illud
clem: A diebus autem Joannis Baptist usque nunc, regnum clorum vim patitur, et violenti rapiunt illud.
tr: απο δε των ημερων ιωαννου του βαπτιστου εως αρτι η βασιλεια των ουρανων βιαζεται και βιασται αρπαζουσιν αυτην
kjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

vulg: omnes enim prophetae et lex usque ad Iohannem prophetaverunt
clem: Omnes enim prophet et lex usque ad Joannem prophetaverunt:
tr: παντες γαρ οι προφηται και ο νομος εως ιωαννου προεφητευσαν
kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

vulg: et si vultis recipere ipse est Helias qui venturus est
clem: et si vultis recipere, ipse est Elias, qui venturus est.
tr: και ει θελετε δεξασθαι αυτος εστιν ηλιας ο μελλων ερχεσθαι
kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

vulg: qui habet aures audiendi audiat
clem: Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: ο εχων ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: cui autem similem aestimabo generationem istam similis est pueris sedentibus in foro qui clamantes coaequalibus
clem: Cui autem similem stimabo generationem istam? Similis est pueris sedentibus in foro: qui clamantes coqualibus
tr: τινι δε ομοιωσω την γενεαν ταυτην ομοια εστιν παιδαριοις εν αγοραις καθημενοις και προσφωνουσιν τοις εταιροις αυτων
kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

vulg: dicunt cecinimus vobis et non saltastis lamentavimus et non planxistis
clem: dicunt: Cecinimus vobis, et non saltastis: lamentavimus, et non planxistis.
tr: και λεγουσιν ηυλησαμεν υμιν και ουκ ωρχησασθε εθρηνησαμεν υμιν και ουκ εκοψασθε
kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

vulg: venit enim Iohannes neque manducans neque bibens et dicunt daemonium habet
clem: Venit enim Joannes neque manducans, neque bibens, et dicunt: Dmonium habet.
tr: ηλθεν γαρ ιωαννης μητε εσθιων μητε πινων και λεγουσιν δαιμονιον εχει
kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

vulg: venit Filius hominis manducans et bibens et dicunt ecce homo vorax et potator vini publicanorum et peccatorum amicus et iustificata est sapientia a filiis suis
clem: Venit Filius hominis manducans, et bibens, et dicunt: Ecce homo vorax, et potator vini, publicanorum et peccatorum amicus. Et justificata est sapientia a filiis suis.
tr: ηλθεν ο υιος του ανθρωπου εσθιων και πινων και λεγουσιν ιδου ανθρωπος φαγος και οινοποτης τελωνων φιλος και αμαρτωλων και εδικαιωθη η σοφια απο των τεκνων αυτης
kjv: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

vulg: tunc coepit exprobrare civitatibus in quibus factae sunt plurimae virtutes eius quia non egissent paenitentiam
clem: Tunc cpit exprobrare civitatibus, in quibus fact sunt plurim virtutes ejus, quia non egissent pnitentiam:
tr: τοτε ηρξατο ονειδιζειν τας πολεις εν αις εγενοντο αι πλεισται δυναμεις αυτου οτι ου μετενοησαν
kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

vulg: vae tibi Corazain vae tibi Bethsaida quia si in Tyro et Sidone factae essent virtutes quae factae sunt in vobis olim in cilicio et cinere paenitentiam egissent
clem: V tibi Corozain, v tibi Bethsaida: quia, si in Tyro et Sidone fact essent virtutes qu fact sunt in vobis, olim in cilicio et cinere pnitentiam egissent.
tr: ουαι σοι χοραζιν ουαι σοι βηθσαιδαν  βηθσαιδα  οτι ει εν τυρω και σιδωνι εγενοντο αι δυναμεις αι γενομεναι εν υμιν παλαι αν εν σακκω και σποδω μετενοησαν
kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

vulg: verumtamen dico vobis Tyro et Sidoni remissius erit in die iudicii quam vobis
clem: Verumtamen dico vobis: Tyro et Sidoni remissius erit in die judicii, quam vobis.
tr: πλην λεγω υμιν τυρω και σιδωνι ανεκτοτερον εσται εν ημερα κρισεως η υμιν
kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

vulg: et tu Capharnaum numquid usque in caelum exaltaberis usque in infernum descendes quia si in Sodomis factae fuissent virtutes quae factae sunt in te forte mansissent usque in hunc diem
clem: Et tu Capharnaum, numquid usque in clum exaltaberis? usque in infernum descendes, quia si in Sodomis fact fuissent virtutes qu fact sunt in te, forte mansissent usque in hanc diem.
tr: και συ καπερναουμ η εως του ουρανου υψωθεισα εως αδου καταβιβασθηση οτι ει εν σοδομοις εγενοντο αι δυναμεις αι γενομεναι εν σοι εμειναν αν μεχρι της σημερον
kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

vulg: verumtamen dico vobis quia terrae Sodomorum remissius erit in die iudicii quam tibi
clem: Verumtamen dico vobis, quia terr Sodomorum remissius erit in die judicii, quam tibi.
tr: πλην λεγω υμιν οτι γη σοδομων ανεκτοτερον εσται εν ημερα κρισεως η σοι
kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

vulg: in illo tempore respondens Iesus dixit confiteor tibi Pater Domine caeli et terrae quia abscondisti haec a sapientibus et prudentibus et revelasti ea parvulis
clem: In illo tempore respondens Jesus dixit: Confiteor tibi, Pater, Domine cli et terr, quia abscondisti hc a sapientibus, et prudentibus, et revelasti ea parvulis.
tr: εν εκεινω τω καιρω αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν εξομολογουμαι σοι πατερ κυριε του ουρανου και της γης οτι απεκρυψας ταυτα απο σοφων και συνετων και απεκαλυψας αυτα νηπιοις
kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

vulg: ita Pater quoniam sic fuit placitum ante te
clem: Ita Pater: quoniam sic fuit placitum ante te.
tr: ναι ο πατηρ οτι ουτως εγενετο ευδοκια εμπροσθεν σου
kjv: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

vulg: omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo et nemo novit Filium nisi Pater neque Patrem quis novit nisi Filius et cui voluerit Filius revelare
clem: Omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo. Et nemo novit Filium, nisi Pater: neque Patrem quis novit, nisi Filius, et cui voluerit Filius revelare.
tr: παντα μοι παρεδοθη υπο του πατρος μου και ουδεις επιγινωσκει τον υιον ει μη ο πατηρ ουδε τον πατερα τις επιγινωσκει ει μη ο υιος και ω εαν βουληται ο υιος αποκαλυψαι
kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

vulg: venite ad me omnes qui laboratis et onerati estis et ego reficiam vos
clem: Venite ad me omnes qui laboratis, et onerati estis, et ego reficiam vos.
tr: δευτε προς με παντες οι κοπιωντες και πεφορτισμενοι καγω αναπαυσω υμας
kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

vulg: tollite iugum meum super vos et discite a me quia mitis sum et humilis corde et invenietis requiem animabus vestris
clem: Tollite jugum meum super vos, et discite a me, quia mitis sum, et humilis corde: et invenietis requiem animabus vestris.
tr: αρατε τον ζυγον μου εφ υμας και μαθετε απ εμου οτι πραος ειμι και ταπεινος τη καρδια και ευρησετε αναπαυσιν ταις ψυχαις υμων
kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

vulg: iugum enim meum suave est et onus meum leve est
clem: Jugum enim meum suave est, et onus meum leve.
tr: ο γαρ ζυγος μου χρηστος και το φορτιον μου ελαφρον εστιν
kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

vulg: in illo tempore abiit Iesus sabbato per sata discipuli autem eius esurientes coeperunt vellere spicas et manducare
clem: In illo tempore abiit Jesus per sata sabbato: discipuli autem ejus esurientes cperunt vellere spicas, et manducare.
tr: εν εκεινω τω καιρω επορευθη ο ιησους τοις σαββασιν δια των σποριμων οι δε μαθηται αυτου επεινασαν και ηρξαντο τιλλειν σταχυας και εσθιειν
kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.

vulg: Pharisaei autem videntes dixerunt ei ecce discipuli tui faciunt quod non licet eis facere sabbatis
clem: Pharisi autem videntes, dixerunt ei: Ecce discipuli tui faciunt quod non licet facere sabbatis.
tr: οι δε φαρισαιοι ιδοντες ειπον αυτω ιδου οι μαθηται σου ποιουσιν ο ουκ εξεστιν ποιειν εν σαββατω
kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

vulg: at ille dixit eis non legistis quid fecerit David quando esuriit et qui cum eo erant
clem: At ille dixit eis: Non legistis quid fecerit David, quando esuriit, et qui cum eo erant:
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις ουκ ανεγνωτε τι εποιησεν δαβιδ οτε επεινασεν αυτος και οι μετ αυτου
kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

vulg: quomodo intravit in domum Dei et panes propositionis comedit quos non licebat ei edere neque his qui cum eo erant nisi solis sacerdotibus
clem: quomodo intravit in domum Dei, et panes propositionis comedit, quos non licebat ei edere, neque his qui cum eo erant, nisi solis sacerdotibus?
tr: πως εισηλθεν εις τον οικον του θεου και τους αρτους της προθεσεως εφαγεν ους ουκ εξον ην αυτω φαγειν ουδε τοις μετ αυτου ει μη τοις ιερευσιν μονοις
kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

vulg: aut non legistis in lege quia sabbatis sacerdotes in templo sabbatum violant et sine crimine sunt
clem: aut non legistis in lege quia sabbatis sacerdotes in templo sabbatum violant, et sine crimine sunt?
tr: η ουκ ανεγνωτε εν τω νομω οτι τοις σαββασιν οι ιερεις εν τω ιερω το σαββατον βεβηλουσιν και αναιτιοι εισιν
kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

vulg: dico autem vobis quia templo maior est hic
clem: Dico autem vobis, quia templo major est hic.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι του ιερου μειζων εστιν ωδε
kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

vulg: si autem sciretis quid est misericordiam volo et non sacrificium numquam condemnassetis innocentes
clem: Si autem sciretis, quid est: Misericordiam volo, et non sacrificium: numquam condemnassetis innocentes:
tr: ει δε εγνωκειτε τι εστιν ελεον θελω και ου θυσιαν ουκ αν κατεδικασατε τους αναιτιους
kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

vulg: dominus est enim Filius hominis etiam sabbati
clem: dominus enim est Filius hominis etiam sabbati.
tr: κυριος γαρ εστιν και του σαββατου ο υιος του ανθρωπου
kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

vulg: et cum inde transisset venit in synagogam eorum
clem: Et cum inde transisset, venit in synagogam eorum.
tr: και μεταβας εκειθεν ηλθεν εις την συναγωγην αυτων
kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

vulg: et ecce homo manum habens aridam et interrogabant eum dicentes si licet sabbatis curare ut accusarent eum
clem: Et ecce homo manum habens aridam, et interrogabant eum, dicentes: Si licet sabbatis curare? ut accusarent eum.
tr: και ιδου ανθρωπος ην την χειρα εχων ξηραν και επηρωτησαν αυτον λεγοντες ει εξεστιν τοις σαββασιν θεραπευειν ινα κατηγορησωσιν αυτου
kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

vulg: ipse autem dixit illis quis erit ex vobis homo qui habeat ovem unam et si ceciderit haec sabbatis in foveam nonne tenebit et levabit eam
clem: Ipse autem dixit illis: Quis erit ex vobis homo, qui habeat ovem unam, et si ceciderit hc sabbatis in foveam, nonne tenebit et levabit eam?
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις τις εσται εξ υμων ανθρωπος ος εξει προβατον εν και εαν εμπεση τουτο τοις σαββασιν εις βοθυνον ουχι κρατησει αυτο και εγερει
kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

vulg: quanto magis melior est homo ove itaque licet sabbatis benefacere
clem: Quanto magis melior est homo ove? itaque licet sabbatis benefacere.
tr: ποσω ουν διαφερει ανθρωπος προβατου ωστε εξεστιν τοις σαββασιν καλως ποιειν
kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

vulg: tunc ait homini extende manum tuam et extendit et restituta est sanitati sicut altera
clem: Tunc ait homini: Extende manum tuam. Et extendit, et restituta est sanitati sicut altera.
tr: τοτε λεγει τω ανθρωπω εκτεινον την χειρα σου και εξετεινεν και αποκατεσταθη υγιης ως η αλλη
kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

vulg: exeuntes autem Pharisaei consilium faciebant adversus eum quomodo eum perderent
clem: Exeuntes autem pharisi, consilium faciebant adversus eum, quomodo perderent eum.
tr: οι δε φαρισαιοι συμβουλιον ελαβον κατ αυτου εξελθοντες οπως αυτον απολεσωσιν
kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

vulg: Iesus autem sciens recessit inde et secuti sunt eum multi et curavit eos omnes
clem: Jesus autem sciens recessit inde: et secuti sunt eum multi, et curavit eos omnes:
tr: ο δε ιησους γνους ανεχωρησεν εκειθεν και ηκολουθησαν αυτω οχλοι πολλοι και εθεραπευσεν αυτους παντας
kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
