vulg: et praecepit eis ne manifestum eum facerent
clem: et prcepit eis ne manifestum eum facerent.
tr: και επετιμησεν αυτοις ινα μη φανερον αυτον ποιησωσιν
kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:

vulg: ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Esaiam prophetam dicentem
clem: Ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam, dicentem:
tr: οπως πληρωθη το ρηθεν δια ησαιου του προφητου λεγοντος
kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

vulg: ecce puer meus quem elegi dilectus meus in quo bene placuit animae meae ponam spiritum meum super eum et iudicium gentibus nuntiabit
clem: [Ecce puer meus, quem elegi, dilectus meus, in quo bene complacuit anim me. Ponam spiritum meum super eum, et judicium gentibus nuntiabit.
tr: ιδου ο παις μου ον ηρετισα ο αγαπητος μου εις ον ευδοκησεν η ψυχη μου θησω το πνευμα μου επ αυτον και κρισιν τοις εθνεσιν απαγγελει
kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

vulg: non contendet neque clamabit neque audiet aliquis in plateis vocem eius
clem: Non contendet, neque clamabit, neque audiet aliquis in plateis vocem ejus:
tr: ουκ ερισει ουδε κραυγασει ουδε ακουσει τις εν ταις πλατειαις την φωνην αυτου
kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

vulg: harundinem quassatam non confringet et linum fumigans non extinguet donec eiciat ad victoriam iudicium
clem: arundinem quassatam non confringet, et linum fumigans non extinguet, donec ejiciat ad victoriam judicium:
tr: καλαμον συντετριμμενον ου κατεαξει και λινον τυφομενον ου σβεσει εως αν εκβαλη εις νικος την κρισιν
kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

vulg: et in nomine eius gentes sperabunt
clem: et in nomine ejus gentes sperabunt.]
tr: και εν τω ονοματι αυτου εθνη ελπιουσιν
kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

vulg: tunc oblatus est ei daemonium habens caecus et mutus et curavit eum ita ut loqueretur et videret
clem: Tunc oblatus est ei dmonium habens, ccus, et mutus, et curavit eum ita ut loqueretur, et videret.
tr: τοτε προσηνεχθη αυτω δαιμονιζομενος τυφλος και κωφος και εθεραπευσεν αυτον ωστε τον τυφλον και κωφον και λαλειν και βλεπειν
kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

vulg: et stupebant omnes turbae et dicebant numquid hic est Filius David
clem: Et stupebant omnes turb, et dicebant: Numquid hic est filius David?
tr: και εξισταντο παντες οι οχλοι και ελεγον μητι ουτος εστιν ο υιος δαβιδ
kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

vulg: Pharisaei autem audientes dixerunt hic non eicit daemones nisi in Beelzebub principe daemoniorum
clem: Pharisi autem audientes, dixerunt: Hic non ejicit dmones nisi in Beelzebub principe dmoniorum.
tr: οι δε φαρισαιοι ακουσαντες ειπον ουτος ουκ εκβαλλει τα δαιμονια ει μη εν τω βεελζεβουλ αρχοντι των δαιμονιων
kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

vulg: Iesus autem sciens cogitationes eorum dixit eis omne regnum divisum contra se desolatur et omnis civitas vel domus divisa contra se non stabit
clem: Jesus autem sciens cogitationes eorum, dixit eis: Omne regnum divisum contra se desolabitur: et omnis civitas vel domus divisa contra se, non stabit.
tr: ειδως δε ο ιησους τας ενθυμησεις αυτων ειπεν αυτοις πασα βασιλεια μερισθεισα καθ εαυτης ερημουται και πασα πολις η οικια μερισθεισα καθ εαυτης ου σταθησεται
kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

vulg: et si Satanas Satanan eicit adversus se divisus est quomodo ergo stabit regnum eius
clem: Et si Satanas Satanam ejicit, adversus se divisus est: quomodo ergo stabit regnum ejus?
tr: και ει ο σατανας τον σαταναν εκβαλλει εφ εαυτον εμερισθη πως ουν σταθησεται η βασιλεια αυτου
kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

vulg: et si ego in Beelzebub eicio daemones filii vestri in quo eiciunt ideo ipsi iudices erunt vestri
clem: Et si ego in Beelzebub ejicio dmones, filii vestri in quo ejiciunt? ideo ipsi judices vestri erunt.
tr: και ει εγω εν βεελζεβουλ εκβαλλω τα δαιμονια οι υιοι υμων εν τινι εκβαλλουσιν δια τουτο αυτοι υμων εσονται κριται
kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

vulg: si autem ego in Spiritu Dei eicio daemones igitur pervenit in vos regnum Dei
clem: Si autem ego in Spiritu Dei ejicio dmones, igitur pervenit in vos regnum Dei.
tr: ει δε εγω εν πνευματι θεου εκβαλλω τα δαιμονια αρα εφθασεν εφ υμας η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

vulg: aut quomodo potest quisquam intrare in domum fortis et vasa eius diripere nisi prius alligaverit fortem et tunc domum illius diripiat
clem: Aut quomodo potest quisquam intrare in domum fortis, et vasa ejus diripere, nisi prius alligaverit fortem? et tunc domum illius diripiet.
tr: η πως δυναται τις εισελθειν εις την οικιαν του ισχυρου και τα σκευη αυτου διαρπασαι εαν μη πρωτον δηση τον ισχυρον και τοτε την οικιαν αυτου διαρπασει
kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

vulg: qui non est mecum contra me est et qui non congregat mecum spargit
clem: Qui non est mecum, contra me est; et qui non congregat mihi, spargit.
tr: ο μη ων μετ εμου κατ εμου εστιν και ο μη συναγων μετ εμου σκορπιζει
kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

vulg: ideo dico vobis omne peccatum et blasphemia remittetur hominibus Spiritus autem blasphemia non remittetur
clem: Ideo dico vobis: Omne peccatum et blasphemia remittetur hominibus, Spiritus autem blasphemia non remittetur.
tr: δια τουτο λεγω υμιν πασα αμαρτια και βλασφημια αφεθησεται τοις ανθρωποις η δε του πνευματος βλασφημια ουκ αφεθησεται τοις ανθρωποις
kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

vulg: et quicumque dixerit verbum contra Filium hominis remittetur ei qui autem dixerit contra Spiritum Sanctum non remittetur ei neque in hoc saeculo neque in futuro
clem: Et quicumque dixerit verbum contra Filium hominis, remittetur ei: qui autem dixerit contra Spiritum Sanctum, non remittetur ei, neque in hoc sculo, neque in futuro.
tr: και ος αν ειπη λογον κατα του υιου του ανθρωπου αφεθησεται αυτω ος δ αν ειπη κατα του πνευματος του αγιου ουκ αφεθησεται αυτω ουτε εν τουτω τω αιωνι ουτε εν τω μελλοντι
kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

vulg: aut facite arborem bonam et fructum eius bonum aut facite arborem malam et fructum eius malum siquidem ex fructu arbor agnoscitur
clem: Aut facite arborem bonam, et fructum ejus bonum: aut facite arborem malam, et fructum ejus malum: siquidem ex fructu arbor agnoscitur.
tr: η ποιησατε το δενδρον καλον και τον καρπον αυτου καλον η ποιησατε το δενδρον σαπρον και τον καρπον αυτου σαπρον εκ γαρ του καρπου το δενδρον γινωσκεται
kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

vulg: progenies viperarum quomodo potestis bona loqui cum sitis mali ex abundantia enim cordis os loquitur
clem: Progenies viperarum, quomodo potestis bona loqui, cum sitis mali? ex abundantia enim cordis os loquitur.
tr: γεννηματα εχιδνων πως δυνασθε αγαθα λαλειν πονηροι οντες εκ γαρ του περισσευματος της καρδιας το στομα λαλει
kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

vulg: bonus homo de bono thesauro profert bona et malus homo de malo thesauro profert mala
clem: Bonus homo de bono thesauro profert bona: et malus homo de malo thesauro profert mala.
tr: ο αγαθος ανθρωπος εκ του αγαθου θησαυρου της καρδιας εκβαλλει τα αγαθα και ο πονηρος ανθρωπος εκ του πονηρου θησαυρου εκβαλλει πονηρα
kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

vulg: dico autem vobis quoniam omne verbum otiosum quod locuti fuerint homines reddent rationem de eo in die iudicii
clem: Dico autem vobis quoniam omne verbum otiosum, quod locuti fuerint homines, reddent rationem de eo in die judicii.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι παν ρημα αργον ο εαν λαλησωσιν οι ανθρωποι αποδωσουσιν περι αυτου λογον εν ημερα κρισεως
kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

vulg: ex verbis enim tuis iustificaberis et ex verbis tuis condemnaberis
clem: Ex verbis enim tuis justificaberis et ex verbis tuis condemnaberis.
tr: εκ γαρ των λογων σου δικαιωθηση και εκ των λογων σου καταδικασθηση
kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

vulg: tunc responderunt ei quidam de scribis et Pharisaeis dicentes magister volumus a te signum videre
clem: Tunc responderunt ei quidam de scribis et pharisis, dicentes: Magister, volumus a te signum videre.
tr: τοτε απεκριθησαν τινες των γραμματεων και φαρισαιων λεγοντες διδασκαλε θελομεν απο σου σημειον ιδειν
kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

vulg: qui respondens ait illis generatio mala et adultera signum quaerit et signum non dabitur ei nisi signum Ionae prophetae
clem: Qui respondens ait illis: Generatio mala et adultera signum qurit: et signum non dabitur ei, nisi signum Jon prophet.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις γενεα πονηρα και μοιχαλις σημειον επιζητει και σημειον ου δοθησεται αυτη ει μη το σημειον ιωνα του προφητου
kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

vulg: sicut enim fuit Ionas in ventre ceti tribus diebus et tribus noctibus sic erit Filius hominis in corde terrae tribus diebus et tribus noctibus
clem: Sicut enim fuit Jonas in ventre ceti tribus diebus, et tribus noctibus, sic erit Filius hominis in corde terr tribus diebus et tribus noctibus.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ ην ιωνας εν τη κοιλια του κητους τρεις ημερας και τρεις νυκτας ουτως εσται ο υιος του ανθρωπου εν τη καρδια της γης τρεις ημερας και τρεις νυκτας
kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

vulg: viri ninevitae surgent in iudicio cum generatione ista et condemnabunt eam quia paenitentiam egerunt in praedicatione Ionae et ecce plus quam Iona hic
clem: Viri Ninivit surgent in judicio cum generatione ista, et condemnabunt eam: quia pnitentiam egerunt in prdicatione Jon. Et ecce plus quam Jonas hic.
tr: ανδρες νινευιται αναστησονται εν τη κρισει μετα της γενεας ταυτης και κατακρινουσιν αυτην οτι μετενοησαν εις το κηρυγμα ιωνα και ιδου πλειον ιωνα ωδε
kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

vulg: regina austri surget in iudicio cum generatione ista et condemnabit eam quia venit a finibus terrae audire sapientiam Salomonis et ecce plus quam Salomon hic
clem: Regina austri surget in judicio cum generatione ista, et condemnabit eam: quia venit a finibus terr audire sapientiam Salomonis, et ecce plus quam Salomon hic.
tr: βασιλισσα νοτου εγερθησεται εν τη κρισει μετα της γενεας ταυτης και κατακρινει αυτην οτι ηλθεν εκ των περατων της γης ακουσαι την σοφιαν σολομωντος και ιδου πλειον σολομωντος ωδε
kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

vulg: cum autem inmundus spiritus exierit ab homine ambulat per loca arida quaerens requiem et non invenit
clem: Cum autem immundus spiritus exierit ab homine, ambulat per loca arida, qurens requiem, et non invenit.
tr: οταν δε το ακαθαρτον πνευμα εξελθη απο του ανθρωπου διερχεται δι ανυδρων τοπων ζητουν αναπαυσιν και ουχ ευρισκει
kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

vulg: tunc dicit revertar in domum meam unde exivi et veniens invenit vacantem scopis mundatam et ornatam
clem: Tunc dicit: Revertar in domum meam, unde exivi. Et veniens invenit eam vacantem, scopis mundatam, et ornatam.
tr: τοτε λεγει επιστρεψω εις τον οικον μου οθεν εξηλθον και ελθον ευρισκει σχολαζοντα σεσαρωμενον και κεκοσμημενον
kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

vulg: tunc vadit et adsumit septem alios spiritus secum nequiores se et intrantes habitant ibi et fiunt novissima hominis illius peiora prioribus sic erit et generationi huic pessimae
clem: Tunc vadit, et assumit septem alios spiritus secum nequiores se, et intrantes habitant ibi: et fiunt novissima hominis illius pejora prioribus. Sic erit et generationi huic pessim.
tr: τοτε πορευεται και παραλαμβανει μεθ εαυτου επτα ετερα πνευματα πονηροτερα εαυτου και εισελθοντα κατοικει εκει και γινεται τα εσχατα του ανθρωπου εκεινου χειρονα των πρωτων ουτως εσται και τη γενεα ταυτη τη πονηρα
kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

vulg: adhuc eo loquente ad turbas ecce mater eius et fratres stabant foris quaerentes loqui ei
clem: Adhuc eo loquente ad turbas, ecce mater ejus et fratres stabant foras, qurentes loqui ei.
tr: ετι δε αυτου λαλουντος τοις οχλοις ιδου η μητηρ και οι αδελφοι αυτου ειστηκεισαν εξω ζητουντες αυτω λαλησαι
kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

vulg: dixit autem ei quidam ecce mater tua et fratres tui foris stant quaerentes te
clem: Dixit autem ei quidam: Ecce mater tua, et fratres tui foris stant qurentes te.
tr: ειπεν δε τις αυτω ιδου η μητηρ σου και οι αδελφοι σου εξω εστηκασιν ζητουντες σοι λαλησαι
kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

vulg: at ipse respondens dicenti sibi ait quae est mater mea et qui sunt fratres mei
clem: At ipse respondens dicenti sibi, ait: Qu est mater mea, et qui sunt fratres mei?
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν τω ειποντι αυτω τις εστιν η μητηρ μου και τινες εισιν οι αδελφοι μου
kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

vulg: et extendens manum in discipulos suos dixit ecce mater mea et fratres mei
clem: Et extendens manum in discipulos suos, dixit: Ecce mater mea, et fratres mei.
tr: και εκτεινας την χειρα αυτου επι τους μαθητας αυτου ειπεν ιδου η μητηρ μου και οι αδελφοι μου
kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

vulg: quicumque enim fecerit voluntatem Patris mei qui in caelis est ipse meus et frater et soror et mater est
clem: Quicumque enim fecerit voluntatem Patris mei, qui in clis est, ipse meus frater, et soror, et mater est.
tr: οστις γαρ αν ποιηση το θελημα του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις αυτος μου αδελφος και αδελφη και μητηρ εστιν
kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

vulg: in illo die exiens Iesus de domo sedebat secus mare
clem: In illo die exiens Jesus de domo, sedebat secus mare.
tr: εν δε τη ημερα εκεινη εξελθων ο ιησους απο της οικιας εκαθητο παρα την θαλασσαν
kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

vulg: et congregatae sunt ad eum turbae multae ita ut in naviculam ascendens sederet et omnis turba stabat in litore
clem: Et congregat sunt ad eum turb mult, ita ut naviculam ascendens sederet: et omnis turba stabat in littore,
tr: και συνηχθησαν προς αυτον οχλοι πολλοι ωστε αυτον εις το πλοιον εμβαντα καθησθαι και πας ο οχλος επι τον αιγιαλον ειστηκει
kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

vulg: et locutus est eis multa in parabolis dicens ecce exiit qui seminat seminare
clem: et locutus est eis multa in parabolis, dicens: Ecce exiit qui seminat, seminare.
tr: και ελαλησεν αυτοις πολλα εν παραβολαις λεγων ιδου εξηλθεν ο σπειρων του σπειρειν
kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

vulg: et dum seminat quaedam ceciderunt secus viam et venerunt volucres et comederunt ea
clem: Et dum seminat, qudam ceciderunt secus viam, et venerunt volucres cli, et comederunt ea.
tr: και εν τω σπειρειν αυτον α μεν επεσεν παρα την οδον και ηλθεν τα πετεινα και κατεφαγεν αυτα
kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

vulg: alia autem ceciderunt in petrosa ubi non habebat terram multam et continuo exorta sunt quia non habebant altitudinem terrae
clem: Alia autem ceciderunt in petrosa, ubi non habebant terram multam: et continuo exorta sunt, quia non habebant altitudinem terr:
tr: αλλα δε επεσεν επι τα πετρωδη οπου ουκ ειχεν γην πολλην και ευθεως εξανετειλεν δια το μη εχειν βαθος γης
kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

vulg: sole autem orto aestuaverunt et quia non habebant radicem aruerunt
clem: sole autem orto stuaverunt; et quia non habebant radicem, aruerunt.
tr: ηλιου δε ανατειλαντος εκαυματισθη και δια το μη εχειν ριζαν εξηρανθη
kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

vulg: alia autem ceciderunt in spinas et creverunt spinae et suffocaverunt ea
clem: Alia autem ceciderunt in spinas: et creverunt spin, et suffocaverunt ea.
tr: αλλα δε επεσεν επι τας ακανθας και ανεβησαν αι ακανθαι και απεπνιξαν αυτα
kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

vulg: alia vero ceciderunt in terram bonam et dabant fructum aliud centesimum aliud sexagesimum aliud tricesimum
clem: Alia autem ceciderunt in terram bonam: et dabant fructum, aliud centesimum, aliud sexagesimum, aliud trigesimum.
tr: αλλα δε επεσεν επι την γην την καλην και εδιδου καρπον ο μεν εκατον ο δε εξηκοντα ο δε τριακοντα
kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

vulg: qui habet aures audiendi audiat
clem: Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: ο εχων ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: et accedentes discipuli dixerunt ei quare in parabolis loqueris eis
clem: Et accedentes discipuli dixerunt ei: Quare in parabolis loqueris eis?
tr: και προσελθοντες οι μαθηται ειπον αυτω δια τι εν παραβολαις λαλεις αυτοις
kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

vulg: qui respondens ait illis quia vobis datum est nosse mysteria regni caelorum illis autem non est datum
clem: Qui respondens, ait illis: Quia vobis datum est nosse mysteria regni clorum: illis autem non est datum.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις οτι υμιν δεδοται γνωναι τα μυστηρια της βασιλειας των ουρανων εκεινοις δε ου δεδοται
kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

vulg: qui enim habet dabitur ei et abundabit qui autem non habet et quod habet auferetur ab eo
clem: Qui enim habet, dabitur ei, et abundabit: qui autem non habet, et quod habet auferetur ab eo.
tr: οστις γαρ εχει δοθησεται αυτω και περισσευθησεται οστις δε ουκ εχει και ο εχει αρθησεται απ αυτου
kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

vulg: ideo in parabolis loquor eis quia videntes non vident et audientes non audiunt neque intellegunt
clem: Ideo in parabolis loquor eis: quia videntes non vident, et audientes non audiunt, neque intelligunt.
tr: δια τουτο εν παραβολαις αυτοις λαλω οτι βλεποντες ου βλεπουσιν και ακουοντες ουκ ακουουσιν ουδε συνιουσιν
kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

vulg: et adimpletur eis prophetia Esaiae dicens auditu audietis et non intellegetis et videntes videbitis et non videbitis
clem: Et adimpletur in eis prophetia Isai, dicentis: [Auditu audietis, et non intelligetis: et videntes videbitis, et non videbitis.
tr: και αναπληρουται επ αυτοις η προφητεια ησαιου η λεγουσα ακοη ακουσετε και ου μη συνητε και βλεποντες βλεψετε και ου μη ιδητε
kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

vulg: incrassatum est enim cor populi huius et auribus graviter audierunt et oculos suos cluserunt nequando oculis videant et auribus audiant et corde intellegant et convertantur et sanem eos
clem: Incrassatum est enim cor populi hujus, et auribus graviter audierunt, et oculos suos clauserunt: nequando videant oculis, et auribus audiant, et corde intelligant, et convertantur, et sanem eos.]
tr: επαχυνθη γαρ η καρδια του λαου τουτου και τοις ωσιν βαρεως ηκουσαν και τους οφθαλμους αυτων εκαμμυσαν μηποτε ιδωσιν τοις οφθαλμοις και τοις ωσιν ακουσωσιν και τη καρδια συνωσιν και επιστρεψωσιν και ιασωμαι αυτους
kjv: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

vulg: vestri autem beati oculi quia vident et aures vestrae quia audiunt
clem: Vestri autem beati oculi quia vident, et aures vestr quia audiunt.
tr: υμων δε μακαριοι οι οφθαλμοι οτι βλεπουσιν και τα ωτα υμων οτι ακουει
kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

vulg: amen quippe dico vobis quia multi prophetae et iusti cupierunt videre quae videtis et non viderunt et audire quae auditis et non audierunt
clem: Amen quippe dico vobis, quia multi prophet et justi cupierunt videre qu videtis, et non viderunt: et audire qu auditis, et non audierunt.
tr: αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν οτι πολλοι προφηται και δικαιοι επεθυμησαν ιδειν α βλεπετε και ουκ ειδον και ακουσαι α ακουετε και ουκ ηκουσαν
kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

vulg: vos ergo audite parabolam seminantis
clem: Vos ergo audite parabolam seminantis.
tr: υμεις ουν ακουσατε την παραβολην του σπειροντος
kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

vulg: omnis qui audit verbum regni et non intellegit venit malus et rapit quod seminatum est in corde eius hic est qui secus viam seminatus est
clem: Omnis qui audit verbum regni, et non intelligit, venit malus, et rapit quod seminatum est in corde ejus: hic est qui secus viam seminatus est.
tr: παντος ακουοντος τον λογον της βασιλειας και μη συνιεντος ερχεται ο πονηρος και αρπαζει το εσπαρμενον εν τη καρδια αυτου ουτος εστιν ο παρα την οδον σπαρεις
kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

vulg: qui autem supra petrosa seminatus est hic est qui verbum audit et continuo cum gaudio accipit illud
clem: Qui autem super petrosa seminatus est, hic est qui verbum audit, et continuo cum gaudio accipit illud:
tr: ο δε επι τα πετρωδη σπαρεις ουτος εστιν ο τον λογον ακουων και ευθυς μετα χαρας λαμβανων αυτον
kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

vulg: non habet autem in se radicem sed est temporalis facta autem tribulatione et persecutione propter verbum continuo scandalizatur
clem: non habet autem in se radicem, sed est temporalis: facta autem tribulatione et persecutione propter verbum, continuo scandalizatur.
tr: ουκ εχει δε ριζαν εν εαυτω αλλα προσκαιρος εστιν γενομενης δε θλιψεως η διωγμου δια τον λογον ευθυς σκανδαλιζεται
kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

vulg: qui autem est seminatus in spinis hic est qui verbum audit et sollicitudo saeculi istius et fallacia divitiarum suffocat verbum et sine fructu efficitur
clem: Qui autem seminatus est in spinis, hic est qui verbum audit, et sollicitudo sculi istius, et fallacia divitiarum suffocat verbum, et sine fructu efficitur.
tr: ο δε εις τας ακανθας σπαρεις ουτος εστιν ο τον λογον ακουων και η μεριμνα του αιωνος τουτου και η απατη του πλουτου συμπνιγει τον λογον και ακαρπος γινεται
kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

vulg: qui vero in terra bona seminatus est hic est qui audit verbum et intellegit et fructum adfert et facit aliud quidem centum aliud autem sexaginta porro aliud triginta
clem: Qui vero in terram bonam seminatus est, hic est qui audit verbum, et intelligit, et fructum affert, et facit aliud quidem centesimum, aliud autem sexagesimum, aliud vero trigesimum.
tr: ο δε επι την γην την καλην σπαρεις ουτος εστιν ο τον λογον ακουων και συνιων ος δη καρποφορει και ποιει ο μεν εκατον ο δε εξηκοντα ο δε τριακοντα
kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

vulg: aliam parabolam proposuit illis dicens simile factum est regnum caelorum homini qui seminavit bonum semen in agro suo
clem: Aliam parabolam proposuit illis, dicens: Simile factum est regnum clorum homini, qui seminavit bonum semen in agro suo:
tr: αλλην παραβολην παρεθηκεν αυτοις λεγων ωμοιωθη η βασιλεια των ουρανων ανθρωπω σπειροντι  σπειραντι  καλον σπερμα εν τω αγρω αυτου
kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

vulg: cum autem dormirent homines venit inimicus eius et superseminavit zizania in medio tritici et abiit
clem: cum autem dormirent homines, venit inimicus ejus, et superseminavit zizania in medio tritici, et abiit.
tr: εν δε τω καθευδειν τους ανθρωπους ηλθεν αυτου ο εχθρος και εσπειρεν ζιζανια ανα μεσον του σιτου και απηλθεν
kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

vulg: cum autem crevisset herba et fructum fecisset tunc apparuerunt et zizania
clem: Cum autem crevisset herba, et fructum fecisset, tunc apparuerunt et zizania.
tr: οτε δε εβλαστησεν ο χορτος και καρπον εποιησεν τοτε εφανη και τα ζιζανια
kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

vulg: accedentes autem servi patris familias dixerunt ei domine nonne bonum semen seminasti in agro tuo unde ergo habet zizania
clem: Accedentes autem servi patrisfamilias, dixerunt ei: Domine, nonne bonum semen seminasti in agro tuo? unde ergo habet zizania?
tr: προσελθοντες δε οι δουλοι του οικοδεσποτου ειπον αυτω κυριε ουχι καλον σπερμα εσπειρας εν τω σω αγρω ποθεν ουν εχει τα ζιζανια
kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

vulg: et ait illis inimicus homo hoc fecit servi autem dixerunt ei vis imus et colligimus ea
clem: Et ait illis: Inimicus homo hoc fecit. Servi autem dixerunt ei: Vis, imus, et colligimus ea?
tr: ο δε εφη αυτοις εχθρος ανθρωπος τουτο εποιησεν οι δε δουλοι ειπον αυτω θελεις ουν απελθοντες συλλεξωμεν αυτα
kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

vulg: et ait non ne forte colligentes zizania eradicetis simul cum eis et triticum
clem: Et ait: Non: ne forte colligentes zizania, eradicetis simul cum eis et triticum.
tr: ο δε εφη ου μηποτε συλλεγοντες τα ζιζανια εκριζωσητε αμα αυτοις τον σιτον
kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

vulg: sinite utraque crescere usque ad messem et in tempore messis dicam messoribus colligite primum zizania et alligate ea fasciculos ad conburendum triticum autem congregate in horreum meum
clem: Sinite utraque crescere usque ad messem, et in tempore messis dicam messoribus: Colligite primum zizania, et alligate ea in fasciculos ad comburendum: triticum autem congregate in horreum meum.
tr: αφετε συναυξανεσθαι αμφοτερα μεχρι του θερισμου και εν τω καιρω του θερισμου ερω τοις θερισταις συλλεξατε πρωτον τα ζιζανια και δησατε αυτα εις δεσμας προς το κατακαυσαι αυτα τον δε σιτον συναγαγετε εις την αποθηκην μου
kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

vulg: aliam parabolam proposuit eis dicens simile est regnum caelorum grano sinapis quod accipiens homo seminavit in agro suo
clem: Aliam parabolam proposuit eis dicens: Similis est regnum clorum grano sinapis, quod accipiens homo seminavit in agro suo:
tr: αλλην παραβολην παρεθηκεν αυτοις λεγων ομοια εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων κοκκω σιναπεως ον λαβων ανθρωπος εσπειρεν εν τω αγρω αυτου
kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

vulg: quod minimum quidem est omnibus seminibus cum autem creverit maius est omnibus holeribus et fit arbor ita ut volucres caeli veniant et habitent in ramis eius
clem: quod minimum quidem est omnibus seminibus: cum autem creverit, majus est omnibus oleribus, et fit arbor, ita ut volucres cli veniant, et habitent in ramis ejus.
tr: ο μικροτερον μεν εστιν παντων των σπερματων οταν δε αυξηθη μειζον των λαχανων εστιν και γινεται δενδρον ωστε ελθειν τα πετεινα του ουρανου και κατασκηνουν εν τοις κλαδοις αυτου
kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

vulg: aliam parabolam locutus est eis simile est regnum caelorum fermento quod acceptum mulier abscondit in farinae satis tribus donec fermentatum est totum
clem: Aliam parabolam locutus est eis: Similis est regnum clorum fermento, quod acceptum mulier abscondit in farin satis tribus, donec fermentatum est totum.
tr: αλλην παραβολην ελαλησεν αυτοις ομοια εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων ζυμη ην λαβουσα γυνη ενεκρυψεν εις αλευρου σατα τρια εως ου εζυμωθη ολον
kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

vulg: haec omnia locutus est Iesus in parabolis ad turbas et sine parabolis non loquebatur eis
clem: Hc omnia locutus est Jesus in parabolis ad turbas: et sine parabolis non loquebatur eis:
tr: ταυτα παντα ελαλησεν ο ιησους εν παραβολαις τοις οχλοις και χωρις παραβολης ουκ ελαλει αυτοις
kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

vulg: ut impleretur quod dictum erat per prophetam dicentem aperiam in parabolis os meum eructabo abscondita a constitutione mundi
clem: ut impleretur quod dictum erat per prophetam dicentem: Aperiam in parabolis os meum; eructabo abscondita a constitutione mundi.
tr: οπως πληρωθη το ρηθεν δια του προφητου λεγοντος ανοιξω εν παραβολαις το στομα μου ερευξομαι κεκρυμμενα απο καταβολης κοσμου
kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

vulg: tunc dimissis turbis venit in domum et accesserunt ad eum discipuli eius dicentes dissere nobis parabolam zizaniorum agri
clem: Tunc, dimissis turbis, venit in domum: et accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus, dicentes: Edissere nobis parabolam zizaniorum agri.
tr: τοτε αφεις τους οχλους ηλθεν εις την οικιαν ο ιησους και προσηλθον αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου λεγοντες φρασον ημιν την παραβολην των ζιζανιων του αγρου
kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

vulg: qui respondens ait qui seminat bonum semen est Filius hominis
clem: Qui respondens ait illis: Qui seminat bonum semen, est Filius hominis.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ο σπειρων το καλον σπερμα εστιν ο υιος του ανθρωπου
kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

vulg: ager autem est mundus bonum vero semen hii sunt filii regni zizania autem filii sunt nequam
clem: Ager autem est mundus. Bonum vero semen, hi sunt filii regnum. Zizania autem, filii sunt nequam.
tr: ο δε αγρος εστιν ο κοσμος το δε καλον σπερμα ουτοι εισιν οι υιοι της βασιλειας τα δε ζιζανια εισιν οι υιοι του πονηρου
kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

vulg: inimicus autem qui seminavit ea est diabolus messis vero consummatio saeculi est messores autem angeli sunt
clem: Inimicus autem, qui seminavit ea, est diabolus. Messis vero, consummatio sculi est. Messores autem, angeli sunt.
tr: ο δε εχθρος ο σπειρας αυτα εστιν ο διαβολος ο δε θερισμος συντελεια του αιωνος εστιν οι δε θερισται αγγελοι εισιν
kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

vulg: sicut ergo colliguntur zizania et igni conburuntur sic erit in consummatione saeculi
clem: Sicut ergo colliguntur zizania, et igni comburuntur: sic erit in consummatione sculi.
tr: ωσπερ ουν συλλεγεται τα ζιζανια και πυρι κατακαιεται ουτως εσται εν τη συντελεια του αιωνος τουτου
kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

vulg: mittet Filius hominis angelos suos et colligent de regno eius omnia scandala et eos qui faciunt iniquitatem
clem: Mittet Filius hominis angelos suos, et colligent de regno ejus omnia scandala, et eos qui faciunt iniquitatem:
tr: αποστελει ο υιος του ανθρωπου τους αγγελους αυτου και συλλεξουσιν εκ της βασιλειας αυτου παντα τα σκανδαλα και τους ποιουντας την ανομιαν
kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

vulg: et mittent eos in caminum ignis ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium
clem: et mittent eos in caminum ignis. Ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
tr: και βαλουσιν αυτους εις την καμινον του πυρος εκει εσται ο κλαυθμος και ο βρυγμος των οδοντων
kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

vulg: tunc iusti fulgebunt sicut sol in regno Patris eorum qui habet aures audiat
clem: Tunc justi fulgebunt sicut sol in regno Patris eorum. Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: τοτε οι δικαιοι εκλαμψουσιν ως ο ηλιος εν τη βασιλεια του πατρος αυτων ο εχων ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: simile est regnum caelorum thesauro abscondito in agro quem qui invenit homo abscondit et prae gaudio illius vadit et vendit universa quae habet et emit agrum illum
clem: Simile est regnum clorum thesauro abscondito in agro: quem qui invenit homo, abscondit, et pr gaudio illius vadit, et vendit universa qu habet, et emit agrum illum.
tr: παλιν ομοια εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων θησαυρω κεκρυμμενω εν τω αγρω ον ευρων ανθρωπος εκρυψεν και απο της χαρας αυτου υπαγει και παντα οσα εχει πωλει και αγοραζει τον αγρον εκεινον
kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

vulg: iterum simile est regnum caelorum homini negotiatori quaerenti bonas margaritas
clem: Iterum simile est regnum clorum homini negotiatori, qurenti bonas margaritas.
tr: παλιν ομοια εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων ανθρωπω εμπορω ζητουντι καλους μαργαριτας
kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

vulg: inventa autem una pretiosa margarita abiit et vendidit omnia quae habuit et emit eam
clem: Inventa autem una pretiosa margarita, abiit, et vendidit omnia qu habuit, et emit eam.
tr: ος ευρων ενα πολυτιμον μαργαριτην απελθων πεπρακεν παντα οσα ειχεν και ηγορασεν αυτον
kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

vulg: iterum simile est regnum caelorum sagenae missae in mare et ex omni genere congreganti
clem: Iterum simile est regnum clorum sagen miss in mare, et ex omni genere piscium congreganti.
tr: παλιν ομοια εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων σαγηνη βληθειση εις την θαλασσαν και εκ παντος γενους συναγαγουση
kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

vulg: quam cum impleta esset educentes et secus litus sedentes elegerunt bonos in vasa malos autem foras miserunt
clem: Quam, cum impleta esset, educentes, et secus littus sedentes, elegerunt bonis in vasa, malos autem foras miserunt.
tr: ην οτε επληρωθη αναβιβασαντες επι τον αιγιαλον και καθισαντες συνελεξαν τα καλα εις αγγεια τα δε σαπρα εξω εβαλον
kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

vulg: sic erit in consummatione saeculi exibunt angeli et separabunt malos de medio iustorum
clem: Sic erit in consummatione sculi: exibunt angeli, et separabunt malos de medio justorum,
tr: ουτως εσται εν τη συντελεια του αιωνος εξελευσονται οι αγγελοι και αφοριουσιν τους πονηρους εκ μεσου των δικαιων
kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

vulg: et mittent eos in caminum ignis ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium
clem: et mittent eos in caminum ignis: ibi erit fletus, et stridor dentium.
tr: και βαλουσιν αυτους εις την καμινον του πυρος εκει εσται ο κλαυθμος και ο βρυγμος των οδοντων
kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

vulg: intellexistis haec omnia dicunt ei etiam
clem: Intellexistis hc omnia? Dicunt ei: Etiam.
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους συνηκατε ταυτα παντα λεγουσιν αυτω ναι κυριε
kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

vulg: ait illis ideo omnis scriba doctus in regno caelorum similis est homini patri familias qui profert de thesauro suo nova et vetera
clem: Ait illis: Ideo omnis scriba doctus in regno clorum, similis est homini patrifamilias, qui profert de thesauro suo nova et vetera.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις δια τουτο πας γραμματευς μαθητευθεις εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων ομοιος εστιν ανθρωπω οικοδεσποτη οστις εκβαλλει εκ του θησαυρου αυτου καινα και παλαια
kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

vulg: et factum est cum consummasset Iesus parabolas istas transiit inde
clem: Et factum est, cum consummasset Jesus parabolas istas, transiit inde.
tr: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους τας παραβολας ταυτας μετηρεν εκειθεν
kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

vulg: et veniens in patriam suam docebat eos in synagogis eorum ita ut mirarentur et dicerent unde huic sapientia haec et virtutes
clem: Et veniens in patriam suam, docebat eos in synagogis eorum, ita ut mirarentur, et dicerent: Unde huic sapientia hc, et virtutes?
tr: και ελθων εις την πατριδα αυτου εδιδασκεν αυτους εν τη συναγωγη αυτων ωστε εκπληττεσθαι αυτους και λεγειν ποθεν τουτω η σοφια αυτη και αι δυναμεις
kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

vulg: nonne hic est fabri filius nonne mater eius dicitur Maria et fratres eius Iacobus et Ioseph et Simon et Iudas
clem: Nonne hic est fabri filius? nonne mater ejus dicitur Maria, et fratres ejus, Jacobus, et Joseph, et Simon, et Judas?
tr: ουχ ουτος εστιν ο του τεκτονος υιος ουχι η μητηρ αυτου λεγεται μαριαμ και οι αδελφοι αυτου ιακωβος και ιωσης και σιμων και ιουδας
kjv: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

vulg: et sorores eius nonne omnes apud nos sunt unde ergo huic omnia ista
clem: et sorores ejus, nonne omnes apud nos sunt? unde ergo huic omnia ista?
tr: και αι αδελφαι αυτου ουχι πασαι προς ημας εισιν ποθεν ουν τουτω ταυτα παντα
kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

vulg: et scandalizabantur in eo Iesus autem dixit eis non est propheta sine honore nisi in patria sua et in domo sua
clem: Et scandalizabantur in eo. Jesus autem dixit eis: Non est propheta sine honore, nisi in patria sua, et in domo sua.
tr: και εσκανδαλιζοντο εν αυτω ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ουκ εστιν προφητης ατιμος ει μη εν τη πατριδι αυτου και εν τη οικια αυτου
kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

vulg: et non fecit ibi virtutes multas propter incredulitatem illorum
clem: Et non fecit ibi virtutes multas propter incredulitatem illorum.
tr: και ουκ εποιησεν εκει δυναμεις πολλας δια την απιστιαν αυτων
kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

vulg: in illo tempore audiit Herodes tetrarcha famam Iesu
clem: In illo tempore audivit Herodes tetrarcha fama Jesu:
tr: εν εκεινω τω καιρω ηκουσεν ηρωδης ο τετραρχης την ακοην ιησου
kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

vulg: et ait pueris suis hic est Iohannes Baptista ipse surrexit a mortuis et ideo virtutes inoperantur in eo
clem: et ait pueris suis: Hic est Joannes Baptista: ipse surrexit a mortuis, et ideo virtutes operantur in eo.
tr: και ειπεν τοις παισιν αυτου ουτος εστιν ιωαννης ο βαπτιστης αυτος ηγερθη απο των νεκρων και δια τουτο αι δυναμεις ενεργουσιν εν αυτω
kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

vulg: Herodes enim tenuit Iohannem et alligavit eum et posuit in carcere propter Herodiadem uxorem fratris sui
clem: Herodes enim tenuit Joannem, et alligavit eum: et posuit in carcerem propter Herodiadem uxorem fratris sui.
tr: ο γαρ ηρωδης κρατησας τον ιωαννην εδησεν αυτον και εθετο εν φυλακη δια ηρωδιαδα την γυναικα φιλιππου του αδελφου αυτου
kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

vulg: dicebat enim illi Iohannes non licet tibi habere eam
clem: Dicebat enim illi Joannes: Non licet tibi habere eam.
tr: ελεγεν γαρ αυτω ο ιωαννης ουκ εξεστιν σοι εχειν αυτην
kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

vulg: et volens illum occidere timuit populum quia sicut prophetam eum habebant
clem: Et volens illum occidere, timuit populum: quia sicut prophetam eum habebant.
tr: και θελων αυτον αποκτειναι εφοβηθη τον οχλον οτι ως προφητην αυτον ειχον
kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

vulg: die autem natalis Herodis saltavit filia Herodiadis in medio et placuit Herodi
clem: Die autem natalis Herodis saltavit filia Herodiadis in medio, et placuit Herodi:
tr: γενεσιων δε αγομενων του ηρωδου ωρχησατο η θυγατηρ της ηρωδιαδος εν τω μεσω και ηρεσεν τω ηρωδη
kjv: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

vulg: unde cum iuramento pollicitus est ei dare quodcumque postulasset ab eo
clem: unde cum juramento pollicitus est ei dare quodcumque postulasset ab eo.
tr: οθεν μεθ ορκου ωμολογησεν αυτη δουναι ο εαν αιτησηται
kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

vulg: at illa praemonita a matre sua da mihi inquit hic in disco caput Iohannis Baptistae
clem: At illa prmonita a matre sua: Da mihi, inquit, hic in disco caput Joannis Baptist.
tr: η δε προβιβασθεισα υπο της μητρος αυτης δος μοι φησιν ωδε επι πινακι την κεφαλην ιωαννου του βαπτιστου
kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

vulg: et contristatus est rex propter iuramentum autem et eos qui pariter recumbebant iussit dari
clem: Et contristatus est rex: propter juramentum autem, et eos qui pariter recumbebant, jussit dari.
tr: και ελυπηθη ο βασιλευς δια δε τους ορκους και τους συνανακειμενους εκελευσεν δοθηναι
kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

vulg: misitque et decollavit Iohannem in carcere
clem: Misitque et decollavit Joannem in carcere.
tr: και πεμψας απεκεφαλισεν τον ιωαννην εν τη φυλακη
kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

vulg: et adlatum est caput eius in disco et datum est puellae et tulit matri suae
clem: Et allatum est caput ejus in disco, et datum est puell, et attulit matri su.
tr: και ηνεχθη η κεφαλη αυτου επι πινακι και εδοθη τω κορασιω και ηνεγκεν τη μητρι αυτης
kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

vulg: et accedentes discipuli eius tulerunt corpus et sepelierunt illud et venientes nuntiaverunt Iesu
clem: Et accedentes discipuli ejus, tulerunt corpus ejus, et sepelierunt illud: et venientes nuntiaverunt Jesu.
tr: και προσελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου ηραν το σωμα και εθαψαν αυτο και ελθοντες απηγγειλαν τω ιησου
kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

vulg: quod cum audisset Iesus secessit inde in navicula in locum desertum seorsum et cum audissent turbae secutae sunt eum pedestres de civitatibus
clem: Quod cum audisset Jesus, secessit inde in navicula, in locum desertum seorsum: et cum audissent turb, secut sunt eum pedestres de civitatibus.
tr: και ακουσας ο ιησους ανεχωρησεν εκειθεν εν πλοιω εις ερημον τοπον κατ ιδιαν και ακουσαντες οι οχλοι ηκολουθησαν αυτω πεζη απο των πολεων
kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

vulg: et exiens vidit turbam multam et misertus est eius et curavit languidos eorum
clem: Et exiens vidit turbam multam, et misertus est eis, et curavit languidos eorum.
tr: και εξελθων ο ιησους ειδεν πολυν οχλον και εσπλαγχνισθη επ αυτους και εθεραπευσεν τους αρρωστους αυτων
kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

vulg: vespere autem facto accesserunt ad eum discipuli eius dicentes desertus est locus et hora iam praeteriit dimitte turbas ut euntes in castella emant sibi escas
clem: Vespere autem facto, accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus, dicentes: Desertus est locus, et hora jam prteriit: dimitte turbas, ut euntes in castella, emant sibi escas.
tr: οψιας δε γενομενης προσηλθον αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου λεγοντες ερημος εστιν ο τοπος και η ωρα ηδη παρηλθεν απολυσον τους οχλους ινα απελθοντες εις τας κωμας αγορασωσιν εαυτοις βρωματα
kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

vulg: Iesus autem dixit eis non habent necesse ire date illis vos manducare
clem: Jesus autem dixit eis: Non habent necesse ire: date illis vos manducare.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ου χρειαν εχουσιν απελθειν δοτε αυτοις υμεις φαγειν
kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

vulg: responderunt ei non habemus hic nisi quinque panes et duos pisces
clem: Responderunt ei: Non habemus hic nisi quinque panes et duos pisces.
tr: οι δε λεγουσιν αυτω ουκ εχομεν ωδε ει μη πεντε αρτους και δυο ιχθυας
kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

vulg: qui ait eis adferte illos mihi huc
clem: Qui ait eis: Afferte mihi illos huc.
tr: ο δε ειπεν φερετε μοι αυτους ωδε
kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.

vulg: et cum iussisset turbam discumbere supra faenum acceptis quinque panibus et duobus piscibus aspiciens in caelum benedixit et fregit et dedit discipulis panes discipuli autem turbis
clem: Et cum jussisset turbam discumbere super fnum, acceptis quinque panibus et duobus piscibus, aspiciens in clum benedixit, et fregit, et dedit discipulis panes, discipuli autem turbis.
tr: και κελευσας τους οχλους ανακλιθηναι επι τους χορτους και λαβων τους πεντε αρτους και τους δυο ιχθυας αναβλεψας εις τον ουρανον ευλογησεν και κλασας εδωκεν τοις μαθηταις τους αρτους οι δε μαθηται τοις οχλοις
kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

vulg: et manducaverunt omnes et saturati sunt et tulerunt reliquias duodecim cofinos fragmentorum plenos
clem: Et manducaverunt omnes, et saturati sunt. Et tulerunt reliquias, duodecim cophinos fragmentorum plenos.
tr: και εφαγον παντες και εχορτασθησαν και ηραν το περισσευον των κλασματων δωδεκα κοφινους πληρεις
kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

vulg: manducantium autem fuit numerus quinque milia virorum exceptis mulieribus et parvulis
clem: Manducantium autem fuit numerus quinque millia virorum, exceptis mulieribus et parvulis.
tr: οι δε εσθιοντες ησαν ανδρες ωσει πεντακισχιλιοι χωρις γυναικων και παιδιων
kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

vulg: et statim iussit discipulos ascendere in navicula et praecedere eum trans fretum donec dimitteret turbas
clem: Et statim compulit Jesus discipulos ascendere in naviculam, et prcedere eum trans fretum, donec dimitteret turbas.
tr: και ευθεως ηναγκασεν ο ιησους τους μαθητας αυτου εμβηναι εις το πλοιον και προαγειν αυτον εις το περαν εως ου απολυση τους οχλους
kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

vulg: et dimissa turba ascendit in montem solus orare vespere autem facto solus erat ibi
clem: Et dimissa turba, ascendit in montem solus orare. Vespere autem facto solus erat ibi:
tr: και απολυσας τους οχλους ανεβη εις το ορος κατ ιδιαν προσευξασθαι οψιας δε γενομενης μονος ην εκει
kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

vulg: navicula autem in medio mari iactabatur fluctibus erat enim contrarius ventus
clem: navicula autem in medio mari jactabatur fluctibus: erat enim contrarius ventus.
tr: το δε πλοιον ηδη μεσον της θαλασσης ην βασανιζομενον υπο των κυματων ην γαρ εναντιος ο ανεμος
kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

vulg: quarta autem vigilia noctis venit ad eos ambulans supra mare
clem: Quarta enim vigilia noctis, venit ad eos ambulans super mare.
tr: τεταρτη δε φυλακη της νυκτος απηλθεν προς αυτους ο ιησους περιπατων επι της θαλασσης
kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

vulg: et videntes eum supra mare ambulantem turbati sunt dicentes quia fantasma est et prae timore clamaverunt
clem: Et videntes eum super mare ambulantem, turbati sunt, dicentes: Quia phantasma est. Et pr timore clamaverunt.
tr: και ιδοντες αυτον οι μαθηται επι την θαλασσαν περιπατουντα εταραχθησαν λεγοντες οτι φαντασμα εστιν και απο του φοβου εκραξαν
kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

vulg: statimque Iesus locutus est eis dicens habete fiduciam ego sum nolite timere
clem: Statimque Jesus locutus est eis, dicens: Habete fiduciam: ego sum, nolite timere.
tr: ευθεως δε ελαλησεν αυτοις ο ιησους λεγων θαρσειτε εγω ειμι μη φοβεισθε
kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

vulg: respondens autem Petrus dixit Domine si tu es iube me venire ad te super aquas
clem: Respondens autem Petrus, dixit: Domine, si tu es, jube me ad te venire super aquas.
tr: αποκριθεις δε αυτω ο πετρος ειπεν κυριε ει συ ει κελευσον με προς σε ελθειν επι τα υδατα
kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

vulg: at ipse ait veni et descendens Petrus de navicula ambulabat super aquam ut veniret ad Iesum
clem: At ipse ait: Veni. Et descendens Petrus de navicula, ambulabat super aquam ut veniret ad Jesum.
tr: ο δε ειπεν ελθε και καταβας απο του πλοιου ο πετρος περιεπατησεν επι τα υδατα ελθειν προς τον ιησουν
kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

vulg: videns vero ventum validum timuit et cum coepisset mergi clamavit dicens Domine salvum me fac
clem: Videns vero ventum validum, timuit: et cum cpisset mergi, clamavit dicens: Domine, salvum me fac.
tr: βλεπων δε τον ανεμον ισχυρον εφοβηθη και αρξαμενος καταποντιζεσθαι εκραξεν λεγων κυριε σωσον με
kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

vulg: et continuo Iesus extendens manum adprehendit eum et ait illi modicae fidei quare dubitasti
clem: Et continuo Jesus extendens manum, apprehendit eum: et ait illi: Modic fidei, quare dubitasti?
tr: ευθεως δε ο ιησους εκτεινας την χειρα επελαβετο αυτου και λεγει αυτω ολιγοπιστε εις τι εδιστασας
kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

vulg: et cum ascendissent in naviculam cessavit ventus
clem: Et cum ascendissent in naviculam, cessavit ventus.
tr: και εμβαντων αυτων εις το πλοιον εκοπασεν ο ανεμος
kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

vulg: qui autem in navicula erant venerunt et adoraverunt eum dicentes vere Filius Dei es
clem: Qui autem in navicula erant, venerunt, et adoraverunt eum, dicentes: Vere Filius Dei es.
tr: οι δε εν τω πλοιω ελθοντες προσεκυνησαν αυτω λεγοντες αληθως θεου υιος ει
kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

vulg: et cum transfretassent venerunt in terram Gennesar
clem: Et cum transfretassent, venerunt in terram Genesar.
tr: και διαπερασαντες ηλθον εις την γην γεννησαρετ
kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

vulg: et cum cognovissent eum viri loci illius miserunt in universam regionem illam et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes
clem: Et cum cognovissent eum viri loci illius, miserunt in universam regionem illam, et obtulerunt ei omnes male habentes:
tr: και επιγνοντες αυτον οι ανδρες του τοπου εκεινου απεστειλαν εις ολην την περιχωρον εκεινην και προσηνεγκαν αυτω παντας τους κακως εχοντας
kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

vulg: et rogabant eum ut vel fimbriam vestimenti eius tangerent et quicumque tetigerunt salvi facti sunt
clem: et rogabant eum ut vel fimbriam vestimenti ejus tangerent. Et quicumque tetigerunt, salvi facti sunt.
tr: και παρεκαλουν αυτον ινα μονον αψωνται του κρασπεδου του ιματιου αυτου και οσοι ηψαντο διεσωθησαν
kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

vulg: tunc accesserunt ad eum ab Hierosolymis scribae et Pharisaei dicentes
clem: Tunc accesserunt ad eum ab Jerosolymis scrib et pharisi, dicentes:
tr: τοτε προσερχονται τω ιησου οι απο ιεροσολυμων γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι λεγοντες
kjv: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

vulg: quare discipuli tui transgrediuntur traditionem seniorum non enim lavant manus suas cum panem manducant
clem: Quare discipuli tui transgrediuntur traditionem seniorum? non enim lavant manus suas cum panem manducant.
tr: δια τι οι μαθηται σου παραβαινουσιν την παραδοσιν των πρεσβυτερων ου γαρ νιπτονται τας χειρας αυτων οταν αρτον εσθιωσιν
kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

vulg: ipse autem respondens ait illis quare et vos transgredimini mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram
clem: Ipse autem respondens ait illis: Quare et vos transgredimini mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram? Nam Deus dixit:
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις δια τι και υμεις παραβαινετε την εντολην του θεου δια την παραδοσιν υμων
kjv: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

vulg: nam Deus dixit honora patrem et matrem et qui maledixerit patri vel matri morte moriatur
clem: Honora patrem, et matrem: et, Qui maledixerit patri, vel matri, morte moriatur.
tr: ο γαρ θεος ενετειλατο λεγων τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα και ο κακολογων πατερα η μητερα θανατω τελευτατω
kjv: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

vulg: vos autem dicitis quicumque dixerit patri vel matri munus quodcumque est ex me tibi proderit
clem: Vos autem dicitis: Quicumque dixerit patri, vel matri: Munus, quodcumque est ex me, tibi proderit:
tr: υμεις δε λεγετε ος αν ειπη τω πατρι η τη μητρι δωρον ο εαν εξ εμου ωφεληθης
kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

vulg: et non honorificabit patrem suum aut matrem et irritum fecistis mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram
clem: et non honorificavit patrem suum, aut matrem suam: et irritum fecistis mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram.
tr: και ου μη τιμηση τον πατερα αυτου η την μητερα αυτου (15:6) και ηκυρωσατε την εντολην του θεου δια την παραδοσιν υμων
kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

vulg: hypocritae bene prophetavit de vobis Esaias dicens
clem: Hypocrit, bene prophetavit de vobis Isaias, dicens:
tr: υποκριται καλως προεφητευσεν περι υμων ησαιας λεγων
kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

vulg: populus hic labiis me honorat cor autem eorum longe est a me
clem: [Populus hic labiis me honorat: cor autem eorum longe est a me.
tr: εγγιζει μοι ο λαος ουτος τω στοματι αυτων και τοις χειλεσιν με τιμα η δε καρδια αυτων πορρω απεχει απ εμου
kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

vulg: sine causa autem colunt me docentes doctrinas mandata hominum
clem: Sine causa autem colunt me, docentes doctrinas et mandata hominum.]
tr: ματην δε σεβονται με διδασκοντες διδασκαλιας ενταλματα ανθρωπων
kjv: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

vulg: et convocatis ad se turbis dixit eis audite et intellegite
clem: Et convocatis ad se turbis, dixit eis: Audite, et intelligite.
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος τον οχλον ειπεν αυτοις ακουετε και συνιετε
kjv: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

vulg: non quod intrat in os coinquinat hominem sed quod procedit ex ore hoc coinquinat hominem
clem: Non quod intrat in os, coinquinat hominem: sed quod procedit ex ore, hoc coinquinat hominem.
tr: ου το εισερχομενον εις το στομα κοινοι τον ανθρωπον αλλα το εκπορευομενον εκ του στοματος τουτο κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

vulg: tunc accedentes discipuli eius dixerunt ei scis quia Pharisaei audito verbo scandalizati sunt
clem: Tunc accedentes discipuli ejus, dixerunt ei: Scis quia pharisi audito verbo hoc, scandalizati sunt?
tr: τοτε προσελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου ειπον αυτω οιδας οτι οι φαρισαιοι ακουσαντες τον λογον εσκανδαλισθησαν
kjv: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

vulg: at ille respondens ait omnis plantatio quam non plantavit Pater meus caelestis eradicabitur
clem: At ille respondens ait: Omnis plantatio, quam non plantavit Pater meus clestis, eradicabitur.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν πασα φυτεια ην ουκ εφυτευσεν ο πατηρ μου ο ουρανιος εκριζωθησεται
kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

vulg: sinite illos caeci sunt duces caecorum caecus autem si caeco ducatum praestet ambo in foveam cadunt
clem: Sinite illos: cci sunt, et duces ccorum; ccus autem si cco ducatum prstet, ambo in foveam cadunt.
tr: αφετε αυτους οδηγοι εισιν τυφλοι τυφλων τυφλος δε τυφλον εαν οδηγη αμφοτεροι εις βοθυνον πεσουνται
kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

vulg: respondens autem Petrus dixit ei edissere nobis parabolam istam
clem: Respondens autem Petrus dixit ei: Edissere nobis parabolam istam.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος ειπεν αυτω φρασον ημιν την παραβολην ταυτην
kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

vulg: at ille dixit adhuc et vos sine intellectu estis
clem: At ille dixit: Adhuc et vos sine intellectu estis?
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν ακμην και υμεις ασυνετοι εστε
kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

vulg: non intellegitis quia omne quod in os intrat in ventrem vadit et in secessum emittitur
clem: Non intelligitis quia omne quod in os intrat, in ventrem vadit, et in secessum emittitur?
tr: ουπω νοειτε οτι παν το εισπορευομενον εις το στομα εις την κοιλιαν χωρει και εις αφεδρωνα εκβαλλεται
kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

vulg: quae autem procedunt de ore de corde exeunt et ea coinquinant hominem
clem: Qu autem procedunt de ore, de corde exeunt, et ea coinquinant hominem:
tr: τα δε εκπορευομενα εκ του στοματος εκ της καρδιας εξερχεται κακεινα κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
kjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

vulg: de corde enim exeunt cogitationes malae homicidia adulteria fornicationes furta falsa testimonia blasphemiae
clem: de corde enim exeunt cogitationes mal, homicidia, adulteria, fornicationes, furta, falsa testimonia, blasphemi:
tr: εκ γαρ της καρδιας εξερχονται διαλογισμοι πονηροι φονοι μοιχειαι πορνειαι κλοπαι ψευδομαρτυριαι βλασφημιαι
kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

vulg: haec sunt quae coinquinant hominem non lotis autem manibus manducare non coinquinat hominem
clem: hc sunt, qu coinquinant hominem. Non lotis autem manibus manducare, non coinquinat hominem.
tr: ταυτα εστιν τα κοινουντα τον ανθρωπον το δε ανιπτοις χερσιν φαγειν ου κοινοι τον ανθρωπον
kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

vulg: et egressus inde Iesus secessit in partes Tyri et Sidonis
clem: Et egressus inde Jesus secessit in partes Tyri et Sidonis.
tr: και εξελθων εκειθεν ο ιησους ανεχωρησεν εις τα μερη τυρου και σιδωνος
kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

vulg: et ecce mulier chananea a finibus illis egressa clamavit dicens ei miserere mei Domine Fili David filia mea male a daemonio vexatur
clem: Et ecce mulier chanana a finibus illis egressa clamavit, dicens ei: Miserere mei, Domine fili David: filia mea male a dmonio vexatur.
tr: και ιδου γυνη χαναναια απο των οριων εκεινων εξελθουσα εκραυγασεν αυτω λεγουσα ελεησον με κυριε υιε δαβιδ η θυγατηρ μου κακως δαιμονιζεται
kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

vulg: qui non respondit ei verbum et accedentes discipuli eius rogabant eum dicentes dimitte eam quia clamat post nos
clem: Qui non respondit ei verbum. Et accedentes discipuli ejus rogabant eum dicentes: Dimitte eam: quia clamat post nos.
tr: ο δε ουκ απεκριθη αυτη λογον και προσελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου ηρωτων αυτον λεγοντες απολυσον αυτην οτι κραζει οπισθεν ημων
kjv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

vulg: ipse autem respondens ait non sum missus nisi ad oves quae perierunt domus Israhel
clem: Ipse autem respondens ait: Non sum missus nisi ad oves, qu perierunt domus Isral.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν ουκ απεσταλην ει μη εις τα προβατα τα απολωλοτα οικου ισραηλ
kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

vulg: at illa venit et adoravit eum dicens Domine adiuva me
clem: At illa venit, et adoravit eum, dicens: Domine, adjuva me.
tr: η δε ελθουσα προσεκυνει αυτω λεγουσα κυριε βοηθει μοι
kjv: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

vulg: qui respondens ait non est bonum sumere panem filiorum et mittere canibus
clem: Qui respondens ait: Non est bonum sumere panem filiorum, et mittere canibus.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν ουκ εστιν καλον λαβειν τον αρτον των τεκνων και βαλειν τοις κυναριοις
kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.

vulg: at illa dixit etiam Domine nam et catelli edunt de micis quae cadunt de mensa dominorum suorum
clem: At illa dixit: Etiam Domine: nam et catelli edunt de micis qu cadunt de mensa dominorum suorum.
tr: η δε ειπεν ναι κυριε και γαρ τα κυναρια εσθιει απο των ψιχιων των πιπτοντων απο της τραπεζης των κυριων αυτων
kjv: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

vulg: tunc respondens Iesus ait illi o mulier magna est fides tua fiat tibi sicut vis et sanata est filia illius ex illa hora
clem: Tunc respondens Jesus, ait illi: O mulier, magna est fides tua: fiat tibi sicut vis. Et sanata est filia ejus ex illa hora.
tr: τοτε αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτη ω γυναι μεγαλη σου η πιστις γενηθητω σοι ως θελεις και ιαθη η θυγατηρ αυτης απο της ωρας εκεινης
kjv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

vulg: et cum transisset inde Iesus venit secus mare Galilaeae et ascendens in montem sedebat ibi
clem: Et cum transisset inde Jesus, venit secus mare Galil: et ascendens in montem, sedebat ibi.
tr: και μεταβας εκειθεν ο ιησους ηλθεν παρα την θαλασσαν της γαλιλαιας και αναβας εις το ορος εκαθητο εκει
kjv: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

vulg: et accesserunt ad eum turbae multae habentes secum mutos clodos caecos debiles et alios multos et proiecerunt eos ad pedes eius et curavit eos
clem: Et accesserunt ad eum turb mult, habentes secum mutos, ccos, claudos, debiles, et alios multos: et projecerunt eos ad pedes ejus, et curavit eos,
tr: και προσηλθον αυτω οχλοι πολλοι εχοντες μεθ εαυτων χωλους τυφλους κωφους κυλλους και ετερους πολλους και ερριψαν αυτους παρα τους ποδας του ιησου και εθεραπευσεν αυτους
kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

vulg: ita ut turbae mirarentur videntes mutos loquentes clodos ambulantes caecos videntes et magnificabant Deum Israhel
clem: ita ut turb mirarentur, videntes mutos loquentes, claudos ambulantes, ccos videntes: et magnificabant Deum Isral.
tr: ωστε τους οχλους θαυμασαι βλεποντας κωφους λαλουντας κυλλους υγιεις χωλους περιπατουντας και τυφλους βλεποντας και εδοξασαν τον θεον ισραηλ
kjv: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

vulg: Iesus autem convocatis discipulis suis dixit misereor turbae quia triduo iam perseverant mecum et non habent quod manducent et dimittere eos ieiunos nolo ne deficiant in via
clem: Jesus autem, convocatis discipulis suis, dixit: Misereor turb, quia triduo jam perseverant mecum, et non habent quod manducent: et dimittere eos jejunos nolo, ne deficiant in via.
tr: ο δε ιησους προσκαλεσαμενος τους μαθητας αυτου ειπεν σπλαγχνιζομαι επι τον οχλον οτι ηδη ημερας τρεις προσμενουσιν μοι και ουκ εχουσιν τι φαγωσιν και απολυσαι αυτους νηστεις ου θελω μηποτε εκλυθωσιν εν τη οδω
kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

vulg: et dicunt ei discipuli unde ergo nobis in deserto panes tantos ut saturemus turbam tantam
clem: Et dicunt ei discipuli: Unde ergo nobis in deserto panes tantos, ut saturemus turbam tantam?
tr: και λεγουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ποθεν ημιν εν ερημια αρτοι τοσουτοι ωστε χορτασαι οχλον τοσουτον
kjv: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

vulg: et ait illis Iesus quot panes habetis at illi dixerunt septem et paucos pisciculos
clem: Et ait illis Jesus: Quot habetis panes? At illi dixerunt: Septem, et paucos pisciculos.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους ποσους αρτους εχετε οι δε ειπον επτα και ολιγα ιχθυδια
kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

vulg: et praecepit turbae ut discumberet super terram
clem: Et prcepit turb ut discumberent super terram.
tr: και εκελευσεν τοις οχλοις αναπεσειν επι την γην
kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

vulg: et accipiens septem panes et pisces et gratias agens fregit et dedit discipulis suis et discipuli dederunt populo
clem: Et accipiens septem panes, et pisces, et gratias agens, fregit, et dedit discipulis suis, et discipuli dederunt populo.
tr: και λαβων τους επτα αρτους και τους ιχθυας ευχαριστησας εκλασεν και εδωκεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου οι δε μαθηται τω οχλω
kjv: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

vulg: et comederunt omnes et saturati sunt et quod superfuit de fragmentis tulerunt septem sportas plenas
clem: Et comederunt omnes, et saturati sunt. Et quod superfuit de fragmentis, tulerunt septem sportas plenas.
tr: και εφαγον παντες και εχορτασθησαν και ηραν το περισσευον των κλασματων επτα σπυριδας πληρεις
kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

vulg: erant autem qui manducaverant quattuor milia hominum extra parvulos et mulieres
clem: Erant autem qui manducaverunt quatuor millia hominum, extra parvulos et mulieres.
tr: οι δε εσθιοντες ησαν τετρακισχιλιοι ανδρες χωρις γυναικων και παιδιων
kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

vulg: et dimissa turba ascendit in naviculam et venit in fines Magedan
clem: Et, dimissa turba, ascendit in naviculam: et venit in fines Magedan.
tr: και απολυσας τους οχλους ενεβη εις το πλοιον και ηλθεν εις τα ορια μαγδαλα
kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

vulg: et accesserunt ad eum Pharisaei et Sadducaei temptantes et rogaverunt eum ut signum de caelo ostenderet eis
clem: Et accesserunt ad eum pharisi et sadduci tentantes: et rogaverunt eum ut signum de clo ostenderet eis.
tr: και προσελθοντες οι φαρισαιοι και σαδδουκαιοι πειραζοντες επηρωτησαν αυτον σημειον εκ του ουρανου επιδειξαι αυτοις
kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

vulg: at ille respondens ait eis facto vespere dicitis serenum erit rubicundum est enim caelum
clem: At ille respondens, ait illis: Facto vespere dicitis: Serenum erit, rubicundum est enim clum.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις οψιας γενομενης λεγετε ευδια πυρραζει γαρ ο ουρανος
kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

vulg: et mane hodie tempestas rutilat enim triste caelum
clem: Et mane: Hodie tempestas, rutilat enim triste clum.
tr: και πρωι σημερον χειμων πυρραζει γαρ στυγναζων ο ουρανος υποκριται το μεν προσωπον του ουρανου γινωσκετε διακρινειν τα δε σημεια των καιρων ου δυνασθε
kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowering. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

vulg: faciem ergo caeli diiudicare nostis signa autem temporum non potestis generatio mala et adultera signum quaerit et signum non dabitur ei nisi signum Ionae et relictis illis abiit
clem: Faciem ergo cli dijudicare nostis: signa autem temporum non potestis scire? Generatio mala et adultera signum qurit: et signum non dabitur ei, nisi signum Jon prophet. Et relictis illis, abiit.
tr: γενεα πονηρα και μοιχαλις σημειον επιζητει και σημειον ου δοθησεται αυτη ει μη το σημειον ιωνα του προφητου και καταλιπων αυτους απηλθεν
kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

vulg: et cum venissent discipuli eius trans fretum obliti sunt panes accipere
clem: Et cum venissent discipuli ejus trans fretum, obliti sunt panes accipere.
tr: και ελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου εις το περαν επελαθοντο αρτους λαβειν
kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

vulg: qui dixit illis intuemini et cavete a fermento Pharisaeorum et Sadducaeorum
clem: Qui dixit illis: Intuemini, et cavete a fermento pharisorum et sadducorum.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ορατε και προσεχετε απο της ζυμης των φαρισαιων και σαδδουκαιων
kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

vulg: at illi cogitabant inter se dicentes quia panes non accepimus
clem: At illi cogitabant intra se dicentes: Quia panes non accepimus.
tr: οι δε διελογιζοντο εν εαυτοις λεγοντες οτι αρτους ουκ ελαβομεν
kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

vulg: sciens autem Iesus dixit quid cogitatis inter vos modicae fidei quia panes non habetis
clem: Sciens autem Jesus, dixit: Quid cogitatis intra vos modic fidei, quia panes non habetis?
tr: γνους δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις τι διαλογιζεσθε εν εαυτοις ολιγοπιστοι οτι αρτους ουκ ελαβετε
kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

vulg: nondum intellegitis neque recordamini quinque panum quinque milium hominum et quot cofinos sumpsistis
clem: Nondum intelligitis, neque recordamini quinque panum in quinque millia hominum, et quot cophinos sumpsistis?
tr: ουπω νοειτε ουδε μνημονευετε τους πεντε αρτους των πεντακισχιλιων και ποσους κοφινους ελαβετε
kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

vulg: neque septem panum quattuor milium hominum et quot sportas sumpsistis
clem: neque septem panum in quatuor millia hominum, et quot sportas sumpsistis?
tr: ουδε τους επτα αρτους των τετρακισχιλιων και ποσας σπυριδας ελαβετε
kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

vulg: quare non intellegitis quia non de pane dixi vobis cavete a fermento Pharisaeorum et Sadducaeorum
clem: Quare non intelligitis, quia non de pane dixi vobis: Cavete a fermento pharisorum et sadducorum?
tr: πως ου νοειτε οτι ου περι αρτου ειπον υμιν προσεχειν απο της ζυμης των φαρισαιων και σαδδουκαιων
kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

vulg: tunc intellexerunt quia non dixerit cavendum a fermento panum sed a doctrina Pharisaeorum et Sadducaeorum
clem: Tunc intellexerunt quia non dixerit cavendum a fermento panum, sed a doctrina pharisorum et sadducorum.
tr: τοτε συνηκαν οτι ουκ ειπεν προσεχειν απο της ζυμης του αρτου αλλ απο της διδαχης των φαρισαιων και σαδδουκαιων
kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

vulg: venit autem Iesus in partes Caesareae Philippi et interrogabat discipulos suos dicens quem dicunt homines esse Filium hominis
clem: Venit autem Jesus in partes Csare Philippi: et interrogabat discipulos suos, dicens: Quem dicunt homines esse Filium hominis?
tr: ελθων δε ο ιησους εις τα μερη καισαρειας της φιλιππου ηρωτα τους μαθητας αυτου λεγων τινα με λεγουσιν οι ανθρωποι ειναι τον υιον του ανθρωπου
kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

vulg: at illi dixerunt alii Iohannem Baptistam alii autem Heliam alii vero Hieremiam aut unum ex prophetis
clem: At illi dixerunt: Alii Joannem Baptistam, alii autem Eliam, alii vero Jeremiam, aut unum ex prophetis.
tr: οι δε ειπον οι μεν ιωαννην τον βαπτιστην αλλοι δε ηλιαν ετεροι δε ιερεμιαν η ενα των προφητων
kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

vulg: dicit illis vos autem quem me esse dicitis
clem: Dicit illis Jesus: Vos autem, quem me esse dicitis?
tr: λεγει αυτοις υμεις δε τινα με λεγετε ειναι
kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

vulg: respondens Simon Petrus dixit tu es Christus Filius Dei vivi
clem: Respondens Simon Petrus dixit: Tu es Christus, Filius Dei vivi.
tr: αποκριθεις δε σιμων πετρος ειπεν συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου του ζωντος
kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
