vulg: respondens autem Iesus dixit ei beatus es Simon Bar Iona quia caro et sanguis non revelavit tibi sed Pater meus qui in caelis est
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit ei: Beatus es Simon Bar Jona: quia caro et sanguis non revelavit tibi, sed Pater meus, qui in clis est.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτω μακαριος ει σιμων βαρ ιωνα οτι σαρξ και αιμα ουκ απεκαλυψεν σοι αλλ ο πατηρ μου ο εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

vulg: et ego dico tibi quia tu es Petrus et super hanc petram aedificabo ecclesiam meam et portae inferi non praevalebunt adversum eam
clem: Et ego dico tibi, quia tu es Petrus, et super hanc petram dificabo Ecclesiam meam, et port inferi non prvalebunt adversus eam.
tr: καγω δε σοι λεγω οτι συ ει πετρος και επι ταυτη τη πετρα οικοδομησω μου την εκκλησιαν και πυλαι αδου ου κατισχυσουσιν αυτης
kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

vulg: et tibi dabo claves regni caelorum et quodcumque ligaveris super terram erit ligatum in caelis et quodcumque solveris super terram erit solutum in caelis
clem: Et tibi dabo claves regni clorum. Et quodcumque ligaveris super terram, erit ligatum et in clis: et quodcumque solveris super terram, erit solutum et in clis.
tr: και δωσω σοι τας κλεις της βασιλειας των ουρανων και ο εαν δησης επι της γης εσται δεδεμενον εν τοις ουρανοις και ο εαν λυσης επι της γης εσται λελυμενον εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

vulg: tunc praecepit discipulis suis ut nemini dicerent quia ipse esset Iesus Christus
clem: Tunc prcepit discipulis suis ut nemini dicerent quia ipse esset Jesus Christus.
tr: τοτε διεστειλατο τοις μαθηταις αυτου ινα μηδενι ειπωσιν οτι αυτος εστιν ιησους ο χριστος
kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

vulg: exinde coepit Iesus ostendere discipulis suis quia oporteret eum ire Hierosolymam et multa pati a senioribus et scribis et principibus sacerdotum et occidi et tertia die resurgere
clem: Exinde cpit Jesus ostendere discipulis suis, quia oporteret eum ire Jerosolymam, et multa pati a senioribus, et scribis, et principibus sacerdotum, et occidi, et tertia die resurgere.
tr: απο τοτε ηρξατο ο ιησους δεικνυειν τοις μαθηταις αυτου οτι δει αυτον απελθειν εις ιεροσολυμα και πολλα παθειν απο των πρεσβυτερων και αρχιερεων και γραμματεων και αποκτανθηναι και τη τριτη ημερα εγερθηναι
kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

vulg: et adsumens eum Petrus coepit increpare illum dicens absit a te Domine non erit tibi hoc
clem: Et assumens eum Petrus, cpit increpare illum dicens: Absit a te, Domine: non erit tibi hoc.
tr: και προσλαβομενος αυτον ο πετρος ηρξατο επιτιμαν αυτω λεγων ιλεως σοι κυριε ου μη εσται σοι τουτο
kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

vulg: qui conversus dixit Petro vade post me Satana scandalum es mihi quia non sapis ea quae Dei sunt sed ea quae hominum
clem: Qui conversus, dixit Petro: Vade post me Satana, scandalum es mihi: quia non sapis ea qu Dei sunt, sed ea qu hominum.
tr: ο δε στραφεις ειπεν τω πετρω υπαγε οπισω μου σατανα σκανδαλον μου ει οτι ου φρονεις τα του θεου αλλα τα των ανθρωπων
kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

vulg: tunc Iesus dixit discipulis suis si quis vult post me venire abneget semet ipsum et tollat crucem suam et sequatur me
clem: Tunc Jesus dixit discipulis suis: Si quis vult post me venire, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequatur me.
tr: τοτε ο ιησους ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου ει τις θελει οπισω μου ελθειν απαρνησασθω εαυτον και αρατω τον σταυρον αυτου και ακολουθειτω μοι
kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

vulg: qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere perdet eam qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me inveniet eam
clem: Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere, perdet eam: qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me, inveniet eam.
tr: ος γαρ αν θελη την ψυχην αυτου σωσαι απολεσει αυτην ος δ αν απολεση την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου ευρησει αυτην
kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

vulg: quid enim prodest homini si mundum universum lucretur animae vero suae detrimentum patiatur aut quam dabit homo commutationem pro anima sua
clem: Quid enim prodest homini, si mundum universum lucretur, anim vero su detrimentum patiatur? aut quam dabit homo commutationem pro anima sua?
tr: τι γαρ ωφελειται ανθρωπος εαν τον κοσμον ολον κερδηση την δε ψυχην αυτου ζημιωθη η τι δωσει ανθρωπος ανταλλαγμα της ψυχης αυτου
kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

vulg: Filius enim hominis venturus est in gloria Patris sui cum angelis suis et tunc reddet unicuique secundum opus eius
clem: Filius enim hominis venturus est in gloria Patris sui cum angelis suis: et tunc reddet unicuique secundum opera ejus.
tr: μελλει γαρ ο υιος του ανθρωπου ερχεσθαι εν τη δοξη του πατρος αυτου μετα των αγγελων αυτου και τοτε αποδωσει εκαστω κατα την πραξιν αυτου
kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

vulg: amen dico vobis sunt quidam de hic stantibus qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant Filium hominis venientem in regno suo
clem: Amen dico vobis, sunt quidam de hic stantibus, qui non gustabunt mortem, donec videant Filium hominis venientem in regno suo.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν εισιν τινες των ωδε εστηκοτων οιτινες ου μη γευσωνται θανατου εως αν ιδωσιν τον υιον του ανθρωπου ερχομενον εν τη βασιλεια αυτου
kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

vulg: et post dies sex adsumpsit Iesus Petrum et Iacobum et Iohannem fratrem eius et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum
clem: Et post dies sex assumit Jesus Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem fratrem ejus, et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum:
tr: και μεθ ημερας εξ παραλαμβανει ο ιησους τον πετρον και ιακωβον και ιωαννην τον αδελφον αυτου και αναφερει αυτους εις ορος υψηλον κατ ιδιαν
kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

vulg: et transfiguratus est ante eos et resplenduit facies eius sicut sol vestimenta autem eius facta sunt alba sicut nix
clem: et transfiguratus est ante eos. Et resplenduit facies ejus sicut sol: vestimenta autem ejus facta sunt alba sicut nix.
tr: και μετεμορφωθη εμπροσθεν αυτων και ελαμψεν το προσωπον αυτου ως ο ηλιος τα δε ιματια αυτου εγενετο λευκα ως το φως
kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

vulg: et ecce apparuit illis Moses et Helias cum eo loquentes
clem: Et ecce apparuerunt illis Moyses et Elias cum eo loquentes.
tr: και ιδου ωφθησαν αυτοις μωσης και ηλιας μετ αυτου συλλαλουντες
kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

vulg: respondens autem Petrus dixit ad Iesum Domine bonum est nos hic esse si vis faciamus hic tria tabernacula tibi unum et Mosi unum et Heliae unum
clem: Respondens autem Petrus, dixit ad Jesum: Domine, bonum est nos hic esse: si vis, faciamus tria tabernacula, tibi unum, Moysi unum, et Eli unum.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος ειπεν τω ιησου κυριε καλον εστιν ημας ωδε ειναι ει θελεις ποιησωμεν ωδε τρεις σκηνας σοι μιαν και μωση μιαν και μιαν ηλια
kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

vulg: adhuc eo loquente ecce nubes lucida obumbravit eos et ecce vox de nube dicens hic est Filius meus dilectus in quo mihi bene conplacuit ipsum audite
clem: Adhuc eo loquente, ecce nubes lucida obumbravit eos. Et ecce vox de nube, dicens: Hic est Filius meus dilectus, in quo mihi bene complacui: ipsum audite.
tr: ετι αυτου λαλουντος ιδου νεφελη φωτεινη επεσκιασεν αυτους και ιδου φωνη εκ της νεφελης λεγουσα ουτος εστιν ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος εν ω ευδοκησα αυτου ακουετε
kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

vulg: et audientes discipuli ceciderunt in faciem suam et timuerunt valde
clem: Et audientes discipuli ceciderunt in faciem suam, et timuerunt valde.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι μαθηται επεσον επι προσωπον αυτων και εφοβηθησαν σφοδρα
kjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

vulg: et accessit Iesus et tetigit eos dixitque eis surgite et nolite timere
clem: Et accessit Jesus, et tetigit eos: dixitque eis: Surgite, et nolite timere.
tr: και προσελθων ο ιησους ηψατο αυτων και ειπεν εγερθητε και μη φοβεισθε
kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

vulg: levantes autem oculos suos neminem viderunt nisi solum Iesum
clem: Levantes autem oculos suos, neminem viderunt, nisi solum Jesum.
tr: επαραντες δε τους οφθαλμους αυτων ουδενα ειδον ει μη τον ιησουν μονον
kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

vulg: et descendentibus illis de monte praecepit Iesus dicens nemini dixeritis visionem donec Filius hominis a mortuis resurgat
clem: Et descendentibus illis de monte, prcepit eis Jesus, dicens: Nemini dixeritis visionem, donec Filius hominis a mortuis resurgat.
tr: και καταβαινοντων αυτων απο του ορους ενετειλατο αυτοις ο ιησους λεγων μηδενι ειπητε το οραμα εως ου ο υιος του ανθρωπου εκ νεκρων αναστη
kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

vulg: et interrogaverunt eum discipuli dicentes quid ergo scribae dicunt quod Heliam oporteat primum venire
clem: Et interrogaverunt eum discipuli, dicentes: Quid ergo scrib dicunt, quod Eliam oporteat primum venire?
tr: και επηρωτησαν αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου λεγοντες τι ουν οι γραμματεις λεγουσιν οτι ηλιαν δει ελθειν πρωτον
kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

vulg: at ille respondens ait eis Helias quidem venturus est et restituet omnia
clem: At ille respondens, ait eis: Elias quidem venturus est, et restituet omnia.
tr: ο δε ιησους αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ηλιας μεν ερχεται πρωτον και αποκαταστησει παντα
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

vulg: dico autem vobis quia Helias iam venit et non cognoverunt eum sed fecerunt in eo quaecumque voluerunt sic et Filius hominis passurus est ab eis
clem: Dico autem vobis, quia Elias jam venit, et non cognoverunt eum, sed fecerunt in eo qucumque voluerunt. Sic et Filius hominis passurus est ab eis.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ηλιας ηδη ηλθεν και ουκ επεγνωσαν αυτον αλλ εποιησαν εν αυτω οσα ηθελησαν ουτως και ο υιος του ανθρωπου μελλει πασχειν υπ αυτων
kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

vulg: tunc intellexerunt discipuli quia de Iohanne Baptista dixisset eis
clem: Tunc intellexerunt discipuli, quia de Joanne Baptista dixisset eis.
tr: τοτε συνηκαν οι μαθηται οτι περι ιωαννου του βαπτιστου ειπεν αυτοις
kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

vulg: et cum venisset ad turbam accessit ad eum homo genibus provolutus ante eum dicens Domine miserere filii mei quia lunaticus est et male patitur nam saepe cadit in ignem et crebro in aquam
clem: Et cum venisset ad turbam, accessit ad eum homo genibus provolutus ante eum, dicens: Domine, miserere filio meo, quia lunaticus est, et male patitur: nam spe cadit in ignem, et crebro in aquam.
tr: και ελθοντων αυτων προς τον οχλον προσηλθεν αυτω ανθρωπος γονυπετων αυτω (17:15) και λεγων
kjv: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

vulg: et obtuli eum discipulis tuis et non potuerunt curare eum
clem: Et obtuli eum discipulis tuis, et non potuerunt curare eum.
tr: κυριε ελεησον μου τον υιον οτι σεληνιαζεται και κακως πασχει πολλακις γαρ πιπτει εις το πυρ και πολλακις εις το υδωρ
kjv: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

vulg: respondens Iesus ait o generatio incredula et perversa quousque ero vobiscum usquequo patiar vos adferte huc illum ad me
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, ait: O generatio incredula, et perversa, quousque ero vobiscum? usquequo patiar vos? Afferte huc illum ad me.
tr: και προσηνεγκα αυτον τοις μαθηταις σου και ουκ ηδυνηθησαν αυτον θεραπευσαι
kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

vulg: et increpavit ei Iesus et exiit ab eo daemonium et curatus est puer ex illa hora
clem: Et increpavit illum Jesus, et exiit ab eo dmonium, et curatus est puer ex illa hora.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν ω γενεα απιστος και διεστραμμενη εως ποτε εσομαι μεθ υμων εως ποτε ανεξομαι υμων φερετε μοι αυτον ωδε
kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

vulg: tunc accesserunt discipuli ad Iesum secreto et dixerunt quare nos non potuimus eicere illum
clem: Tunc accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum secreto, et dixerunt: Quare nos non potuimus ejicere illum?
tr: και επετιμησεν αυτω ο ιησους και εξηλθεν απ αυτου το δαιμονιον και εθεραπευθη ο παις απο της ωρας εκεινης
kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

vulg: dicit illis propter incredulitatem vestram amen quippe dico vobis si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis dicetis monti huic transi hinc et transibit et nihil inpossibile erit vobis
clem: Dixit illis Jesus: Propter incredulitatem vestram. Amen quippe dico vobis, si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis, dicetis monti huic: Transi hinc illuc, et transibit, et nihil impossibile erit vobis.
tr: τοτε προσελθοντες οι μαθηται τω ιησου κατ ιδιαν ειπον δια τι ημεις ουκ ηδυνηθημεν εκβαλειν αυτο
kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

vulg: hoc autem genus non eicitur nisi per orationem et ieiunium
clem: Hoc autem genus non ejicitur nisi per orationem et jejunium.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις δια την απιστιαν υμων αμην γαρ λεγω υμιν εαν εχητε πιστιν ως κοκκον σιναπεως ερειτε τω ορει τουτω μεταβηθι εντευθεν εκει και μεταβησεται και ουδεν αδυνατησει υμιν
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

vulg: conversantibus autem eis in Galilaea dixit illis Iesus Filius hominis tradendus est in manus hominum
clem: Conversantibus autem eis in Galila, dixit illis Jesus: Filius hominis tradendus est in manus hominum:
tr: τουτο δε το γενος ουκ εκπορευεται ει μη εν προσευχη και νηστεια
kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

vulg: et occident eum et tertio die resurget et contristati sunt vehementer
clem: et occident eum, et tertia die resurget. Et contristati sunt vehementer.
tr: αναστρεφομενων δε αυτων εν τη γαλιλαια ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους μελλει ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοσθαι εις χειρας ανθρωπων
kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

vulg: et cum venissent Capharnaum accesserunt qui didragma accipiebant ad Petrum et dixerunt magister vester non solvit didragma
clem: Et cum venissent Capharnaum, accesserunt qui didrachma accipiebant ad Petrum, et dixerunt ei: Magister vester non solvit didrachma?
tr: και αποκτενουσιν αυτον και τη τριτη ημερα εγερθησεται και ελυπηθησαν σφοδρα
kjv: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

vulg: ait etiam et cum intrasset domum praevenit eum Iesus dicens quid tibi videtur Simon reges terrae a quibus accipiunt tributum vel censum a filiis suis an ab alienis
clem: Ait: Etiam. Et cum intrasset in domum, prvenit eum Jesus, dicens: Quid tibi videtur Simon? reges terr a quibus accipiunt tributum vel censum? a filiis suis, an ab alienis?
tr: ελθοντων δε αυτων εις καπερναουμ προσηλθον οι τα διδραχμα λαμβανοντες τω πετρω και ειπον ο διδασκαλος υμων ου τελει τα διδραχμα
kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

vulg: et ille dixit ab alienis dixit illi Iesus ergo liberi sunt filii
clem: Et ille dixit: Ab alienis. Dixit illi Jesus: Ergo liberi sunt filii.
tr: λεγει ναι και οτε εισηλθεν εις την οικιαν προεφθασεν αυτον ο ιησους λεγων τι σοι δοκει σιμων οι βασιλεις της γης απο τινων λαμβανουσιν τελη η κηνσον απο των υιων αυτων η απο των αλλοτριων
kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

vulg: ut autem non scandalizemus eos vade ad mare et mitte hamum et eum piscem qui primus ascenderit tolle et aperto ore eius invenies staterem illum sumens da eis pro me et te
clem: Ut autem non scandalizemus eos, vade ad mare, et mitte hamum: et eum piscem, qui primus ascenderit, tolle: et aperto ore ejus, invenies staterem: illum sumens, da eis pro me et te.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο πετρος απο των αλλοτριων εφη αυτω ο ιησους αραγε ελευθεροι εισιν οι υιοι
kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

tr: ινα δε μη σκανδαλισωμεν αυτους πορευθεις εις την θαλασσαν βαλε αγκιστρον και τον αναβαντα πρωτον ιχθυν αρον και ανοιξας το στομα αυτου ευρησεις στατηρα εκεινον λαβων δος αυτοις αντι εμου και σου
kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

vulg: in illa hora accesserunt discipuli ad Iesum dicentes quis putas maior est in regno caelorum
clem: In illa hora accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum, dicentes: Quis, putas, major est in regno clorum?
tr: εν εκεινη τη ωρα προσηλθον οι μαθηται τω ιησου λεγοντες τις αρα μειζων εστιν εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

vulg: et advocans Iesus parvulum statuit eum in medio eorum
clem: Et advocans Jesus parvulum, statuit eum in medio eorum,
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος ο ιησους παιδιον εστησεν αυτο εν μεσω αυτων
kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

vulg: et dixit amen dico vobis nisi conversi fueritis et efficiamini sicut parvuli non intrabitis in regnum caelorum
clem: et dixit: Amen dico vobis, nisi conversi fueritis, et efficiamini sicut parvuli, non intrabitis in regnum clorum.
tr: και ειπεν αμην λεγω υμιν εαν μη στραφητε και γενησθε ως τα παιδια ου μη εισελθητε εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων
kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: quicumque ergo humiliaverit se sicut parvulus iste hic est maior in regno caelorum
clem: Quicumque ergo humiliaverit se sicut parvulus iste, hic est major in regno clorum.
tr: οστις ουν ταπεινωση εαυτον ως το παιδιον τουτο ουτος εστιν ο μειζων εν τη βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: et qui susceperit unum parvulum talem in nomine meo me suscipit
clem: Et qui susceperit unum parvulum talem in nomine meo, me suscipit:
tr: και ος εαν δεξηται παιδιον τοιουτον εν επι τω ονοματι μου εμε δεχεται
kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

vulg: qui autem scandalizaverit unum de pusillis istis qui in me credunt expedit ei ut suspendatur mola asinaria in collo eius et demergatur in profundum maris
clem: qui autem scandalizaverit unum de pusillis istis, qui in me credunt, expedit ei ut suspendatur mola asinaria in collo ejus, et demergatur in profundum maris.
tr: ος δ αν σκανδαλιση ενα των μικρων τουτων των πιστευοντων εις εμε συμφερει αυτω ινα κρεμασθη μυλος ονικος επι τον τραχηλον αυτου και καταποντισθη εν τω πελαγει της θαλασσης
kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

vulg: vae mundo ab scandalis necesse est enim ut veniant scandala verumtamen vae homini per quem scandalum venit
clem: V mundo a scandalis! Necesse est enim ut veniant scandala: verumtamen v homini illi, per quem scandalum venit.
tr: ουαι τω κοσμω απο των σκανδαλων αναγκη γαρ εστιν ελθειν τα σκανδαλα πλην ουαι τω ανθρωπω εκεινω δι ου το σκανδαλον ερχεται
kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

vulg: si autem manus tua vel pes tuus scandalizat te abscide eum et proice abs te bonum tibi est ad vitam ingredi debilem vel clodum quam duas manus vel duos pedes habentem mitti in ignem aeternum
clem: Si autem manus tua, vel pes tuus scandalizat te, abscide eum, et projice abs te: bonum tibi est ad vitam ingredi debilem, vel claudum, quam duas manus vel duos pedes habentem mitti in ignem ternum.
tr: ει δε η χειρ σου η ο πους σου σκανδαλιζει σε εκκοψον αυτα και βαλε απο σου καλον σοι εστιν εισελθειν εις την ζωην χωλον η κυλλον η δυο χειρας η δυο ποδας εχοντα βληθηναι εις το πυρ το αιωνιον
kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

vulg: et si oculus tuus scandalizat te erue eum et proice abs te bonum tibi est unoculum in vitam intrare quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis
clem: Et si oculus tuus scandalizat te, erue eum, et projice abs te: bonum tibi est cum uno oculo in vitam intrare, quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis.
tr: και ει ο οφθαλμος σου σκανδαλιζει σε εξελε αυτον και βαλε απο σου καλον σοι εστιν μονοφθαλμον εις την ζωην εισελθειν η δυο οφθαλμους εχοντα βληθηναι εις την γεενναν του πυρος
kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

vulg: videte ne contemnatis unum ex his pusillis dico enim vobis quia angeli eorum in caelis semper vident faciem Patris mei qui in caelis est
clem: Videte ne contemnatis unum ex his pusillis: dico enim vobis, quia angeli eorum in clis semper vident faciem Patris mei, qui in clis est.
tr: ορατε μη καταφρονησητε ενος των μικρων τουτων λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι οι αγγελοι αυτων εν ουρανοις δια παντος βλεπουσιν το προσωπον του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

vulg: venit enim Filius hominis salvare quod perierat
clem: Venit enim Filius hominis salvare quod perierat.
tr: ηλθεν γαρ ο υιος του ανθρωπου σωσαι το απολωλος
kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

vulg: quid vobis videtur si fuerint alicui centum oves et erraverit una ex eis nonne relinquet nonaginta novem in montibus et vadit quaerere eam quae erravit
clem: Quid vobis videtur? si fuerint alicui centum oves, et erravit una ex eis: nonne relinquit nonaginta novem in montibus, et vadit qurere eam qu erravit?
tr: τι υμιν δοκει εαν γενηται τινι ανθρωπω εκατον προβατα και πλανηθη εν εξ αυτων ουχι αφεις τα εννενηκονταεννεα επι τα ορη πορευθεις ζητει το πλανωμενον
kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

vulg: et si contigerit ut inveniat eam amen dico vobis quia gaudebit super eam magis quam super nonaginta novem quae non erraverunt
clem: Et si contigerit ut inveniat eam: amen dico vobis, quia gaudet super eam magis quam super nonaginta novem, qu non erraverunt.
tr: και εαν γενηται ευρειν αυτο αμην λεγω υμιν οτι χαιρει επ αυτω μαλλον η επι τοις εννενηκονταεννεα τοις μη πεπλανημενοις
kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

vulg: sic non est voluntas ante Patrem vestrum qui in caelis est ut pereat unus de pusillis istis
clem: Sic non est voluntas ante Patrem vestrum, qui in clis est, ut pereat unus de pusillis istis.
tr: ουτως ουκ εστιν θελημα εμπροσθεν του πατρος υμων του εν ουρανοις ινα αποληται εις των μικρων τουτων
kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

vulg: si autem peccaverit in te frater tuus vade et corripe eum inter te et ipsum solum si te audierit lucratus es fratrem tuum
clem: Si autem peccaverit in te frater tuus, vade, et corripe eum inter te, et ipsum solum: si te audierit, lucratus eris fratrem tuum.
tr: εαν δε αμαρτηση εις σε ο αδελφος σου υπαγε και ελεγξον αυτον μεταξυ σου και αυτου μονου εαν σου ακουση εκερδησας τον αδελφον σου
kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

vulg: si autem non te audierit adhibe tecum adhuc unum vel duos ut in ore duorum testium vel trium stet omne verbum
clem: Si autem te non audierit, adhibe tecum adhuc unum, vel duos, ut in ore duorum, vel trium testium stet omne verbum.
tr: εαν δε μη ακουση παραλαβε μετα σου ετι ενα η δυο ινα επι στοματος δυο μαρτυρων η τριων σταθη παν ρημα
kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

vulg: quod si non audierit eos dic ecclesiae si autem et ecclesiam non audierit sit tibi sicut ethnicus et publicanus
clem: Quod si non audierit eos: dic ecclesi. Si autem ecclesiam non audierit, sit tibi sicut ethnicus et publicanus.
tr: εαν δε παρακουση αυτων ειπε τη εκκλησια εαν δε και της εκκλησιας παρακουση εστω σοι ωσπερ ο εθνικος και ο τελωνης
kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

vulg: amen dico vobis quaecumque alligaveritis super terram erunt ligata et in caelo et quaecumque solveritis super terram erunt soluta et in caelo
clem: Amen dico vobis, qucumque alligaveritis super terram, erunt ligata et in clo: et qucumque solveritis super terram, erunt soluta et in clo.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οσα εαν δησητε επι της γης εσται δεδεμενα εν τω ουρανω και οσα εαν λυσητε επι της γης εσται λελυμενα εν τω ουρανω
kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

vulg: iterum dico vobis quia si duo ex vobis consenserint super terram de omni re quacumque petierint fiet illis a Patre meo qui in caelis est
clem: Iterum dico vobis, quia si duo ex vobis consenserint super terram, de omni re quamcumque petierint, fiet illis a Patre meo, qui in clis est.
tr: παλιν λεγω υμιν οτι εαν δυο υμων συμφωνησωσιν επι της γης περι παντος πραγματος ου εαν αιτησωνται γενησεται αυτοις παρα του πατρος μου του εν ουρανοις
kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

vulg: ubi enim sunt duo vel tres congregati in nomine meo ibi sum in medio eorum
clem: Ubi enim sunt duo vel tres congregati in nomine meo, ibi sum in medio eorum.
tr: ου γαρ εισιν δυο η τρεις συνηγμενοι εις το εμον ονομα εκει ειμι εν μεσω αυτων
kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

vulg: tunc accedens Petrus ad eum dixit Domine quotiens peccabit in me frater meus et dimittam ei usque septies
clem: Tunc accedens Petrus ad eum, dixit: Domine, quoties peccabit in me frater meus, et dimittam ei? usque septies?
tr: τοτε προσελθων αυτω ο πετρος ειπεν κυριε ποσακις αμαρτησει εις εμε ο αδελφος μου και αφησω αυτω εως επτακις
kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

vulg: dicit illi Iesus non dico tibi usque septies sed usque septuagies septies
clem: Dicit illi Jesus: Non dico tibi usque septies: sed usque septuagies septies.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους ου λεγω σοι εως επτακις αλλ εως εβδομηκοντακις επτα
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

vulg: ideo adsimilatum est regnum caelorum homini regi qui voluit rationem ponere cum servis suis
clem: Ideo assimilatum est regnum clorum homini regi, qui voluit rationem ponere cum servis suis.
tr: δια τουτο ωμοιωθη η βασιλεια των ουρανων ανθρωπω βασιλει ος ηθελησεν συναραι λογον μετα των δουλων αυτου
kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

vulg: et cum coepisset rationem ponere oblatus est ei unus qui debebat decem milia talenta
clem: Et cum cpisset rationem ponere, oblatus est ei unus, qui debebat ei decem millia talenta.
tr: αρξαμενου δε αυτου συναιρειν προσηνεχθη αυτω εις οφειλετης μυριων ταλαντων
kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

vulg: cum autem non haberet unde redderet iussit eum dominus venundari et uxorem eius et filios et omnia quae habebat et reddi
clem: Cum autem non haberet unde redderet, jussit eum dominus ejus venundari, et uxorem ejus, et filios, et omnia qu habebat, et reddi.
tr: μη εχοντος δε αυτου αποδουναι εκελευσεν αυτον ο κυριος αυτου πραθηναι και την γυναικα αυτου και τα τεκνα και παντα οσα ειχεν και αποδοθηναι
kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

vulg: procidens autem servus ille orabat eum dicens patientiam habe in me et omnia reddam tibi
clem: Procidens autem servus ille, orabat eum, dicens: Patientiam habe in me, et omnia reddam tibi.
tr: πεσων ουν ο δουλος προσεκυνει αυτω λεγων κυριε μακροθυμησον επ εμοι και παντα σοι αποδωσω
kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

vulg: misertus autem dominus servi illius dimisit eum et debitum dimisit ei
clem: Misertus autem dominus servi illius, dimisit eum, et debitum dimisit ei.
tr: σπλαγχνισθεις δε ο κυριος του δουλου εκεινου απελυσεν αυτον και το δανειον αφηκεν αυτω
kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

vulg: egressus autem servus ille invenit unum de conservis suis qui debebat ei centum denarios et tenens suffocabat eum dicens redde quod debes
clem: Egressus autem servus ille invenit unum de conservis suis, qui debebat ei centum denarios: et tenens suffocavit eum, dicens: Redde quod debes.
tr: εξελθων δε ο δουλος εκεινος ευρεν ενα των συνδουλων αυτου ος ωφειλεν αυτω εκατον δηναρια και κρατησας αυτον επνιγεν λεγων αποδος μοι ο τι οφειλεις
kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

vulg: et procidens conservus eius rogabat eum dicens patientiam habe in me et omnia reddam tibi
clem: Et procidens conservus ejus, rogabat eum, dicens: Patientiam habe in me, et omnia reddam tibi.
tr: πεσων ουν ο συνδουλος αυτου εις τους ποδας αυτου παρεκαλει αυτον λεγων μακροθυμησον επ εμοι και παντα αποδωσω σοι
kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

vulg: ille autem noluit sed abiit et misit eum in carcerem donec redderet debitum
clem: Ille autem noluit: sed abiit, et misit eum in carcerem donec redderet debitum.
tr: ο δε ουκ ηθελεν αλλα  αλλ  απελθων εβαλεν αυτον εις φυλακην εως ου αποδω το οφειλομενον
kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

vulg: videntes autem conservi eius quae fiebant contristati sunt valde et venerunt et narraverunt domino suo omnia quae facta erant
clem: Videntes autem conservi ejus qu fiebant, contristati sunt valde: et venerunt, et narraverunt domino suo omnia qu facta fuerant.
tr: ιδοντες δε οι συνδουλοι αυτου τα γενομενα ελυπηθησαν σφοδρα και ελθοντες διεσαφησαν τω κυριω αυτων παντα τα γενομενα
kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

vulg: tunc vocavit illum dominus suus et ait illi serve nequam omne debitum dimisi tibi quoniam rogasti me
clem: Tunc vocavit illum dominus suus: et ait illi: Serve nequam, omne debitum dimisi tibi quoniam rogasti me:
tr: τοτε προσκαλεσαμενος αυτον ο κυριος αυτου λεγει αυτω δουλε πονηρε πασαν την οφειλην εκεινην αφηκα σοι επει παρεκαλεσας με
kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

vulg: non ergo oportuit et te misereri conservi tui sicut et ego tui misertus sum
clem: nonne ergo oportuit et te misereri conservi tui, sicut et ego tui misertus sum?
tr: ουκ εδει και σε ελεησαι τον συνδουλον σου ως και εγω σε ηλεησα
kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

vulg: et iratus dominus eius tradidit eum tortoribus quoadusque redderet universum debitum
clem: Et iratus dominus ejus tradidit eum tortoribus, quoadusque redderet universum debitum.
tr: και οργισθεις ο κυριος αυτου παρεδωκεν αυτον τοις βασανισταις εως ου αποδω παν το οφειλομενον αυτω
kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

vulg: sic et Pater meus caelestis faciet vobis si non remiseritis unusquisque fratri suo de cordibus vestris
clem: Sic et Pater meus clestis faciet vobis, si non remiseritis unusquisque fratri suo de cordibus vestris.
tr: ουτως και ο πατηρ μου ο επουρανιος ποιησει υμιν εαν μη αφητε εκαστος τω αδελφω αυτου απο των καρδιων υμων τα παραπτωματα αυτων
kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

vulg: et factum est cum consummasset Iesus sermones istos migravit a Galilaea et venit in fines Iudaeae trans Iordanen
clem: Et factum est, cum consumasset Jesus sermones istos, migravit a Galila, et venit in fines Jud trans Jordanem,
tr: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους τους λογους τουτους μετηρεν απο της γαλιλαιας και ηλθεν εις τα ορια της ιουδαιας περαν του ιορδανου
kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

vulg: et secutae sunt eum turbae multae et curavit eos ibi
clem: et secut sunt eum turb mult, et curavit eos ibi.
tr: και ηκολουθησαν αυτω οχλοι πολλοι και εθεραπευσεν αυτους εκει
kjv: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

vulg: et accesserunt ad eum Pharisaei temptantes eum et dicentes si licet homini dimittere uxorem suam quacumque ex causa
clem: Et accesserunt ad eum pharisi tentantes eum, et dicentes: Si licet homini dimittere uxorem suam, quacumque ex causa?
tr: και προσηλθον αυτω οι φαρισαιοι πειραζοντες αυτον και λεγοντες αυτω ει εξεστιν ανθρωπω απολυσαι την γυναικα αυτου κατα πασαν αιτιαν
kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

vulg: qui respondens ait eis non legistis quia qui fecit ab initio masculum et feminam fecit eos
clem: Qui respondens, ait eis: Non legistis, quia qui fecit hominem ab initio, masculum et feminam fecit eos? Et dixit:
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ουκ ανεγνωτε οτι ο ποιησας απ αρχης αρσεν και θηλυ εποιησεν αυτους
kjv: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

vulg: et dixit propter hoc dimittet homo patrem et matrem et adherebit uxori suae et erunt duo in carne una
clem: Propter hoc dimittet homo patrem, et matrem, et adhrebit uxori su, et erunt duo in carne una.
tr: και ειπεν ενεκεν τουτου καταλειψει ανθρωπος τον πατερα και την μητερα και προσκολληθησεται τη γυναικι αυτου και εσονται οι δυο εις σαρκα μιαν
kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

vulg: itaque iam non sunt duo sed una caro quod ergo Deus coniunxit homo non separet
clem: Itaque jam non sunt duo, sed una caro. Quod ergo Deus conjunxit, homo non separet.
tr: ωστε ουκετι εισιν δυο αλλα σαρξ μια ο ουν ο θεος συνεζευξεν ανθρωπος μη χωριζετω
kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

vulg: dicunt illi quid ergo Moses mandavit dari libellum repudii et dimittere
clem: Dicunt illi: Quid ergo Moyses mandavit dare libellum repudii, et dimittere?
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω τι ουν μωσης ενετειλατο δουναι βιβλιον αποστασιου και απολυσαι αυτην
kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

vulg: ait illis quoniam Moses ad duritiam cordis vestri permisit vobis dimittere uxores vestras ab initio autem non sic fuit
clem: Ait illis: Quoniam Moyses ad duritiam cordis vestri permisit vobis dimittere uxores vestras: ab initio autem non fuit sic.
tr: λεγει αυτοις οτι μωσης προς την σκληροκαρδιαν υμων επετρεψεν υμιν απολυσαι τας γυναικας υμων απ αρχης δε ου γεγονεν ουτως
kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

vulg: dico autem vobis quia quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam nisi ob fornicationem et aliam duxerit moechatur et qui dimissam duxerit moechatur
clem: Dico autem vobis, quia quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam, nisi ob fornicationem, et aliam duxerit, mchatur: et qui dimissam duxerit, mchatur.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ος αν απολυση την γυναικα αυτου ει μη επι πορνεια και γαμηση αλλην μοιχαται και ο απολελυμενην γαμησας μοιχαται
kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

vulg: dicunt ei discipuli eius si ita est causa homini cum uxore non expedit nubere
clem: Dicunt ei discipuli ejus: Si ita est causa hominis cum uxore, non expedit nubere.
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ει ουτως εστιν η αιτια του ανθρωπου μετα της γυναικος ου συμφερει γαμησαι
kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

vulg: qui dixit non omnes capiunt verbum istud sed quibus datum est
clem: Qui dixit illis: Non omnes capiunt verbum istud, sed quibus datum est.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις ου παντες χωρουσιν τον λογον τουτον αλλ οις δεδοται
kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

vulg: sunt enim eunuchi qui de matris utero sic nati sunt et sunt eunuchi qui facti sunt ab hominibus et sunt eunuchi qui se ipsos castraverunt propter regnum caelorum qui potest capere capiat
clem: Sunt enim eunuchi, qui de matris utero sic nati sunt: et sunt eunuchi, qui facti sunt ab hominibus: et sunt eunuchi, qui seipsos castraverunt propter regnum clorum. Qui potest capere capiat.
tr: εισιν γαρ ευνουχοι οιτινες εκ κοιλιας μητρος εγεννηθησαν ουτως και εισιν ευνουχοι οιτινες ευνουχισθησαν υπο των ανθρωπων και εισιν ευνουχοι οιτινες ευνουχισαν εαυτους δια την βασιλειαν των ουρανων ο δυναμενος χωρειν χωρειτω
kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

vulg: tunc oblati sunt ei parvuli ut manus eis inponeret et oraret discipuli autem increpabant eis
clem: Tunc oblati sunt ei parvuli, ut manus eis imponeret, et oraret. Discipuli autem increpabant eos.
tr: τοτε προσηνεχθη αυτω παιδια ινα τας χειρας επιθη αυτοις και προσευξηται οι δε μαθηται επετιμησαν αυτοις
kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

vulg: Iesus vero ait eis sinite parvulos et nolite eos prohibere ad me venire talium est enim regnum caelorum
clem: Jesus vero ait eis: Sinite parvulos, et nolite eos prohibere ad me venire: talium est enim regnum clorum.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αφετε τα παιδια και μη κωλυετε αυτα ελθειν προς με των γαρ τοιουτων εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων
kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: et cum inposuisset eis manus abiit inde
clem: Et cum imposuisset eis manus, abiit inde.
tr: και επιθεις αυτοις τας χειρας επορευθη εκειθεν
kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

vulg: et ecce unus accedens ait illi magister bone quid boni faciam ut habeam vitam aeternam
clem: Et ecce unus accedens, ait illi: Magister bone, quid boni faciam ut habeam vitam ternam?
tr: και ιδου εις προσελθων ειπεν αυτω διδασκαλε αγαθε τι αγαθον ποιησω ινα εχω ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

vulg: qui dixit ei quid me interrogas de bono unus est bonus Deus si autem vis ad vitam ingredi serva mandata
clem: Qui dixit ei: Quid me interrogas de bono? Unus est bonus, Deus. Si autem vis ad vitam ingredi, serva mandata.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτω τι με λεγεις αγαθον ουδεις αγαθος ει μη εις ο θεος ει δε θελεις εισελθειν εις την ζωην τηρησον τας εντολας
kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

vulg: dicit illi quae Iesus autem dixit non homicidium facies non adulterabis non facies furtum non falsum testimonium dices
clem: Dicit illi: Qu? Jesus autem dixit: Non homicidium facies; non adulterabis; non facies furtum; non falsum testimonium dices;
tr: λεγει αυτω ποιας ο δε ιησους ειπεν το ου φονευσεις ου μοιχευσεις ου κλεψεις ου ψευδομαρτυρησεις
kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

vulg: honora patrem et matrem et diliges proximum tuum sicut te ipsum
clem: honora patrem tuum, et matrem tuam, et diliges proximum tuum sicut teipsum.
tr: τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα και αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον
kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

vulg: dicit illi adulescens omnia haec custodivi quid adhuc mihi deest
clem: Dicit illi adolescens: Omnia hc custodivi a juventute mea: quid adhuc mihi deest?
tr: λεγει αυτω ο νεανισκος παντα ταυτα εφυλαξαμην εκ νεοτητος μου τι ετι υστερω
kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

vulg: ait illi Iesus si vis perfectus esse vade vende quae habes et da pauperibus et habebis thesaurum in caelo et veni sequere me
clem: Ait illi Jesus: Si vis perfectus esse, vade, vende qu habes, et da pauperibus, et habebis thesaurum in clo: et veni, sequere me.
tr: εφη αυτω ο ιησους ει θελεις τελειος ειναι υπαγε πωλησον σου τα υπαρχοντα και δος πτωχοις και εξεις θησαυρον εν ουρανω και δευρο ακολουθει μοι
kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

vulg: cum audisset autem adulescens verbum abiit tristis erat enim habens multas possessiones
clem: Cum audisset autem adolescens verbum, abiit tristis: erat enim habens multas possessiones.
tr: ακουσας δε ο νεανισκος τον λογον απηλθεν λυπουμενος ην γαρ εχων κτηματα πολλα
kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

vulg: Iesus autem dixit discipulis suis amen dico vobis quia dives difficile intrabit in regnum caelorum
clem: Jesus autem dixit discipulis suis: Amen dico vobis, quia dives difficile intrabit in regnum clorum.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου αμην λεγω υμιν οτι δυσκολως πλουσιος εισελευσεται εις την βασιλειαν των ουρανων
kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

vulg: et iterum dico vobis facilius est camelum per foramen acus transire quam divitem intrare in regnum caelorum
clem: Et iterum dico vobis: Facilius est camelum per foramen acus transire, quam divitem intrare in regnum clorum.
tr: παλιν δε λεγω υμιν ευκοπωτερον εστιν καμηλον δια τρυπηματος ραφιδος διελθειν η πλουσιον εις την βασιλειαν του θεου εισελθειν
kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

vulg: auditis autem his discipuli mirabantur valde dicentes quis ergo poterit salvus esse
clem: Auditis autem his, discipuli mirabantur valde, dicentes: Quis ergo poterit salvus esse?
tr: ακουσαντες δε οι μαθηται αυτου εξεπλησσοντο σφοδρα λεγοντες τις αρα δυναται σωθηναι
kjv: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

vulg: aspiciens autem Iesus dixit illis apud homines hoc inpossibile est apud Deum autem omnia possibilia sunt
clem: Aspiciens autem Jesus, dixit illis: Apud homines hoc impossibile est: apud Deum autem omnia possibilia sunt.
tr: εμβλεψας δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις παρα ανθρωποις τουτο αδυνατον εστιν παρα δε θεω παντα δυνατα εστιν
kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

vulg: tunc respondens Petrus dixit ei ecce nos reliquimus omnia et secuti sumus te quid ergo erit nobis
clem: Tunc respondens Petrus, dixit ei: Ecce nos reliquimus omnia, et secuti sumus te: quid ergo erit nobis?
tr: τοτε αποκριθεις ο πετρος ειπεν αυτω ιδου ημεις αφηκαμεν παντα και ηκολουθησαμεν σοι τι αρα εσται ημιν
kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

vulg: Iesus autem dixit illis amen dico vobis quod vos qui secuti estis me in regeneratione cum sederit Filius hominis in sede maiestatis suae sedebitis et vos super sedes duodecim iudicantes duodecim tribus Israhel
clem: Jesus autem dixit illis: Amen dico vobis, quod vos, qui secuti estis me, in regeneratione cum sederit Filius hominis in sede majestatis su, sedebitis et vos super sedes duodecim, judicantes duodecim tribus Isral.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι υμεις οι ακολουθησαντες μοι εν τη παλιγγενεσια οταν καθιση ο υιος του ανθρωπου επι θρονου δοξης αυτου καθισεσθε και υμεις επι δωδεκα θρονους κρινοντες τας δωδεκα φυλας του ισραηλ
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

vulg: et omnis qui reliquit domum vel fratres aut sorores aut patrem aut matrem aut uxorem aut filios aut agros propter nomen meum centuplum accipiet et vitam aeternam possidebit
clem: Et omnis qui reliquerit domum, vel fratres, aut sorores, aut patrem, aut matrem, aut uxorem, aut filios, aut agros propter nomen meum, centuplum accipiet, et vitam ternam possidebit.
tr: και πας ος αφηκεν οικιας η αδελφους η αδελφας η πατερα η μητερα η γυναικα η τεκνα η αγρους ενεκεν του ονοματος μου εκατονταπλασιονα ληψεται και ζωην αιωνιον κληρονομησει
kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

vulg: multi autem erunt primi novissimi et novissimi primi
clem: Multi autem erunt primi novissimi, et novissimi primi.
tr: πολλοι δε εσονται πρωτοι εσχατοι και εσχατοι πρωτοι
kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

vulg: simile est enim regnum caelorum homini patri familias qui exiit primo mane conducere operarios in vineam suam
clem: Simile est regnum clorum homini patrifamilias, qui exiit primo mane conducere operarios in vineam suam.
tr: ομοια γαρ εστιν η βασιλεια των ουρανων ανθρωπω οικοδεσποτη οστις εξηλθεν αμα πρωι μισθωσασθαι εργατας εις τον αμπελωνα αυτου
kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

vulg: conventione autem facta cum operariis ex denario diurno misit eos in vineam suam
clem: Conventione autem facta cum operariis ex denario diurno, misit eos in vineam suam.
tr: συμφωνησας δε μετα των εργατων εκ δηναριου την ημεραν απεστειλεν αυτους εις τον αμπελωνα αυτου
kjv: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

vulg: et egressus circa horam tertiam vidit alios stantes in foro otiosos
clem: Et egressus circa horam tertiam, vidit alios stantes in foro otiosos,
tr: και εξελθων περι την τριτην ωραν ειδεν αλλους εστωτας εν τη αγορα αργους
kjv: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

vulg: et illis dixit ite et vos in vineam et quod iustum fuerit dabo vobis
clem: et dixit illis: Ite et vos in vineam meam, et quod justum fuerit dabo vobis.
tr: κακεινοις ειπεν υπαγετε και υμεις εις τον αμπελωνα και ο εαν η δικαιον δωσω υμιν (20:5) οι δε απηλθον
kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

vulg: illi autem abierunt iterum autem exiit circa sextam et nonam horam et fecit similiter
clem: Illi autem abierunt. Iterum autem exiit circa sextam et nonam horam: et fecit similiter.
tr: παλιν εξελθων περι εκτην και εννατην ωραν εποιησεν ωσαυτως
kjv: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

vulg: circa undecimam vero exiit et invenit alios stantes et dicit illis quid hic statis tota die otiosi
clem: Circa undecimam vero exiit, et invenit alios stantes, et dicit illis: Quid hic statis tota die otiosi?
tr: περι δε την ενδεκατην ωραν εξελθων ευρεν αλλους εστωτας αργους και λεγει αυτοις τι ωδε εστηκατε ολην την ημεραν αργοι
kjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

vulg: dicunt ei quia nemo nos conduxit dicit illis ite et vos in vineam
clem: Dicunt ei: Quia nemo nos conduxit. Dicit illis: Ite et vos in vineam meam.
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω οτι ουδεις ημας εμισθωσατο λεγει αυτοις υπαγετε και υμεις εις τον αμπελωνα και ο εαν η δικαιον ληψεσθε
kjv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

vulg: cum sero autem factum esset dicit dominus vineae procuratori suo voca operarios et redde illis mercedem incipiens a novissimis usque ad primos
clem: Cum sero autem factum esset, dicit dominus vine procuratori suo: Voca operarios, et redde illis mercedem incipiens a novissimis usque ad primos.
tr: οψιας δε γενομενης λεγει ο κυριος του αμπελωνος τω επιτροπω αυτου καλεσον τους εργατας και αποδος αυτοις τον μισθον αρξαμενος απο των εσχατων εως των πρωτων
kjv: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

vulg: cum venissent ergo qui circa undecimam horam venerant acceperunt singulos denarios
clem: Cum venissent ergo qui circa undecimam horam venerant, acceperunt singulos denarios.
tr: και ελθοντες οι περι την ενδεκατην ωραν ελαβον ανα δηναριον
kjv: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

vulg: venientes autem et primi arbitrati sunt quod plus essent accepturi acceperunt autem et ipsi singulos denarios
clem: Venientes autem et primi, arbitrati sunt quod plus essent accepturi: acceperunt autem et ipsi singulos denarios.
tr: ελθοντες δε οι πρωτοι ενομισαν οτι πλειονα ληψονται και ελαβον και αυτοι ανα δηναριον
kjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

vulg: et accipientes murmurabant adversus patrem familias
clem: Et accipientes murmurabant adversus patremfamilias,
tr: λαβοντες δε εγογγυζον κατα του οικοδεσποτου
kjv: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

vulg: dicentes hii novissimi una hora fecerunt et pares illos nobis fecisti qui portavimus pondus diei et aestus
clem: dicentes: Hi novissimi una hora fecerunt, et pares illos nobis fecisti, qui portavimus pondus diei, et stus.
tr: λεγοντες οτι ουτοι οι εσχατοι μιαν ωραν εποιησαν και ισους ημιν αυτους εποιησας τοις βαστασασιν το βαρος της ημερας και τον καυσωνα
kjv: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

vulg: at ille respondens uni eorum dixit amice non facio tibi iniuriam nonne ex denario convenisti mecum
clem: At ille respondens uni eorum, dixit: Amice, non facio tibi injuriam: nonne ex denario convenisti mecum?
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν ενι αυτων εταιρε ουκ αδικω σε ουχι δηναριου συνεφωνησας μοι
kjv: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

vulg: tolle quod tuum est et vade volo autem et huic novissimo dare sicut et tibi
clem: Tolle quod tuum est, et vade: volo autem et huic novissimo dare sicut et tibi.
tr: αρον το σον και υπαγε θελω δε τουτω τω εσχατω δουναι ως και σοι
kjv: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

vulg: aut non licet mihi quod volo facere an oculus tuus nequam est quia ego bonus sum
clem: Aut non licet mihi quod volo, facere? an oculus tuus nequam est, quia ego bonus sum?
tr: η ουκ εξεστιν μοι ποιησαι ο θελω εν τοις εμοις ει ο οφθαλμος σου πονηρος εστιν οτι εγω αγαθος ειμι
kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

vulg: sic erunt novissimi primi et primi novissimi multi sunt enim vocati pauci autem electi
clem: Sic erunt novissimi primi, et primi novissimi. Multi enim sunt vocati, pauci vero electi.
tr: ουτως εσονται οι εσχατοι πρωτοι και οι πρωτοι εσχατοι πολλοι γαρ εισιν κλητοι ολιγοι δε εκλεκτοι
kjv: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

vulg: et ascendens Iesus Hierosolymam adsumpsit duodecim discipulos secreto et ait illis
clem: Et ascendens Jesus Jerosolymam, assumpsit duodecim discipulos secreto, et ait illis:
tr: και αναβαινων ο ιησους εις ιεροσολυμα παρελαβεν τους δωδεκα μαθητας κατ ιδιαν εν τη οδω και ειπεν αυτοις
kjv: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

vulg: ecce ascendimus Hierosolymam et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum et scribis et condemnabunt eum morte
clem: Ecce ascendimus Jerosolymam, et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum, et scribis, et condemnabunt eum morte,
tr: ιδου αναβαινομεν εις ιεροσολυμα και ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδοθησεται τοις αρχιερευσιν και γραμματευσιν και κατακρινουσιν αυτον θανατω
kjv: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

vulg: et tradent eum gentibus ad deludendum et flagellandum et crucifigendum et tertia die resurget
clem: et tradent eum gentibus ad illudendum, et flagellandum, et crucifigendum, et tertia die resurget.
tr: και παραδωσουσιν αυτον τοις εθνεσιν εις το εμπαιξαι και μαστιγωσαι και σταυρωσαι και τη τριτη ημερα αναστησεται
kjv: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

vulg: tunc accessit ad eum mater filiorum Zebedaei cum filiis suis adorans et petens aliquid ab eo
clem: Tunc accessit ad eum mater filiorum Zebedi cum filiis suis, adorans et petens aliquid ab eo.
tr: τοτε προσηλθεν αυτω η μητηρ των υιων ζεβεδαιου μετα των υιων αυτης προσκυνουσα και αιτουσα τι παρ αυτου
kjv: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

vulg: qui dixit ei quid vis ait illi dic ut sedeant hii duo filii mei unus ad dexteram tuam et unus ad sinistram in regno tuo
clem: Qui dixit ei: Quid vis? Ait illi: Dic ut sedeant hi duo filii mei, unus ad dexteram tuam, et unus ad sinistram in regno tuo.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτη τι θελεις λεγει αυτω ειπε ινα καθισωσιν ουτοι οι δυο υιοι μου εις εκ δεξιων σου και εις εξ ευωνυμων εν τη βασιλεια σου
kjv: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

vulg: respondens autem Iesus dixit nescitis quid petatis potestis bibere calicem quem ego bibiturus sum dicunt ei possumus
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit: Nescitis quid petatis. Potestis bibere calicem, quem ego bibiturus sum? Dicunt ei: Possumus.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν ουκ οιδατε τι αιτεισθε δυνασθε πιειν το ποτηριον ο εγω μελλω πινειν και το βαπτισμα ο εγω βαπτιζομαι βαπτισθηναι λεγουσιν αυτω δυναμεθα
kjv: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

vulg: ait illis calicem quidem meum bibetis sedere autem ad dexteram meam et sinistram non est meum dare vobis sed quibus paratum est a Patre meo
clem: Ait illis: Calicem quidem meum bibetis: sedere autem ad dexteram meam vel sinistram non est meum dare vobis, sed quibus paratum est a Patre meo.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις το μεν ποτηριον μου πιεσθε και το βαπτισμα ο εγω βαπτιζομαι βαπτισθησεσθε το δε καθισαι εκ δεξιων μου και εξ ευωνυμων μου ουκ εστιν εμον δουναι αλλ οις ητοιμασται υπο του πατρος μου
kjv: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

vulg: et audientes decem indignati sunt de duobus fratribus
clem: Et audientes decem, indignati sunt de duobus fratribus.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι δεκα ηγανακτησαν περι των δυο αδελφων
kjv: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

vulg: Iesus autem vocavit eos ad se et ait scitis quia principes gentium dominantur eorum et qui maiores sunt potestatem exercent in eos
clem: Jesus autem vocavit eos ad se, et ait: Scitis quia principes gentium dominantur eorum: et qui majores sunt, potestatem exercent in eos.
tr: ο δε ιησους προσκαλεσαμενος αυτους ειπεν οιδατε οτι οι αρχοντες των εθνων κατακυριευουσιν αυτων και οι μεγαλοι κατεξουσιαζουσιν αυτων
kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

vulg: non ita erit inter vos sed quicumque voluerit inter vos maior fieri sit vester minister
clem: Non ita erit inter vos: sed quicumque voluerit inter vos major fieri, sit vester minister:
tr: ουχ ουτως δε εσται εν υμιν αλλ ος εαν θελη εν υμιν μεγας γενεσθαι εστω υμων διακονος
kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

vulg: et qui voluerit inter vos primus esse erit vester servus
clem: et qui voluerit inter vos primus esse, erit vester servus.
tr: και ος εαν θελη εν υμιν ειναι πρωτος εστω υμων δουλος
kjv: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

vulg: sicut Filius hominis non venit ministrari sed ministrare et dare animam suam redemptionem pro multis
clem: Sicut Filius hominis non venit ministrari, sed ministrare, et dare animam suam redemptionem pro multis.
tr: ωσπερ ο υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ ηλθεν διακονηθηναι αλλα διακονησαι και δουναι την ψυχην αυτου λυτρον αντι πολλων
kjv: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

vulg: et egredientibus eis ab Hiericho secuta est eum turba multa
clem: Et egredientibus illis ab Jericho, secuta est eum turba multa,
tr: και εκπορευομενων αυτων απο ιεριχω ηκολουθησεν αυτω οχλος πολυς
kjv: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

vulg: et ecce duo caeci sedentes secus viam audierunt quia Iesus transiret et clamaverunt dicentes Domine miserere nostri Fili David
clem: et ecce duo cci sedentes secus viam audierunt quia Jesus transiret: et clamaverunt, dicentes: Domine, miserere nostri, fili David.
tr: και ιδου δυο τυφλοι καθημενοι παρα την οδον ακουσαντες οτι ιησους παραγει εκραξαν λεγοντες ελεησον ημας κυριε υιος δαβιδ
kjv: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.

vulg: turba autem increpabat eos ut tacerent at illi magis clamabant dicentes Domine miserere nostri Fili David
clem: Turba autem increpabat eos ut tacerent. At illi magis clamabant, dicentes: Domine, miserere nostri, fili David.
tr: ο δε οχλος επετιμησεν αυτοις ινα σιωπησωσιν οι δε μειζον εκραζον λεγοντες ελεησον ημας κυριε υιος δαβιδ
kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.

vulg: et stetit Iesus et vocavit eos et ait quid vultis ut faciam vobis
clem: Et stetit Jesus, et vocavit eos, et ait: Quid vultis ut faciam vobis?
tr: και στας ο ιησους εφωνησεν αυτους και ειπεν τι θελετε ποιησω υμιν
kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

vulg: dicunt illi Domine ut aperiantur oculi nostri
clem: Dicunt illi: Domine, ut aperiantur oculi nostri.
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω κυριε ινα ανοιχθωσιν ημων οι οφθαλμοι
kjv: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

vulg: misertus autem eorum Iesus tetigit oculos eorum et confestim viderunt et secuti sunt eum
clem: Misertus autem eorum Jesus, tetigit oculos eorum. Et confestim viderunt, et secuti sunt eum.
tr: σπλαγχνισθεις δε ο ιησους ηψατο των οφθαλμων αυτων και ευθεως ανεβλεψαν αυτων οι οφθαλμοι και ηκολουθησαν αυτω
kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

vulg: et cum adpropinquassent Hierosolymis et venissent Bethfage ad montem Oliveti tunc Iesus misit duos discipulos
clem: Et cum appropinquassent Jerosolymis, et venissent Bethphage ad montem Oliveti: tunc Jesus misit duos discipulos,
tr: και οτε ηγγισαν εις ιεροσολυμα και ηλθον εις βηθφαγη προς το ορος των ελαιων τοτε ο ιησους απεστειλεν δυο μαθητας
kjv: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

vulg: dicens eis ite in castellum quod contra vos est et statim invenietis asinam alligatam et pullum cum ea solvite et adducite mihi
clem: dicens eis: Ite in castellum, quod contra vos est, et statim invenietis asinam alligatam, et pullum cum ea: solvite, et adducite mihi:
tr: λεγων αυτοις πορευθητε εις την κωμην την απεναντι υμων και ευθεως ευρησετε ονον δεδεμενην και πωλον μετ αυτης λυσαντες αγαγετε μοι
kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

vulg: et si quis vobis aliquid dixerit dicite quia Dominus his opus habet et confestim dimittet eos
clem: et si quis vobis aliquid dixerit, dicite quia Dominus his opus habet: et confestim dimittet eos.
tr: και εαν τις υμιν ειπη τι ερειτε οτι ο κυριος αυτων χρειαν εχει ευθεως δε αποστελει αυτους
kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

vulg: hoc autem factum est ut impleretur quod dictum est per prophetam dicentem
clem: Hoc autem totum factum est, ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetam dicentem:
tr: τουτο δε ολον γεγονεν ινα πληρωθη το ρηθεν δια του προφητου λεγοντος
kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

vulg: dicite filiae Sion ecce rex tuus venit tibi mansuetus et sedens super asinam et pullum filium subiugalis
clem: [Dicite fili Sion: Ecce rex tuus venit tibi mansuetus, sedens super asinam, et pullum filium subjugalis.]
tr: ειπατε τη θυγατρι σιων ιδου ο βασιλευς σου ερχεται σοι πραυς και επιβεβηκως επι ονον και πωλον υιον υποζυγιου
kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

vulg: euntes autem discipuli fecerunt sicut praecepit illis Iesus
clem: Euntes autem discipuli fecerunt sicut prcepit illis Jesus.
tr: πορευθεντες δε οι μαθηται και ποιησαντες καθως προσεταξεν αυτοις ο ιησους
kjv: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

vulg: et adduxerunt asinam et pullum et inposuerunt super eis vestimenta sua et eum desuper sedere fecerunt
clem: Et adduxerunt asinam, et pullum: et imposuerunt super eos vestimenta sua, et eum desuper sedere fecerunt.
tr: ηγαγον την ονον και τον πωλον και επεθηκαν επανω αυτων τα ιματια αυτων και επεκαθισεν  επεκαθισαν  επανω αυτων
kjv: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

vulg: plurima autem turba straverunt vestimenta sua in via alii autem caedebant ramos de arboribus et sternebant in via
clem: Plurima autem turba straverunt vestimenta sua in via: alii autem cdebant ramos de arboribus, et sternebant in via:
tr: ο δε πλειστος οχλος εστρωσαν εαυτων τα ιματια εν τη οδω αλλοι δε εκοπτον κλαδους απο των δενδρων και εστρωννυον εν τη οδω
kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

vulg: turbae autem quae praecedebant et quae sequebantur clamabant dicentes osanna Filio David benedictus qui venturus est in nomine Domini osanna in altissimis
clem: turb autem, qu prcedebant, et qu sequebantur, clamabant, dicentes: Hosanna filio David: benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini: hosanna in altissimis.
tr: οι δε οχλοι οι προαγοντες και οι ακολουθουντες εκραζον λεγοντες ωσαννα τω υιω δαβιδ ευλογημενος ο ερχομενος εν ονοματι κυριου ωσαννα εν τοις υψιστοις
kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

vulg: et cum intrasset Hierosolymam commota est universa civitas dicens quis est hic
clem: Et cum intrasset Jerosolymam, commota est universa civitas, dicens: Quis est hic?
tr: και εισελθοντος αυτου εις ιεροσολυμα εσεισθη πασα η πολις λεγουσα τις εστιν ουτος
kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

vulg: populi autem dicebant hic est Iesus propheta a Nazareth Galilaeae
clem: Populi autem dicebant: Hic est Jesus propheta a Nazareth Galil.
tr: οι δε οχλοι ελεγον ουτος εστιν ιησους ο προφητης ο απο ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  της γαλιλαιας
kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

vulg: et intravit Iesus in templum Dei et eiciebat omnes vendentes et ementes in templo et mensas nummulariorum et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit
clem: Et intravit Jesus in templum Dei, et ejiciebat omnes vendentes et ementes in templo, et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:
tr: και εισηλθεν ο ιησους εις το ιερον του θεου και εξεβαλεν παντας τους πωλουντας και αγοραζοντας εν τω ιερω και τας τραπεζας των κολλυβιστων κατεστρεψεν και τας καθεδρας των πωλουντων τας περιστερας
kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

vulg: et dicit eis scriptum est domus mea domus orationis vocabitur vos autem fecistis eam speluncam latronum
clem: et dicit eis: Scriptum est: Domus mea domus orationis vocabitur: vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum.
tr: και λεγει αυτοις γεγραπται ο οικος μου οικος προσευχης κληθησεται υμεις δε αυτον εποιησατε σπηλαιον ληστων
kjv: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

vulg: et accesserunt ad eum caeci et claudi in templo et sanavit eos
clem: Et accesserunt ad eum cci, et claudi in templo: et sanavit eos.
tr: και προσηλθον αυτω τυφλοι και χωλοι εν τω ιερω και εθεραπευσεν αυτους
kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

vulg: videntes autem principes sacerdotum et scribae mirabilia quae fecit et pueros clamantes in templo et dicentes osanna Filio David indignati sunt
clem: Videntes autem principes sacerdotum et scrib mirabilia qu fecit, et pueros clamantes in templo, et dicentes: Hosanna filio David: indignati sunt,
tr: ιδοντες δε οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις τα θαυμασια α εποιησεν και τους παιδας κραζοντας εν τω ιερω και λεγοντας ωσαννα τω υιω δαβιδ ηγανακτησαν
kjv: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,

vulg: et dixerunt ei audis quid isti dicant Iesus autem dicit eis utique numquam legistis quia ex ore infantium et lactantium perfecisti laudem
clem: et dixerunt ei: Audis quid isti dicunt? Jesus autem dixit eis: Utique. Numquam legistis: Quia ex ore infantium et lactentium perfecisti laudem?
tr: και ειπον αυτω ακουεις τι ουτοι λεγουσιν ο δε ιησους λεγει αυτοις ναι ουδεποτε ανεγνωτε οτι εκ στοματος νηπιων και θηλαζοντων κατηρτισω αινον
kjv: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

vulg: et relictis illis abiit foras extra civitatem in Bethaniam ibique mansit
clem: Et relictis illis, abiit foras extra civitatem in Bethaniam: ibique mansit.
tr: και καταλιπων αυτους εξηλθεν εξω της πολεως εις βηθανιαν και ηυλισθη εκει
kjv: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

vulg: mane autem revertens in civitatem esuriit
clem: Mane autem revertens in civitatem, esuriit.
tr: πρωιας δε επαναγων εις την πολιν επεινασεν
kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

vulg: et videns fici arborem unam secus viam venit ad eam et nihil invenit in ea nisi folia tantum et ait illi numquam ex te fructus nascatur in sempiternum et arefacta est continuo ficulnea
clem: Et videns fici arborem unam secus viam, venit ad eam: et nihil invenit in ea nisi folia tantum, et ait illi: Numquam ex te fructus nascatur in sempiternum. Et arefacta est continuo ficulnea.
tr: και ιδων συκην μιαν επι της οδου ηλθεν επ αυτην και ουδεν ευρεν εν αυτη ει μη φυλλα μονον και λεγει αυτη μηκετι εκ σου καρπος γενηται εις τον αιωνα και εξηρανθη παραχρημα η συκη
kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

vulg: et videntes discipuli mirati sunt dicentes quomodo continuo aruit
clem: Et videntes discipuli, mirati sunt, dicentes: Quomodo continuo aruit?
tr: και ιδοντες οι μαθηται εθαυμασαν λεγοντες πως παραχρημα εξηρανθη η συκη
kjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

vulg: respondens autem Iesus ait eis amen dico vobis si habueritis fidem et non haesitaveritis non solum de ficulnea facietis sed et si monti huic dixeritis tolle et iacta te in mare fiet
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, ait eis: Amen dico vobis, si habueritis fidem, et non hsitaveritis, non solum de ficulnea facietis, sed et si monti huic dixeritis: Tolle, et jacta te in mare, fiet.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν εαν εχητε πιστιν και μη διακριθητε ου μονον το της συκης ποιησετε αλλα καν τω ορει τουτω ειπητε αρθητι και βληθητι εις την θαλασσαν γενησεται
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

vulg: et omnia quaecumque petieritis in oratione credentes accipietis
clem: Et omnia qucumque petieritis in oratione credentes, accipietis.
tr: και παντα οσα αν αιτησητε εν τη προσευχη πιστευοντες ληψεσθε
kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

vulg: et cum venisset in templum accesserunt ad eum docentem principes sacerdotum et seniores populi dicentes in qua potestate haec facis et quis tibi dedit hanc potestatem
clem: Et cum venisset in templum, accesserunt ad eum docentem principes sacerdotum, et seniores populi, dicentes: In qua potestate hc facis? et quis tibi dedit hanc potestatem?
tr: και ελθοντι αυτω εις το ιερον προσηλθον αυτω διδασκοντι οι αρχιερεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι του λαου λεγοντες εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιεις και τις σοι εδωκεν την εξουσιαν ταυτην
kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

vulg: respondens Iesus dixit illis interrogabo vos et ego unum sermonem quem si dixeritis mihi et ego vobis dicam in qua potestate haec facio
clem: Respondens Jesus dixit eis: Interrogabo vos et ego unum sermonem: quem si dixeritis mihi, et ego vobis dicam in qua potestate hc facio.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ερωτησω υμας καγω λογον ενα ον εαν ειπητε μοι καγω υμιν ερω εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιω
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

vulg: baptismum Iohannis unde erat e caelo an ex hominibus at illi cogitabant inter se dicentes si dixerimus e caelo dicet nobis quare ergo non credidistis illi
clem: Baptismus Joannis unde erat? e clo, an ex hominibus? At illi cogitabant inter se, dicentes:
tr: το βαπτισμα ιωαννου ποθεν ην εξ ουρανου η εξ ανθρωπων οι δε διελογιζοντο παρ εαυτοις λεγοντες εαν ειπωμεν εξ ουρανου ερει ημιν δια τι ουν ουκ επιστευσατε αυτω
kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

vulg: si autem dixerimus ex hominibus timemus turbam omnes enim habent Iohannem sicut prophetam
clem: Si dixerimus, e clo, dicet nobis: Quare ergo non credidistis illi? Si autem dixerimus, ex hominibus, timemus turbam: omnes enim habebant Joannem sicut prophetam.
tr: εαν δε ειπωμεν εξ ανθρωπων φοβουμεθα τον οχλον παντες γαρ εχουσιν τον ιωαννην ως προφητην
kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

vulg: et respondentes Iesu dixerunt nescimus ait illis et ipse nec ego dico vobis in qua potestate haec facio
clem: Et respondentes Jesu, dixerunt: Nescimus. Ait illis et ipse: Nec ego dico vobis in qua potestate hc facio.
tr: και αποκριθεντες τω ιησου ειπον ουκ οιδαμεν εφη αυτοις και αυτος ουδε εγω λεγω υμιν εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιω
kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

vulg: quid autem vobis videtur homo habebat duos filios et accedens ad primum dixit fili vade hodie operare in vinea mea
clem: Quid autem vobis videtur? Homo quidam habebat duos filios, et accedens ad primum, dixit: Fili, vade hodie, operare in vinea mea.
tr: τι δε υμιν δοκει ανθρωπος ειχεν τεκνα δυο και προσελθων τω πρωτω ειπεν τεκνον υπαγε σημερον εργαζου εν τω αμπελωνι μου
kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

vulg: ille autem respondens ait nolo postea autem paenitentia motus abiit
clem: Ille autem respondens, ait: Nolo. Postea autem, pnitentia motus, abiit.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν ου θελω υστερον δε μεταμεληθεις απηλθεν
kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

vulg: accedens autem ad alterum dixit similiter at ille respondens ait eo domine et non ivit
clem: Accedens autem ad alterum, dixit similiter. At ille respondens, ait: Eo, domine, et non ivit:
tr: και προσελθων τω δευτερω ειπεν ωσαυτως ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν εγω κυριε και ουκ απηλθεν
kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.

vulg: quis ex duobus fecit voluntatem patris dicunt novissimus dicit illis Iesus amen dico vobis quia publicani et meretrices praecedunt vos in regno Dei
clem: quis ex duobus fecit voluntatem patris? Dicunt ei: Primus. Dicit illis Jesus: Amen dico vobis, quia publicani et meretrices prcedent vos in regnum Dei.
tr: τις εκ των δυο εποιησεν το θελημα του πατρος λεγουσιν αυτω ο πρωτος λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους αμην λεγω υμιν οτι οι τελωναι και αι πορναι προαγουσιν υμας εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

vulg: venit enim ad vos Iohannes in via iustitiae et non credidistis ei publicani autem et meretrices crediderunt ei vos autem videntes nec paenitentiam habuistis postea ut crederetis ei
clem: Venit enim ad vos Joannes in via justiti, et non credidistis ei: publicani autem et meretrices crediderunt ei: vos autem videntes nec pnitentiam habuistis postea, ut crederetis ei.
tr: ηλθεν γαρ προς υμας ιωαννης εν οδω δικαιοσυνης και ουκ επιστευσατε αυτω οι δε τελωναι και αι πορναι επιστευσαν αυτω υμεις δε ιδοντες ου μετεμεληθητε υστερον του πιστευσαι αυτω
