kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

vulg: aliam parabolam audite homo erat pater familias qui plantavit vineam et sepem circumdedit ei et fodit in ea torcular et aedificavit turrem et locavit eam agricolis et peregre profectus est
clem: Aliam parabolam audite: Homo erat paterfamilias, qui plantavit vineam, et sepem circumdedit ei, et fodit in ea torcular, et dificavit turrim, et locavit eam agricolis, et peregre profectus est.
tr: αλλην παραβολην ακουσατε ανθρωπος τις ην οικοδεσποτης οστις εφυτευσεν αμπελωνα και φραγμον αυτω περιεθηκεν και ωρυξεν εν αυτω ληνον και ωκοδομησεν πυργον και εξεδοτο αυτον γεωργοις και απεδημησεν
kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

vulg: cum autem tempus fructuum adpropinquasset misit servos suos ad agricolas ut acciperent fructus eius
clem: Cum autem tempus fructuum appropinquasset, misit servos suos ad agricolas, ut acciperent fructus ejus.
tr: οτε δε ηγγισεν ο καιρος των καρπων απεστειλεν τους δουλους αυτου προς τους γεωργους λαβειν τους καρπους αυτου
kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

vulg: et agricolae adprehensis servis eius alium ceciderunt alium occiderunt alium vero lapidaverunt
clem: Et agricol, apprehensis servis ejus, alium ceciderunt, alium occiderunt, alium vero lapidaverunt.
tr: και λαβοντες οι γεωργοι τους δουλους αυτου ον μεν εδειραν ον δε απεκτειναν ον δε ελιθοβολησαν
kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

vulg: iterum misit alios servos plures prioribus et fecerunt illis similiter
clem: Iterum misit alios servos plures prioribus, et fecerunt illis similiter.
tr: παλιν απεστειλεν αλλους δουλους πλειονας των πρωτων και εποιησαν αυτοις ωσαυτως
kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

vulg: novissime autem misit ad eos filium suum dicens verebuntur filium meum
clem: Novissime autem misit ad eos filium suum, dicens: Verebuntur filium meum.
tr: υστερον δε απεστειλεν προς αυτους τον υιον αυτου λεγων εντραπησονται τον υιον μου
kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

vulg: agricolae autem videntes filium dixerunt intra se hic est heres venite occidamus eum et habebimus hereditatem eius
clem: Agricol autem videntes filium dixerunt intra se: Hic est hres, venite, occidamus eum, et habebimus hreditatem ejus.
tr: οι δε γεωργοι ιδοντες τον υιον ειπον εν εαυτοις ουτος εστιν ο κληρονομος δευτε αποκτεινωμεν αυτον και κατασχωμεν την κληρονομιαν αυτου
kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

vulg: et adprehensum eum eiecerunt extra vineam et occiderunt
clem: Et apprehensum eum ejecerunt extra vineam, et occiderunt.
tr: και λαβοντες αυτον εξεβαλον εξω του αμπελωνος και απεκτειναν
kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

vulg: cum ergo venerit dominus vineae quid faciet agricolis illis
clem: Cum ergo venerit dominus vine, quid faciet agricolis illis?
tr: οταν ουν ελθη ο κυριος του αμπελωνος τι ποιησει τοις γεωργοις εκεινοις
kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

vulg: aiunt illi malos male perdet et vineam locabit aliis agricolis qui reddant ei fructum temporibus suis
clem: Aiunt illi: Malos male perdet: et vineam suam locabit aliis agricolis, qui reddant ei fructum temporibus suis.
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω κακους κακως απολεσει αυτους και τον αμπελωνα εκδοσεται αλλοις γεωργοις οιτινες αποδωσουσιν αυτω τους καρπους εν τοις καιροις αυτων
kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

vulg: dicit illis Iesus numquam legistis in scripturis lapidem quem reprobaverunt aedificantes hic factus est in caput anguli a Domino factum est istud et est mirabile in oculis nostris
clem: Dicit illis Jesus: Numquam legistis in Scripturis: [Lapidem quem reprobaverunt dificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli: a Domino factum est istud, et est mirabile in oculis nostris?]
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους ουδεποτε ανεγνωτε εν ταις γραφαις λιθον ον απεδοκιμασαν οι οικοδομουντες ουτος εγενηθη εις κεφαλην γωνιας παρα κυριου εγενετο αυτη και εστιν θαυμαστη εν οφθαλμοις ημων
kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

vulg: ideo dico vobis quia auferetur a vobis regnum Dei et dabitur genti facienti fructus eius
clem: Ideo dico vobis, quia auferetur a vobis regnum Dei, et dabitur genti facienti fructus ejus.
tr: δια τουτο λεγω υμιν οτι αρθησεται αφ υμων η βασιλεια του θεου και δοθησεται εθνει ποιουντι τους καρπους αυτης
kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

vulg: et qui ceciderit super lapidem istum confringetur super quem vero ceciderit conteret eum
clem: Et qui ceciderit super lapidem istum, confringetur: super quem vero ceciderit, conteret eum.
tr: και ο πεσων επι τον λιθον τουτον συνθλασθησεται εφ ον δ αν πεση λικμησει αυτον
kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

vulg: et cum audissent principes sacerdotum et Pharisaei parabolas eius cognoverunt quod de ipsis diceret
clem: Et cum audissent principes sacerdotum et pharisi parabolas ejus, cognoverunt quod de ipsis diceret.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι αρχιερεις και οι φαρισαιοι τας παραβολας αυτου εγνωσαν οτι περι αυτων λεγει
kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

vulg: et quaerentes eum tenere timuerunt turbas quoniam sicut prophetam eum habebant
clem: Et qurentes eum tenere, timuerunt turbas: quoniam sicut prophetam eum habebant.
tr: και ζητουντες αυτον κρατησαι εφοβηθησαν τους οχλους επειδη ως προφητην αυτον ειχον
kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

vulg: et respondens Iesus dixit iterum in parabolis eis dicens
clem: Et respondens Jesus, dixit iterum in parabolis eis, dicens:
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους παλιν ειπεν αυτοις εν παραβολαις λεγων
kjv: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

vulg: simile factum est regnum caelorum homini regi qui fecit nuptias filio suo
clem: Simile factum est regnum clorum homini regi, qui fecit nuptias filio suo.
tr: ωμοιωθη η βασιλεια των ουρανων ανθρωπω βασιλει οστις εποιησεν γαμους τω υιω αυτου
kjv: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

vulg: et misit servos suos vocare invitatos ad nuptias et nolebant venire
clem: Et misit servos suos vocare invitatos ad nuptias, et nolebant venire.
tr: και απεστειλεν τους δουλους αυτου καλεσαι τους κεκλημενους εις τους γαμους και ουκ ηθελον ελθειν
kjv: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

vulg: iterum misit alios servos dicens dicite invitatis ecce prandium meum paravi tauri mei et altilia occisa et omnia parata venite ad nuptias
clem: Iterum misit alios servos, dicens: Dicite invitatis: Ecce prandium meum paravi, tauri mei et altilia occisa sunt, et omnia parata: venite ad nuptias.
tr: παλιν απεστειλεν αλλους δουλους λεγων ειπατε τοις κεκλημενοις ιδου το αριστον μου ητοιμασα οι ταυροι μου και τα σιτιστα τεθυμενα και παντα ετοιμα δευτε εις τους γαμους
kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

vulg: illi autem neglexerunt et abierunt alius in villam suam alius vero ad negotiationem suam
clem: Illi autem neglexerunt: et abierunt, alius in villam suam, alius vero ad negotiationem suam:
tr: οι δε αμελησαντες απηλθον ο μεν εις τον ιδιον αγρον ο δε εις την εμποριαν αυτου
kjv: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

vulg: reliqui vero tenuerunt servos eius et contumelia adfectos occiderunt
clem: reliqui vero tenuerunt servos ejus, et contumeliis affectos occiderunt.
tr: οι δε λοιποι κρατησαντες τους δουλους αυτου υβρισαν και απεκτειναν
kjv: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

vulg: rex autem cum audisset iratus est et missis exercitibus suis perdidit homicidas illos et civitatem illorum succendit
clem: Rex autem cum audisset, iratus est: et missis exercitibus suis, perdidit homicidas illos, et civitatem illorum succendit.
tr: ακουσας δε ο βασιλευς ωργισθη και πεμψας τα στρατευματα αυτου απωλεσεν τους φονεις εκεινους και την πολιν αυτων ενεπρησεν
kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

vulg: tunc ait servis suis nuptiae quidem paratae sunt sed qui invitati erant non fuerunt digni
clem: Tunc ait servis suis: Nupti quidem parat sunt, sed qui invitati erant, non fuerunt digni:
tr: τοτε λεγει τοις δουλοις αυτου ο μεν γαμος ετοιμος εστιν οι δε κεκλημενοι ουκ ησαν αξιοι
kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

vulg: ite ergo ad exitus viarum et quoscumque inveneritis vocate ad nuptias
clem: ite ergo ad exitus viarum, et quoscumque inveneritis, vocate ad nuptias.
tr: πορευεσθε ουν επι τας διεξοδους των οδων και οσους αν ευρητε καλεσατε εις τους γαμους
kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

vulg: et egressi servi eius in vias congregaverunt omnes quos invenerunt malos et bonos et impletae sunt nuptiae discumbentium
clem: Et egressi servi ejus in vias, congregaverunt omnes quos invenerunt, malos et bonos: et implet sunt nupti discumbentium.
tr: και εξελθοντες οι δουλοι εκεινοι εις τας οδους συνηγαγον παντας οσους ευρον πονηρους τε και αγαθους και επλησθη ο γαμος ανακειμενων
kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

vulg: intravit autem rex ut videret discumbentes et vidit ibi hominem non vestitum veste nuptiali
clem: Intravit autem rex ut viderent discumbentes, et vidit ibi hominem non vestitum veste nuptiali.
tr: εισελθων δε ο βασιλευς θεασασθαι τους ανακειμενους ειδεν εκει ανθρωπον ουκ ενδεδυμενον ενδυμα γαμου
kjv: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

vulg: et ait illi amice quomodo huc intrasti non habens vestem nuptialem at ille obmutuit
clem: Et ait illi: Amice, quomodo huc intrasti non habens vestem nuptialem? At ille obmutavit.
tr: και λεγει αυτω εταιρε πως εισηλθες ωδε μη εχων ενδυμα γαμου ο δε εφιμωθη
kjv: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

vulg: tunc dixit rex ministris ligatis pedibus eius et manibus mittite eum in tenebras exteriores ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium
clem: Tunc dicit rex ministris: Ligatis manibus et pedibus ejus, mittite eum in tenebras exteriores: ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
tr: τοτε ειπεν ο βασιλευς τοις διακονοις δησαντες αυτου ποδας και χειρας αρατε αυτον και εκβαλετε εις το σκοτος το εξωτερον εκει εσται ο κλαυθμος και ο βρυγμος των οδοντων
kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

vulg: multi autem sunt vocati pauci vero electi
clem: Multi enim sunt vocati, pauci vero electi.
tr: πολλοι γαρ εισιν κλητοι ολιγοι δε εκλεκτοι
kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.

vulg: tunc abeuntes Pharisaei consilium inierunt ut caperent eum in sermone
clem: Tunc abeuntes pharisi, consilium inierunt ut caperent eum in sermone.
tr: τοτε πορευθεντες οι φαρισαιοι συμβουλιον ελαβον οπως αυτον παγιδευσωσιν εν λογω
kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

vulg: et mittunt ei discipulos suos cum Herodianis dicentes magister scimus quia verax es et viam Dei in veritate doces et non est tibi cura de aliquo non enim respicis personam hominum
clem: Et mittunt ei discipulos suos cum Herodianis, dicentes: Magister, scimus quia verax es, et viam Dei in veritate doces, et non est tibi cura de aliquo: non enim respicis personam hominum:
tr: και αποστελλουσιν αυτω τους μαθητας αυτων μετα των ηρωδιανων λεγοντες διδασκαλε οιδαμεν οτι αληθης ει και την οδον του θεου εν αληθεια διδασκεις και ου μελει σοι περι ουδενος ου γαρ βλεπεις εις προσωπον ανθρωπων
kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

vulg: dic ergo nobis quid tibi videatur licet censum dare Caesari an non
clem: dic ergo nobis quid tibi videtur, licet censum dare Csari, an non?
tr: ειπε ουν ημιν τι σοι δοκει εξεστιν δουναι κηνσον καισαρι η ου
kjv: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

vulg: cognita autem Iesus nequitia eorum ait quid me temptatis hypocritae
clem: Cognita autem Jesus nequitia eorum, ait: Quid me tentatis hypocrit?
tr: γνους δε ο ιησους την πονηριαν αυτων ειπεν τι με πειραζετε υποκριται
kjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

vulg: ostendite mihi nomisma census at illi obtulerunt ei denarium
clem: Ostendite mihi numisma census. At illi obtulerunt ei denarium.
tr: επιδειξατε μοι το νομισμα του κηνσου οι δε προσηνεγκαν αυτω δηναριον
kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

vulg: et ait illis Iesus cuius est imago haec et suprascriptio
clem: Et ait illis Jesus: Cujus est imago hc, et superscriptio?
tr: και λεγει αυτοις τινος η εικων αυτη και η επιγραφη
kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

vulg: dicunt ei Caesaris tunc ait illis reddite ergo quae sunt Caesaris Caesari et quae sunt Dei Deo
clem: Dicunt ei: Csaris. Tunc ait illis: Reddite ergo qu sunt Csaris, Csari: et qu sunt Dei, Deo.
tr: λεγουσιν αυτω καισαρος τοτε λεγει αυτοις αποδοτε ουν τα καισαρος καισαρι και τα του θεου τω θεω
kjv: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

vulg: et audientes mirati sunt et relicto eo abierunt
clem: Et audientes mirati sunt, et relicto eo abierunt.
tr: και ακουσαντες εθαυμασαν και αφεντες αυτον απηλθον
kjv: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

vulg: in illo die accesserunt ad eum Sadducaei qui dicunt non esse resurrectionem et interrogaverunt eum
clem: In illo die accesserunt ad eum sadduci, qui dicunt non esse resurrectionem: et interrogaverunt eum,
tr: εν εκεινη τη ημερα προσηλθον αυτω σαδδουκαιοι οι λεγοντες μη ειναι αναστασιν και επηρωτησαν αυτον
kjv: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

vulg: dicentes magister Moses dixit si quis mortuus fuerit non habens filium ut ducat frater eius uxorem illius et suscitet semen fratri suo
clem: dicentes: Magister, Moyses dixit: Si quis mortuus fuerit non habens filium, ut ducat frater ejus uxorem illius, et suscitet semen fratri suo.
tr: λεγοντες διδασκαλε μωσης ειπεν εαν τις αποθανη μη εχων τεκνα επιγαμβρευσει ο αδελφος αυτου την γυναικα αυτου και αναστησει σπερμα τω αδελφω αυτου
kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

vulg: erant autem apud nos septem fratres et primus uxore ducta defunctus est et non habens semen reliquit uxorem suam fratri suo
clem: Erant autem apud nos septem fratres: et primus, uxore ducta, defunctus est: et non habens semen, reliquit uxorem suam fratri suo.
tr: ησαν δε παρ ημιν επτα αδελφοι και ο πρωτος γαμησας ετελευτησεν και μη εχων σπερμα αφηκεν την γυναικα αυτου τω αδελφω αυτου
kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

vulg: similiter secundus et tertius usque ad septimum
clem: Similiter secundus, et tertius usque ad septimum.
tr: ομοιως και ο δευτερος και ο τριτος εως των επτα
kjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

vulg: novissime autem omnium et mulier defuncta est
clem: Novissime autem omnium et mulier defuncta est.
tr: υστερον δε παντων απεθανεν και η γυνη
kjv: And last of all the woman died also.

vulg: in resurrectione ergo cuius erit de septem uxor omnes enim habuerunt eam
clem: In resurrectione ergo cujus erit de septem uxor? omnes enim habuerunt eam.
tr: εν τη ουν αναστασει τινος των επτα εσται γυνη παντες γαρ εσχον αυτην
kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

vulg: respondens autem Iesus ait illis erratis nescientes scripturas neque virtutem Dei
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, ait illis: Erratis nescientes Scripturas, neque virtutem Dei.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις πλανασθε μη ειδοτες τας γραφας μηδε την δυναμιν του θεου
kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

vulg: in resurrectione enim neque nubent neque nubentur sed sunt sicut angeli Dei in caelo
clem: In resurrectione enim neque nubent, neque nubentur: sed erunt sicut angeli Dei in clo.
tr: εν γαρ τη αναστασει ουτε γαμουσιν ουτε εκγαμιζονται αλλ ως αγγελοι του θεου εν ουρανω εισιν
kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

vulg: de resurrectione autem mortuorum non legistis quod dictum est a Deo dicente vobis
clem: De resurrectione autem mortuorum non legistis quod dictum est a Deo dicente vobis:
tr: περι δε της αναστασεως των νεκρων ουκ ανεγνωτε το ρηθεν υμιν υπο του θεου λεγοντος
kjv: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

vulg: ego sum Deus Abraham et Deus Isaac et Deus Iacob non est Deus mortuorum sed viventium
clem: Ego sum Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob? Non est Deus mortuorum, sed viventium.
tr: εγω ειμι ο θεος αβρααμ και ο θεος ισαακ και ο θεος ιακωβ ουκ εστιν ο θεος θεος νεκρων αλλα ζωντων
kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

vulg: et audientes turbae mirabantur in doctrina eius
clem: Et audientes turb, mirabantur in doctrina ejus.
tr: και ακουσαντες οι οχλοι εξεπλησσοντο επι τη διδαχη αυτου
kjv: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.

vulg: Pharisaei autem audientes quod silentium inposuisset Sadducaeis convenerunt in unum
clem: Pharisi autem audientes quod silentium imposuisset sadducis, convenerunt in unum:
tr: οι δε φαρισαιοι ακουσαντες οτι εφιμωσεν τους σαδδουκαιους συνηχθησαν επι το αυτο
kjv: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

vulg: et interrogavit eum unus ex eis legis doctor temptans eum
clem: et interrogavit eum unus ex eis legis doctor, tentans eum:
tr: και επηρωτησεν εις εξ αυτων νομικος πειραζων αυτον και λεγων
kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

vulg: magister quod est mandatum magnum in lege
clem: Magister, quod est mandatum magnum in lege?
tr: διδασκαλε ποια εντολη μεγαλη εν τω νομω
kjv: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

vulg: ait illi Iesus diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo et in tota anima tua et in tota mente tua
clem: Ait illi Jesus: Diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, et in tota anima tua, et in tota mente tua.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω αγαπησεις κυριον τον θεον σου εν ολη τη καρδια σου και εν ολη τη ψυχη σου και εν ολη τη διανοια σου
kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

vulg: hoc est maximum et primum mandatum
clem: Hoc est maximum, et primum mandatum.
tr: αυτη εστιν πρωτη και μεγαλη εντολη
kjv: This is the first and great commandment.

vulg: secundum autem simile est huic diliges proximum tuum sicut te ipsum
clem: Secundum autem simile est huic: Diliges proximum tuum, sicut teipsum.
tr: δευτερα δε ομοια αυτη αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον
kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

vulg: in his duobus mandatis universa lex pendet et prophetae
clem: In his duobus mandatis universa lex pendet, et prophet.
tr: εν ταυταις ταις δυσιν εντολαις ολος ο νομος και οι προφηται κρεμανται
kjv: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

vulg: congregatis autem Pharisaeis interrogavit eos Iesus
clem: Congregatis autem pharisis, interrogavit eos Jesus,
tr: συνηγμενων δε των φαρισαιων επηρωτησεν αυτους ο ιησους
kjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

vulg: dicens quid vobis videtur de Christo cuius filius est dicunt ei David
clem: dicens: Quid vobis videtur de Christo? cujus filius est? Dicunt ei: David.
tr: λεγων τι υμιν δοκει περι του χριστου τινος υιος εστιν λεγουσιν αυτω του δαβιδ
kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.

vulg: ait illis quomodo ergo David in spiritu vocat eum Dominum dicens
clem: Ait illis: Quomodo ergo David in spiritu vocat eum Dominum, dicens:
tr: λεγει αυτοις πως ουν δαβιδ εν πνευματι κυριον αυτον καλει λεγων
kjv: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

vulg: dixit Dominus Domino meo sede a dextris meis donec ponam inimicos tuos scabillum pedum tuorum
clem: Dixit Dominus Domino meo: Sede a dextris meis, donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum?
tr: ειπεν ο κυριος τω κυριω μου καθου εκ δεξιων μου εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
kjv: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

vulg: si ergo David vocat eum Dominum quomodo filius eius est
clem: Si ergo David vocat eum Dominum, quomodo filius ejus est?
tr: ει ουν δαβιδ καλει αυτον κυριον πως υιος αυτου εστιν
kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

vulg: et nemo poterat respondere ei verbum neque ausus fuit quisquam ex illa die eum amplius interrogare
clem: Et nemo poterat ei respondere verbum: neque ausus fuit quisquam ex illa die eum amplius interrogare.
tr: και ουδεις εδυνατο αυτω αποκριθηναι λογον ουδε ετολμησεν τις απ εκεινης της ημερας επερωτησαι αυτον ουκετι
kjv: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

vulg: tunc Iesus locutus est ad turbas et discipulos suos
clem: Tunc Jesus locutus est ad turbas, et ad discipulos suos,
tr: τοτε ο ιησους ελαλησεν τοις οχλοις και τοις μαθηταις αυτου
kjv: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

vulg: dicens super cathedram Mosi sederunt scribae et Pharisaei
clem: dicens: Super cathedram Moysi sederunt scrib et pharisi.
tr: λεγων επι της μωσεως καθεδρας εκαθισαν οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι
kjv: Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

vulg: omnia ergo quaecumque dixerint vobis servate et facite secundum opera vero eorum nolite facere dicunt enim et non faciunt
clem: Omnia ergo qucumque dixerint vobis, servate, et facite: secundum opera vero eorum nolite facere: dicunt enim, et non faciunt.
tr: παντα ουν οσα αν ειπωσιν υμιν τηρειν τηρειτε και ποιειτε κατα δε τα εργα αυτων μη ποιειτε λεγουσιν γαρ και ου ποιουσιν
kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

vulg: alligant autem onera gravia et inportabilia et inponunt in umeros hominum digito autem suo nolunt ea movere
clem: Alligant enim onera gravia, et importabilia, et imponunt in humeros hominum: digito autem suo nolunt ea movere.
tr: δεσμευουσιν γαρ φορτια βαρεα και δυσβαστακτα και επιτιθεασιν επι τους ωμους των ανθρωπων τω δε δακτυλω αυτων ου θελουσιν κινησαι αυτα
kjv: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

vulg: omnia vero opera sua faciunt ut videantur ab hominibus dilatant enim phylacteria sua et magnificant fimbrias
clem: Omnia vero opera sua faciunt ut videantur ab hominibus: dilatant enim phylacteria sua, et magnificant fimbrias.
tr: παντα δε τα εργα αυτων ποιουσιν προς το θεαθηναι τοις ανθρωποις πλατυνουσιν δε τα φυλακτηρια αυτων και μεγαλυνουσιν τα κρασπεδα των ιματιων αυτων
kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

vulg: amant autem primos recubitus in cenis et primas cathedras in synagogis
clem: Amant autem primos recubitus in cnis, et primas cathedras in synagogis,
tr: φιλουσιν τε την πρωτοκλισιαν εν τοις δειπνοις και τας πρωτοκαθεδριας εν ταις συναγωγαις
kjv: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

vulg: et salutationes in foro et vocari ab hominibus rabbi
clem: et salutationes in foro, et vocari ab hominibus Rabbi.
tr: και τους ασπασμους εν ταις αγοραις και καλεισθαι υπο των ανθρωπων ραββι ραββι
kjv: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

vulg: vos autem nolite vocari rabbi unus enim est magister vester omnes autem vos fratres estis
clem: Vos autem nolite vocari Rabbi: unus est enim magister vester, omnes autem vos fratres estis.
tr: υμεις δε μη κληθητε ραββι εις γαρ εστιν υμων ο καθηγητης ο χριστος παντες δε υμεις αδελφοι εστε
kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

vulg: et patrem nolite vocare vobis super terram unus enim est Pater vester qui in caelis est
clem: Et patrem nolite vocare vobis super terram: unus est enim pater vester qui in clis est.
tr: και πατερα μη καλεσητε υμων επι της γης εις γαρ εστιν ο πατηρ υμων ο εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

vulg: nec vocemini magistri quia magister vester unus est Christus
clem: Nec vocemini magistri: quia magister vester unus est, Christus.
tr: μηδε κληθητε καθηγηται εις γαρ υμων εστιν ο καθηγητης ο χριστος
kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

vulg: qui maior est vestrum erit minister vester
clem: Qui major est vestrum, erit minister vester.
tr: ο δε μειζων υμων εσται υμων διακονος
kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

vulg: qui autem se exaltaverit humiliabitur et qui se humiliaverit exaltabitur
clem: Qui autem se exaltaverit, humiliabitur: et qui se humiliaverit, exaltabitur.
tr: οστις δε υψωσει εαυτον ταπεινωθησεται και οστις ταπεινωσει εαυτον υψωθησεται
kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

vulg: vae autem vobis scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae quia clauditis regnum caelorum ante homines vos enim non intratis nec introeuntes sinitis intrare
clem: V autem vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, quia clauditis regnum clorum ante homines! vos enim non intratis, nec intrountes sinitis intrare.
tr: (23:14) ουαι  ουαι δε  υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι κλειετε την βασιλειαν των ουρανων εμπροσθεν των ανθρωπων υμεις γαρ ουκ εισερχεσθε ουδε τους εισερχομενους αφιετε εισελθειν
kjv: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

clem: V vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, quia comeditis domos viduarum, orationes longas orantes! propter hoc amplius accipietis judicium.
tr: (23:13) ουαι δε  ουαι  υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι κατεσθιετε τας οικιας των χηρων και προφασει μακρα προσευχομενοι δια τουτο ληψεσθε περισσοτερον κριμα
kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

vulg: vae vobis scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae quia circuitis mare et aridam ut faciatis unum proselytum et cum fuerit factus facitis eum filium gehennae duplo quam vos
clem: V vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, quia circuitis mare, et aridam, ut faciatis unum proselytum, et cum fuerit factus, facitis eum filium gehenn duplo quam vos.
tr: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι περιαγετε την θαλασσαν και την ξηραν ποιησαι ενα προσηλυτον και οταν γενηται ποιειτε αυτον υιον γεεννης διπλοτερον υμων
kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

vulg: vae vobis duces caeci qui dicitis quicumque iuraverit per templum nihil est qui autem iuraverit in aurum templi debet
clem: V vobis duces cci, qui dicitis: Quicumque juraverit per templum, nihil est: qui autem juraverit in auro templo, debet.
tr: ουαι υμιν οδηγοι τυφλοι οι λεγοντες ος αν ομοση εν τω ναω ουδεν εστιν ος δ αν ομοση εν τω χρυσω του ναου οφειλει
kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

vulg: stulti et caeci quid enim maius est aurum an templum quod sanctificat aurum
clem: Stulti et cci: quid enim majus est? aurum, an templum, quod sanctificat aurum?
tr: μωροι και τυφλοι τις γαρ μειζων εστιν ο χρυσος η ο ναος ο αγιαζων τον χρυσον
kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

vulg: et quicumque iuraverit in altari nihil est quicumque autem iuraverit in dono quod est super illud debet
clem: Et quicumque juraverit in altari, nihil est: quicumque autem juraverit in dono, quod est super illud, debet.
tr: και ος εαν ομοση εν τω θυσιαστηριω ουδεν εστιν ος δ αν ομοση εν τω δωρω τω επανω αυτου οφειλει
kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

vulg: caeci quid enim maius est donum an altare quod sanctificat donum
clem: Cci: quid enim majus est, donum, an altare, quod sanctificat donum?
tr: μωροι και τυφλοι τι γαρ μειζον το δωρον η το θυσιαστηριον το αγιαζον το δωρον
kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

vulg: qui ergo iurat in altare iurat in eo et in omnibus quae super illud sunt
clem: Qui ergo jurat in altari, jurat in eo, et in omnibus qu super illud sunt.
tr: ο ουν ομοσας εν τω θυσιαστηριω ομνυει εν αυτω και εν πασιν τοις επανω αυτου
kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

vulg: et qui iuraverit in templo iurat in illo et in eo qui inhabitat in ipso
clem: Et quicumque juraverit in templo, jurat in illo, et in eo qui habitat in ipso:
tr: και ο ομοσας εν τω ναω ομνυει εν αυτω και εν τω κατοικουντι αυτον
kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

vulg: et qui iurat in caelo iurat in throno Dei et in eo qui sedet super eum
clem: et qui jurat in clo, jurat in throno Dei, et in eo qui sedet super eum.
tr: και ο ομοσας εν τω ουρανω ομνυει εν τω θρονω του θεου και εν τω καθημενω επανω αυτου
kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

vulg: vae vobis scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae quia decimatis mentam et anethum et cyminum et reliquistis quae graviora sunt legis iudicium et misericordiam et fidem haec oportuit facere et illa non omittere
clem: V vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, qui decimatis mentham, et anethum, et cyminum, et reliquistis qu graviora sunt legis, judicium, et misericordiam, et fidem! hc oportuit facere, et illa non omittere.
tr: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι αποδεκατουτε το ηδυοσμον και το ανηθον και το κυμινον και αφηκατε τα βαρυτερα του νομου την κρισιν και τον ελεον και την πιστιν ταυτα εδει ποιησαι κακεινα μη αφιεναι
kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

vulg: duces caeci excolantes culicem camelum autem gluttientes
clem: Duces cci, excolantes culicem, camelum autem glutientes.
tr: οδηγοι τυφλοι οι διυλιζοντες τον κωνωπα την δε καμηλον καταπινοντες
kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

vulg: vae vobis scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae quia mundatis quod de foris est calicis et parapsidis intus autem pleni sunt rapina et inmunditia
clem: V vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, quia mundatis quod deforis est calicis et paropsidis; intus autem pleni estis rapina et immunditia!
tr: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι καθαριζετε το εξωθεν του ποτηριου και της παροψιδος εσωθεν δε γεμουσιν εξ αρπαγης και ακρασιας
kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

vulg: Pharisaee caece munda prius quod intus est calicis et parapsidis ut fiat et id quod de foris est mundum
clem: Pharise cce, munda prius quod intus est calicis, et paropsidis, ut fiat id, quod deforis est, mundum.
tr: φαρισαιε τυφλε καθαρισον πρωτον το εντος του ποτηριου και της παροψιδος ινα γενηται και το εκτος αυτων καθαρον
kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

vulg: vae vobis scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae quia similes estis sepulchris dealbatis quae a foris parent hominibus speciosa intus vero plena sunt ossibus mortuorum et omni spurcitia
clem: V vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, quia similes estis sepulchris dealbatis, qu a foris parent hominibus speciosa, intus vero pleni sunt ossibus mortuorum, et omni spurcitia!
tr: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι παρομοιαζετε ταφοις κεκονιαμενοις οιτινες εξωθεν μεν φαινονται ωραιοι εσωθεν δε γεμουσιν οστεων νεκρων και πασης ακαθαρσιας
kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

vulg: sic et vos a foris quidem paretis hominibus iusti intus autem pleni estis hypocrisi et iniquitate
clem: Sic et vos a foris quidem paretis hominibus justi: intus autem pleni estis hypocrisi et iniquitate.
tr: ουτως και υμεις εξωθεν μεν φαινεσθε τοις ανθρωποις δικαιοι εσωθεν δε μεστοι εστε υποκρισεως και ανομιας
kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

vulg: vae vobis scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae quia aedificatis sepulchra prophetarum et ornatis monumenta iustorum
clem: V vobis scrib et pharisi hypocrit, qui dificatis sepulchra prophetarum, et ornatis monumenta justorum,
tr: ουαι υμιν γραμματεις και φαρισαιοι υποκριται οτι οικοδομειτε τους ταφους των προφητων και κοσμειτε τα μνημεια των δικαιων
kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

vulg: et dicitis si fuissemus in diebus patrum nostrorum non essemus socii eorum in sanguine prophetarum
clem: et dicitis: Si fuissemus in diebus patrum nostrorum, non essemus socii eorum in sanguine prophetarum!
tr: και λεγετε ει ημεν εν ταις ημεραις των πατερων ημων ουκ αν ημεν κοινωνοι αυτων εν τω αιματι των προφητων
kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

vulg: itaque testimonio estis vobismet ipsis quia filii estis eorum qui prophetas occiderunt
clem: itaque testimonio estis vobismetipsis, quia filii estis eorum, qui prophetas occiderunt.
tr: ωστε μαρτυρειτε εαυτοις οτι υιοι εστε των φονευσαντων τους προφητας
kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

vulg: et vos implete mensuram patrum vestrorum
clem: Et vos implete mensuram patrum vestrorum.
tr: και υμεις πληρωσατε το μετρον των πατερων υμων
kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

vulg: serpentes genimina viperarum quomodo fugietis a iudicio gehennae
clem: Serpentes genimina viperarum, quomodo fugietis a judicio gehenn?
tr: οφεις γεννηματα εχιδνων πως φυγητε απο της κρισεως της γεεννης
kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

vulg: ideo ecce ego mitto ad vos prophetas et sapientes et scribas ex illis occidetis et crucifigetis et ex eis flagellabitis in synagogis vestris et persequemini de civitate in civitatem
clem: Ideo ecce ego mitto ad vos prophetas, et sapientes, et scribas, et ex illis occidetis, et crucifigetis, et ex eis flagellabitis in synagogis vestris, et persequemini de civitate in civitatem:
tr: δια τουτο ιδου εγω αποστελλω προς υμας προφητας και σοφους και γραμματεις και εξ αυτων αποκτενειτε και σταυρωσετε και εξ αυτων μαστιγωσετε εν ταις συναγωγαις υμων και διωξετε απο πολεως εις πολιν
kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

vulg: ut veniat super vos omnis sanguis iustus qui effusus est super terram a sanguine Abel iusti usque ad sanguinem Zacchariae filii Barachiae quem occidistis inter templum et altare
clem: ut veniat super vos omnis sanguis justus, qui effusus est super terram, a sanguine Abel justi usque ad sanguinem Zachari, filii Barachi, quem occidistis inter templum et altare.
tr: οπως ελθη εφ υμας παν αιμα δικαιον εκχυνομενον επι της γης απο του αιματος αβελ του δικαιου εως του αιματος ζαχαριου υιου βαραχιου ον εφονευσατε μεταξυ του ναου και του θυσιαστηριου
kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

vulg: amen dico vobis venient haec omnia super generationem istam
clem: Amen dico vobis, venient hc omnia super generationem istam.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν ηξει ταυτα παντα επι την γενεαν ταυτην
kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

vulg: Hierusalem Hierusalem quae occidis prophetas et lapidas eos qui ad te missi sunt quotiens volui congregare filios tuos quemadmodum gallina congregat pullos suos sub alas et noluisti
clem: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, qu occidis prophetas, et lapidas eos, qui ad te missi sunt, quoties volui congregare filios tuos, quemadmodum gallina congregat pullos suos sub alas, et noluisti?
tr: ιερουσαλημ ιερουσαλημ η αποκτεινουσα τους προφητας και λιθοβολουσα τους απεσταλμενους προς αυτην ποσακις ηθελησα επισυναγαγειν τα τεκνα σου ον τροπον επισυναγει ορνις τα νοσσια εαυτης υπο τας πτερυγας και ουκ ηθελησατε
kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

vulg: ecce relinquitur vobis domus vestra deserta
clem: Ecce relinquetur vobis domus vestra deserta.
tr: ιδου αφιεται υμιν ο οικος υμων ερημος
kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

vulg: dico enim vobis non me videbitis amodo donec dicatis benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini
clem: Dico enim vobis, non me videbitis amodo, donec dicatis: Benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν ου μη με ιδητε απ αρτι εως αν ειπητε ευλογημενος ο ερχομενος εν ονοματι κυριου
kjv: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

vulg: et egressus Iesus de templo ibat et accesserunt discipuli eius ut ostenderent ei aedificationes templi
clem: Et egressus Jesus de templo, ibat. Et accesserunt discipuli ejus, ut ostenderent ei dificationes templi.
tr: και εξελθων ο ιησους επορευετο απο του ιερου και προσηλθον οι μαθηται αυτου επιδειξαι αυτω τας οικοδομας του ιερου
kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

vulg: ipse autem respondens dixit eis videtis haec omnia amen dico vobis non relinquetur hic lapis super lapidem qui non destruatur
clem: Ipse autem respondens dixit illis: Videtis hc omnia? amen dico vobis, non relinquetur hic lapis super lapidem, qui non destruatur.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ου βλεπετε παντα ταυτα αμην λεγω υμιν ου μη αφεθη ωδε λιθος επι λιθον ος ου μη καταλυθησεται
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

vulg: sedente autem eo super montem Oliveti accesserunt ad eum discipuli secreto dicentes dic nobis quando haec erunt et quod signum adventus tui et consummationis saeculi
clem: Sedente autem eo super montem Oliveti, accesserunt ad eum discipuli secreto, dicentes: Dic nobis, quando hc erunt? et quod signum adventus tui, et consummationis sculi?
tr: καθημενου δε αυτου επι του ορους των ελαιων προσηλθον αυτω οι μαθηται κατ ιδιαν λεγοντες ειπε ημιν ποτε ταυτα εσται και τι το σημειον της σης παρουσιας και της συντελειας του αιωνος
kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

vulg: et respondens Iesus dixit eis videte ne quis vos seducat
clem: Et respondens Jesus, dixit eis: Videte ne quis vos seducat:
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις βλεπετε μη τις υμας πλανηση
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

vulg: multi enim venient in nomine meo dicentes ego sum Christus et multos seducent
clem: multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes: Ego sum Christus: et multos seducent.
tr: πολλοι γαρ ελευσονται επι τω ονοματι μου λεγοντες εγω ειμι ο χριστος και πολλους πλανησουσιν
kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

vulg: audituri autem estis proelia et opiniones proeliorum videte ne turbemini oportet enim haec fieri sed nondum est finis
clem: Audituri enim estis prlia, et opiniones prliorum. Videte ne turbemini: oportet enim hc fieri, sed nondum est finis:
tr: μελλησετε δε ακουειν πολεμους και ακοας πολεμων ορατε μη θροεισθε δει γαρ παντα γενεσθαι αλλ ουπω εστιν το τελος
kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

vulg: consurget enim gens in gentem et regnum in regnum et erunt pestilentiae et fames et terraemotus per loca
clem: consurget enim gens in gentem, et regnum in regnum, et erunt pestilenti, et fames, et terrmotus per loca:
tr: εγερθησεται γαρ εθνος επι εθνος και βασιλεια επι βασιλειαν και εσονται λιμοι και λοιμοι και σεισμοι κατα τοπους
kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

vulg: haec autem omnia initia sunt dolorum
clem: hc autem omnia initia sunt dolorum.
tr: παντα δε ταυτα αρχη ωδινων
kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

vulg: tunc tradent vos in tribulationem et occident vos et eritis odio omnibus gentibus propter nomen meum
clem: Tunc tradent vos in tribulationem, et occident vos: et eritis odio omnibus gentibus propter nomen meum.
tr: τοτε παραδωσουσιν υμας εις θλιψιν και αποκτενουσιν υμας και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων των εθνων δια το ονομα μου
kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

vulg: et tunc scandalizabuntur multi et invicem tradent et odio habebunt invicem
clem: Et tunc scandalizabuntur multi, et invicem tradent, et odio habebunt invicem.
tr: και τοτε σκανδαλισθησονται πολλοι και αλληλους παραδωσουσιν και μισησουσιν αλληλους
kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

vulg: et multi pseudoprophetae surgent et seducent multos
clem: Et multi pseudoprophet surgent, et seducent multos.
tr: και πολλοι ψευδοπροφηται εγερθησονται και πλανησουσιν πολλους
kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

vulg: et quoniam abundabit iniquitas refrigescet caritas multorum
clem: Et quoniam abundavit iniquitas, refrigescet caritas multorum:
tr: και δια το πληθυνθηναι την ανομιαν ψυγησεται η αγαπη των πολλων
kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

vulg: qui autem permanserit usque in finem hic salvus erit
clem: qui autem perseveraverit usque in finem, hic salvus erit.
tr: ο δε υπομεινας εις τελος ουτος σωθησεται
kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

vulg: et praedicabitur hoc evangelium regni in universo orbe in testimonium omnibus gentibus et tunc veniet consummatio
clem: Et prdicabitur hoc Evangelium regni in universo orbe, in testimonium omnibus gentibus: et tunc veniet consummatio.
tr: και κηρυχθησεται τουτο το ευαγγελιον της βασιλειας εν ολη τη οικουμενη εις μαρτυριον πασιν τοις εθνεσιν και τοτε ηξει το τελος
kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

vulg: cum ergo videritis abominationem desolationis quae dicta est a Danihelo propheta stantem in loco sancto qui legit intellegat
clem: Cum ergo videritis abominationem desolationis, qu dicta est a Daniele propheta, stantem in loco sancto, qui legit, intelligat:
tr: οταν ουν ιδητε το βδελυγμα της ερημωσεως το ρηθεν δια δανιηλ του προφητου εστος  εστως  εν τοπω αγιω ο αναγινωσκων νοειτω
kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

vulg: tunc qui in Iudaea sunt fugiant ad montes
clem: tunc qui in Juda sunt, fugiant ad montes:
tr: τοτε οι εν τη ιουδαια φευγετωσαν επι τα ορη
kjv: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

vulg: et qui in tecto non descendat tollere aliquid de domo sua
clem: et qui in tecto, non descendat tollere aliquid de domo sua:
tr: ο επι του δωματος μη καταβαινετω αραι τι εκ της οικιας αυτου
kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

vulg: et qui in agro non revertatur tollere tunicam suam
clem: et qui in agro, non revertatur tollere tunicam suam.
tr: και ο εν τω αγρω μη επιστρεψατω οπισω αραι τα ιματια αυτου
kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

vulg: vae autem praegnatibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus
clem: V autem prgnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus!
tr: ουαι δε ταις εν γαστρι εχουσαις και ταις θηλαζουσαις εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις
kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

vulg: orate autem ut non fiat fuga vestra hieme vel sabbato
clem: Orate autem ut non fiat fuga vestra in hieme, vel sabbato:
tr: προσευχεσθε δε ινα μη γενηται η φυγη υμων χειμωνος μηδε εν σαββατω
kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

vulg: erit enim tunc tribulatio magna qualis non fuit ab initio mundi usque modo neque fiet
clem: erit enim tunc tribulatio magna, qualis non fuit ab initio mundi usque modo, neque fiet.
tr: εσται γαρ τοτε θλιψις μεγαλη οια ου γεγονεν απ αρχης κοσμου εως του νυν ουδ ου μη γενηται
kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

vulg: et nisi breviati fuissent dies illi non fieret salva omnis caro sed propter electos breviabuntur dies illi
clem: Et nisi breviati fuissent dies illi, non fieret salva omnis caro: sed propter electos breviabuntur dies illi.
tr: και ει μη εκολοβωθησαν αι ημεραι εκειναι ουκ αν εσωθη πασα σαρξ δια δε τους εκλεκτους κολοβωθησονται αι ημεραι εκειναι
kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

vulg: tunc si quis vobis dixerit ecce hic Christus aut illic nolite credere
clem: Tunc si quis vobis dixerit: Ecce hic est Christus, aut illic: nolite credere.
tr: τοτε εαν τις υμιν ειπη ιδου ωδε ο χριστος η ωδε μη πιστευσητε
kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

vulg: surgent enim pseudochristi et pseudoprophetae et dabunt signa magna et prodigia ita ut in errorem inducantur si fieri potest etiam electi
clem: Surgent enim pseudochristi, et pseudoprophet: et dabunt signa magna, et prodigia, ita ut in errorem inducantur (si fieri potest) etiam electi.
tr: εγερθησονται γαρ ψευδοχριστοι και ψευδοπροφηται και δωσουσιν σημεια μεγαλα και τερατα ωστε πλανησαι ει δυνατον και τους εκλεκτους
kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

vulg: ecce praedixi vobis
clem: Ecce prdixi vobis.
tr: ιδου προειρηκα υμιν
kjv: Behold, I have told you before.

vulg: si ergo dixerint vobis ecce in deserto est nolite exire ecce in penetrabilibus nolite credere
clem: Si ergo dixerint vobis: Ecce in deserto est, nolite exire; Ecce in penetralibus, nolite credere.
tr: εαν ουν ειπωσιν υμιν ιδου εν τη ερημω εστιν μη εξελθητε ιδου εν τοις ταμειοις μη πιστευσητε
kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

vulg: sicut enim fulgur exit ab oriente et paret usque in occidente ita erit et adventus Filii hominis
clem: Sicut enim fulgur exit ab oriente, et paret usque in occidentem: ita erit et adventus Filii hominis.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ η αστραπη εξερχεται απο ανατολων και φαινεται εως δυσμων ουτως εσται και η παρουσια του υιου του ανθρωπου
kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

vulg: ubicumque fuerit corpus illuc congregabuntur aquilae
clem: Ubicumque fuerit corpus, illic congregabuntur et aquil.
tr: οπου γαρ εαν η το πτωμα εκει συναχθησονται οι αετοι
kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

vulg: statim autem post tribulationem dierum illorum sol obscurabitur et luna non dabit lumen suum et stellae cadent de caelo et virtutes caelorum commovebuntur
clem: Statim autem post tribulationem dierum illorum sol obscurabitur, et luna non dabit lumen suum, et stell cadent de clo, et virtutes clorum commovebuntur:
tr: ευθεως δε μετα την θλιψιν των ημερων εκεινων ο ηλιος σκοτισθησεται και η σεληνη ου δωσει το φεγγος αυτης και οι αστερες πεσουνται απο του ουρανου και αι δυναμεις των ουρανων σαλευθησονται
kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

vulg: et tunc parebit signum Filii hominis in caelo et tunc plangent omnes tribus terrae et videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus caeli cum virtute multa et maiestate
clem: et tunc parebit signum Filii hominis in clo: et tunc plangent omnes tribus terr: et videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus cli cum virtute multa et majestate.
tr: και τοτε φανησεται το σημειον του υιου του ανθρωπου εν τω ουρανω και τοτε κοψονται πασαι αι φυλαι της γης και οψονται τον υιον του ανθρωπου ερχομενον επι των νεφελων του ουρανου μετα δυναμεως και δοξης πολλης
kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

vulg: et mittet angelos suos cum tuba et voce magna et congregabunt electos eius a quattuor ventis a summis caelorum usque ad terminos eorum
clem: Et mittet angelos suos cum tuba, et voce magna: et congregabunt electos ejus a quatuor ventis, a summis clorum usque ad terminos eorum.
tr: και αποστελει τους αγγελους αυτου μετα σαλπιγγος φωνης μεγαλης και επισυναξουσιν τους εκλεκτους αυτου εκ των τεσσαρων ανεμων απ ακρων ουρανων εως ακρων αυτων
kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

vulg: ab arbore autem fici discite parabolam cum iam ramus eius tener fuerit et folia nata scitis quia prope est aestas
clem: Ab arbore autem fici discite parabolam: cum jam ramus ejus tener fuerit, et folia nata, scitis quia prope est stas:
tr: απο δε της συκης μαθετε την παραβολην οταν ηδη ο κλαδος αυτης γενηται απαλος και τα φυλλα εκφυη γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς το θερος
kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

vulg: ita et vos cum videritis haec omnia scitote quia prope est in ianuis
clem: ita et vos cum videritis hc omnia, scitote quia prope est, in januis.
tr: ουτως και υμεις οταν ιδητε παντα ταυτα γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς εστιν επι θυραις
kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

vulg: amen dico vobis quia non praeteribit haec generatio donec omnia haec fiant
clem: Amen dico vobis, quia non prteribit generatio hc, donec omnia hc fiant.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν ου μη παρελθη η γενεα αυτη εως αν παντα ταυτα γενηται
kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

vulg: caelum et terra transibunt verba vero mea non praeteribunt
clem: Clum et terra transibunt, verba autem mea non prteribunt.
tr: ο ουρανος και η γη παρελευσονται οι δε λογοι μου ου μη παρελθωσιν
kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

vulg: de die autem illa et hora nemo scit neque angeli caelorum nisi Pater solus
clem: De die autem illa et hora nemo scit, neque angeli clorum, nisi solus Pater.
tr: περι δε της ημερας εκεινης και της ωρας ουδεις οιδεν ουδε οι αγγελοι των ουρανων ει μη ο πατηρ μου μονος
kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

vulg: sicut autem in diebus Noe ita erit et adventus Filii hominis
clem: Sicut autem in diebus No, ita erit et adventus Filii hominis:
tr: ωσπερ δε αι ημεραι του νωε ουτως εσται και η παρουσια του υιου του ανθρωπου
kjv: But as the days of Noah were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

vulg: sicut enim erant in diebus ante diluvium comedentes et bibentes nubentes et nuptum tradentes usque ad eum diem quo introivit in arcam Noe
clem: sicut enim erant in diebus ante diluvium comedentes et bibentes, nubentes et nuptum tradentes, usque ad eum diem, quo intravit No in arcam,
tr: ωσπερ γαρ ησαν εν ταις ημεραις ταις προ του κατακλυσμου τρωγοντες και πινοντες γαμουντες και εκγαμιζοντες αχρι ης ημερας εισηλθεν νωε εις την κιβωτον
kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

vulg: et non cognoverunt donec venit diluvium et tulit omnes ita erit et adventus Filii hominis
clem: et non cognoverunt donec venit diluvium, et tulit omnes: ita erit et adventus Filii hominis.
tr: και ουκ εγνωσαν εως ηλθεν ο κατακλυσμος και ηρεν απαντας ουτως εσται και η παρουσια του υιου του ανθρωπου
kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

vulg: tunc duo erunt in agro unus adsumetur et unus relinquetur
clem: Tunc duo erunt in agro: unus assumetur, et unus relinquetur.
tr: τοτε δυο εσονται εν τω αγρω ο εις παραλαμβανεται και ο εις αφιεται
kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

vulg: duae molentes in mola una adsumetur et una relinquetur
clem: Du molentes in mola: una assumetur, et una relinquetur.
tr: δυο αληθουσαι εν τω μυλωνι μια παραλαμβανεται και μια αφιεται
kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

vulg: vigilate ergo quia nescitis qua hora Dominus vester venturus sit
clem: Vigilate ergo, quia nescitis qua hora Dominus vester venturus sit.
tr: γρηγορειτε ουν οτι ουκ οιδατε ποια ωρα ο κυριος υμων ερχεται
kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

vulg: illud autem scitote quoniam si sciret pater familias qua hora fur venturus esset vigilaret utique et non sineret perfodiri domum suam
clem: Illud autem scitote, quoniam si sciret paterfamilias qua hora fur venturus esset, vigilaret utique, et non sineret perfodi domum suam.
tr: εκεινο δε γινωσκετε οτι ει ηδει ο οικοδεσποτης ποια φυλακη ο κλεπτης ερχεται εγρηγορησεν αν και ουκ αν ειασεν διορυγηναι την οικιαν αυτου
kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

vulg: ideoque et vos estote parati quia qua nescitis hora Filius hominis venturus est
clem: Ideo et vos estote parati: quia qua nescitis hora Filius hominis venturus est.
tr: δια τουτο και υμεις γινεσθε ετοιμοι οτι η ωρα ου δοκειτε ο υιος του ανθρωπου ερχεται
kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

vulg: quis putas est fidelis servus et prudens quem constituit dominus suus supra familiam suam ut det illis cibum in tempore
clem: Quis, putas, est fidelis servus, et prudens, quem constituit dominus suus super familiam suam ut det illis cibum in tempore?
tr: τις αρα εστιν ο πιστος δουλος και φρονιμος ον κατεστησεν ο κυριος αυτου επι της θεραπειας αυτου του διδοναι αυτοις την τροφην εν καιρω
kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

vulg: beatus ille servus quem cum venerit dominus eius invenerit sic facientem
clem: Beatus ille servus, quem cum venerit dominus ejus, invenerit sic facientem.
tr: μακαριος ο δουλος εκεινος ον ελθων ο κυριος αυτου ευρησει ποιουντα ουτως
kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

vulg: amen dico vobis quoniam super omnia bona sua constituet eum
clem: Amen dico vobis, quoniam super omnia bona sua constituet eum.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οτι επι πασιν τοις υπαρχουσιν αυτου καταστησει αυτον
kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

vulg: si autem dixerit malus servus ille in corde suo moram facit dominus meus venire
clem: Si autem dixerit malus servus ille in corde suo: Moram fecit dominus meus venire:
tr: εαν δε ειπη ο κακος δουλος εκεινος εν τη καρδια αυτου χρονιζει ο κυριος μου ελθειν
kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

vulg: et coeperit percutere conservos suos manducet autem et bibat cum ebriis
clem: et cperit percutere conservos suos, manducet autem et bibat cum ebriosis:
tr: και αρξηται τυπτειν τους συνδουλους εσθιειν δε και πινειν μετα των μεθυοντων
kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

vulg: veniet dominus servi illius in die qua non sperat et hora qua ignorat
clem: veniet dominus servi illius in die qua non sperat, et hora qua ignorat:
tr: ηξει ο κυριος του δουλου εκεινου εν ημερα η ου προσδοκα και εν ωρα η ου γινωσκει
kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

vulg: et dividet eum partemque eius ponet cum hypocritis illic erit fletus et stridor dentium
clem: et dividet eum, partemque ejus ponet cum hypocritis: illic erit fletus et stridor dentium.
tr: και διχοτομησει αυτον και το μερος αυτου μετα των υποκριτων θησει εκει εσται ο κλαυθμος και ο βρυγμος των οδοντων
kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

vulg: tunc simile erit regnum caelorum decem virginibus quae accipientes lampadas suas exierunt obviam sponso et sponsae
clem: Tunc simile erit regnum clorum decem virginibus: qu accipientes lampades suas exierunt obviam sponso et spons.
tr: τοτε ομοιωθησεται η βασιλεια των ουρανων δεκα παρθενοις αιτινες λαβουσαι τας λαμπαδας αυτων εξηλθον εις απαντησιν του νυμφιου
kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

vulg: quinque autem ex eis erant fatuae et quinque prudentes
clem: Quinque autem ex eis erant fatu, et quinque prudentes:
tr: πεντε δε ησαν εξ αυτων φρονιμοι και αι πεντε μωραι
kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

vulg: sed quinque fatuae acceptis lampadibus non sumpserunt oleum secum
clem: sed quinque fatu, acceptis lampadibus, non sumpserunt oleum secum:
tr: αιτινες μωραι λαβουσαι τας λαμπαδας εαυτων ουκ ελαβον μεθ εαυτων ελαιον
kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

vulg: prudentes vero acceperunt oleum in vasis suis cum lampadibus
clem: prudentes vero acceperunt oleum in vasis suis cum lampadibus.
tr: αι δε φρονιμοι ελαβον ελαιον εν τοις αγγειοις αυτων μετα των λαμπαδων αυτων
kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

vulg: moram autem faciente sponso dormitaverunt omnes et dormierunt
clem: Moram autem faciente sponso, dormitaverunt omnes et dormierunt.
tr: χρονιζοντος δε του νυμφιου ενυσταξαν πασαι και εκαθευδον
kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

vulg: media autem nocte clamor factus est ecce sponsus venit exite obviam ei
clem: Media autem nocte clamor factus est: Ecce sponsus venit, exite obviam ei.
tr: μεσης δε νυκτος κραυγη γεγονεν ιδου ο νυμφιος ερχεται εξερχεσθε εις απαντησιν αυτου
kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

vulg: tunc surrexerunt omnes virgines illae et ornaverunt lampades suas
clem: Tunc surrexerunt omnes virgines ill, et ornaverunt lampades suas.
tr: τοτε ηγερθησαν πασαι αι παρθενοι εκειναι και εκοσμησαν τας λαμπαδας αυτων
kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

vulg: fatuae autem sapientibus dixerunt date nobis de oleo vestro quia lampades nostrae extinguntur
clem: Fatu autem sapientibus dixerunt: Date nobis de oleo vestro, quia lampades nostr extinguuntur.
tr: αι δε μωραι ταις φρονιμοις ειπον δοτε ημιν εκ του ελαιου υμων οτι αι λαμπαδες ημων σβεννυνται
kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

vulg: responderunt prudentes dicentes ne forte non sufficiat nobis et vobis ite potius ad vendentes et emite vobis
clem: Responderunt prudentes, dicentes: Ne forte non sufficiat nobis, et vobis, ite potius ad vendentes, et emite vobis.
tr: απεκριθησαν δε αι φρονιμοι λεγουσαι μηποτε ουκ αρκεση ημιν και υμιν πορευεσθε δε μαλλον προς τους πωλουντας και αγορασατε εαυταις
kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

vulg: dum autem irent emere venit sponsus et quae paratae erant intraverunt cum eo ad nuptias et clausa est ianua
clem: Dum autem irent emere, venit sponsus: et qu parat erant, intraverunt cum eo ad nuptias, et clausa est janua.
tr: απερχομενων δε αυτων αγορασαι ηλθεν ο νυμφιος και αι ετοιμοι εισηλθον μετ αυτου εις τους γαμους και εκλεισθη η θυρα
kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

vulg: novissime veniunt et reliquae virgines dicentes domine domine aperi nobis
clem: Novissime vero veniunt et reliqu virgines, dicentes: Domine, domine, aperi nobis.
tr: υστερον δε ερχονται και αι λοιπαι παρθενοι λεγουσαι κυριε κυριε ανοιξον ημιν
kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

vulg: at ille respondens ait amen dico vobis nescio vos
clem: At ille respondens, ait: Amen dico vobis, nescio vos.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αμην λεγω υμιν ουκ οιδα υμας
kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

vulg: vigilate itaque quia nescitis diem neque horam
clem: Vigilate itaque, quia nescitis diem, neque horam.
tr: γρηγορειτε ουν οτι ουκ οιδατε την ημεραν ουδε την ωραν εν η ο υιος του ανθρωπου ερχεται
kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

vulg: sicut enim homo proficiscens vocavit servos suos et tradidit illis bona sua
clem: Sicut enim homo peregre proficiscens, vocavit servos suos, et tradidit illis bona sua.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ ανθρωπος αποδημων εκαλεσεν τους ιδιους δουλους και παρεδωκεν αυτοις τα υπαρχοντα αυτου
kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

vulg: et uni dedit quinque talenta alii autem duo alii vero unum unicuique secundum propriam virtutem et profectus est statim
clem: Et uni dedit quinque talenta, alii autem duo, alii vero unum, unicuique secundum propriam virtutem: et profectus est statim.
tr: και ω μεν εδωκεν πεντε ταλαντα ω δε δυο ω δε εν εκαστω κατα την ιδιαν δυναμιν και απεδημησεν ευθεως
kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

vulg: abiit autem qui quinque talenta acceperat et operatus est in eis et lucratus est alia quinque
clem: Abiit autem qui quinque talenta acceperat, et operatus est in eis, et lucratus est alia quinque.
tr: πορευθεις δε ο τα πεντε ταλαντα λαβων ειργασατο εν αυτοις και εποιησεν αλλα πεντε ταλαντα
kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

vulg: similiter qui duo acceperat lucratus est alia duo
clem: Similiter et qui duo acceperat, lucratus est alia duo.
tr: ωσαυτως και ο τα δυο εκερδησεν και αυτος αλλα δυο
kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

vulg: qui autem unum acceperat abiens fodit in terra et abscondit pecuniam domini sui
clem: Qui autem unum acceperat, abiens fodit in terram, et abscondit pecuniam domini sui.
tr: ο δε το εν λαβων απελθων ωρυξεν εν τη γη και απεκρυψεν το αργυριον του κυριου αυτου
kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

vulg: post multum vero temporis venit dominus servorum illorum et posuit rationem cum eis
clem: Post multum vero temporis venit dominus servorum illorum, et posuit rationem cum eis.
tr: μετα δε χρονον πολυν ερχεται ο κυριος των δουλων εκεινων και συναιρει μετ αυτων λογον
kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

vulg: et accedens qui quinque talenta acceperat obtulit alia quinque talenta dicens domine quinque talenta mihi tradidisti ecce alia quinque superlucratus sum
clem: Et accedens qui quinque talenta acceperat, obtulit alia quinque talenta, dicens: Domine, quinque talenta tradidisti mihi, ecce alia quinque superlucratus sum.
tr: και προσελθων ο τα πεντε ταλαντα λαβων προσηνεγκεν αλλα πεντε ταλαντα λεγων κυριε πεντε ταλαντα μοι παρεδωκας ιδε αλλα πεντε ταλαντα εκερδησα επ αυτοις
kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

vulg: ait illi dominus eius euge bone serve et fidelis quia super pauca fuisti fidelis super multa te constituam intra in gaudium domini tui
clem: Ait illi dominus ejus: Euge serve bone, et fidelis: quia super pauca fuisti fidelis, super multa te constituam; intra in gaudium domini tui.
tr: εφη δε αυτω ο κυριος αυτου ευ δουλε αγαθε και πιστε επι ολιγα ης πιστος επι πολλων σε καταστησω εισελθε εις την χαραν του κυριου σου
kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

vulg: accessit autem et qui duo talenta acceperat et ait domine duo talenta tradidisti mihi ecce alia duo lucratus sum
clem: Accessit autem et qui duo talenta acceperat, et ait: Domine, duo talenta tradidisti mihi, ecce alia duo lucratus sum.
tr: προσελθων δε και ο τα δυο ταλαντα λαβων ειπεν κυριε δυο ταλαντα μοι παρεδωκας ιδε αλλα δυο ταλαντα εκερδησα επ αυτοις
kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

vulg: ait illi dominus eius euge serve bone et fidelis quia super pauca fuisti fidelis supra multa te constituam intra in gaudium domini tui
clem: Ait illi dominus ejus: Euge serve bone, et fidelis: quia super pauca fuisti fidelis, super multa te constituam; intra in gaudium domini tui.
tr: εφη αυτω ο κυριος αυτου ευ δουλε αγαθε και πιστε επι ολιγα ης πιστος επι πολλων σε καταστησω εισελθε εις την χαραν του κυριου σου
kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

vulg: accedens autem et qui unum talentum acceperat ait domine scio quia homo durus es metis ubi non seminasti et congregas ubi non sparsisti
clem: Accedens autem et qui unum talentum acceperat, ait: Domine, scio quia homo durus es; metis ubi non seminasti, et congregas ubi non sparsisti:
tr: προσελθων δε και ο το εν ταλαντον ειληφως ειπεν κυριε εγνων σε οτι σκληρος ει ανθρωπος θεριζων οπου ουκ εσπειρας και συναγων οθεν ου διεσκορπισας
kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

vulg: et timens abii et abscondi talentum tuum in terra ecce habes quod tuum est
clem: et timens abii, et abscondi talentum tuum in terra: ecce habes quod tuum est.
tr: και φοβηθεις απελθων εκρυψα το ταλαντον σου εν τη γη ιδε εχεις το σον
kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

vulg: respondens autem dominus eius dixit ei serve male et piger sciebas quia meto ubi non semino et congrego ubi non sparsi
clem: Respondens autem dominus ejus, dixit ei: Serve male, et piger, sciebas quia meto ubi non semino, et congrego ubi non sparsi:
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο κυριος αυτου ειπεν αυτω πονηρε δουλε και οκνηρε ηδεις οτι θεριζω οπου ουκ εσπειρα και συναγω οθεν ου διεσκορπισα
kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

vulg: oportuit ergo te mittere pecuniam meam nummulariis et veniens ego recepissem utique quod meum est cum usura
clem: oportuit ergo te committere pecuniam meam numulariis, et veniens ego recepissem utique quod meum est cum usura.
tr: εδει ουν σε βαλειν το αργυριον μου τοις τραπεζιταις και ελθων εγω εκομισαμην αν το εμον συν τοκω
kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

vulg: tollite itaque ab eo talentum et date ei qui habet decem talenta
clem: Tollite itaque ab eo talentum, et date ei qui habet decem talenta:
tr: αρατε ουν απ αυτου το ταλαντον και δοτε τω εχοντι τα δεκα ταλαντα
kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

vulg: omni enim habenti dabitur et abundabit ei autem qui non habet et quod videtur habere auferetur ab eo
clem: omni enim habenti dabitur, et abundabit: ei autem qui non habet, et quod videtur habere, auferetur ab eo.
tr: τω γαρ εχοντι παντι δοθησεται και περισσευθησεται απο δε του μη εχοντος και ο εχει αρθησεται απ αυτου
kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

vulg: et inutilem servum eicite in tenebras exteriores illic erit fletus et stridor dentium
clem: Et inutilem servum ejicite in tenebras exteriores: illic erit fletus, et stridor dentium.
tr: και τον αχρειον δουλον εκβαλλετε εις το σκοτος το εξωτερον εκει εσται ο κλαυθμος και ο βρυγμος των οδοντων
kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

vulg: cum autem venerit Filius hominis in maiestate sua et omnes angeli cum eo tunc sedebit super sedem maiestatis suae
clem: Cum autem venerit Filius hominis in majestate sua, et omnes angeli cum eo, tunc sedebit super sedem majestatis su:
tr: οταν δε ελθη ο υιος του ανθρωπου εν τη δοξη αυτου και παντες οι αγιοι αγγελοι μετ αυτου τοτε καθισει επι θρονου δοξης αυτου
kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

vulg: et congregabuntur ante eum omnes gentes et separabit eos ab invicem sicut pastor segregat oves ab hedis
clem: et congregabuntur ante eum omnes gentes, et separabit eos ab invicem, sicut pastor segregat oves ab hdis:
tr: και συναχθησεται εμπροσθεν αυτου παντα τα εθνη και αφοριει αυτους απ αλληλων ωσπερ ο ποιμην αφοριζει τα προβατα απο των εριφων
kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

vulg: et statuet oves quidem a dextris suis hedos autem a sinistris
clem: et statuet oves quidem a dextris suis, hdos autem a sinistris.
tr: και στησει τα μεν προβατα εκ δεξιων αυτου τα δε εριφια εξ ευωνυμων
kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

vulg: tunc dicet rex his qui a dextris eius erunt venite benedicti Patris mei possidete paratum vobis regnum a constitutione mundi
clem: Tunc dicet rex his qui a dextris ejus erunt: Venite benedicti Patris mei, possidete paratum vobis regnum a constitutione mundi:
tr: τοτε ερει ο βασιλευς τοις εκ δεξιων αυτου δευτε οι ευλογημενοι του πατρος μου κληρονομησατε την ητοιμασμενην υμιν βασιλειαν απο καταβολης κοσμου
kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

vulg: esurivi enim et dedistis mihi manducare sitivi et dedistis mihi bibere hospes eram et collexistis me
clem: esurivi enim, et dedistis mihi manducare: sitivi, et dedistis mihi bibere: hospes eram, et collegistis me:
tr: επεινασα γαρ και εδωκατε μοι φαγειν εδιψησα και εποτισατε με ξενος ημην και συνηγαγετε με
kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

vulg: nudus et operuistis me infirmus et visitastis me in carcere eram et venistis ad me
clem: nudus, et cooperuistis me: infirmus, et visitastis me: in carcere eram, et venistis ad me.
tr: γυμνος και περιεβαλετε με ησθενησα και επεσκεψασθε με εν φυλακη ημην και ηλθετε προς με
kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

vulg: tunc respondebunt ei iusti dicentes Domine quando te vidimus esurientem et pavimus sitientem et dedimus tibi potum
clem: Tunc respondebunt ei justi, dicentes: Domine, quando te vidimus esurientem, et pavimus te: sitientem, et dedimus tibi potum?
tr: τοτε αποκριθησονται αυτω οι δικαιοι λεγοντες κυριε ποτε σε ειδομεν πεινωντα και εθρεψαμεν η διψωντα και εποτισαμεν
kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

vulg: quando autem te vidimus hospitem et colleximus te aut nudum et cooperuimus
clem: quando autem te vidimus hospitem, et collegimus te: aut nudum, et cooperuimus te?
tr: ποτε δε σε ειδομεν ξενον και συνηγαγομεν η γυμνον και περιεβαλομεν
kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

vulg: aut quando te vidimus infirmum aut in carcere et venimus ad te
clem: aut quando te vidimus infirmum, aut in carcere, et venimus ad te?
tr: ποτε δε σε ειδομεν ασθενη η εν φυλακη και ηλθομεν προς σε
kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

vulg: et respondens rex dicet illis amen dico vobis quamdiu fecistis uni de his fratribus meis minimis mihi fecistis
clem: Et respondens rex, dicet illis: Amen dico vobis, quamdiu fecistis uni ex his fratribus meis minimis, mihi fecistis.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο βασιλευς ερει αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν εφ οσον εποιησατε ενι τουτων των αδελφων μου των ελαχιστων εμοι εποιησατε
kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

vulg: tunc dicet et his qui a sinistris erunt discedite a me maledicti in ignem aeternum qui paratus est diabolo et angelis eius
clem: Tunc dicet et his qui a sinistris erunt: Discedite a me maledicti in ignem ternum, qui paratus est diabolo, et angelis ejus:
tr: τοτε ερει και τοις εξ ευωνυμων πορευεσθε απ εμου οι κατηραμενοι εις το πυρ το αιωνιον το ητοιμασμενον τω διαβολω και τοις αγγελοις αυτου
kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

vulg: esurivi enim et non dedistis mihi manducare sitivi et non dedistis mihi potum
clem: esurivi enim, et non dedistis mihi manducare: sitivi, et non desistis mihi potum:
tr: επεινασα γαρ και ουκ εδωκατε μοι φαγειν εδιψησα και ουκ εποτισατε με
kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

vulg: hospes eram et non collexistis me nudus et non operuistis me infirmus et in carcere et non visitastis me
clem: hospes eram, et non collegistis me: nudus, et non cooperuistis me: infirmus, et in carcere, et non visitastis me.
tr: ξενος ημην και ου συνηγαγετε με γυμνος και ου περιεβαλετε με ασθενης και εν φυλακη και ουκ επεσκεψασθε με
kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

vulg: tunc respondebunt et ipsi dicentes Domine quando te vidimus esurientem aut sitientem aut hospitem aut nudum aut infirmum vel in carcere et non ministravimus tibi
clem: Tunc respondebunt ei et ipsi, dicentes: Domine, quando te vidimus esurientem, aut sitientem, aut hospitem, aut nudum, aut infirmum, aut in carcere, et non ministravimus tibi?
tr: τοτε αποκριθησονται αυτω και αυτοι λεγοντες κυριε ποτε σε ειδομεν πεινωντα η διψωντα η ξενον η γυμνον η ασθενη η εν φυλακη και ου διηκονησαμεν σοι
kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

vulg: tunc respondebit illis dicens amen dico vobis quamdiu non fecistis uni de minoribus his nec mihi fecistis
clem: Tunc respondebit illis, dicens: Amen dico vobis: Quamdiu non fecistis uni de minoribus his, nec mihi fecistis.
tr: τοτε αποκριθησεται αυτοις λεγων αμην λεγω υμιν εφ οσον ουκ εποιησατε ενι τουτων των ελαχιστων ουδε εμοι εποιησατε
