kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

vulg: et ibunt hii in supplicium aeternum iusti autem in vitam aeternam
clem: Et ibunt hi in supplicium ternum: justi autem in vitam ternam.
tr: και απελευσονται ουτοι εις κολασιν αιωνιον οι δε δικαιοι εις ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

vulg: et factum est cum consummasset Iesus sermones hos omnes dixit discipulis suis
clem: Et factum est: cum consummasset Jesus sermones hos omnes, dixit discipulis suis:
tr: και εγενετο οτε ετελεσεν ο ιησους παντας τους λογους τουτους ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου
kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,

vulg: scitis quia post biduum pascha fiet et Filius hominis tradetur ut crucifigatur
clem: Scitis quia post biduum Pascha fiet, et Filius hominis tradetur ut crucifigatur.
tr: οιδατε οτι μετα δυο ημερας το πασχα γινεται και ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται εις το σταυρωθηναι
kjv: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

vulg: tunc congregati sunt principes sacerdotum et seniores populi in atrium principis sacerdotum qui dicebatur Caiaphas
clem: Tunc congregati sunt principes sacerdotum, et seniores populi, in atrium principis sacerdotum, qui dicebatur Caiphas:
tr: τοτε συνηχθησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι του λαου εις την αυλην του αρχιερεως του λεγομενου καιαφα
kjv: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

vulg: et consilium fecerunt ut Iesum dolo tenerent et occiderent
clem: et consilium fecerunt ut Jesum dolo tenerent, et occiderent.
tr: και συνεβουλευσαντο ινα τον ιησουν κρατησωσιν δολω και αποκτεινωσιν
kjv: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.

vulg: dicebant autem non in die festo ne forte tumultus fieret in populo
clem: Dicebant autem: Non in die festo, ne forte tumultus fieret in populo.
tr: ελεγον δε μη εν τη εορτη ινα μη θορυβος γενηται εν τω λαω
kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

vulg: cum autem esset Iesus in Bethania in domo Simonis leprosi
clem: Cum autem Jesus esset in Bethania in domo Simonis leprosi,
tr: του δε ιησου γενομενου εν βηθανια εν οικια σιμωνος του λεπρου
kjv: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

vulg: accessit ad eum mulier habens alabastrum unguenti pretiosi et effudit super caput ipsius recumbentis
clem: accessit ad eum mulier habens alabastrum unguenti pretiosi, et effudit super caput ipsius recumbentis.
tr: προσηλθεν αυτω γυνη αλαβαστρον μυρου εχουσα βαρυτιμου και κατεχεεν επι την κεφαλην αυτου ανακειμενου
kjv: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.

vulg: videntes autem discipuli indignati sunt dicentes ut quid perditio haec
clem: Videntes autem discipuli, indignati sunt, dicentes: Ut quid perditio hc?
tr: ιδοντες δε οι μαθηται αυτου ηγανακτησαν λεγοντες εις τι η απωλεια αυτη
kjv: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

vulg: potuit enim istud venundari multo et dari pauperibus
clem: potuit enim istud venundari multo, et dari pauperibus.
tr: ηδυνατο γαρ τουτο το μυρον πραθηναι πολλου και δοθηναι πτωχοις
kjv: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

vulg: sciens autem Iesus ait illis quid molesti estis mulieri opus bonum operata est in me
clem: Sciens autem Jesus, ait illis: Quid molesti estis huic mulieri? opus enim bonum operata est in me.
tr: γνους δε ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις τι κοπους παρεχετε τη γυναικι εργον γαρ καλον ειργασατο εις εμε
kjv: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

vulg: nam semper pauperes habetis vobiscum me autem non semper habetis
clem: Nam semper pauperes habetis vobiscum: me autem non semper habetis.
tr: παντοτε γαρ τους πτωχους εχετε μεθ εαυτων εμε δε ου παντοτε εχετε
kjv: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

vulg: mittens enim haec unguentum hoc in corpus meum ad sepeliendum me fecit
clem: Mittens enim hc unguentum hoc in corpus meum, ad sepeliendum me fecit.
tr: βαλουσα γαρ αυτη το μυρον τουτο επι του σωματος μου προς το ενταφιασαι με εποιησεν
kjv: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

vulg: amen dico vobis ubicumque praedicatum fuerit hoc evangelium in toto mundo dicetur et quod haec fecit in memoriam eius
clem: Amen dico vobis, ubicumque prdicatum fuerit hoc Evangelium in toto mundo, dicetur et quod hc fecit in memoriam ejus.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οπου εαν κηρυχθη το ευαγγελιον τουτο εν ολω τω κοσμω λαληθησεται και ο εποιησεν αυτη εις μνημοσυνον αυτης
kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

vulg: tunc abiit unus de duodecim qui dicitur Iudas Scarioth ad principes sacerdotum
clem: Tunc abiit unus de duodecim, qui dicebatur Judas Iscariotes, ad principes sacerdotum:
tr: τοτε πορευθεις εις των δωδεκα ο λεγομενος ιουδας ισκαριωτης προς τους αρχιερεις
kjv: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

vulg: et ait illis quid vultis mihi dare et ego vobis eum tradam at illi constituerunt ei triginta argenteos
clem: et ait illis: Quid vultis mihi dare, et ego vobis eum tradam? At illi constituerunt ei triginta argenteos.
tr: ειπεν τι θελετε μοι δουναι καγω υμιν παραδωσω αυτον οι δε εστησαν αυτω τριακοντα αργυρια
kjv: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

vulg: et exinde quaerebat oportunitatem ut eum traderet
clem: Et exinde qurebat opportunitatem ut eum traderet.
tr: και απο τοτε εζητει ευκαιριαν ινα αυτον παραδω
kjv: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

vulg: prima autem azymorum accesserunt discipuli ad Iesum dicentes ubi vis paremus tibi comedere pascha
clem: Prima autem die azymorum accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum, dicentes: Ubi vis paremus tibi comedere Pascha?
tr: τη δε πρωτη των αζυμων προσηλθον οι μαθηται τω ιησου λεγοντες αυτω που θελεις ετοιμασωμεν σοι φαγειν το πασχα
kjv: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

vulg: at Iesus dixit ite in civitatem ad quendam et dicite ei magister dicit tempus meum prope est apud te facio pascha cum discipulis meis
clem: At Jesus dixit: Ite in civitatem ad quemdam, et dicite ei: Magister dicit: Tempus meum prope est, apud te facio Pascha cum discipulis meis.
tr: ο δε ειπεν υπαγετε εις την πολιν προς τον δεινα και ειπατε αυτω ο διδασκαλος λεγει ο καιρος μου εγγυς εστιν προς σε ποιω το πασχα μετα των μαθητων μου
kjv: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

vulg: et fecerunt discipuli sicut constituit illis Iesus et paraverunt pascha
clem: Et fecerunt discipuli sicut constituit illis Jesus, et paraverunt Pascha.
tr: και εποιησαν οι μαθηται ως συνεταξεν αυτοις ο ιησους και ητοιμασαν το πασχα
kjv: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

vulg: vespere autem facto discumbebat cum duodecim discipulis
clem: Vespere autem facto, discumbebat cum duodecim discipulis suis.
tr: οψιας δε γενομενης ανεκειτο μετα των δωδεκα
kjv: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

vulg: et edentibus illis dixit amen dico vobis quia unus vestrum me traditurus est
clem: Et edentibus illis, dixit: Amen dico vobis, quia unus vestrum me traditurus est.
tr: και εσθιοντων αυτων ειπεν αμην λεγω υμιν οτι εις εξ υμων παραδωσει με
kjv: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

vulg: et contristati valde coeperunt singuli dicere numquid ego sum Domine
clem: Et contristati valde, cperunt singuli dicere: Numquid ego sum Domine?
tr: και λυπουμενοι σφοδρα ηρξαντο λεγειν αυτω εκαστος αυτων μητι εγω ειμι κυριε
kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

vulg: at ipse respondens ait qui intinguit mecum manum in parapside hic me tradet
clem: At ipse respondens, ait: Qui intingit mecum manum in paropside, hic me tradet.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν ο εμβαψας μετ εμου εν τω τρυβλιω την χειρα ουτος με παραδωσει
kjv: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

vulg: Filius quidem hominis vadit sicut scriptum est de illo vae autem homini illi per quem Filius hominis traditur bonum erat ei si natus non fuisset homo ille
clem: Filius quidem hominis vadit, sicut scriptum est de illo: v autem homini illi, per quem Filius hominis tradetur! bonum erat ei, si natus non fuisset homo ille.
tr: ο μεν υιος του ανθρωπου υπαγει καθως γεγραπται περι αυτου ουαι δε τω ανθρωπω εκεινω δι ου ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται καλον ην αυτω ει ουκ εγεννηθη ο ανθρωπος εκεινος
kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

vulg: respondens autem Iudas qui tradidit eum dixit numquid ego sum rabbi ait illi tu dixisti
clem: Respondens autem Judas, qui tradidit eum, dixit: Numquid ego sum Rabbi? Ait illi: Tu dixisti.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ιουδας ο παραδιδους αυτον ειπεν μητι εγω ειμι ραββι λεγει αυτω συ ειπας
kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

vulg: cenantibus autem eis accepit Iesus panem et benedixit ac fregit deditque discipulis suis et ait accipite et comedite hoc est corpus meum
clem: Cnantibus autem eis, accepit Jesus panem, et benedixit, ac fregit, deditque discipulis suis, et ait: Accipite, et comedite: hoc est corpus meum.
tr: εσθιοντων δε αυτων λαβων ο ιησους τον αρτον και ευλογησας εκλασεν και εδιδου τοις μαθηταις και ειπεν λαβετε φαγετε τουτο εστιν το σωμα μου
kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

vulg: et accipiens calicem gratias egit et dedit illis dicens bibite ex hoc omnes
clem: Et accipiens calicem, gratias egit: et dedit illis, dicens: Bibite ex hoc omnes.
tr: και λαβων το ποτηριον και ευχαριστησας εδωκεν αυτοις λεγων πιετε εξ αυτου παντες
kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

vulg: hic est enim sanguis meus novi testamenti qui pro multis effunditur in remissionem peccatorum
clem: Hic est enim sanguis meus novi testamenti, qui pro multis effundetur in remissionem peccatorum.
tr: τουτο γαρ εστιν το αιμα μου το της καινης διαθηκης το περι πολλων εκχυνομενον εις αφεσιν αμαρτιων
kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

vulg: dico autem vobis non bibam amodo de hoc genimine vitis usque in diem illum cum illud bibam vobiscum novum in regno Patris mei
clem: Dico autem vobis: non bibam amodo de hoc genimine vitis usque in diem illum, cum illud bibam vobiscum novum in regno Patris mei.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι ου μη πιω απ αρτι εκ τουτου του γεννηματος της αμπελου εως της ημερας εκεινης οταν αυτο πινω μεθ υμων καινον εν τη βασιλεια του πατρος μου
kjv: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

vulg: et hymno dicto exierunt in montem Oliveti
clem: Et hymno dicto, exierunt in montem Oliveti.
tr: και υμνησαντες εξηλθον εις το ορος των ελαιων
kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

vulg: tunc dicit illis Iesus omnes vos scandalum patiemini in me in ista nocte scriptum est enim percutiam pastorem et dispergentur oves gregis
clem: Tunc dicit illis Jesus: Omnes vos scandalum patiemini in me in ista nocte. Scriptum est enim: Percutiam pastorem, et dispergentur oves gregis.
tr: τοτε λεγει αυτοις ο ιησους παντες υμεις σκανδαλισθησεσθε εν εμοι εν τη νυκτι ταυτη γεγραπται γαρ παταξω τον ποιμενα και διασκορπισθησεται τα προβατα της ποιμνης
kjv: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

vulg: postquam autem resurrexero praecedam vos in Galilaeam
clem: Postquam autem resurrexero, prcedam vos in Galilam.
tr: μετα δε το εγερθηναι με προαξω υμας εις την γαλιλαιαν
kjv: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

vulg: respondens autem Petrus ait illi et si omnes scandalizati fuerint in te ego numquam scandalizabor
clem: Respondens autem Petrus, ait illi: Et si omnes scandalizati fuerint in te, ego numquam scandalizabor.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος ειπεν αυτω ει και παντες σκανδαλισθησονται εν σοι εγω ουδεποτε σκανδαλισθησομαι
kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

vulg: ait illi Iesus amen dico tibi quia in hac nocte antequam gallus cantet ter me negabis
clem: Ait illi Jesus: Amen dico tibi, quia in hac nocte, antequam gallus cantet, ter me negabis.
tr: εφη αυτω ο ιησους αμην λεγω σοι οτι εν ταυτη τη νυκτι πριν αλεκτορα φωνησαι τρις απαρνηση με
kjv: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

vulg: ait illi Petrus etiam si oportuerit me mori tecum non te negabo similiter et omnes discipuli dixerunt
clem: Ait illi Petrus: Etiamsi oportuerit me mori tecum, non te negabo. Similiter et omnes discipuli dixerunt.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο πετρος καν δεη με συν σοι αποθανειν ου μη σε απαρνησομαι ομοιως και παντες οι μαθηται ειπον
kjv: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

vulg: tunc venit Iesus cum illis in villam quae dicitur Gethsemani et dixit discipulis suis sedete hic donec vadam illuc et orem
clem: Tunc venit Jesus cum illis in villam, qu dicitur Gethsemani, et dixit discipulis suis: Sedete hic donec vadam illuc, et orem.
tr: τοτε ερχεται μετ αυτων ο ιησους εις χωριον λεγομενον γεθσημανη και λεγει τοις μαθηταις καθισατε αυτου εως ου απελθων προσευξωμαι εκει
kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

vulg: et adsumpto Petro et duobus filiis Zebedaei coepit contristari et maestus esse
clem: Et assumpto Petro, et duobus filiis Zebedi, cpit contristari et mstus esse.
tr: και παραλαβων τον πετρον και τους δυο υιους ζεβεδαιου ηρξατο λυπεισθαι και αδημονειν
kjv: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

vulg: tunc ait illis tristis est anima mea usque ad mortem sustinete hic et vigilate mecum
clem: Tunc ait illis: Tristis est anima mea usque ad mortem: sustinete hic, et vigilate mecum.
tr: τοτε λεγει αυτοις περιλυπος εστιν η ψυχη μου εως θανατου μεινατε ωδε και γρηγορειτε μετ εμου
kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

vulg: et progressus pusillum procidit in faciem suam orans et dicens mi Pater si possibile est transeat a me calix iste verumtamen non sicut ego volo sed sicut tu
clem: Et progressus pusillum, procidit in faciem suam, orans, et dicens: Pater mi, si possibile est, transeat a me calix iste: verumtamen non sicut ego volo, sed sicut tu.
tr: και προελθων μικρον επεσεν επι προσωπον αυτου προσευχομενος και λεγων πατερ μου ει δυνατον εστιν παρελθετω απ εμου το ποτηριον τουτο πλην ουχ ως εγω θελω αλλ ως συ
kjv: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

vulg: et venit ad discipulos et invenit eos dormientes et dicit Petro sic non potuistis una hora vigilare mecum
clem: Et venit ad discipulos suos, et invenit eos dormientes, et dicit Petro: Sic non potuistis una hora vigilare mecum?
tr: και ερχεται προς τους μαθητας και ευρισκει αυτους καθευδοντας και λεγει τω πετρω ουτως ουκ ισχυσατε μιαν ωραν γρηγορησαι μετ εμου
kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

vulg: vigilate et orate ut non intretis in temptationem spiritus quidem promptus est caro autem infirma
clem: Vigilate, et orate ut non intretis in tentationem. Spiritus quidem promptus est, caro autem infirma.
tr: γρηγορειτε και προσευχεσθε ινα μη εισελθητε εις πειρασμον το μεν πνευμα προθυμον η δε σαρξ ασθενης
kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

vulg: iterum secundo abiit et oravit dicens Pater mi si non potest hic calix transire nisi bibam illum fiat voluntas tua
clem: Iterum secundo abiit, et oravit, dicens: Pater mi, si non potest hic calix transire nisi bibam illum, fiat voluntas tua.
tr: παλιν εκ δευτερου απελθων προσηυξατο λεγων πατερ μου ει ου δυναται τουτο το ποτηριον παρελθειν απ εμου εαν μη αυτο πιω γενηθητω το θελημα σου
kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

vulg: et venit iterum et invenit eos dormientes erant enim oculi eorum gravati
clem: Et venit iterum, et invenit eos dormientes: erant enim oculi eorum gravati.
tr: και ελθων ευρισκει αυτους παλιν καθευδοντας ησαν γαρ αυτων οι οφθαλμοι βεβαρημενοι
kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

vulg: et relictis illis iterum abiit et oravit tertio eundem sermonem dicens
clem: Et relictis illis, iterum abiit, et oravit tertio, eumdem sermonem dicens.
tr: και αφεις αυτους απελθων παλιν προσηυξατο εκ τριτου τον αυτον λογον ειπων
kjv: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

vulg: tunc venit ad discipulos suos et dicit illis dormite iam et requiescite ecce adpropinquavit hora et Filius hominis traditur in manus peccatorum
clem: Tunc venit ad discipulos suos, et dicit illis: Dormite jam, et requiescite: ecce appropinquavit hora, et Filius hominis tradetur in manus peccatorum.
tr: τοτε ερχεται προς τους μαθητας αυτου και λεγει αυτοις καθευδετε  το λοιπον και αναπαυεσθε  ιδου ηγγικεν η ωρα και ο υιος του ανθρωπου παραδιδοται εις χειρας αμαρτωλων
kjv: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

vulg: surgite eamus ecce adpropinquavit qui me tradit
clem: Surgite, eamus: ecce appropinquavit qui me tradet.
tr: εγειρεσθε αγωμεν ιδου ηγγικεν ο παραδιδους με
kjv: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

vulg: adhuc ipso loquente ecce Iudas unus de duodecim venit et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et fustibus a principibus sacerdotum et senioribus populi
clem: Adhuc eo loquente, ecce Judas unus de duodecim venit, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et fustibus, missi a principibus sacerdotum, et senioribus populi.
tr: και ετι αυτου λαλουντος ιδου ιουδας εις των δωδεκα ηλθεν και μετ αυτου οχλος πολυς μετα μαχαιρων και ξυλων απο των αρχιερεων και πρεσβυτερων του λαου
kjv: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

vulg: qui autem tradidit eum dedit illis signum dicens quemcumque osculatus fuero ipse est tenete eum
clem: Qui autem tradidit eum, dedit illis signum, dicens: Quemcumque osculatus fuero, ipse est, tenete eum.
tr: ο δε παραδιδους αυτον εδωκεν αυτοις σημειον λεγων ον αν φιλησω αυτος εστιν κρατησατε αυτον
kjv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

vulg: et confestim accedens ad Iesum dixit have rabbi et osculatus est eum
clem: Et confestim accedens ad Jesum, dixit: Ave Rabbi. Et osculatus est eum.
tr: και ευθεως προσελθων τω ιησου ειπεν χαιρε ραββι και κατεφιλησεν αυτον
kjv: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

vulg: dixitque illi Iesus amice ad quod venisti tunc accesserunt et manus iniecerunt in Iesum et tenuerunt eum
clem: Dixitque illi Jesus: Amice, ad quid venisti? Tunc accesserunt, et manus injecerunt in Jesum, et tenuerunt eum.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω εταιρε εφ ω παρει τοτε προσελθοντες επεβαλον τας χειρας επι τον ιησουν και εκρατησαν αυτον
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus and took him.

vulg: et ecce unus ex his qui erant cum Iesu extendens manum exemit gladium suum et percutiens servum principis sacerdotum amputavit auriculam eius
clem: Et ecce unus ex his qui erant cum Jesu, extendens manum, exemit gladium suum, et percutiens servum principis sacerdotum amputavit auriculam ejus.
tr: και ιδου εις των μετα ιησου εκτεινας την χειρα απεσπασεν την μαχαιραν αυτου και παταξας τον δουλον του αρχιερεως αφειλεν αυτου το ωτιον
kjv: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

vulg: tunc ait illi Iesus converte gladium tuum in locum suum omnes enim qui acceperint gladium gladio peribunt
clem: Tunc ait illi Jesus: Converte gladium tuum in locum suum: omnes enim, qui acceperint gladium, gladio peribunt.
tr: τοτε λεγει αυτω ο ιησους αποστρεψον σου την μαχαιραν εις τον τοπον αυτης παντες γαρ οι λαβοντες μαχαιραν εν μαχαιρα απολουνται
kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

vulg: an putas quia non possum rogare Patrem meum et exhibebit mihi modo plus quam duodecim legiones angelorum
clem: An putas, quia non possum rogare patrem meum, et exhibebit mihi modo plusquam duodecim legiones angelorum?
tr: η δοκεις οτι ου δυναμαι αρτι παρακαλεσαι τον πατερα μου και παραστησει μοι πλειους η δωδεκα λεγεωνας αγγελων
kjv: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

vulg: quomodo ergo implebuntur scripturae quia sic oportet fieri
clem: Quomodo ergo implebuntur Scriptur, quia sic oportet fieri?
tr: πως ουν πληρωθωσιν αι γραφαι οτι ουτως δει γενεσθαι
kjv: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

vulg: in illa hora dixit Iesus turbis tamquam ad latronem existis cum gladiis et fustibus conprehendere me cotidie apud vos sedebam docens in templo et non me tenuistis
clem: In illa hora dixit Jesus turbis: Tamquam ad latronem existis cum gladiis et fustibus comprehendere me: quotidie apud vos sedebam docens in templo, et non me tenuistis.
tr: εν εκεινη τη ωρα ειπεν ο ιησους τοις οχλοις ως επι ληστην εξηλθετε μετα μαχαιρων και ξυλων συλλαβειν με καθ ημεραν προς υμας εκαθεζομην διδασκων εν τω ιερω και ουκ εκρατησατε με
kjv: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

vulg: hoc autem totum factum est ut implerentur scripturae prophetarum tunc discipuli omnes relicto eo fugerunt
clem: Hoc autem totum factum est, ut adimplerentur Scriptur prophetarum. Tunc discipuli omnes, relicto eo, fugerunt.
tr: τουτο δε ολον γεγονεν ινα πληρωθωσιν αι γραφαι των προφητων τοτε οι μαθηται παντες αφεντες αυτον εφυγον
kjv: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

vulg: at illi tenentes Iesum duxerunt ad Caiaphan principem sacerdotum ubi scribae et seniores convenerant
clem: At illi tenentes Jesum, duxerunt ad Caipham principem sacerdotum, ubi scrib et seniores convenerant.
tr: οι δε κρατησαντες τον ιησουν απηγαγον προς καιαφαν τον αρχιερεα οπου οι γραμματεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι συνηχθησαν
kjv: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

vulg: Petrus autem sequebatur eum a longe usque in atrium principis sacerdotum et ingressus intro sedebat cum ministris ut videret finem
clem: Petrus autem sequebatur eum a longe, usque in atrium principis sacerdotum. Et ingressus intro, sedebat cum ministris, ut videret finem.
tr: ο δε πετρος ηκολουθει αυτω απο μακροθεν εως της αυλης του αρχιερεως και εισελθων εσω εκαθητο μετα των υπηρετων ιδειν το τελος
kjv: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

vulg: principes autem sacerdotum et omne concilium quaerebant falsum testimonium contra Iesum ut eum morti traderent
clem: Principes autem sacerdotum, et omne concilium, qurebant falsum testimonium contra Jesum, ut eum morti traderent:
tr: οι δε αρχιερεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι και το συνεδριον ολον εζητουν ψευδομαρτυριαν κατα του ιησου οπως αυτον θανατωσωσιν
kjv: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

vulg: et non invenerunt cum multi falsi testes accessissent novissime autem venerunt duo falsi testes
clem: et non invenerunt, cum multi falsi testes accessissent. Novissime autem venerunt duo falsi testes,
tr: και ουχ ευρον και πολλων ψευδομαρτυρων προσελθοντων ουχ ευρον (26:61) υστερον δε προσελθοντες δυο ψευδομαρτυρες
kjv: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

vulg: et dixerunt hic dixit possum destruere templum Dei et post triduum aedificare illud
clem: et dixerunt: Hic dixit: Possum destruere templum Dei, et post triduum redificare illud.
tr: ειπον ουτος εφη δυναμαι καταλυσαι τον ναον του θεου και δια τριων ημερων οικοδομησαι αυτον
kjv: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

vulg: et surgens princeps sacerdotum ait illi nihil respondes ad ea quae isti adversum te testificantur
clem: Et surgens princeps sacerdotum, ait illi: Nihil respondes ad ea, qu isti adversum te testificantur?
tr: και αναστας ο αρχιερευς ειπεν αυτω ουδεν αποκρινη τι ουτοι σου καταμαρτυρουσιν
kjv: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

vulg: Iesus autem tacebat et princeps sacerdotum ait illi adiuro te per Deum vivum ut dicas nobis si tu es Christus Filius Dei
clem: Jesus autem tacebat. Et princeps sacerdotum ait illi: Adjuro te per Deum vivum, ut dicas nobis si tu es Christus Filius Dei.
tr: ο δε ιησους εσιωπα και αποκριθεις ο αρχιερευς ειπεν αυτω εξορκιζω σε κατα του θεου του ζωντος ινα ημιν ειπης ει συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου
kjv: But Jesus held his peace, And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

vulg: dicit illi Iesus tu dixisti verumtamen dico vobis amodo videbitis Filium hominis sedentem a dextris virtutis et venientem in nubibus caeli
clem: Dicit illi Jesus: Tu dixisti. Verumtamen dico vobis, amodo videbitis Filium hominis sedentem a dextris virtutis Dei, et venientem in nubibus cli.
tr: λεγει αυτω ο ιησους συ ειπας πλην λεγω υμιν απ αρτι οψεσθε τον υιον του ανθρωπου καθημενον εκ δεξιων της δυναμεως και ερχομενον επι των νεφελων του ουρανου
kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

vulg: tunc princeps sacerdotum scidit vestimenta sua dicens blasphemavit quid adhuc egemus testibus ecce nunc audistis blasphemiam
clem: Tunc princeps sacerdotum scidit vestimenta sua, dicens: Blasphemavit: quid adhuc egemus testibus? ecce nunc audistis blasphemiam:
tr: τοτε ο αρχιερευς διερρηξεν τα ιματια αυτου λεγων οτι εβλασφημησεν τι ετι χρειαν εχομεν μαρτυρων ιδε νυν ηκουσατε την βλασφημιαν αυτου
kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

vulg: quid vobis videtur at illi respondentes dixerunt reus est mortis
clem: quid vobis videtur? At illi respondentes dixerunt: Reus est mortis.
tr: τι υμιν δοκει οι δε αποκριθεντες ειπον ενοχος θανατου εστιν
kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

vulg: tunc expuerunt in faciem eius et colaphis eum ceciderunt alii autem palmas in faciem ei dederunt
clem: Tunc exspuerunt in faciem ejus, et colaphis eum ceciderunt, alii autem palmas in faciem ejus dederunt,
tr: τοτε ενεπτυσαν εις το προσωπον αυτου και εκολαφισαν αυτον οι δε ερραπισαν
kjv: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

vulg: dicentes prophetiza nobis Christe quis est qui te percussit
clem: dicentes: Prophetiza nobis Christe, quis est qui te percussit?
tr: λεγοντες προφητευσον ημιν χριστε τις εστιν ο παισας σε
kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

vulg: Petrus vero sedebat foris in atrio et accessit ad eum una ancilla dicens et tu cum Iesu Galilaeo eras
clem: Petrus vero sedebat foris in atrio: et accessit ad eum una ancilla, dicens: Et tu cum Jesu Galilo eras.
tr: ο δε πετρος εξω εκαθητο εν τη αυλη και προσηλθεν αυτω μια παιδισκη λεγουσα και συ ησθα μετα ιησου του γαλιλαιου
kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

vulg: at ille negavit coram omnibus dicens nescio quid dicis
clem: At ille negavit coram omnibus, dicens: Nescio quid dicis.
tr: ο δε ηρνησατο εμπροσθεν παντων λεγων ουκ οιδα τι λεγεις
kjv: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

vulg: exeunte autem illo ianuam vidit eum alia et ait his qui erant ibi et hic erat cum Iesu Nazareno
clem: Exeunte autem illo januam, vidit eum alia ancilla, et ait his qui erant ibi: Et hic erat cum Jesu Nazareno.
tr: εξελθοντα δε αυτον εις τον πυλωνα ειδεν αυτον αλλη και λεγει τοις εκει και ουτος ην μετα ιησου του ναζωραιου
kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

vulg: et iterum negavit cum iuramento quia non novi hominem
clem: Et iterum negavit cum juramento: Quia non novi hominem.
tr: και παλιν ηρνησατο μεθ ορκου οτι ουκ οιδα τον ανθρωπον
kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

vulg: et post pusillum accesserunt qui stabant et dixerunt Petro vere et tu ex illis es nam et loquella tua manifestum te facit
clem: Et post pusillum accesserunt qui stabant, et dixerunt Petro: Vere et tu ex illis es: nam et loquela tua manifestum te facit.
tr: μετα μικρον δε προσελθοντες οι εστωτες ειπον τω πετρω αληθως και συ εξ αυτων ει και γαρ η λαλια σου δηλον σε ποιει
kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

vulg: tunc coepit detestari et iurare quia non novisset hominem et continuo gallus cantavit
clem: Tunc cpit detestari et jurare quia non novisset hominem. Et continuo gallus cantavit.
tr: τοτε ηρξατο καταναθεματιζειν και ομνυειν οτι ουκ οιδα τον ανθρωπον και ευθεως αλεκτωρ εφωνησεν
kjv: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

vulg: et recordatus est Petrus verbi Iesu quod dixerat priusquam gallus cantet ter me negabis et egressus foras ploravit amare
clem: Et recordatus est Petrus verbi Jesu, quod dixerat: Priusquam gallus cantet, ter me negabis. Et egressus foras, flevit amare.
tr: και εμνησθη ο πετρος του ρηματος του ιησου ειρηκοτος αυτω οτι πριν αλεκτορα φωνησαι τρις απαρνηση με και εξελθων εξω εκλαυσεν πικρως
kjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

vulg: mane autem facto consilium inierunt omnes principes sacerdotum et seniores populi adversus Iesum ut eum morti traderent
clem: Mane autem facto, consilium inierunt omnes principes sacerdotum et seniores populi adversus Jesum, ut eum morti traderent.
tr: πρωιας δε γενομενης συμβουλιον ελαβον παντες οι αρχιερεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι του λαου κατα του ιησου ωστε θανατωσαι αυτον
kjv: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

vulg: et vinctum adduxerunt eum et tradiderunt Pontio Pilato praesidi
clem: Et vinctum adduxerunt eum, et tradiderunt Pontio Pilato prsidi.
tr: και δησαντες αυτον απηγαγον και παρεδωκαν αυτον ποντιω πιλατω τω ηγεμονι
kjv: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

vulg: tunc videns Iudas qui eum tradidit quod damnatus esset paenitentia ductus rettulit triginta argenteos principibus sacerdotum et senioribus
clem: Tunc videns Judas, qui eum tradidit, quod damnatus esset, pnitentia ductus, retulit triginta argenteos principibus sacerdotum, et senioribus,
tr: τοτε ιδων ιουδας ο παραδιδους αυτον οτι κατεκριθη μεταμεληθεις απεστρεψεν τα τριακοντα αργυρια τοις αρχιερευσιν και τοις πρεσβυτεροις
kjv: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

vulg: dicens peccavi tradens sanguinem iustum at illi dixerunt quid ad nos tu videris
clem: dicens: Peccavi, tradens sanguinem justum. At illi dixerunt: Quid ad nos? tu videris.
tr: λεγων ημαρτον παραδους αιμα αθωον οι δε ειπον τι προς ημας συ οψει
kjv: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.

vulg: et proiectis argenteis in templo recessit et abiens laqueo se suspendit
clem: Et projectis argenteis in templo, recessit: et abiens laqueo se suspendit.
tr: και ριψας τα αργυρια εν τω ναω ανεχωρησεν και απελθων απηγξατο
kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

vulg: principes autem sacerdotum acceptis argenteis dixerunt non licet mittere eos in corbanan quia pretium sanguinis est
clem: Principes autem sacerdotum, acceptis argenteis, dixerunt: Non licet eos mittere in corbonam: quia pretium sanguinis est.
tr: οι δε αρχιερεις λαβοντες τα αργυρια ειπον ουκ εξεστιν βαλειν αυτα εις τον κορβαναν επει τιμη αιματος εστιν
kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

vulg: consilio autem inito emerunt ex illis agrum figuli in sepulturam peregrinorum
clem: Consilio autem inito, emerunt ex illis agrum figuli, in sepulturam peregrinorum.
tr: συμβουλιον δε λαβοντες ηγορασαν εξ αυτων τον αγρον του κεραμεως εις ταφην τοις ξενοις
kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

vulg: propter hoc vocatus est ager ille Acheldemach ager sanguinis usque in hodiernum diem
clem: Propter hoc vocatus est ager ille, Haceldama, hoc est, Ager sanguinis, usque in hodiernum diem.
tr: διο εκληθη ο αγρος εκεινος αγρος αιματος εως της σημερον
kjv: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

vulg: tunc impletum est quod dictum est per Hieremiam prophetam dicentem et acceperunt triginta argenteos pretium adpretiati quem adpretiaverunt a filiis Israhel
clem: Tunc impletum est quod dictum est per Jeremiam prophetam, dicentem: Et acceperunt triginta argenteos pretium appretiati, quem appretiaverunt a filiis Isral:
tr: τοτε επληρωθη το ρηθεν δια ιερεμιου του προφητου λεγοντος και ελαβον  τα τριακοντα αργυρια την τιμην του τετιμημενου ον ετιμησαντο απο υιων ισραηλ
kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

vulg: et dederunt eos in agrum figuli sicut constituit mihi Dominus
clem: et dederunt eos in agrum figuli, sicut constituit mihi Dominus.
tr: και εδωκαν αυτα εις τον αγρον του κεραμεως καθα συνεταξεν μοι κυριος
kjv: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

vulg: Iesus autem stetit ante praesidem et interrogavit eum praeses dicens tu es rex Iudaeorum dicit ei Iesus tu dicis
clem: Jesus autem stetit ante prsidem, et interrogavit eum prses, dicens: Tu es rex Judorum? Dicit illi Jesus: Tu dicis.
tr: ο δε ιησους εστη εμπροσθεν του ηγεμονος και επηρωτησεν αυτον ο ηγεμων λεγων συ ει ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων ο δε ιησους εφη αυτω συ λεγεις
kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

vulg: et cum accusaretur a principibus sacerdotum et senioribus nihil respondit
clem: Et cum accusaretur a principibus sacerdotum et senioribus, nihil respondit.
tr: και εν τω κατηγορεισθαι αυτον υπο των αρχιερεων και των πρεσβυτερων ουδεν απεκρινατο
kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

vulg: tunc dicit illi Pilatus non audis quanta adversum te dicant testimonia
clem: Tunc dicit illi Pilatus: Non audis quanta adversum te dicunt testimonia?
tr: τοτε λεγει αυτω ο πιλατος ουκ ακουεις ποσα σου καταμαρτυρουσιν
kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

vulg: et non respondit ei ad ullum verbum ita ut miraretur praeses vehementer
clem: Et non respondit ei ad ullum verbum, ita ut miraretur prses vehementer.
tr: και ουκ απεκριθη αυτω προς ουδε εν ρημα ωστε θαυμαζειν τον ηγεμονα λιαν
kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

vulg: per diem autem sollemnem consueverat praeses dimittere populo unum vinctum quem voluissent
clem: Per diem autem solemnem consueverat prses populi dimittere unum vinctum, quem voluissent:
tr: κατα δε εορτην ειωθει ο ηγεμων απολυειν ενα τω οχλω δεσμιον ον ηθελον
kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

vulg: habebat autem tunc vinctum insignem qui dicebatur Barabbas
clem: habebat autem tunc vinctum insignem, qui dicebatur Barrabas.
tr: ειχον δε τοτε δεσμιον επισημον λεγομενον βαραββαν
kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

vulg: congregatis ergo illis dixit Pilatus quem vultis dimittam vobis Barabban an Iesum qui dicitur Christus
clem: Congregatis ergo illis, dixit Pilatus: Quem vultis dimittam vobis: Barabbam, an Jesum, qui dicitur Christus?
tr: συνηγμενων ουν αυτων ειπεν αυτοις ο πιλατος τινα θελετε απολυσω υμιν βαραββαν η ιησουν τον λεγομενον χριστον
kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?

vulg: sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum
clem: Sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum.
tr: ηδει γαρ οτι δια φθονον παρεδωκαν αυτον
kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

vulg: sedente autem illo pro tribunali misit ad illum uxor eius dicens nihil tibi et iusto illi multa enim passa sum hodie per visum propter eum
clem: Sedente autem illo pro tribunali, misit ad eum uxor ejus, dicens: Nihil tibi, et justo illi: multa enim passa sum hodie per visum propter eum.
tr: καθημενου δε αυτου επι του βηματος απεστειλεν προς αυτον η γυνη αυτου λεγουσα μηδεν σοι και τω δικαιω εκεινω πολλα γαρ επαθον σημερον κατ οναρ δι αυτον
kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

vulg: princeps autem sacerdotum et seniores persuaserunt populis ut peterent Barabban Iesum vero perderent
clem: Principes autem sacerdotum et seniores persuaserunt populis ut peterent Barabbam, Jesum vero perderent.
tr: οι δε αρχιερεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι επεισαν τους οχλους ινα αιτησωνται τον βαραββαν τον δε ιησουν απολεσωσιν
kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

vulg: respondens autem praeses ait illis quem vultis vobis de duobus dimitti at illi dixerunt Barabban
clem: Respondens autem prses, ait illis: Quem vultis vobis de duobus dimitti? At illi dixerunt: Barabbam.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ηγεμων ειπεν αυτοις τινα θελετε απο των δυο απολυσω υμιν οι δε ειπον βαραββαν
kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

vulg: dicit illis Pilatus quid igitur faciam de Iesu qui dicitur Christus
clem: Dicit illis Pilatus: Quid igitur faciam de Jesu, qui dicitur Christus?
tr: λεγει αυτοις ο πιλατος τι ουν ποιησω ιησουν τον λεγομενον χριστον λεγουσιν αυτω παντες σταυρωθητω
kjv: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

vulg: dicunt omnes crucifigatur ait illis praeses quid enim mali fecit at illi magis clamabant dicentes crucifigatur
clem: Dicunt omnes: Crucifigatur. Ait illis prses: Quid enim mali fecit? At illi magis clamabant dicentes: Crucifigatur.
tr: ο δε ηγεμων εφη τι γαρ κακον εποιησεν οι δε περισσως εκραζον λεγοντες σταυρωθητω
kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

vulg: videns autem Pilatus quia nihil proficeret sed magis tumultus fieret accepta aqua lavit manus coram populo dicens innocens ego sum a sanguine iusti huius vos videritis
clem: Videns autem Pilatus quia nihil proficeret, sed magis tumultus fieret: accepta aqua, lavit manus coram populo, dicens: Innocens ego sum a sanguine justi hujus: vos videritis.
tr: ιδων δε ο πιλατος οτι ουδεν ωφελει αλλα μαλλον θορυβος γινεται λαβων υδωρ απενιψατο τας χειρας απεναντι του οχλου λεγων αθωος ειμι απο του αιματος του δικαιου τουτου υμεις οψεσθε
kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

vulg: et respondens universus populus dixit sanguis eius super nos et super filios nostros
clem: Et respondens universus populus, dixit: Sanguis ejus super nos, et super filios nostros.
tr: και αποκριθεις πας ο λαος ειπεν το αιμα αυτου εφ ημας και επι τα τεκνα ημων
kjv: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

vulg: tunc dimisit illis Barabban Iesum autem flagellatum tradidit eis ut crucifigeretur
clem: Tunc dimisit illis Barabbam: Jesum autem flagellatum tradidit eis ut crucifigeretur.
tr: τοτε απελυσεν αυτοις τον βαραββαν τον δε ιησουν φραγελλωσας παρεδωκεν ινα σταυρωθη
kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

vulg: tunc milites praesidis suscipientes Iesum in praetorio congregaverunt ad eum universam cohortem
clem: Tunc milites prsidis suscipientes Jesum in prtorium, congregaverunt ad eum universam cohortem:
tr: τοτε οι στρατιωται του ηγεμονος παραλαβοντες τον ιησουν εις το πραιτωριον συνηγαγον επ αυτον ολην την σπειραν
kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.

vulg: et exuentes eum clamydem coccineam circumdederunt ei
clem: et exeuntes eum, chlamydem coccineam circumdederunt ei,
tr: και εκδυσαντες αυτον περιεθηκαν αυτω χλαμυδα κοκκινην
kjv: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

vulg: et plectentes coronam de spinis posuerunt super caput eius et harundinem in dextera eius et genu flexo ante eum inludebant dicentes have rex Iudaeorum
clem: et plectentes coronam de spinis, posuerunt super caput ejus, et arundinem in dextera ejus. Et genu flexo ante eum, illudebant ei, dicentes: Ave rex Judorum.
tr: και πλεξαντες στεφανον εξ ακανθων επεθηκαν επι την κεφαλην αυτου και καλαμον επι την δεξιαν αυτου και γονυπετησαντες εμπροσθεν αυτου ενεπαιζον αυτω λεγοντες χαιρε ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
kjv: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

vulg: et expuentes in eum acceperunt harundinem et percutiebant caput eius
clem: Et exspuentes in eum, acceperunt arundinem, et percutiebant caput ejus.
tr: και εμπτυσαντες εις αυτον ελαβον τον καλαμον και ετυπτον εις την κεφαλην αυτου
kjv: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.

vulg: et postquam inluserunt ei exuerunt eum clamydem et induerunt eum vestimentis eius et duxerunt eum ut crucifigerent
clem: Et postquam illuserunt ei, exuerunt eum chlamyde, et induerunt eum vestimentis ejus, et duxerunt eum ut crucifigerent.
tr: και οτε ενεπαιξαν αυτω εξεδυσαν αυτον την χλαμυδα και ενεδυσαν αυτον τα ιματια αυτου και απηγαγον αυτον εις το σταυρωσαι
kjv: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.

vulg: exeuntes autem invenerunt hominem cyreneum nomine Simonem hunc angariaverunt ut tolleret crucem eius
clem: Exeuntes autem invenerunt hominem Cyrenum, nomine Simonem: hunc angariaverunt ut tolleret crucem ejus.
tr: εξερχομενοι δε ευρον ανθρωπον κυρηναιον ονοματι σιμωνα τουτον ηγγαρευσαν ινα αρη τον σταυρον αυτου
kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

vulg: et venerunt in locum qui dicitur Golgotha quod est Calvariae locus
clem: Et venerunt in locum qui dicitur Golgotha, quod est Calvari locus.
tr: και ελθοντες εις τοπον λεγομενον γολγοθα ος εστιν λεγομενος κρανιου τοπος
kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

vulg: et dederunt ei vinum bibere cum felle mixtum et cum gustasset noluit bibere
clem: Et dederunt ei vinum bibere cum felle mistum. Et cum gustasset, noluit bibere.
tr: εδωκαν αυτω πιειν οξος μετα χολης μεμιγμενον και γευσαμενος ουκ ηθελεν πιειν
kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.

vulg: postquam autem crucifixerunt eum diviserunt vestimenta eius sortem mittentes
clem: Postquam autem crucifixerunt eum, diviserunt vestimenta ejus, sortem mittentes: ut impleretur quod dictum est per prophetam dicentem: Diviserunt sibi vestimenta mea, et super vestem meam miserunt sortem.
tr: σταυρωσαντες δε αυτον διεμερισαντο τα ιματια αυτου βαλλοντες κληρον ινα πληρωθη το ρηθεν υπο του προφητου διεμερισαντο τα ιματια μου εαυτοις και επι τον ιματισμον μου εβαλον κληρον
kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

vulg: et sedentes servabant eum
clem: Et sedentes servabant eum.
tr: και καθημενοι ετηρουν αυτον εκει
kjv: And sitting down they watched him there;

vulg: et inposuerunt super caput eius causam ipsius scriptam hic est Iesus rex Iudaeorum
clem: Et imposuerunt super caput ejus causam ipsius scriptam: Hic est Jesus rex Judorum.
tr: και επεθηκαν επανω της κεφαλης αυτου την αιτιαν αυτου γεγραμμενην ουτος εστιν ιησους ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, This Is Jesus The King Of The Jews.

vulg: tunc crucifixi sunt cum eo duo latrones unus a dextris et unus a sinistris
clem: Tunc crucifixi sunt cum eo duo latrones: unus a dextris, et unus a sinistris.
tr: τοτε σταυρουνται συν αυτω δυο λησται εις εκ δεξιων και εις εξ ευωνυμων
kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

vulg: praetereuntes autem blasphemabant eum moventes capita sua
clem: Prtereuntes autem blasphemabant eum moventes capita sua,
tr: οι δε παραπορευομενοι εβλασφημουν αυτον κινουντες τας κεφαλας αυτων
kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

vulg: et dicentes qui destruit templum et in triduo illud reaedificat salva temet ipsum si Filius Dei es descende de cruce
clem: et dicentes: Vah qui destruis templum Dei, et in triduo illud redificas: salva temetipsum: si Filius Dei es, descende de cruce.
tr: και λεγοντες ο καταλυων τον ναον και εν τρισιν ημεραις οικοδομων σωσον σεαυτον ει υιος ει του θεου καταβηθι απο του σταυρου
kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

vulg: similiter et principes sacerdotum inludentes cum scribis et senioribus dicentes
clem: Similiter et principes sacerdotum illudentes cum scribis et senioribus dicebant:
tr: ομοιως δε και οι αρχιερεις εμπαιζοντες μετα των γραμματεων και πρεσβυτερων ελεγον
kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,

vulg: alios salvos fecit se ipsum non potest salvum facere si rex Israhel est descendat nunc de cruce et credemus ei
clem: Alios salvos fecit, seipsum non potest salvum facere: si rex Isral est, descendat nunc de cruce, et credimus ei:
tr: αλλους εσωσεν εαυτον ου δυναται σωσαι ει βασιλευς ισραηλ εστιν καταβατω νυν απο του σταυρου και πιστευσομεν αυτω
kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

vulg: confidet in Deo liberet nunc eum si vult dixit enim quia Dei Filius sum
clem: confidit in Deo: liberet nunc, si vult eum: dixit enim: Quia Filius Dei sum.
tr: πεποιθεν επι τον θεον ρυσασθω νυν αυτον ει θελει αυτον ειπεν γαρ οτι θεου ειμι υιος
kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

vulg: id ipsum autem et latrones qui fixi erant cum eo inproperabant ei
clem: Idipsum autem et latrones, qui crucifixi erant cum eo, improperabant ei.
tr: το δ αυτο και οι λησται οι συσταυρωθεντες αυτω ωνειδιζον αυτω
kjv: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

vulg: a sexta autem hora tenebrae factae sunt super universam terram usque ad horam nonam
clem: A sexta autem hora tenebr fact sunt super universam terram usque ad horam nonam.
tr: απο δε εκτης ωρας σκοτος εγενετο επι πασαν την γην εως ωρας εννατης
kjv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.

vulg: et circa horam nonam clamavit Iesus voce magna dicens Heli Heli lema sabacthani hoc est Deus meus Deus meus ut quid dereliquisti me
clem: Et circa horam nonam clamavit Jesus voce magna, dicens: Eli, Eli, lamma sabacthani? hoc est: Deus meus, Deus meus, ut quid dereliquisti me?
tr: περι δε την εννατην ωραν ανεβοησεν ο ιησους φωνη μεγαλη λεγων ηλι ηλι λαμα σαβαχθανι τουτ εστιν θεε μου θεε μου ινα τι με εγκατελιπες
kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

vulg: quidam autem illic stantes et audientes dicebant Heliam vocat iste
clem: Quidam autem illic stantes, et audientes, dicebant: Eliam vocat iste.
tr: τινες δε των εκει εστωτων ακουσαντες ελεγον οτι ηλιαν φωνει ουτος
kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.

vulg: et continuo currens unus ex eis acceptam spongiam implevit aceto et inposuit harundini et dabat ei bibere
clem: Et continuo currens unus ex eis, acceptam spongiam implevit aceto, et imposuit arundini, et dabat ei bibere.
tr: και ευθεως δραμων εις εξ αυτων και λαβων σπογγον πλησας τε οξους και περιθεις καλαμω εποτιζεν αυτον
kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

vulg: ceteri vero dicebant sine videamus an veniat Helias liberans eum
clem: Ceteri vero dicebant: Sine, videamus an veniat Elias liberans eum.
tr: οι δε λοιποι ελεγον αφες ιδωμεν ει ερχεται ηλιας σωσων αυτον
kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

vulg: Iesus autem iterum clamans voce magna emisit spiritum
clem: Jesus autem iterum clamans voce magna, emisit spiritum.
tr: ο δε ιησους παλιν κραξας φωνη μεγαλη αφηκεν το πνευμα
kjv: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

vulg: et ecce velum templi scissum est in duas partes a summo usque deorsum et terra mota est et petrae scissae sunt
clem: Et ecce velum templi scissum est in duas partes a summo usque deorsum: et terra mota est, et petr sciss sunt,
tr: και ιδου το καταπετασμα του ναου εσχισθη εις δυο απο ανωθεν εως κατω και η γη εσεισθη και αι πετραι εσχισθησαν
kjv: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

vulg: et monumenta aperta sunt et multa corpora sanctorum qui dormierant surrexerunt
clem: et monumenta aperta sunt: et multa corpora sanctorum, qui dormierant, surrexerunt.
tr: και τα μνημεια ανεωχθησαν και πολλα σωματα των κεκοιμημενων αγιων ηγερθη
kjv: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

vulg: et exeuntes de monumentis post resurrectionem eius venerunt in sanctam civitatem et apparuerunt multis
clem: Et exeuntes de monumentis post resurrectionem ejus, venerunt in sanctam civitatem, et apparuerunt multis.
tr: και εξελθοντες εκ των μνημειων μετα την εγερσιν αυτου εισηλθον εις την αγιαν πολιν και ενεφανισθησαν πολλοις
kjv: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

vulg: centurio autem et qui cum eo erant custodientes Iesum viso terraemotu et his quae fiebant timuerunt valde dicentes vere Dei Filius erat iste
clem: Centurio autem, et qui cum eo erant, custodientes Jesum, viso terrmotu, et his qu fiebant, timuerunt valde, dicentes: Vere Filius Dei erat iste.
tr: ο δε εκατονταρχος και οι μετ αυτου τηρουντες τον ιησουν ιδοντες τον σεισμον και τα γενομενα εφοβηθησαν σφοδρα λεγοντες αληθως θεου υιος ην ουτος
kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

vulg: erant autem ibi mulieres multae a longe quae secutae erant Iesum a Galilaea ministrantes ei
clem: Erant autem ibi mulieres mult a longe, qu secut erant Jesum a Galila, ministrantes ei:
tr: ησαν δε εκει γυναικες πολλαι απο μακροθεν θεωρουσαι αιτινες ηκολουθησαν τω ιησου απο της γαλιλαιας διακονουσαι αυτω
kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

vulg: inter quas erat Maria Magdalene et Maria Iacobi et Ioseph mater et mater filiorum Zebedaei
clem: inter quas erat Maria Magdalene, et Maria Jacobi, et Joseph mater, et mater filiorum Zebedi.
tr: εν αις ην μαρια η μαγδαληνη και μαρια η του ιακωβου και ιωση μητηρ και η μητηρ των υιων ζεβεδαιου
kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.

vulg: cum sero autem factum esset venit quidam homo dives ab Arimathia nomine Ioseph qui et ipse discipulus erat Iesu
clem: Cum autem sero factum esset, venit quidam homo dives ab Arimatha, nomine Joseph, qui et ipse discipulus erat Jesu:
tr: οψιας δε γενομενης ηλθεν ανθρωπος πλουσιος απο αριμαθαιας τουνομα ιωσηφ ος και αυτος εμαθητευσεν τω ιησου
kjv: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

vulg: hic accessit ad Pilatum et petiit corpus Iesu tunc Pilatus iussit reddi corpus
clem: hic accessit ad Pilatum, et petiit corpus Jesu. Tunc Pilatus jussit reddi corpus.
tr: ουτος προσελθων τω πιλατω ητησατο το σωμα του ιησου τοτε ο πιλατος εκελευσεν αποδοθηναι το σωμα
kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

vulg: et accepto corpore Ioseph involvit illud sindone munda
clem: Et accepto corpore, Joseph involvit illud in sindone munda,
tr: και λαβων το σωμα ο ιωσηφ ενετυλιξεν αυτο σινδονι καθαρα
kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

vulg: et posuit illud in monumento suo novo quod exciderat in petra et advolvit saxum magnum ad ostium monumenti et abiit
clem: et posuit illud in monumento suo novo, quod exciderat in petra. Et advolvit saxum magnum ad ostium monumenti, et abiit.
tr: και εθηκεν αυτο εν τω καινω αυτου μνημειω ο ελατομησεν εν τη πετρα και προσκυλισας λιθον μεγαν τη θυρα του μνημειου απηλθεν
kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

vulg: erat autem ibi Maria Magdalene et altera Maria sedentes contra sepulchrum
clem: Erant autem ibi Maria Magdalene, et altera Maria, sedentes contra sepulchrum.
tr: ην δε εκει μαρια η μαγδαληνη και η αλλη μαρια καθημεναι απεναντι του ταφου
kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

vulg: altera autem die quae est post parasceven convenerunt principes sacerdotum et Pharisaei ad Pilatum
clem: Altera autem die, qu est post Parasceven, convenerunt principes sacerdotum et pharisi ad Pilatum,
tr: τη δε επαυριον ητις εστιν μετα την παρασκευην συνηχθησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι φαρισαιοι προς πιλατον
kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

vulg: dicentes domine recordati sumus quia seductor ille dixit adhuc vivens post tres dies resurgam
clem: dicentes: Domine, recordati sumus, quia seductor ille dixit adhuc vivens: Post tres dies resurgam.
tr: λεγοντες κυριε εμνησθημεν οτι εκεινος ο πλανος ειπεν ετι ζων μετα τρεις ημερας εγειρομαι
kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

vulg: iube ergo custodiri sepulchrum usque in diem tertium ne forte veniant discipuli eius et furentur eum et dicant plebi surrexit a mortuis et erit novissimus error peior priore
clem: Jube ergo custodiri sepulchrum usque in diem tertium: ne forte veniant discipuli ejus, et furentur eum, et dicant plebi: Surrexit a mortuis: et erit novissimus error pejor priore.
tr: κελευσον ουν ασφαλισθηναι τον ταφον εως της τριτης ημερας μηποτε ελθοντες οι μαθηται αυτου νυκτος κλεψωσιν αυτον και ειπωσιν τω λαω ηγερθη απο των νεκρων και εσται η εσχατη πλανη χειρων της πρωτης
kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

vulg: ait illis Pilatus habetis custodiam ite custodite sicut scitis
clem: Ait illis Pilatus: Habetis custodiam, ite, custodite sicut scitis.
tr: εφη δε αυτοις ο πιλατος εχετε κουστωδιαν υπαγετε ασφαλισασθε ως οιδατε
kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

vulg: illi autem abeuntes munierunt sepulchrum signantes lapidem cum custodibus
clem: Illi autem abeuntes, munierunt sepulchrum, signantes lapidem, cum custodibus.
tr: οι δε πορευθεντες ησφαλισαντο τον ταφον σφραγισαντες τον λιθον μετα της κουστωδιας
kjv: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.

vulg: vespere autem sabbati quae lucescit in primam sabbati venit Maria Magdalene et altera Maria videre sepulchrum
clem: Vespere autem sabbati, qu lucescit in prima sabbati, venit Maria Magdalene, et altera Maria, videre sepulchrum.
tr: οψε δε σαββατων τη επιφωσκουση εις μιαν σαββατων ηλθεν μαρια η μαγδαληνη και η αλλη μαρια θεωρησαι τον ταφον
kjv: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

vulg: et ecce terraemotus factus est magnus angelus enim Domini descendit de caelo et accedens revolvit lapidem et sedebat super eum
clem: Et ecce terrmotus factus est magnus. Angelus enim Domini descendit de clo: et accedens revolvit lapidem, et sedebat super eum:
tr: και ιδου σεισμος εγενετο μεγας αγγελος γαρ κυριου καταβας εξ ουρανου προσελθων απεκυλισεν τον λιθον απο της θυρας και εκαθητο επανω αυτου
kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

vulg: erat autem aspectus eius sicut fulgur et vestimentum eius sicut nix
clem: erat autem aspectus ejus sicut fulgur: et vestimentum ejus sicut nix.
tr: ην δε η ιδεα αυτου ως αστραπη και το ενδυμα αυτου λευκον ωσει χιων
kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

vulg: prae timore autem eius exterriti sunt custodes et facti sunt velut mortui
clem: Pr timore autem ejus exterriti sunt custodes, et facti sunt velut mortui.
tr: απο δε του φοβου αυτου εσεισθησαν οι τηρουντες και εγενοντο ωσει νεκροι
kjv: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

vulg: respondens autem angelus dixit mulieribus nolite timere vos scio enim quod Iesum qui crucifixus est quaeritis
clem: Respondens autem angelus dixit mulieribus: Nolite timere vos: scio enim, quod Jesum, qui crucifixus est, quritis.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο αγγελος ειπεν ταις γυναιξιν μη φοβεισθε υμεις οιδα γαρ οτι ιησουν τον εσταυρωμενον ζητειτε
kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

vulg: non est hic surrexit enim sicut dixit venite videte locum ubi positus erat Dominus
clem: Non est hic: surrexit enim, sicut dixit: venite, et videte locum ubi positus erat Dominus.
tr: ουκ εστιν ωδε ηγερθη γαρ καθως ειπεν δευτε ιδετε τον τοπον οπου εκειτο ο κυριος
kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

vulg: et cito euntes dicite discipulis eius quia surrexit et ecce praecedit vos in Galilaeam ibi eum videbitis ecce praedixi vobis
clem: Et cito euntes, dicite discipulis ejus quia surrexit: et ecce prcedit vos in Galilam: ibi eum videbitis: ecce prdixi vobis.
tr: και ταχυ πορευθεισαι ειπατε τοις μαθηταις αυτου οτι ηγερθη απο των νεκρων και ιδου προαγει υμας εις την γαλιλαιαν εκει αυτον οψεσθε ιδου ειπον υμιν
kjv: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

vulg: et exierunt cito de monumento cum timore et magno gaudio currentes nuntiare discipulis eius
clem: Et exierunt cito de monumento cum timore et gaudio magno, currentes nuntiare discipulis ejus.
tr: και εξελθουσαι ταχυ απο του μνημειου μετα φοβου και χαρας μεγαλης εδραμον απαγγειλαι τοις μαθηταις αυτου
kjv: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

vulg: et ecce Iesus occurrit illis dicens havete illae autem accesserunt et tenuerunt pedes eius et adoraverunt eum
clem: Et ecce Jesus occurrit illis, dicens: Avete. Ill autem accesserunt, et tenuerunt pedes ejus, et adoraverunt eum.
tr: ως δε επορευοντο απαγγειλαι τοις μαθηταις αυτου και ιδου ο ιησους απηντησεν αυταις λεγων χαιρετε αι δε προσελθουσαι εκρατησαν αυτου τους ποδας και προσεκυνησαν αυτω
kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

vulg: tunc ait illis Iesus nolite timere ite nuntiate fratribus meis ut eant in Galilaeam ibi me videbunt
clem: Tunc ait illis Jesus: Nolite timere: ite, nuntiare fratribus meis ut eant in Galilam; ibi me videbunt.
tr: τοτε λεγει αυταις ο ιησους μη φοβεισθε υπαγετε απαγγειλατε τοις αδελφοις μου ινα απελθωσιν εις την γαλιλαιαν κακει με οψονται
kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

vulg: quae cum abissent ecce quidam de custodibus venerunt in civitatem et nuntiaverunt principibus sacerdotum omnia quae facta fuerant
clem: Qu cum abiissent, ecce quidam de custodibus venerunt in civitatem, et nuntiaverunt principibus sacerdotum omnia qu facta fuerant.
tr: πορευομενων δε αυτων ιδου τινες της κουστωδιας ελθοντες εις την πολιν απηγγειλαν τοις αρχιερευσιν απαντα τα γενομενα
kjv: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

vulg: et congregati cum senioribus consilio accepto pecuniam copiosam dederunt militibus
clem: Et congregati cum senioribus consilio accepto, pecuniam copiosam dederunt militibus,
tr: και συναχθεντες μετα των πρεσβυτερων συμβουλιον τε λαβοντες αργυρια ικανα εδωκαν τοις στρατιωταις
kjv: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

vulg: dicentes dicite quia discipuli eius nocte venerunt et furati sunt eum nobis dormientibus
clem: dicentes: Dicite quia discipuli ejus nocte venerunt, et furati sunt eum, nobis dormientibus.
tr: λεγοντες ειπατε οτι οι μαθηται αυτου νυκτος ελθοντες εκλεψαν αυτον ημων κοιμωμενων
kjv: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

vulg: et si hoc auditum fuerit a praeside nos suadebimus ei et securos vos faciemus
clem: Et si hoc auditum fuerit a prside, nos suadebimus ei, et securos vos faciemus.
tr: και εαν ακουσθη τουτο επι του ηγεμονος ημεις πεισομεν αυτον και υμας αμεριμνους ποιησομεν
kjv: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

vulg: at illi accepta pecunia fecerunt sicut erant docti et divulgatum est verbum istud apud Iudaeos usque in hodiernum diem
clem: At illi, accepta pecunia, fecerunt sicut erant edocti. Et divulgatum est verbum istud apud Judos, usque in hodiernum diem.
tr: οι δε λαβοντες τα αργυρια εποιησαν ως εδιδαχθησαν και διεφημισθη ο λογος ουτος παρα ιουδαιοις μεχρι της σημερον
kjv: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

vulg: undecim autem discipuli abierunt in Galilaeam in montem ubi constituerat illis Iesus
clem: Undecim autem discipuli abierunt in Galilam in montem ubi consituerat illis Jesus.
tr: οι δε ενδεκα μαθηται επορευθησαν εις την γαλιλαιαν εις το ορος ου εταξατο αυτοις ο ιησους
kjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

vulg: et videntes eum adoraverunt quidam autem dubitaverunt
clem: Et videntes eum adoraverunt: quidam autem dubitaverunt.
tr: και ιδοντες αυτον προσεκυνησαν αυτω οι δε εδιστασαν
kjv: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

vulg: et accedens Iesus locutus est eis dicens data est mihi omnis potestas in caelo et in terra
clem: Et accedens Jesus locutus est eis, dicens: Data est mihi omnis potestas in clo et in terra:
tr: και προσελθων ο ιησους ελαλησεν αυτοις λεγων εδοθη μοι πασα εξουσια εν ουρανω και επι γης
kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

vulg: euntes ergo docete omnes gentes baptizantes eos in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti
clem: euntes ergo docete omnes gentes: baptizantes eos in nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti:
tr: πορευθεντες ουν μαθητευσατε παντα τα εθνη βαπτιζοντες αυτους εις το ονομα του πατρος και του υιου και του αγιου πνευματος
kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

vulg: docentes eos servare omnia quaecumque mandavi vobis et ecce ego vobiscum sum omnibus diebus usque ad consummationem saeculi
clem: docentes eos servare omnia qucumque mandavi vobis: et ecce ego vobiscum sum omnibus diebus, usque ad consummationem sculi.
tr: διδασκοντες αυτους τηρειν παντα οσα ενετειλαμην υμιν και ιδου εγω μεθ υμων ειμι πασας τας ημερας εως της συντελειας του αιωνος αμην
kjv: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
